items.title: What Squirrel Asset Manager is
items.summary: Squirrel Asset Manager is a local asset management tool that runs inside Maya. It keeps materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, HDRs, dynamics, images, aud
items.text: Squirrel Asset Manager is a local asset management tool that runs inside Maya. It keeps materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, HDRs, dynamics, images, audio, animation data and node trees in one library you can search and import into the scene. Positioning Built for Maya workflows : it is not a modeling or rendering application; it gathers the assets scattered across hard drives, project folders and many Maya files into one reusable library. Local first : assets live as ordinary folders and .zasset packages under the library path you choose, with no cloud dependency by default; the library can sit on this machine, a LAN share or a project drive. A folder is an asset : every .zasset is a folder containing meta.json , the material or geometry files, thumbnails, textures/ and other dependencies, so it can be copied, zipped and backed up directly. Two run modes : the Maya plug-in edition runs inside the Maya process; the standalone edition / EXE starts on its own and drives a running Maya through the local commandPort. Which problems it solves It solves the problem of assets accumulated while working in Maya being hard to manage, and of reusing assets while a project is running. It brings "find assets, view thumbnails, organize categories and tags, batch add to library, export assets, cross-renderer conversion, version and LOD management" into one window, so you no longer switch back and forth between the file browser and Maya. Main capabilities Eleven built-in sub-libraries: materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, HDR, dynamics, images, audio, animation data and node trees. Around them it offers categories and tags, thumbnails (including headless background rendering), batch operations, versions and LODs, material conversion, AI analysis and semantic search, search by image / video and by sound, quick tools, and Maya scene read/write. Fit and boundaries It suits individuals and teams that accumulate and reuse Maya assets over time. It is not a cloud asset marketplace: there are no accounts, comments or online hosting; AI features need a local Ollama or a cloud model you configure; after the license expires you can still browse, while import, export and conversion are restricted.

items.title: Typical scenarios
synonyms: what can it be used for
items.summary: Whenever your Maya assets need to be found again, reused, or shared by several people, Squirrel Asset Manager is useful. Scenario 1: a personal material and mod
items.text: Whenever your Maya assets need to be found again, reused, or shared by several people, Squirrel Asset Manager is useful. Scenario 1: a personal material and model library Collect the metals, fabrics and wood materials you use often, plus character, prop and furniture models, into your own library. Browse by sub-library and category, pick assets from their thumbnails, and import them into the current scene with a double-click or from the context menu. Scenario 2: batch add downloaded assets to the library Turn downloaded or created PBR texture sets, HDR/EXR files and model folders into .zasset packages in batches. Quick tools recognize texture types from naming conventions and generate thumbnails, so you skip creating assets one by one. Scenario 3: reuse across projects Use the project library to organize the assets of one project separately and archive them together when the project ends; put frequently used assets in favorites so you do not dig through folders every time. Scenario 4: version and LOD management When one asset needs several iterations or several levels of detail, keep history, proxy files and different resolutions as versions and LODs instead of copying and renaming files on disk by hand. Scenario 5: cross-renderer material conversion When materials must move between Arnold, V-Ray, Redshift and native Maya materials, material mapping and conversion reduce manual node wiring; for complex networks, still review the result after conversion. Scenario 6: thumbnails, AI classification and search Generate thumbnails for assets, let AI suggest categories, tags and Chinese names, then locate assets quickly by keyword, tag, natural language or image search. Scenario 7: standalone browsing and remote driving If you do not want to open Maya, browse and search assets in the standalone edition / EXE; when Maya is running, the standalone edition can also send import, export and thumbnail jobs to Maya through commandPort. Scenario 8: images, music, animation data and sound search Besides geometry and materials, scattered reference images, background music, sound effects and animation data ( .atom ) can go into the library too: images import as a file node or imagePlane, audio imports onto the timeline, the Time Editor or the Trax Editor, and animation data imports animation mapped by hierarchy onto selected attributes. To find "the music that sounds like that track", record system audio under the audio category; to find "the video that looks like this", record a section of the screen with the screen-recording search.

items.title: What it can and cannot do
path: What it can and cannot do
items.summary: Squirrel Asset Manager covers storing, finding, viewing, editing, importing and exporting Maya assets; it is not a modeling, rendering or cloud collaboration pl
items.text: Squirrel Asset Manager covers storing, finding, viewing, editing, importing and exporting Maya assets; it is not a modeling, rendering or cloud collaboration platform. What it can do Capability What it covers Asset management 11 sub-libraries: materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, HDR, dynamics, images, audio, animation data, node trees; categories, tags, favorites, project libraries Import Import geometry, materials, textures, HDRs, lights, scenes and animation from external files, folders or the library; images can become a file node, an imagePlane or a texture slot assignment, audio can go to the timeline, the Time Editor, Trax or the camera sequencer, and animation data can be imported with hierarchy mapping Export Single asset, batch full-auto, batch semi-auto; supports .ma , .mb , .fbx , .obj , .abc , .usd , .glb , .ass , .vrmesh , .rs , .zmetal , .mcm and more Thumbnails Capture, Maya playblast, render, import an image; headless batch rendering in the background; multiple thumbnail slots and output sizes Media search Upload an image, video or audio file to find visually or acoustically similar assets; screen-capture and screen-recording search; under audio you can record the sound the system is playing (not the microphone) Audio and animation data Audio cards can be auditioned and imported to the timeline; animation data can be imported and exported with hierarchy-to-attribute mapping Batch operations Move, copy, delete, rename, and edit tags and fields in batches Versions and LODs Create a new version, append a LOD, switch version or LOD, per-version materials Materials and lights Cross-renderer material conversion, attribute mapping, material matching, applying material and light parameters, creating a dome light AI Thumbnail analysis, category/tag/Chinese-name suggestions, natural-language search, search by image, semantic index Maya integration Scene read/write, screenshots and renders, native tools, headless batch processing, MCP / external AI access Quick tools PBR, model and HDR to asset conversion, image format conversion, batch mirror copy, material conversion and more What it cannot do No modeling, sculpting, rendering or animation : those stay with Maya and its plug-ins. Not a cloud asset marketplace : there is no online hosting, account system, comment backend or asset trading. The standalone edition cannot edit the scene without Maya : when Maya is offline you can only browse, search and run file-level operations. AI is optional : it needs a local Ollama or a cloud model you configure; without it those features are unavailable, while core browsing and management keep working.

items.title: Maya plug-in edition
items.summary: The Maya plug-in edition installs the whole interface and feature set inside the Maya process and reads and writes the current scene directly. It is the most co
items.text: The Maya plug-in edition installs the whole interface and feature set inside the Maya process and reads and writes the current scene directly. It is the most complete and the smoothest form to work with. How it runs The plug-in code lives in the squirrel_asset_manager folder of the local EXE install directory (default %LOCALAPPDATA%\SquirrelAM , changeable during installation), and one installation serves every installed Maya version . Core modules ship as several .pyd builds, one per Python ABI; Maya loads the matching build at startup. When 「Maya 集成」 (Maya integration) is checked in the installer, it writes a marked startup block into the userSetup.py of every Maya version detected locally (or checked in the wizard): import path, MCP startup registration, status-line button and bridge port. The shelf button is created only once, at install time. Where to open it The 「松鼠资产管家」 (Squirrel Asset Manager) button in the Custom category of the Maya shelf. The squirrel icon on the right side of the Maya status line. MaterialLibraryWindow.show_window() in the Script Editor (no separate Maya menu item is registered). Advantages Uses the current scene and viewport directly: drag and drop, snapping, thumbnail capture and material assignment all happen in the same process. No separate Python or PySide6 install; it uses the Qt bindings that ship with Maya. Shares the same commands and data as the AI backend, MCP and headless batch processing. Requirements and limits Requires one of Maya 2022–2027; earlier versions (2021 and before) have no matching .pyd and cannot run it. Close all Maya instances before installing or overwriting .pyd files so the files are not locked. The plug-in edition cannot run on its own when Maya is not running; use the standalone edition / EXE to browse assets instead.

items.title: Standalone edition and EXE
items.summary: The standalone edition is the same asset interface started outside Maya; the EXE installer sets it up together with a bundled Python runtime and an optional May
items.text: The standalone edition is the same asset interface started outside Maya; the EXE installer sets it up together with a bundled Python runtime and an optional Maya integration. Standalone edition The entry point is squirrel_asset_manager/standalone_preview.py ; in the source package you can also double-click 启动独立预览.bat (Start standalone preview). It runs on system Python with PySide6, or on the mayapy that ships with Maya (without starting the Maya UI). It drives the running Maya through the local commandPort, sending import, export, thumbnail and asset-update jobs to Maya; it has been verified on Maya 2025. When Maya is offline you can only browse, search and run file-level operations; scene import and export are unavailable. EXE installer version Installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\SquirrelAM (changeable during installation), per user, with no administrator rights required. Bundles Python 3.11.9, PySide6 6.9.2, Pillow, requests and pypinyin; on startup SquirrelAssetManager.exe sets up the environment and launches standalone_preview.py . The installer offers an optional 「Maya 集成」 (Maya integration) : it writes the import path, status-line button and bridge port into each version's userSetup.py , and creates the shelf button once during installation (it is not rebuilt later); when no Maya is found the option is unchecked by default. An optional 「AI 助手 dsh（离线）」 (offline AI assistant dsh) unpacks a bundled dsh and portable Node; skipping it does not affect asset browsing and management. Who it is for People who want to organize, search and preview assets without opening Maya. Artists who send asset operations to an already open Maya, or who want an external AI or command line to drive Maya. Users who are not comfortable with Python environments and prefer a double-click install: choose the EXE. Known limits Batch export in the standalone edition is dispatched job by job, without the progress overlay and cancel button of the in-Maya version. Without Maya, scene-dependent features are unavailable; the port only listens on 127.0.0.1 .

items.title: Edition comparison
items.summary: The plug-in edition is the most complete; the standalone edition / EXE is valuable because it browses without Maya and can drive Maya remotely while Maya is run
items.text: The plug-in edition is the most complete; the standalone edition / EXE is valuable because it browses without Maya and can drive Maya remotely while Maya is running. Item Maya plug-in edition Standalone edition / EXE Where it runs Inside the Maya process Separate process, connects to Maya through commandPort Install location The same EXE install directory (imported by Maya when Maya integration is checked) %LOCALAPPDATA%\SquirrelAM Python / Qt Uses the ones that ship with Maya Bundled Python 3.11.9 + PySide6 6.9.2 Browse, search, view thumbnails Yes Yes Import, export, apply materials Yes Yes while Maya is online; unavailable offline Drop into viewport, snap placement Yes Yes while Maya is online Screenshot, playblast, render thumbnails Yes Yes while Maya is online Versions / LODs, batch operations Yes Yes AI analysis, semantic search, dsh Yes (optional components required) Yes (the AI backend is independent of Maya) Multiple Maya versions One install, matched by ABI The toolbar can switch the target Maya Offline use Needs Maya running locally Can browse; scene operations still need Maya Uninstall impact Same uninstaller: removes the install directory and the Maya startup block Same How to choose Work only inside Maya : check 「Maya 集成」 (Maya integration) when installing the EXE and skip the extra process and port. Often organize assets without opening Maya : install the EXE and start the main program directly; browsing and search are always available. Both : one installation is enough. With 「Maya 集成」 (Maya integration) checked you get both the in-Maya entry point and the standalone program; they share the same asset library, settings and license. Team sharing : put the library on a shared drive; keep the semantic index in a local directory per person so several writers do not overwrite each other.

items.title: Renderer and plug-in support
items.summary: The plug-in works with the renderers installed in Maya and does not bundle any renderer; material nodes, proxy formats and conversion depend on whether the matc
items.text: The plug-in works with the renderers installed in Maya and does not bundle any renderer; material nodes, proxy formats and conversion depend on whether the matching plug-in is loaded. Renderer comparison Renderer Common material nodes Proxy format Arnold aiStandardSurface .ass V-Ray VRayMtl .vrmesh Redshift RedshiftMaterial .rs Native Maya standardSurface / lambert / blinn / phong — The material mapping presets also cover newer node combinations such as openPBRSurface and RedshiftOpenPBRMaterial ; after conversion, still check texture connections and special attributes. Installed plug-in detection It queries Maya's pluginInfo to see whether a plug-in is loaded, registered or unavailable; common plug-in names are mtoa (Arnold), vrayformaya (V-Ray) and redshift4maya (Redshift). Results are reported as loaded, present but not loaded, or unavailable, and decide whether proxy import, material conversion and rendering entry points are enabled. Capabilities for MASH, Bifrost and USD follow the plug-ins actually installed in Maya; this product does not ship them (the exact support scope is to be confirmed). Recommendations Confirm the target renderer is loaded before importing or converting, otherwise material nodes or proxy files may not be created. Cross-renderer conversion only handles attributes covered by the mapping table; complex node networks, gradients and procedural textures need a manual review. Proxy import relies on the matching renderer's stand-in or proxy nodes; without the plug-in you can only keep the file, not display it in the viewport.

items.title: Library layout and data safety
items.summary: An asset library is an ordinary folder: assets are .zasset folders, metadata is JSON, and copying the library directory is a complete backup. Library root The r
items.text: An asset library is an ordinary folder: assets are .zasset folders, metadata is JSON, and copying the library directory is a complete backup. Library root The root contains 11 built-in sub-library directories; any missing one is created when the library loads: your asset library/ ├── library.json # library metadata ├── favorites.json # favorites ├── materials/ # materials ├── models/ # models ├── lights/ # lights ├── textures/ # textures ├── scenes/ # scenes ├── hdr/ # HDR ├── ani/ # dynamics ├── images/ # images ├── audio/ # audio ├── animation/ # animation data ├── nodetree/ # node trees └── .squirrel_ai_index/ # semantic index (derived data, rebuildable; official/ and ollama/ per backend) Two rules that are easy to mix up, so keep them apart: The 「创建资产库」 (Create asset library) button in settings creates only 6 base directories : materials , models , lights , textures , scenes , hdr ; Every time a library is loaded or switched to, the plug-in completes the directories for all 11 built-in sub-libraries (creating whatever is missing, plus FolderMetadata.fdata ); if the library root has no library.json yet (first run), or a sub-library has no sub-categories , it also creates sub-categories from the default configuration. Each sub-library and category directory also holds a FolderMetadata.fdata recording its display name and type; top-level categories cannot hold assets directly, assets go into their sub-categories. A single asset MyAsset.zasset/ ├── meta.json # name, category, tags, formats and so on ├── node.zmetal # material node (optional) ├── node.ma / .fbx / ... # geometry (optional) ├── thumb.sicon # static thumbnail (optional) ├── thumb.aicon / .mp4 # animated thumbnail (optional) ├── textures/ # textures (optional) └── deps/ # collected caches, proxies, references (optional; called associated/ in older versions) Settings and logs Application settings: ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/app_settings.json . Bridge and recovery logs: bridge_port.log , bridge_recover.log , broker_boot.log and others in the same directory. Semantic index: by default under the library root, .squirrel_ai_index/<official|ollama>/ (split by backend); a local index root can also be set in settings. Data safety Backup : close Maya and copy the whole library directory together with app_settings.json ; assets are not a database, so a single .zasset can also be copied on its own. Settings writes : settings are written atomically by replacing a temporary file; a corrupt settings file is first backed up as .bak and then reset to defaults. Index : derived data that can be rebuilt; do not put it on a shared or synced drive, because multiple writers are not coordinated across machines and can overwrite each other. Concurrency : the library itself has no cross-machine file lock; when several people share it, avoid renaming or moving the same asset at the same time (the exact lock strategy is to be confirmed).

items.title: System and Maya requirements
items.summary: Check the Windows architecture, Maya version and permissions before installing; this avoids most "failed halfway" installations. Minimum requirements Item Requi
items.text: Check the Windows architecture, Maya version and permissions before installing; this avoids most "failed halfway" installations. Minimum requirements Item Requirement Operating system 64-bit Windows; the installer is a Windows desktop program (minimum Windows version to be confirmed) Maya (plug-in edition) Maya 2022–2027 Standalone edition / EXE Bundled Python 3.11.9 (amd64) and PySide6 6.9.2; no separate Python install UI language The installer and uninstaller support Simplified Chinese / English; the language follows the system by default and can be changed during installation Permissions Installs per user; administrator rights are not required Disk The installer and runtime take a few hundred MB; the optional dsh / Node takes about another 300 MB (see the actual package) Network Core features work offline; online activation, dsh download and cloud AI need a network Steps Double-click the exe to install. If Windows shows a warning, click “More info” and then “Run anyway”. Confirm Windows is 64-bit; 32-bit systems are not supported. Confirm free disk space for the installer, the runtime and the asset library. Close all running Maya instances before installing the plug-in edition. If you only use the standalone edition you do not need Maya; the installer unchecks 「Maya 集成」 (Maya integration) automatically. Verify the result The Maya version can be read and falls within 2022–2027. The target disk is writable and the current user can write to the install directory. No running Maya instance is locking the plug-in directory. Common failures Maya too old : there is no .pyd for that ABI, so the plug-in cannot load. 32-bit system : the bundled Python and Qt are both 64-bit and cannot run. Company policy : antivirus software or an application allowlist may block the installer; request an exception first. macOS / Linux : only a Windows installer ( Setup.exe ) is provided; macOS and Linux have no package and are not supported.

items.title: Pre-installation checklist
items.summary: Spending two minutes on the items below avoids the three usual problems: failed overwrite, lost settings, and an installation that will not start. Steps Confirm
items.text: Spending two minutes on the items below avoids the three usual problems: failed overwrite, lost settings, and an installation that will not start. Steps Confirm the package type : release builds do not have test in the file name. Verify the installer : compare the hash as described in "Installer and SHA256 verification" to confirm the download is complete. Close Maya . Note the current version : write down the old version number so you can find the matching installer when rolling back. Back up settings and the asset library : copy ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/app_settings.json and the library directory; uninstalling does not back them up for you. Check for old copies : look for a squirrel_asset_manager copy left by a historical install in each version's scripts directory (older script installs put it under %MAYA_APP_DIR%\squirrel_asset_manager ) and clean it up when the installer prompts. Confirm the ports are free : driving Maya from the standalone edition needs ports starting at 127.0.0.1:7001 ; a second instance of the same Maya version uses the backup range 7110–7129 . Prepare license information : online activation needs an activation code; offline activation needs the machine code and a license file. Verify the result All Maya instances are closed and the plug-in directory is writable. Settings and the asset library have usable backup copies. The activation method is decided (online or offline). Common failures Uninstalling without a backup : the asset library is usually kept, but custom settings may be reset. Maya still running : overwriting .pyd files fails with "access denied". Wrong build : a test build distributed as a release build, containing documents that must not be published.

items.title: Install the standalone edition / EXE
items.summary: Run the installer, check the Maya integration and the offline dsh as needed, and you get a standalone edition you can start with a double-click. Prerequisites 6
items.text: Run the installer, check the Maya integration and the offline dsh as needed, and you get a standalone edition you can start with a double-click. Prerequisites 64-bit Windows; installs per user, so no administrator rights are needed. The installer has passed SHA256 verification. For the Maya integration, confirm Maya is installed first; without Maya the installer unchecks that component. Steps Double-click SquirrelAssetManager-Setup-1.0.0.exe (the test build is ...-test.exe ). Choose the installer language: it follows the system language by default (English on an English system, as shown) and can be changed here; the whole wizard then uses that language. On the welcome page click Next. Read the EULA summary on the license page and tick both confirmations ("I have read the summary above" and "I have read and agree to the End User License Agreement"); Next becomes available only then. On the components page tick what you need (see the table below). Choose the install directory, %LOCALAPPDATA%\SquirrelAM by default. When it finishes, keep 「启动 Squirrel Asset Manager」 (Launch Squirrel Asset Manager) checked, or open it later from the Start menu or the desktop shortcut. Components Component Description Core program (required) Main program, bundled Python, PySide6, licence and third-party notices Maya integration (optional) Writes the import path, status-line button and bridge port into each version's userSetup.py and creates the shelf button (created only once, during installation) AI assistant dsh (offline) Unpacks the bundled dsh and portable Node Desktop shortcut (optional) Creates a launch shortcut on the desktop Silent installation .\SquirrelAssetManager-Setup-1.0.0.exe /S /COMPONENTS=core,maya,aidsh Optional components not listed in /COMPONENTS are unchecked; the core component is always installed. A silent install shows no language dialog; it also follows the system language. Add /LANG= to override ( 2052 Simplified Chinese / 1033 English): .\SquirrelAssetManager-Setup-1.0.0.exe /S /LANG=1033 /COMPONENTS=core,maya,aidsh The chosen language is stored in HKCU\Software\SquirrelAssetManager\Language , and the uninstaller reuses it instead of asking again. Verify the result With the Maya integration checked, entry points appear in the Maya shelf and status line after restarting Maya. The shelf button is created only at install time and is not restored automatically after manual deletion. Double-clicking the main program opens the asset interface. Common failures SmartScreen warns about an unknown publisher : the current version is unsigned; once you trust the source, choose "More info → Run anyway". Maya integration checked without Maya : no entry point appears after installation; run the installer again and uncheck that component. Startup says the bundled Python is missing : the installation is incomplete; reinstall and check whether antivirus software blocked it. The standalone edition cannot reach Maya : confirm Maya is running and the bridge port is open, see "Multiple Maya versions". Wrong installer language : the installer asks only once; after installation change the UI language in Settings → General → UI language (the uninstaller keeps the language chosen at install time). Run the standalone edition from source In the source package you can double-click 启动独立预览.bat (Start standalone preview), or run python squirrel_asset_manager\standalone_preview.py , provided the system Python has PySide6 installed.

items.title: Launch entry points (shelf / status line / script)
path: Launch entry points (shelf / status line / script)
items.summary: The plug-in edition opens from the Custom category of the Maya shelf or from the status-line icon; the standalone edition opens from the Start menu, the desktop
items.text: The plug-in edition opens from the Custom category of the Maya shelf or from the status-line icon; the standalone edition opens from the Start menu, the desktop shortcut or the main program. Maya plug-in edition Open Maya and wait until startup finishes. Switch the shelf to the 「自定义（Custom）」 (Custom) tab and click the 「松鼠资产管家」 (Squirrel Asset Manager) button. Or click the squirrel icon on the right side of the Maya status line. You can also run this in the Script Editor: from squirrel_asset_manager.ui.main_window import MaterialLibraryWindow MaterialLibraryWindow.show_window() The plug-in does not register a separate Maya menu item; the shelf, the status line and the script are the complete set of entry points. Calling it again in the same Maya session brings the existing window forward instead of opening a second one. Standalone edition / EXE Start menu: Squirrel Asset Manager . Desktop shortcut: Squirrel Asset Manager . Run SquirrelAssetManager.exe in the install directory directly. From source: double-click 启动独立预览.bat (Start standalone preview), or run python squirrel_asset_manager\standalone_preview.py . Verify the result The main window appears and its title contains the current version number. The category tree on the left and the asset grid are visible. In the standalone edition the toolbar shows the Maya selection dropdown and the connection state. Common failures No button on the shelf : the button is created only at install time and is not rebuilt at startup after manual deletion; run the installer again to recreate it. It can also be missed when Maya was running but the shelf was not ready during installation — reinstall once more. Status-line icon missing : PySide / shiboken failed to import; check the Maya Script Editor output. Script says the module cannot be found : the install directory is not on sys.path ; run the installer again and check the matching Maya version to repair the integration. Double-clicking the standalone edition does nothing : check whether antivirus software blocked it, and whether runtime\python\python.exe is intact.

items.title: First launch
items.summary: There is no multi-step "Next" wizard. The first launch does three things: check the license, create a default asset library, and open the main window. What happ
items.text: There is no multi-step "Next" wizard. The first launch does three things: check the license, create a default asset library, and open the main window. What happens License check : if the product is not activated or the license has expired, the 「授权管理」 (License Manager) window appears first and offers one activation attempt. Read-only fallback : clicking 「关闭」 (Close) in that window still continues; the main window opens in read-only mode and the library can still be browsed. Default library : when no library is configured, SquirrelLib is created in the user directory and set as the current library. Main window : shows the category tree on the left, the asset grid in the middle and the properties / preview area on the right; the title contains the version number. Suggested first settings Open Settings → License activation and confirm the current state; if you have a key, enter it under the machine code, or click 「授权管理」 (License management) for offline import / deactivation. Open Settings → General → Asset library management and add an existing library or create a new one. Adjust interface language, theme and font size as needed. AI features are not installed automatically at startup; the dsh install prompt appears only when you click 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) . Verify the result The main window opens normally and is not stuck on a blank page. Settings → License activation shows the state and the machine code. The category tree has at least one library, and all 11 built-in sub-libraries are visible (materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, HDR, dynamics, images, audio, animation data, node trees). Common failures Only the license window is visible : that is the normal flow; after closing it you can still browse read-only. The main window is blank : the library path is invalid or has no assets; check the path and directory permissions first. It keeps saying not activated : confirm the activation code or license file matches this machine's machine code, see "License troubleshooting". No default library : it is not rebuilt automatically when the settings file is corrupt; restore from .bak or add a library manually.

items.title: Initialize the asset library
items.summary: When no library is configured, the plug-in creates SquirrelLib automatically; you can also add an existing directory or create a new empty library. Automatic in
items.text: When no library is configured, the plug-in creates SquirrelLib automatically; you can also add an existing directory or create a new empty library. Automatic initialization The first time the main window opens without a configured library, SquirrelLib is created in the user directory. Loading that library completes the directories for all 11 built-in sub-libraries and creates the default sub-categories plus a 「自定义」 (Custom) category. library.json and favorites.json are written to the library root. Adding or creating a library Open Settings → General . In the 「资产库管理」 (Asset library management) group, click 「添加资产库」 (Add asset library) and pick an existing directory. Or click 「创建资产库」 (Create asset library) and choose a new directory. With a library selected you can click 「设为默认」 (Set as default) so it loads first next time. Click 「确定」 (OK) to save; the category tree in the main window refreshes. What the directories look like after completion The 「创建资产库」 (Create asset library) button creates only 6 base directories : materials , models , lights , textures , scenes , hdr . Loading or switching to that library completes all 11 built-in sub-libraries : materials , models , lights , textures , scenes , hdr , ani , images , audio , animation , nodetree — in other words, the remaining five (dynamics, images, audio, animation data, node trees) appear the first time the library is loaded. On first run (when the library root has no library.json ), or when a sub-library has no sub-categories, sub-category folders are created from the default configuration. Every sub-library root also gets an AAAcustom (custom) sub-category so assets always have a place to go. Top-level categories cannot hold assets directly; assets belong in their sub-categories. Verify the result The category tree on the left shows 11 built-in sub-libraries, and expanding them reveals the default categories and 「自定义」 (Custom) . library.json , favorites.json and the sub-library directories appear in the library root. The library is listed in library_paths in ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/app_settings.json . Common failures Invalid path / no permission : switch to a local directory you can write to, or ask an administrator to grant write access on the share. The library loads empty : the directory has no .zasset packages, or the category levels differ from what you expect; check the sub-library and category directories. The library disappears after the settings file is corrupted : the settings file is backed up as .bak , and library_paths can be restored from it. Several people renaming in a shared library at the same time : the library has no cross-machine file lock, so avoid moving the same asset concurrently (the exact lock strategy is to be confirmed).

items.title: Upgrading
items.summary: An upgrade replaces only the program files; the asset library, settings and sign-in state live outside the program directory and are normally left untouched. Up
items.text: An upgrade replaces only the program files; the asset library, settings and sign-in state live outside the program directory and are normally left untouched. Upgrading the standalone edition / EXE Close the running SquirrelAssetManager.exe and the related dsh front-end processes. Run the new installer; it reads the install directory from the registry and overwrites the original location by default. Re-check the Maya integration and the offline dsh as needed. Restart Maya (if the Maya integration is installed), then start the standalone edition and confirm the version number. Before upgrading Note the old version number and keep the old installer so you can roll back. Confirm the asset library and settings have backups. If the current version is using the AI assistant dsh, close the web front end first so the files are not locked. Verify the result The version number in the main window title is the new one. The existing library, favorites, tags and settings are still there. The Maya shelf / status-line entry points work and the dsh and Node directories have not been deleted. Common failures Access denied : not all Maya instances are closed; close them and reinstall. The entry point disappears after upgrading : restart Maya; if needed, run the installer again with 「Maya 集成」 (Maya integration) checked to rewrite the startup block. Old files left behind : an EXE overwrite install does not remove files deleted in the new version; uninstall first and then install. Settings or library layout incompatible : back up before a major-version upgrade and roll back if needed (the exact compatibility range is to be confirmed).

items.title: Rolling back
synonyms: go back to the old version
items.summary: There is no built-in one-click rollback, so keep the old installer and reinstall manually; back up the asset library and settings before rolling back. Rolling b
items.text: There is no built-in one-click rollback, so keep the old installer and reinstall manually; back up the asset library and settings before rolling back. Rolling back the standalone edition / EXE Uninstall the current version first (user data is not deleted, see "Uninstall and leftover cleanup"). Run the old installer and reinstall the same components. Restart Maya (if the Maya integration is installed), then start the standalone edition and confirm the version. Overwriting the new version with the old installer also works, but files removed by the new version may remain; when diagnosing problems, prefer "uninstall first, then install the old version". Checks before rolling back The Maya versions supported by the old release match your current Maya. The asset library and settings are backed up, and the license file or activation code is available. Verify the result The version number is back at the target version. The library still loads and favorites and tags are intact. The Maya entry points and the license state are normal. Common failures The old version cannot read the new library layout : the library format may have been upgraded; back up before rolling back (compatibility range to be confirmed). Version mismatch : the old package does not include your Maya version, so the plug-in cannot load. The license does not cover the old version : a license may be limited to a version range; reactivate or contact the licensor. The runtime directory is deleted : do not delete the whole directory when replacing folders by hand; move the runtime directory out first.

items.title: Uninstall and leftover cleanup
items.summary: Uninstalling removes the program and the Maya startup block, but the asset library, user settings and license are yours to keep or delete. Uninstall Run the uni
items.text: Uninstalling removes the program and the Maya startup block, but the asset library, user settings and license are yours to keep or delete. Uninstall Run the uninstaller from Windows Settings → Apps or from 「卸载 Squirrel Asset Manager」 (Uninstall Squirrel Asset Manager) in the Start menu. The uninstaller first removes the startup block from each version's userSetup.py , then deletes the install directory, shortcuts and registry entries. It does not delete the asset library, ~/.squirrel_asset_manager or Ollama models. Restart Maya; if the 「松鼠资产管家」 (Squirrel Asset Manager) button is still in the Custom shelf category, delete it from the context menu (the plug-in creates the button only at install time and does not rebuild it at startup). Leftover checklist Location Removed automatically Notes %LOCALAPPDATA%\SquirrelAM Yes, by the EXE uninstaller Install directory (plug-in code, dsh/node/python runtimes); if you installed elsewhere, your chosen directory applies %MAYA_APP_DIR%\squirrel_asset_manager No Leftover from older script-based installs ; new versions do not create it, delete it manually if found ~/.squirrel_asset_manager No Settings and bridge/recovery logs Asset library (default ~/SquirrelLib ) No Your asset data; always back it up before deleting %PROGRAMDATA%\SquirrelAssetManager No May contain license.dat / trial.dat %LOCALAPPDATA%\SquirrelAssetManager\license.dat No License data directory (a different location from the install directory); uninstalling keeps it, back it up before moving machines Maya shelf button No Delete it manually Ollama models / third-party components No Managed by you Verify the result After Maya starts there is no squirrel entry point and the Script Editor shows no plug-in import errors. The install directory is gone and the disk space is released. The asset library is still there and opens normally. Common failures Maya reports import errors after uninstalling : a startup block is still in userSetup.py ; delete the four sentinel blocks by hand ( 「导入路径」 import path , 「状态行按钮」 status-line button , 「MCP 启动注册」 MCP startup registration , 「桥接端口」 bridge port ), each of which appears as a pair. The license is lost : the EXE's local license may sit inside the install directory; back up license.dat before uninstalling, and reactivate if needed. The asset library is deleted by mistake : uninstalling never deletes it, but do not treat it as an install leftover during manual cleanup. The shelf button remains : the button is defined in Maya preferences and the uninstaller does not clean it up; delete it manually.

items.title: License types and machine code
synonyms: which versions does a perpetual license cover
items.summary: Licenses come as trial, perpetual, subscription and floating licenses, plus offline licenses issued by the vendor for a specific machine code. A license is norm
items.text: Licenses come as trial, perpetual, subscription and floating licenses, plus offline licenses issued by the vendor for a specific machine code. A license is normally bound to this machine's code, and activation is either online or offline. License and versions License Validity Which versions it covers Trial Per the license (the current promotion period is 1 year) Latest version Subscription (annual) 365 days, renewable Always the latest version while valid Perpetual No expiry The major version current at first activation, plus new versions released in the following 3 years (older major versions also work); for offline-issued licenses the major version at issue time applies The 3 years of free upgrades for a perpetual license start on the first activation date ( for vendor-issued offline perpetual licenses, the issue date ), and the baseline version is the current major version at activation / issue time (independent of which version is installed on this machine). The license window shows 「版本范围：1.x · 免费升级至 <date>」 (Version range: 1.x · free upgrades until <date>) . After the 3 years, moving to a newer major version needs a new purchase; versions you already own keep working and are never disabled. The message 「当前版本超出该授权范围」 (this version is outside the license range) means the installed version is beyond your version range: keep using the older version or buy a new license. The 「购买授权」 (Buy license) button is always visible and enabled only when the product is unlicensed, expired, or within 15 days of expiry ; with plenty of license time left it is greyed out with a hover reason. The green Activate button appears both on Settings → License activation and in the License management window. With an empty key and no trial started yet, clicking it issues a per-machine trial license from the server ( no sign-in window ); with a key it activates online. License states State Meaning Availability Trial Issued by the server; trial days follow the license Full features Licensed A valid perpetual or subscription license Per license feature flags Grace period The 7 days after a subscription expires Features keep working Expired The trial or subscription ended Read-only, browsing only Not activated No usable license Read-only, browsing only Once the trial or license expires, unlicensed features are limited to read-only mode; the current code checks the license at import, export and conversion entry points. Activation methods Free trial : while unlicensed and no trial started yet, leave the key empty and click the green Activate button; the server issues a per-machine trial license (no sign-in needed) that includes all features. Online activation (code) : enter a SQAM-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX key in the field under the machine code on Settings → License activation , then click Activate . The license window accepts the same key. Offline activation : expand the collapsed 「离线许可证激活」 (Offline license activation) section in the license window and click 「导入许可证文件…」 (Import license file…) to pick a .lic / .dat / .json file issued by the licensor. From the clipboard : copy the full license text and click Import from clipboard ; it activates directly and never shows the license content. You can also drag the license file into the license window. Online-activated licenses : deactivation is limited only by the server's daily cap (max 3 per 24 hours); there is no machine-switch counter. Offline-issued licenses : issued by the vendor for a machine code and cannot be unbound for a machine move . When online they only do read-only registration + heartbeat (no seat, no account binding; the server cannot revoke or delete them). The version range and the 3-year free-upgrade cutoff of a perpetual certificate are fixed at issue time ; a heartbeat inside the upgrade window raises max_version automatically (the window still shows 「版本范围 / 免费升级至」 ). The license is written to %PROGRAMDATA%\SquirrelAssetManager\license.dat first and falls back to %LOCALAPPDATA%\SquirrelAssetMan

items.title: Activation, renewal and transfer
items.summary: Activation happens on Settings → License activation ; renew with a new license by activating again, and release the license on the old machine before moving to
items.text: Activation happens on Settings → License activation ; renew with a new license by activating again, and release the license on the old machine before moving to a new one. Online deactivation is limited only by the server's daily cap (max 3 per 24 hours); offline-issued licenses cannot be unbound for a machine move. Activation steps Open Settings → License activation ; if the product is not activated at first launch, the license window opens directly. Online activation: enter the key in 「激活码」 (Activation key) under the machine code and click 「激活」 (Activate) . To try first: leave the key empty and click the green Activate button ; the server issues a per-machine trial license (no sign-in window) that includes all features. Offline activation: expand the collapsed 「离线许可证激活」 (Offline license activation) section, then click 「导入许可证文件…」 (Import license file…) and pick a .lic / .dat / .json file, or copy the full license text and click Import from clipboard . Offline import only accepts offline license files issued manually by support; files issued by online activation cannot be used for offline activation. You can also drag the license file directly into the license window (no need to expand the section first). On success the state becomes 「已授权」 (Licensed) or 「试用中（剩余 N 天）」 (Trial, N days left) , and both the window and the settings page refresh. Renewal A subscription license has a 7-day grace period after expiry during which features keep working; after the grace period it becomes read-only. To renew, run activation again with the newly issued or renewed license; no uninstall is needed. Moving to a new machine On the old machine click 「解除本机授权」 (Release this machine) in the license window; the confirmation shows that this consumes 1 switch and how many remain. Once the server confirms, the seat is released and the remaining switch count drops by 1 immediately (not only when the new machine activates). Install on the new machine, open the license window, and either activate online with the same activation code or import an offline license matching the new machine code. When the switch count is used up (5 for perpetual / 3 for subscription), the unbind button is unavailable and you must contact the licensor to extend it or arrange the move. Offline-issued licenses cannot be unbound : the button is disabled; contact the licensor to reissue for the new machine code. If the old machine can no longer be used, contact the licensor with the old and new machine codes to request a seat release or transfer. After unbinding, the previously exported copy of the same license file no longer works on this machine and cannot be re-imported; do not keep using that license on the unbound device. In trial or unlicensed states the 「解除本机授权」 (Release this machine) button is unavailable, as it is for offline-issued licenses. Verify the result The state shows 「已授权：<customer name>」 (Licensed: <customer name>) or 「已授权」 (Licensed) . Import, export and conversion entry points are available. On the new machine the machine code matches the license and E_LIC_MACHINE no longer appears. Common failures E_ACT_NET : cannot reach the activation server; use an offline license instead. E_ACT_KEY : the activation code is wrong or no longer valid; check it and retry. E_ACT_SEATS : no seats left; release an old device first or contact the licensor. E_ACT_SWITCH_LIMIT : the machine-switch count is used up (5 for perpetual / 3 for subscription); contact the licensor to arrange the move. E_ACT_OFFLINE_LICENSE : offline-issued licenses cannot be unbound for a machine move; contact the licensor to reissue. E_LIC_REVOKED_FILE : this license file was already unbound and voided on this machine; activate again with the activation code. E_LIC_MACHINE : the license is bound to another computer; request a machine move or use a license that matches this machine. E_LIC_INTEGRITY : program files were modified; reinstall and then activate.

items.title: License troubleshooting
items.summary: Start with the license state and the error code, then work through machine code → network and time → license file → program integrity. Order of checks Open Sett
items.text: Start with the license state and the error code, then work through machine code → network and time → license file → program integrity. Order of checks Open Settings → License activation and confirm the status badge and the machine code display properly. Note the error code shown in the license window (in the form E_LIC_* / E_ACT_* ). Check that the system time is correct and was not set back. If online activation fails, confirm the network can reach the activation server; otherwise use an offline license. Check that the license file is complete and belongs to this product and this machine. If it still fails, consider program file integrity and reinstall if necessary. Common error codes Error code Meaning What to do E_LIC_MISSING No license found Enter an activation code or import a license file E_LIC_MALFORMED The license file is corrupt Obtain the license again E_LIC_BAD_SIG Signature check failed; the file may have been modified Use the original file from the licensor E_LIC_PRODUCT The license is for another product Use a license for the correct product E_LIC_MACHINE The license is bound to another computer Request a machine move, or release the license on the old machine first E_LIC_EXPIRED The license has expired Renew and activate again E_LIC_NOT_FOUND The server does not know this license (deleted / revoked, or issued by another server) Click Sync license to confirm; after that this machine becomes read-only and needs a new activation E_LIC_NEED_KEY The server requires an activation code that was not provided Ask sales / support for an activation code and retry E_LIC_NOT_YET The license is not effective yet Check the system time or contact the licensor E_LIC_CLOCK System time set back was detected Correct the system time and retry E_LIC_VERSION The license does not cover the current version Upgrade the license or use a matching version E_LIC_SCHEMA The license format is newer than the client Upgrade the client E_ACT_NET Cannot connect to the activation server Use offline activation E_ACT_KEY The activation code does not exist or is no longer valid Check it and retry E_ACT_SEATS All license seats are taken Release an old device or contact the licensor to extend E_DEVICE_REMOVED This machine was removed from the license's device list Activate again; contact support to rebind when needed E_ACT_LIMIT The 24-hour unbind / rebind limit (3) is reached Try again tomorrow or contact support E_ACT_OFFLINE Cannot reach the server to confirm the unbind Check the network and retry E_ACT_STALE The local time differs too much from the server Correct the system time and retry E_ACT_REPLAY This request was already processed Do not submit it again E_ACT_OFFLINE_LICENSE Offline-issued licenses cannot be unbound for a machine move Contact the licensor to reissue for the new machine code E_LIC_REVOKED_FILE This license file was already unbound and voided on this machine Activate again with the activation code E_LIC_PROMO_RETIRED The old promotion-period license has been retired Activate again with the activation code E_ACT_SERVER The activation server is failing Retry later or activate offline E_ACT_CONFIG No activation server is configured Use offline activation E_LIC_INTEGRITY Program file integrity check failed Reinstall If it still does not work Plug-in edition: in the Maya Script Editor, read the output beginning with [Licensing] and report it together with the error code. Standalone edition / EXE: check the logs\ directory in the install directory and the startup output; the exact log file names are to be confirmed. When reporting, include: the error code, the machine code, the product version (window title), the Windows version and the steps you tried. Notes Do not edit the license file or the machine code by hand; the signature check will fail. Do not set the system clock back; it triggers E_LIC_CLOCK . An offline license must match the target machine code; unbinding an online license is limited only by the server's daily cap (3 per

items.title: Main window layout
synonyms: what does the interface look like
items.summary: The main window is a dockable three-column layout: top toolbar, left navigation, the asset area in the middle, properties and preview on the right, and the stat
items.text: The main window is a dockable three-column layout: top toolbar, left navigation, the asset area in the middle, properties and preview on the right, and the status bar at the bottom. Areas and responsibilities Position Area Responsibility Top Top toolbar Search, refresh, AI tools, quick tools, panels and layout, settings, help Left Navigation The three tabs 「分类 / 项目 / 收藏」 (Categories / Projects / Favorites) and the category tree Middle Assets View-control row plus the asset card grid or list Right, top Properties Metadata of the current asset: name, category, tags, notes Right, middle Preview Viewing and switching thumbnails, and thumbnail operations Right, bottom AI assistant Open or close the dsh chat surface Bottom Status bar Asset count, current selection, search and background task progress In the default layout the two left columns take a narrow strip and the width goes to the asset area in the middle; the right side stacks properties, preview and AI assistant vertically. Recognizing the areas Every area has a header: the panel name on the left and function buttons (dropdown menus) on the right. The header of the asset area also holds the 「从外部导入 / 创建资产 / 面包屑 / 编辑标签 / 视图 / 排序 / 缩略图大小」 (Import from Files / Create asset / Breadcrumb / Edit tags / View / Sort / Thumbnail size) row. Drag the gap between areas to change width and height; drag an area header to dock or float it. Verify the result Selecting an asset card updates both 「属性」 (Properties) and 「预览」 (Preview) on the right. Clicking the collapse button on the left of the toolbar folds the left column into a narrow icon strip; click again to expand it. Tips Areas can be split, closed and torn off; if the layout gets messy, restore it with 「面板与布局 → 重置布局」 (Panels and layout → Reset layout) in the toolbar. The layout and window size are saved automatically and come back the same next time (see 3.2.5).

items.title: Top toolbar
synonyms: the row of buttons at the top
items.summary: The top toolbar doubles as the window title bar: collapse and search on the left, refresh, AI tools, quick tools, panels and layout, settings and help on the ri
items.text: The top toolbar doubles as the window title bar: collapse and search on the left, refresh, AI tools, quick tools, panels and layout, settings and help on the right. From left to right Control Purpose Squirrel icon Brand mark; hover to see the version number Collapse button Collapse or expand the left column Search box Search by name, tag or ID; three icon buttons for upload, screenshot and screen recording sit on the left inside the box; the placeholder says "describe the asset you are looking for in one sentence, press Enter for AI search" Buttons inside the search box Upload (choose an image, video or audio file from a menu), screenshot search, screen-recording search (the third button becomes audio recording under the 「音乐」 (Music) category) 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) checkbox On the right of the search box; on by default, using AI semantic search when checked and plain keyword search when unchecked Batch operation bar Appears to the right of the search box when several assets are selected Refresh Reloads the current asset library AI tools Analyze thumbnails with AI, preview assets for AI search, AI assistant, stop the AI backend service Quick tools Run scripts from the quicktools directory (including the script browser) Panels and layout New panel, new area, reset layout, lock layout Maintenance Rebuild the asset index, fill in missing thumbnails, clean invalid assets, export diagnostic logs, restore a historical version (see 15.2.8 ) Maya selection Appears only in the standalone edition when Maya is not attaching to it; selects which Maya instance to drive Settings Font size, language, AI, export defaults, context menu and more Help Opens the Help Center; falls back to the legacy help page if it fails Collapse right column Collapse or expand the right column There is a blank drag area on each side of the search box; drag it to move the whole window. Every toolbar button is icon-only and shows its name and description on hover. You can also drop an image, video or audio file onto the search box to find similar assets by actual format. Verify the result Hovering any icon button shows a tooltip. Clicking 「刷新」 (Refresh) reloads the asset grid; clicking 「帮助」 (Help) opens the help home page. Tips The 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) checkbox is on by default; unchecking it returns to plain keyword search and hides the upload / screenshot / screen-recording buttons inside the search box (media search depends on AI). The batch operation bar appears only when several assets are selected and hides for a single selection or none.

items.title: Left navigation (category library / project library / favorites)
path: Left navigation (category library / project library / favorites)
items.summary: The left navigation organizes assets with three tabs: the category library for long-term accumulation, the project library for the current project, and favorite
items.text: The left navigation organizes assets with three tabs: the category library for long-term accumulation, the project library for the current project, and favorites as a cross-category shortlist. The three tabs Tab Contents Best for Categories Library dropdown plus category tree Long-term organization by the 11 built-in sub-libraries : materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, HDR, dynamics, images, audio, animation data, node trees; a 「脚本」 (Scripts) entry sits at the end of the tree Projects Create / refresh buttons plus the project category tree Assets that belong only to the current project, independent of the category library Favorites Favorites panel and collections Gathering frequently used assets in one place without changing their category The library dropdown at the top of the Categories tab switches between several asset libraries; the category tree supports several levels and offers new, edit, move and delete in the context menu. A 「回收站 N」 (Recycle bin N) entry button sits at the bottom left of the category tree (not a tree node); click it to switch the middle area to the recycle bin view. Beyond the 11 built-in sub-libraries you can create your own top-level categories under the library root. 「脚本」 (Scripts) at the end of the tree is a virtual node (clicking it switches the main area to the script browser), not a category on disk, so it has no "add sub-category / edit / delete" context items. How to use it Pick a sub-library and a category on the Categories tab; the asset area shows only the assets of that category and its sub-categories. Drag an asset card onto a target category in the tree to move the asset; a multi-selection can be dragged as one batch. When the left column is collapsed it becomes a narrow icon strip, and top-level categories can still be switched from that strip. Verify the result Clicking different categories changes the contents of the asset grid in the middle. After dragging a card to another category the grid jumps to that category and the card appears in it. Tips The category library and the project library are fully independent and cannot be dragged between directly; to migrate, export the .zasset and import it again. Top-level categories set to "do not show in the main UI" do not appear in the tree; adjust them in Settings → 子库与分类 (Sub-libraries and categories) .

items.title: Asset grid
items.summary: The asset area in the middle is where you work day to day: a view-control row on top and the assets of the current category below, as icon cards or as a list. T
items.text: The asset area in the middle is where you work day to day: a view-control row on top and the assets of the current category below, as icon cards or as a list. The view-control row From left to right: The 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) dropdown: its contents change with the current category (see the table below); on 「全部资产」 (All assets) , favorites or the recycle bin the whole button is disabled. 「创建资产」 (Create asset) : export the object selected in Maya as an asset. The 「音乐播放」 (Music playback) dropdown (only when the 「音乐」 (Music) category has audio): play / pause, previous / next and playback mode. Breadcrumb : shows the current location (All assets › sub-library › category …); click an earlier segment to jump back. 「编辑标签」 (Edit tags) : opens the tag editor to filter by tag. The 「视图」 (View) button: its label shows the current mode ( 「图标」 (Icons) or 「列表」 (List) ); click to switch. The 「名称」 (Name) button (sorting): its label is the current sort key; click to choose the sort field and ascending / descending. The 「缩略图:」 (Thumbnail:) slider: adjusts card size; in icon view you can also zoom with Ctrl + wheel . The asset count is not on this row; it is in the status bar at the bottom ( 材料: 可见数/总数 , materials: visible / total). Import from Files changes with the current category Current category What the menu offers Materials Import from files, import a .zasset asset, import textures Textures Import a .zasset asset, import textures Models / Lights / Scenes / Dynamics / Node trees Import from files, import a .zasset asset HDR Import a .zasset asset, import HDR Images Import images Audio Import music Animation data Import animation data, import a .zasset asset All assets / Favorites / Recycle bin Button disabled; the 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) submenu of the empty-area context menu shows a grey line: 「当前分类不支持从外部导入」 (this category does not support importing from files) The menu is trimmed by top-level sub-library : to import something, first select the specific sub-library or category in the left column so the plug-in knows where the asset should land. Cards and list Icon view: each card shows the thumbnail, the display name and a favorite star; selected cards are highlighted and hovered cards get an outline. List view: columns are the favorite star, name, asset type, category and tags, which makes metadata easy to check. Single-click selects, double-click runs the current sub-library's double-click preset, and the context menu opens the asset menu; drag a card into the Maya viewport or onto the category tree. Right-click empty space to create an asset, paste or import; drag on empty space to marquee-select. Verify the result After switching category the grid shows only that category's assets and the count in the status bar changes accordingly. Switching 「视图」 (View) toggles the same assets between cards and a table, keeping the selection. Tips Double-click behavior differs by sub-library: models / scenes / dynamics / node trees import ma , materials import zmetal , textures create a PBR material, HDR creates a dome light; images create a file node, audio imports to the timeline, and animation data goes through hierarchy mapping. You can change it per sub-library in Settings → 右键菜单 (Context menu) → 双击命令 (Double-click command) . A card with no thumbnail shows a placeholder; capture one in the preview panel, or use 「更新缩略图 → 后台渲染」 (Update thumbnail → Background render) .

items.title: Properties and preview
items.summary: 「属性」 (Properties) sits at the top right and 「预览」 (Preview) below it: the first reads and writes asset metadata, the second views and switches images and fills i
items.text: 「属性」 (Properties) sits at the top right and 「预览」 (Preview) below it: the first reads and writes asset metadata, the second views and switches images and fills in thumbnails. Properties panel The properties panel shows the selected asset's display name, asset name, node type, asset type, category, format, animation format, size, resolution, software, renderer, color space, creation time, tags and notes. With no asset selected it shows 「未选择材质」 (no material selected) and every field is - . Click the edit button in the title row to enter edit mode: change the name, category, tags, notes and so on, then click 「保存」 (Save) to apply or 「取消」 (Cancel) to discard. Notes can be edited by double-clicking; for tags click 「+ 添加标签」 (+ Add tag) and pick a common tag or type a new one. The favorite button adds the asset to or removes it from favorites. Preview panel Shows the thumbnail of the current asset; when there are several, switch with the mouse wheel or the floating arrows on either side of the image. Double-click the preview to open the asset details / full-size preview. The buttons below offer 「截取」 (Capture) , 「导入」 (Import) , 「添加」 (Add) and 「截取添加」 (Capture and add) ; with several images there is also a counter and 「删除」 (Delete) . Right-click the preview for the 「更新缩略图」 (Update thumbnail) menu: capture / import / Maya playblast / render / add / capture and add; for materials, models, lights, scenes, dynamics, textures and node trees there is also 「后台渲染」 (Background render) , a headless offscreen render. Verify the result Selecting a different card in the grid switches the property fields and the preview image together. After changing the display name and saving, the name on the card updates immediately. Tips Rename assets and change categories and tags in these panels or the context menu; do not rename .zasset folders by hand. Properties and preview are two independent areas and can be moved, split or closed separately (see 3.2).

items.title: AI assistant / AI search / script browser
path: AI assistant / AI search / script browser
items.summary: All three are optional panels: the AI assistant handles conversation, AI search finds assets from natural language, and the script browser browses and runs scri
items.text: All three are optional panels: the AI assistant handles conversation, AI search finds assets from natural language, and the script browser browses and runs scripts. AI assistant The AI assistant sits at the bottom of the default right-hand layout with a single toggle button. Clicking it opens the dsh web chat surface embedded in Maya; clicking again closes the panel and ends the dsh process. The button label changes to 「正在启动 AI 助手…」 (Starting the AI assistant…) or 「关闭 AI 助手」 (Close the AI assistant) depending on the state. AI search preview Open it from AI 工具 (AI tools) → AI 搜索预览资产 (AI search preview) in the toolbar. It is a chat-style search window: describe the asset you want in one sentence, the AI extracts keywords and matches names, tags and notes, and the results can be imported directly or located in the library. Script browser Run 「脚本浏览器」 (Script browser) from the 「快捷工具」 (Quick tools) menu to open a separate window; you can also assign 「脚本浏览器」 (Script browser) as the panel type of an area and use it inside the main window. It browses, searches, runs and imports scripts. Switching and coexistence Click the function button in an area header and choose 「AI 助手 / AI 搜索预览资产 / 脚本浏览器」 (AI assistant / AI search preview / Script browser) from the panel type list. The same panel type can appear in several areas at once, each behaving independently. Verify the result After clicking the AI assistant button the label changes and the dsh chat surface appears or closes. Typing a description in the AI search window and pressing Enter returns matching assets. Tips AI features depend on the local dsh, Ollama and the index; when unavailable the interface shows a hint and normal search and asset browsing keep working. Before first use, run the AI dependency check (see 4.5.2).

items.title: Status bar, floating bubble and quick open
path: Status bar, floating bubble and quick open
synonyms: cannot find the window after minimizing
items.summary: The status bar at the bottom of the window shows counts and the current action; when minimized, the window collapses into a floating bubble on the desktop, and
items.text: The status bar at the bottom of the window shows counts and the current action; when minimized, the window collapses into a floating bubble on the desktop, and a single click opens the asset library again (the pure standalone edition keeps its taskbar button). Status bar The status bar is pinned to the bottom of the window; the asset count ( 材料: 可见数/总数 , materials: visible / total) is on the left and the information area on the right changes with what you do, for example: When an asset is selected it shows the asset name. During AI search it shows 「正在思考」 (Thinking) or a description of the results. During image / audio-video search it shows the matching result, for example 「图片搜索：按关键词「…」找到 N 个资产」 (Image search: N assets found for the keyword "...") , 「音视频搜索：命中 N 个资产」 (Audio-video search: N assets matched) or 「文字搜音乐：命中 N 个音频」 (Text search for music: N audio files matched) ; cancelling shows 「已取消以图搜图 / 音视频搜索，恢复当前分类的全部资产」 (Image / audio-video search cancelled; restoring all assets of the current category) . While recording audio or the screen it shows the recording duration and the limit; when finished the recording becomes a search. During 「后台渲染」 (Background render) , the headless thumbnail render, it shows render progress. Messages such as repairing UUIDs or an image search with no results also appear here. Floating bubble With the floating bubble enabled, minimizing the main window collapses it into a draggable squirrel icon: A single click restores the main window, which is the "quick open" of the asset library. Hold and drag the bubble anywhere on screen; its position is remembered. While the AI assistant is running the bubble shows the running state (a glow). Right-clicking the bubble opens a menu that differs by form: both include 「打开资产库」 (Open asset library) and 「打开AI助手」 (Open AI assistant) ; the in-Maya version adds 「关闭窗口」 (Close window) , which closes only the plug-in window, and the standalone edition adds 「退出」 (Exit) , which ends the whole process. In the standalone edition, choosing Exit while the AI assistant is running asks for confirmation first. Verify the result Minimizing the window shows the squirrel bubble; clicking it restores the main window with the layout it had before minimizing. After selecting an asset the status bar shows that asset's name. Tips The in-Maya version and an attached standalone edition have no taskbar button, so restore the window by clicking the floating bubble; the pure standalone edition can still be restored from the system taskbar. A restored window brings back the previous layout, side-column widths and maximized state from the last save (see 3.2.5).

items.title: Dock, float and tear off
items.summary: An area can dock inside the main window or be dragged out into a separate window; drag a floating window back to the edge of the main window to dock it again. D
items.text: An area can dock inside the main window or be dragged out into a separate window; drag a floating window back to the edge of the main window to dock it again. Docking and moving Hold the blank space in the area header (next to the panel name). Drag to another position inside the main window; docking indicators appear while dragging. Release and the area docks to the indicated edge or column. Dragging the gap between areas changes width and height, and the proportions are saved automatically. Floating and tearing off Click the function button on the right of the area header to open the area menu. Choose 「撕下」 (Tear off) to turn the current area into a separate window, or 「撕下副本」 (Tear off a copy) to duplicate the same panel type first and float the copy, leaving the original in the layout. You can also drag the area header out of the main window and release to create a floating window. Floating windows move and resize freely; drag one back to the edge of the main window to dock it again, or choose 「停靠回主窗口」 (Dock back into the main window) in the area menu. Closing an area Area menu → 「关闭本区域」 (Close this area) . At least one area always remains; closing the last one is refused with 「至少要保留一个区域」 (at least one area must remain) in the status bar. Verify the result Tearing off creates a separate window and the freed space in the main window goes to neighboring areas. Dragging the floating window back to the edge of the main window and releasing docks it again. Closing an area reduces the count, and the menu offers creating a new area. Tips With the layout locked you cannot drag areas around or pull them out, but 「撕下」 (Tear off) in the area menu still works (see 3.2.4). Floating state is not kept for the next start : while an area floats the layout tree may not be readable, so by design the plug-in saves nothing and returns to a docked layout after restart; the docked layout, proportions and maximized state are saved automatically (see 3.2.5).

items.title: Split and merge areas
items.summary: Splitting divides one area in two, while merging hands the current area's space to a neighboring area. Splitting an area Click the function button on the right
items.text: Splitting divides one area in two, while merging hands the current area's space to a neighboring area. Splitting an area Click the function button on the right of the target area's header. Choose a direction in the second column: 「向右拆分」 (Split right) , 「向下拆分」 (Split down) , 「向左拆分」 (Split left) , 「向上拆分」 (Split up) . The original and the new area each take half, and the new area shows the same panel type as the original. To change its content, switch the panel type in the new area's header (see 3.2.6). Merging an area Click the function button of the area that should disappear. Choose 「并入…」 (Merge into…) and then a direction (up / down / left / right). That area closes and its space goes to the neighbor in that direction; a direction without a neighbor is not shown. If you only want to remove an area, choose 「关闭本区域」 (Close this area) instead; the space is distributed among sibling neighbors. Verify the result After splitting the area count increases and two panels of the same type appear, each working independently. After merging the area count decreases, the neighbor grows and the original area's content is gone. Reopening the window keeps the split and merge results (the layout is saved automatically). Tips A newly split area holds its own independent panel instance and does not compete with the original; the same panel type can appear in several areas at once. At least one area must remain; when only one is left it can no longer be closed or merged.

items.title: Maximize and restore
items.summary: Maximizing makes the area under the cursor fill the main window while the others are hidden; restoring brings back the previous columns and proportions. Maximiz
items.text: Maximizing makes the area under the cursor fill the main window while the others are hidden; restoring brings back the previous columns and proportions. Maximizing an area Move the mouse over the target area (no need to click inside it first). Press Ctrl + Space , or click the function button in that area's header and choose 「最大化本区域」 (Maximize this area) . The other areas hide, the toolbar and status bar remain, and the target area fills the middle. Restoring Press Ctrl + Space again. Or choose 「还原区域」 (Restore area) in the area menu. All areas reappear and the proportions return to the pre-maximize layout. Verify the result While maximized the other panels are invisible and the target panel is clearly larger. After restoring, the column widths and heights are back to what they were, with the content and selection unchanged. Closing and reopening the window keeps the last maximized area (the layout is saved automatically). Tips Maximizing does nothing when there is only one area. The preview area is normally pinned to the height of its thumbnail; maximizing temporarily releases that, and restoring re-fits it to the content. If the layout tree cannot be read (for example when an area is floating), maximizing silently does nothing; dock the floating area back first.

items.title: Lock the layout
items.summary: Locking the layout prevents accidental drags: once locked, areas cannot be dragged around or pulled out into floating windows, while split and close remain avai
items.text: Locking the layout prevents accidental drags: once locked, areas cannot be dragged around or pulled out into floating windows, while split and close remain available in the menu. Locking Click 「面板与布局」 (Panels and layout) in the toolbar. Check 「锁定布局」 (Lock layout) at the bottom of the menu. The next time the menu opens the item reads 「解锁布局」 (Unlock layout) , meaning the layout is locked. Unlocking Click 「面板与布局」 (Panels and layout) . Click 「解锁布局」 (Unlock layout) ; areas can be dragged and pulled out again. Behavior while locked Action While locked Drag an area header to move it Not available Drag an area out into a floating window Not available Area menu 「撕下」 (Tear off) Still available Split, merge or close an area Still available Drag the gap between areas to resize Not available A floating area is not affected by the lock: it can still be moved and docked back into the main window. Verify the result While locked, holding an area header and dragging no longer changes the layout. After unlocking, the same drag works again. The lock state is saved, and the next start is still locked. Tips Locking only constrains mouse dragging; it does not prevent layout changes through menus. If the layout is so messed up it cannot be restored, use 「重置布局」 (Reset layout) to return to the default layout (see 3.2.5).

items.title: Save, restore and reset the layout
path: Save, restore and reset the layout
