items.summary: The layout needs no manual save: changes are written to the configuration file automatically and restored on the next start; use 「重置布局」 (Reset layout) to return
items.text: The layout needs no manual save: changes are written to the configuration file automatically and restored on the next start; use 「重置布局」 (Reset layout) to return to the default. Automatic saving The following state is written to ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/app_settings.json as you work: Window size and position, the area layout tree and the maximized area. Visibility and width of the left and right columns. The current category, expanded category nodes and the active left-column tab. Icon / list view, sorting, thumbnail size, the AI search switch and the layout lock state. Restoring Reopening the plug-in window restores the saved values. If an area was closed or the layout is damaged, the plug-in restores a missing preview area or falls back to the default layout as far as possible. Resetting the layout Click 「面板与布局」 (Panels and layout) in the toolbar. Choose 「重置布局」 (Reset layout) . Areas return to the default structure: navigation, assets, properties, preview, AI assistant; both side columns are expanded. Data state such as the current category and selection is kept where possible, and assets are never cleared. Verify the result After splitting or closing an area, closing and reopening the window keeps the adjusted layout. After resetting, the area structure is back to default while thumbnails and assets are still there. The maximized state survives a restart (if the window was maximized before closing). Tips Do not edit app_settings.json by hand while the plug-in is running; a bad edit can make the layout unreadable. To back up the layout, close the plug-in first and then copy that JSON file. Persistence of floating areas is to be confirmed; a docked layout is saved reliably.

items.title: Switch panel types
synonyms: turn an area into another panel
items.summary: Any area can be switched to another panel: navigation, assets, properties, preview, AI assistant, AI search preview or script browser. Steps Click the function
items.text: Any area can be switched to another panel: navigation, assets, properties, preview, AI assistant, AI search preview or script browser. Steps Click the function button on the right of the target area's header to open the three-column horizontal menu. Click the type you want under 「面板类型」 (Panel type) in the left column; the current type is marked with a blue highlight frame (there is no check mark). The area switches immediately; the previous panel's content goes to a backup area and is not deleted. For more areas, split an area in its menu first and then choose a type for the new area. The seven panel types Type Purpose Navigation The Categories / Projects / Favorites tabs Assets The view-control row and the asset grid / list Properties Metadata of the current asset Preview Thumbnail viewing and thumbnail operations AI assistant Toggle for the dsh chat surface AI search preview Chat-style natural-language search Script browser Browse, search and run scripts Multiple instances The same type can appear in several areas at once: each area holds an independent instance and they do not take over from each other. Two 「资产」 (Assets) areas, for example, can sit on two different categories. Verify the result After switching, the area content changes and the header title and icon follow. Switching back to the previous type keeps that panel's state (for example, navigation still on the original category). Tips Panel type names are written into the layout configuration, so the layout is saved automatically after switching. If a panel is missing, use 「面板与布局 → 新建面板」 (Panels and layout → New panel) to open a new floating panel of that type. AI search preview and script browser can also be opened as separate windows from the menu, and both can exist at the same time.

items.title: Single-click, double-click and right-click
items.summary: A single click selects, a double-click runs the sub-library preset, and a right-click opens the full asset menu. Single-click Clicking a card selects only that
items.text: A single click selects, a double-click runs the sub-library preset, and a right-click opens the full asset menu. Single-click Clicking a card selects only that card, and the properties and preview on the right update. Clicking empty space clears the selection and the right panels return to the unselected state. Clicking a row in list view selects that row's asset. Double-click A double-click runs the current sub-library's 「双击命令」 (Double-click command) preset. The factory defaults are: Sub-library Double-click action Materials Import .zmetal and rebuild the shading network Models / Scenes / Dynamics / Node trees Import ma (node trees select the newly created nodes after import) Lights Import .zlight Textures Create a PBR material ( openPBRSurface ) HDR Create a dome light (template picked by the current renderer) Images Create a file node (wire the image into a texture node) Audio Import to the Maya timeline (current frame = first frame of the audio) Animation data Run hierarchy mapping and channel selection to write keyframes onto the scene hierarchy Unregistered categories Import the first available format The double-click behavior can be changed per sub-library in Settings → 右键菜单 (Context menu) → 双击命令 (Double-click command) . Right-click Right-click a card; if the card is already part of a multi-selection the whole selection is kept, otherwise it is selected first. The top of the menu holds items specific to that sub-library , which differ between sub-libraries: Materials / models / lights / textures / scenes / HDR / dynamics: import (executed directly for a single format, a submenu for several), add reference, import geometry and so on, each with its own items such as apply material, assign texture, apply light or create dome light; Images: import as a file node, create an imagePlane, assign to a selected material slot, open the image; Audio: import to the timeline, import to the Time Editor, import to the Trax Editor, import to the camera sequencer; Animation data: import animation, import animation (hierarchy mapping)…, import to selected attributes; Node trees: import ma, add reference, preview nodes. The lower part holds common items: favorites, select all, copy, open folder, move / copy to, edit, update thumbnail (capture / import / Maya playblast / render / add / capture and add, and for some sub-libraries 「后台渲染」 (Background render) ), update asset, delete, preview nodes, analyze thumbnail with AI, asset details and so on. Right-clicking empty space in the grid gives a menu that also changes with the category: create asset, paste, import from files and more; under 「全部资产」 (All assets) the 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) submenu shows a grey line: 「当前分类不支持从外部导入」 (this category does not support importing from files) . Verify the result Double-clicking a model asset adds a new object to the Maya viewport and Outliner; double-clicking an image asset adds a file node in the Hypershade; double-clicking an audio asset shows the waveform on the timeline. Right-clicking a material asset shows 「导入」 (Import) and 「应用材质」 (Apply material) ; right-clicking an HDR shows 「创建穹顶灯」 (Create dome light) ; right-clicking animation data shows 「导入动画」 (Import animation) . Tips The complete context menu differs per sub-library and can be toggled in Settings → 右键菜单 (Context menu) , see 4.1.4.6. If a double-click does nothing, first confirm that sub-library's double-click command is not set to 「无」 (None) .

items.title: Multi-select and marquee select
items.summary: Multi-selection follows Windows Explorer habits: Ctrl -click toggles a single item, Shift -click selects a range, and dragging on empty space draws a marquee. M
items.text: Multi-selection follows Windows Explorer habits: Ctrl -click toggles a single item, Shift -click selects a range, and dragging on empty space draws a marquee. Mouse multi-selection Action Result Ctrl + click Toggles this card, keeping the other selected cards Shift + click Adds the range from the anchor to this card; the anchor stays put Ctrl + Shift + click Same as above, adding the range to the existing selection Drag on empty space Marquee select; no modifier = replace the selection, Ctrl / Shift = add Click empty space No modifier = clear; Ctrl / Shift = keep the existing selection The anchor is the card where the last plain or Ctrl click landed; repeated Shift clicks stretch the same range instead of measuring from scratch. Keyboard multi-selection Click into the asset grid to give it keyboard focus. Arrow keys move the focus and the selection; Shift + arrow extends the range; Ctrl + arrow moves only the focus without changing the selection. Ctrl + A selects all; Ctrl + F scrolls the current selection to the center of the viewport. Verify the result After multi-selecting, the batch operation bar appears in the toolbar and the status bar shows how many are selected. Dragging on empty space shows a marquee rectangle and the cards inside highlight live. Ctrl -clicking a selected card deselects it without clearing the rest. Tips List view also supports ExtendedSelection , with the same Ctrl / Shift semantics as icon view. With several cards selected, dragging any one of them drags the whole batch into Maya (see 3.3.5).

items.title: Icon view and list view
items.summary: The same assets can be viewed two ways: icon view shows thumbnails, list view shows fields such as name, type, category and tags. Switching Click the 「视图」 (View
items.text: The same assets can be viewed two ways: icon view shows thumbnails, list view shows fields such as name, type, category and tags. Switching Click the 「视图」 (View) button in the view-control row. Choose 「图标」 (Icons) or 「列表」 (List) ; the menu items are not check-marked, and the current mode is shown by the button label. The icon and label on the button follow the current mode. Icon view Cards show the thumbnail, the display name and a favorite star. Drag the 「缩略图」 (Thumbnail) slider to change the card size; Ctrl + wheel also zooms. Supports marquee selection, multi-selection, and dragging to the viewport or the category tree. Cards wrap into as many columns as the width allows, and widening the window adds columns. List view The columns are: favorite star, name, asset type, category, tags. Clicking the star column adds or removes a favorite without changing the selected row. Clicking a header sorts by that column; clicking the same column again toggles ascending / descending. Double-clicking a row runs the same preset as the icon card, and the context menu is the same. Verify the result Switching views keeps the current category and selection. Clicking the 「名称」 (Name) header in list view sorts assets by name; clicking again reverses it. Dragging the slider in icon view makes cards larger or smaller and changes the column count. Tips Choose the default view in Settings → 常规 → 默认视图 (General → Default view) . The view mode, sorting and thumbnail size are all saved and restored on the next start.

items.title: Sorting and filtering
items.summary: Sorting decides the order of assets and filtering decides which assets appear; the two combine. The asset count is shown in the status bar at the bottom. Sortin
items.text: Sorting decides the order of assets and filtering decides which assets appear; the two combine. The asset count is shown in the status bar at the bottom. Sorting Click the sort button in the view-control row (its label is the current sort key, 「名称」 (Name) by default). Choose the sort key in the upper part: 「名称 / 类型 / 分类 / 时间」 (Name / Type / Category / Time) (items are not check-marked; the current one is shown by the button label). Choose the direction in the lower part: 「升序 / 降序」 (Ascending / Descending) ; the arrow on the button points in the current direction (accent color). List view can also sort by clicking the 「名称 / 类型 / 分类」 (Name / Type / Category) header directly (there is no time column in the header), and clicking the same column toggles the direction. Filtering Keyword search: type a name, tag or ID in the top search box and results filter as you type. AI search: check 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) in the search box, type a sentence and press Enter. Tag filter: click 「编辑标签」 (Edit tags) in the view-control row to open the tag editor and click tag chips to filter (multiple tags form a union : any match counts); the button stays highlighted while a filter is active. Category filter: select a category in the left tree and the grid shows only that category and its sub-categories. Media search: from the search box you can upload an image, video or audio file, take a screenshot or record the screen (audio recording under the 「音乐」 (Music) category), or drag a file into the search box. Clearing the search box or clicking a selected tag again removes that filter. Verify the result Changing the sort order reorders the cards immediately, and the header arrows in list view follow. Typing a keyword reduces the count in the status bar, and clearing it restores everything. After checking a tag only assets with that tag remain, and the matching filter term appears in the search box. Tips If AI search is unavailable it falls back to keyword search automatically and does not affect normal filtering. Sorting and thumbnail size are saved together with the layout.

items.title: Drag assets into the viewport
items.summary: Drag an asset card out of the plug-in window and release over the Maya viewport to import it; the drop semantics differ by sub-library. Drop behavior by sub-lib
items.text: Drag an asset card out of the plug-in window and release over the Maya viewport to import it; the drop semantics differ by sub-library. Drop behavior by sub-library Sub-library Result after releasing Models / Dynamics / Scenes Imports and snaps to the surface under the cursor: stands up along the normal with its bottom edge on the surface Lights Imports and aims the light direction (−Z) at the normal of the hit surface Materials / Textures Rebuilds the material network; assigns it to the selected object when something is selected HDR Picks a template by the current renderer and creates a dome light Steps Hold a card in the asset grid and drag it out of the plug-in window. While dragging model-type assets the viewport shows an axis preview: the origin is the drop point and the green axis is the normal direction. Move the cursor onto the target model surface and release. With several cards selected, dragging one imports the whole batch using each asset's double-click preset; if the whole batch can snap, the assets line up side by side along the surface. Verify the result The newly imported model appears on the surface under the cursor and is selected automatically. After dropping a material onto a selected object, the object's shading network is replaced or assigned. The Script Editor shows a [DragDrop] 收到拖拽: [...] log line. If no surface is hit, the import happens at the original position and the model still appears in the scene. Tips Snapping is controlled by Settings → 常规 → 拖放 (General → Drag and drop) and is on by default; with it off, models import at their original position. Dragging selects: if you drag a card that is not currently selected it is selected first, so you never import the wrong asset. A mixed selection of models and materials is imported one by one without snapping.

items.title: Keyboard shortcuts (summary)
items.summary: Only the keys used most in the main window and the asset grid are listed here; the full table is in 5.6. Window and layout Key Action Ctrl + Space Maximize / re
items.text: Only the keys used most in the main window and the asset grid are listed here; the full table is in 5.6. Window and layout Key Action Ctrl + Space Maximize / restore the area under the cursor Ctrl + F Scroll the selected card to the center of the viewport Asset grid (icon view) Key Action Arrow keys Move the focus back / forward / up / down and select Shift + arrow Extend the selection from the anchor Ctrl + arrow Move the focus only, without changing the selection Home / End First / last card PageUp / PageDown Move one screen Ctrl + A Select all Ctrl + C Copy the selected assets Space Open a cross menu at the mouse for import / reference / apply / convert Type a letter or digit Jump by the first letter of the name Backspace Remove one typed jump letter Ctrl + wheel Zoom the cards Mouse Action Effect Ctrl + click Toggle a single item Shift + click Add a contiguous range Drag on empty space Marquee select Double-click a card Run that sub-library's double-click preset Right-click a card Open the asset menu Ctrl + hover an audio card Play an audition automatically Search and media search Action Effect Enter in the search box Run keyword / AI search (depending on the 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) checkbox) Click ✕ on the right of the search box Cancel the current search / tag filter / image or audio-video search and restore all assets of the current category Click the query thumbnail / media marker in the search box Cancel this media search Verify the result Pressing Ctrl + Space maximizes the area under the cursor; pressing it again restores it. After clicking into the grid, pressing an arrow key moves the focus frame; Ctrl + A shows the batch operation bar. Tips Only Ctrl + Space is registered as an application-level shortcut in the current code; the rest are key handlers inside the asset grid. While an input field has focus the arrow keys belong to that field; click the grid once before using keyboard navigation.

items.title: Create or import an asset
synonyms: put a model in the library
items.summary: Turn an external model into an asset Import a model file from outside and the plug-in wraps it into a .zasset inside the current category; this is the first ste
items.text: Turn an external model into an asset Import a model file from outside and the plug-in wraps it into a .zasset inside the current category; this is the first step of the whole workflow. Create an asset from a Maya model Prerequisites The asset library is initialized and its categories display properly. A specific sub-library and category are selected on the left (while 「全部资产」 (All assets) or favorites is active, the import entry is disabled). Have a model file ready, for example .ma , .mb , .fbx , .obj , .usd , .abc or .glb . Steps On the 「分类」 (Categories) tab on the left, choose the 「模型」 (Models) sub-library and then a specific category. In the view-control row in the middle click 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) and choose 「从文件导入」 (Import from files) . In the file dialog select one or more model files and confirm. Each file becomes its own .zasset , named after the file; duplicate names get a non-conflicting name automatically. The grid refreshes when the import finishes and jumps to the target category showing the new assets. Check the name, format and size in the properties panel on the right, and add a thumbnail if needed. Verify the result New cards appear in the target category with the same names as the source files. The properties panel shows the asset type, format and file size. The source files were not moved or deleted; they were copied into the library. Tips You must select a specific sub-library / category first : while 「全部资产」 (All assets) or favorites is active the 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) button is disabled (greyed out), and the 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) submenu of the empty-area context menu shows a grey line: 「当前分类不支持从外部导入」 (this category does not support importing from files) . To bring in a .zasset , use 「从外部导入 → 导入 .zasset 资产」 (Import from Files → Import a .zasset asset) ; do not copy folders by hand. Having no thumbnail right after import is normal: capture one in the preview panel or use 「更新缩略图 → 后台渲染」 (Update thumbnail → Background render) (see 4.1.7).

items.title: Import an asset into the scene
path: Import an asset into the scene
items.summary: The last step is putting a library asset into Maya: double-click to import with the preset, or right-click to choose a specific format and import method. Steps
items.text: The last step is putting a library asset into Maya: double-click to import with the preset, or right-click to choose a specific format and import method. Steps Find the asset you just organized in the library and select it. Double-click the card to run that sub-library's double-click preset; models import ma by default and materials import zmetal . To pick a format or import method, right-click the card and choose 「导入」 (Import) plus a specific format at the top of the menu; when several formats exist, pick one from the submenu. For material assets with an object selected, right-click and choose 「应用材质」 (Apply material) to apply the material network to the selected object. After importing, confirm the new object in the Maya viewport and Outliner; transform it directly in Maya when it needs to be moved. Verify the result A new root node appears in the Outliner and the imported model or material is visible in the viewport. After importing a material asset, the complete shading network appears in the Hypershade. After a double-click or context-menu import, the Script Editor shows the matching import log. If an import fails, the Script Editor reports the error, which helps you check the format and dependencies. Tips Models, dynamics and scenes snap to the surface under the cursor when dragged into the viewport, which is better for placement than a double-click (see 3.3.5). Images, audio, animation data and node trees behave differently from geometry assets on double-click: images create a file node, audio goes to the timeline, animation data uses hierarchy mapping and node trees import ma ; see 3.3.1. .zmetal records the complete material network, so it can be rebuilt even when the original Maya file is gone. If textures are missing or materials do not match, first check that the asset is complete, then see the import troubleshooting chapter.

items.title: Help home and contents
items.summary: The Help Center is a local web page: the home page uses cards as entry points, the left side holds the four-level contents of the whole book, and the article ha
items.text: The Help Center is a local web page: the home page uses cards as entry points, the left side holds the four-level contents of the whole book, and the article has a breadcrumb and previous / next links above it. Opening the help Click 「帮助」 (Help) in the main window toolbar, to the left of the right-column collapse button. The plug-in starts the local help service and opens the help home page in your browser; if the Help Center is unavailable it falls back to the legacy help page. You can also reach each chapter from the cards on the help home page. Home page The top of the home page holds the search box and the title, followed by 8 entry cards: What's new, 5-minute start, Interface overview, Common workflows, Shortcuts, Command reference, FAQ and Support. Pages you have visited appear under 「最近访问」 (Recently visited) . Contents and article The left contents tree has up to four levels: book → chapter → section → article page; click to expand or collapse. Opening a page expands the tree automatically and highlights the current path. A breadcrumb above the article lets you click back up level by level. Long pages show 「本页内容」 (On this page) anchors on the right, highlighting the current heading as you scroll. The bottom of the page has previous / next links and 「此页是否有帮助」 (Was this page helpful?) . Deep links and narrow screens Every page has a stable address #/<page ID> , for example #/3.1.1 , which you can bookmark or share. English pages use #/en/<page ID> . On narrow windows the left contents collapse into a drawer; click the button to expand it. A page ID that does not exist shows 「找不到这个帮助页面」 (Help page not found) with a link back to the home page. Verify the result Home page cards lead to the matching chapters, and the breadcrumb walks back level by level. Refreshing the browser keeps you on the same page with the contents tree still expanded.

items.title: Searching the help
items.summary: The search box at the top of the Help Center supports both keyword and semantic retrieval and can find pages, commands and sections. Steps Type a keyword in the
items.text: The search box at the top of the Help Center supports both keyword and semantic retrieval and can find pages, commands and sections. Steps Type a keyword in the search box at the top of the help page, for example "import model", "font size" or "crash". Results first show local lexical matches, then are replaced by fused "semantic + lexical" results when the service is available. Each result shows the title, a type badge (page / concept / reference / command / section), its path and a hit snippet. Use ↑ / ↓ to move, Enter to open and Esc to close the results. Command results jump to the command reference and highlight the matching row; section results open the section overview. Result states A label at the top states the current mode: 「语义 + 词法」 (semantic + lexical) , 「词法检索」 (lexical) or 「词法检索 · 语义暂不可用」 (lexical · semantic unavailable) . With no hits it says 「没有找到匹配的帮助页，试试更短的关键词」 (no matching help page; try a shorter keyword) . If the search index has not been generated it asks you to run the build command in the project root (release builds normally ship the index). Verify the result Typing "import model" returns pages such as importing geometry and importing from files. Typing "text too small" finds the pages about font size. Pressing Esc closes the results without navigating away. Tips Semantic retrieval depends on the local embedding model; when unavailable it falls back to lexical retrieval and search still works. The shorter the keyword and the closer it is to UI wording, the more reliable the hit.

items.title: Feedback and support
items.summary: Every help page ends with 「此页是否有帮助」 (Was this page helpful?) , which records the quality of that page; to report a plug-in issue to the author, use Settings → 关
items.text: Every help page ends with 「此页是否有帮助」 (Was this page helpful?) , which records the quality of that page; to report a plug-in issue to the author, use Settings → 关于 → 反馈与建议 → 发送反馈 (About → Feedback and suggestions → Send feedback) in the main window. In-page feedback Open any help page and scroll to the bottom. Click 「有帮助」 (Yes) or 「没帮助」 (No) . 「已记录，谢谢反馈。」 (Recorded. Thanks for the feedback.) appears next to the buttons; the next time you open that page it shows your previous choice. Feedback is stored in the local storage of the current browser (key squirrel.help.feedback ); it is not uploaded to a server and does not create a ticket automatically. When something goes wrong First search this help for the symptom, for example "import failed", "empty asset" or "crash". Work through the Troubleshooting chapter following "symptom → cause → fix"; log locations are described in 6.8.1. To report to the author, open Settings → 关于 (About) in the main window, click 「发送反馈」 (Send feedback) in the 「反馈与建议」 (Feedback and suggestions) group and fill in the form (screenshots and logs can be attached). Having the following ready makes diagnosis much faster: Maya version and plug-in version; steps to reproduce, expected result and actual result; relevant screenshots or screen recordings; Script Editor output and log files. Verify the result After clicking the in-page feedback, 「已记录，谢谢反馈。」 (Recorded. Thanks for the feedback.) appears. After refreshing the browser and reopening the page, your previous feedback state is shown. Tips In-page feedback only says whether the page is good; it cannot replace a defect report. Report defects through Settings → 关于 → 发送反馈 (About → Send feedback) . When reporting a defect, do not just write "it does not work"; include reproducible steps and logs so it can be located much faster.

items.title: Assets, sub-libraries, categories and tags
items.summary: An asset is the smallest unit the plug-in manages: one .zasset folder is one asset. The sub-library decides which kind of asset it is, the category is the folde
items.text: An asset is the smallest unit the plug-in manages: one .zasset folder is one asset. The sub-library decides which kind of asset it is, the category is the folder hierarchy inside the library, and tags are cross-category search terms. Key nouns Noun Meaning Where it appears in the interface Asset A .zasset folder containing metadata, thumbnails, materials / geometry / textures and other files Every card in the asset grid Sub-library A top-level container under the library root that decides the asset type Top-level nodes of the Categories tree in the left column: materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, HDR, dynamics, images, audio, animation data, node trees (11 built-in sub-libraries) Category A multi-level folder inside a sub-library (or under a custom top-level category in the library root) Nodes at every level of the tree Tag A free-form word in the asset metadata, used for filtering 「标签」 (Tags) in the properties panel, 「编辑标签」 (Edit tags) in the toolbar Why it is split this way The sub-library decides how an asset is imported and which commands its context menu shows. A category is a pure folder structure; moving a category moves the folder, and sub-categories travel with their assets. Tags do not consume folder levels: one asset can carry several tags, which makes cross-category lookup possible. Notes Do not copy, move or rename .zasset folders by hand, and do not delete category folders inside the library directly. The plug-in indexes assets by metadata and folder structure, so manual changes make assets invisible; do moves, renames and deletions inside the plug-in. A category's folder name is its internal ID and cannot be changed through the interface after creation.

items.title: Versions and LODs
items.summary: A version is one complete iteration of an asset, and a LOD is a geometry detail level inside one version; both hang off the main asset, and the grid usually sho
items.text: A version is one complete iteration of an asset, and a LOD is a geometry detail level inside one version; both hang off the main asset, and the grid usually shows only the main asset. Versions The main .zasset can hold version directories such as V1 and V2 , each self-contained with geometry, materials, textures and thumbnails; the main asset's meta.json registers them under version_assets . Versions preserve revisitable results. In 「更新资产」 (Update asset) you can choose 「创建新版本」 (Create new version) . When a card shows a multi-version badge, double-clicking the preview image opens the 「版本浏览器」 (Version browser) , where a version can be viewed, imported or deleted. LODs A LOD is a chain of geometry detail levels inside one version, indexed in lods.json in the version directory; LOD0 always points at the geometry in the version root, and further levels live in lod1 , lod2 and so on. LODs switch detail by purpose or distance, for example a high-poly display model and a low-poly proxy for placement. A card showing an L badge means the asset has several LODs; the context menu item 「导入变体 / 版本」 (Import variant / version) (also labelled 「导入版本 / LOD」 (Import version / LOD) ) lets you choose the version, level and variant to import. Variants A variant is one of several geometry forms of the same asset that share one set of textures and materials ; the geometry sits flat under variants/ and thumbnails are stored separately. Variants versus versions: a version is a complete self-contained asset with its own materials and textures, while a variant stores only geometry and inherits materials and textures from the asset root. This fits cases such as "one material, many kinds of bricks and screws"; 「更新资产」 (Update asset) offers adding a new variant, batch-adding variants, updating variants and opening variant management. When to use which Use versions when something needs repeated edits without losing earlier results; use LODs when one asset must switch between detail levels; use variants when one set of textures needs several shapes. All three can coexist; see "Append a LOD", "Create a new version", "Switch version and LOD" and the "Variants" section.

items.title: Main asset library and project library
path: Main asset library and project library
items.summary: The main asset library accumulates assets over time, while the project library belongs to the current Maya project; the two are isolated, and favorites are stor
items.text: The main asset library accumulates assets over time, while the project library belongs to the current Maya project; the two are isolated, and favorites are stored separately as well. Main asset library The library dropdown above the 「分类」 (Categories) tab switches the current asset library; it opens the default library set in settings. The main library holds assets reused across projects (materials, models, textures, lights, scenes, HDR, dynamics, images, audio, animation data, node trees); its path is chosen when the library is added and it is kept long term. Several libraries can be added and switched at any time; see "Library list and switching". Project library The project library always lives in SquirrelLib under the root of the current Maya project, travels with the project and never pollutes the main library. The 「项目」 (Projects) tab in the left column offers 「创建」 (Create) and 「刷新」 (Refresh) : when the project has no SquirrelLib yet the status area says 「项目库未创建」 (project library not created) , and clicking Create generates the sub-library directories; after switching projects click Refresh to load it again. The project tree works like the main library category tree, but it is not affected by the "show in the main UI" hiding setting. Between the two Assets are not synchronized automatically. To reuse one, select it in the main library, right-click 「复制」 (Copy) , switch to the 「项目」 (Projects) tab and 「粘贴」 (Paste) ; the same works in reverse. Favorites are stored per library, so after switching you see that library's own favorites.

items.title: Favorites and wishlist
items.summary: Favorites are persistent, per-library groups of bookmarked assets; the wishlist is a temporary cross-session "to look at" queue inside AI search. The two are un
items.text: Favorites are persistent, per-library groups of bookmarked assets; the wishlist is a temporary cross-session "to look at" queue inside AI search. The two are unrelated. Favorites They live on the 「收藏」 (Favorites) tab in the left column; each library has its own set, so the list changes with the library, and the panel header names the current library (main asset library / project library). A 「默认收藏夹」 (default collection) is built in; new collections can be renamed, emptied or deleted (the default collection can only be emptied). The star at the bottom left of an asset card shows whether it belongs to the active collection; click the star to add or remove it. The data is written to favorites.json in the library root. Wishlist It sits on the right of the AI search dialog as a linear queue, independent of collections and libraries, and persists across sessions. Right-click a card in the AI search results to add it to the wishlist, or drag the card into the wishlist panel; clicking an entry locates it in the main window, ✕ on an entry removes it, and the top right can clear the whole list. The wishlist stores only the light fields needed to locate an asset; it is not a copy of the asset. Which one to use Long-term grouping and repeated use → favorites; just gathering a batch of search results to look at later → wishlist.

items.title: Category library
items.summary: The 「分类」 (Categories) tab, the category library view, mirrors the folders of the current main asset library: 「全部资产」 (All assets) at the top, then sub-libraries
items.text: The 「分类」 (Categories) tab, the category library view, mirrors the folders of the current main asset library: 「全部资产」 (All assets) at the top, then sub-libraries and categories level by level. What the panel contains Library dropdown at the top: switches the current asset library. 「全部资产」 (All assets) : shows every asset across all sub-libraries, counted as the sum of them; it is always shown and never affected by hiding settings. Top-level nodes: the sub-libraries (materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, HDR, dynamics, images, audio, animation data, node trees — 11 built-in sub-libraries) plus custom top-level categories in the library root; a sub-library can be hidden with Settings → 子库与分类 → 显示在主 UI (Sub-libraries and categories → Show in the main UI) (the screenshot hides 「节点树」 (Node trees) ). The last row, 「脚本」 (Scripts) , is the script library entry and not a sub-library; the 「回收站」 (Recycle bin) entry sits below it (see 15.3.4.4 ). Counts: the number after a category name is the asset count of that category and all its descendants. Actions Clicking a category shows only the assets of that category and its sub-categories in the middle grid, and refreshes the properties / preview on the right. Ctrl -click and Shift -click select several categories, and the grid shows the union of all selected categories (including their descendants); selections can span sub-libraries. Right-clicking a category offers new sub-category, open folder, move, edit and delete; parent nodes also offer 「全部展开 / 全部折叠」 (Expand all / Collapse all) . When collapsed, the left column becomes a narrow icon strip that still switches top-level categories. The tree order follows the folders on disk; after adding, moving or deleting a category the tree is rebuilt and keeps the previous expansion and selection where possible.

items.title: Project library
items.summary: The 「项目」 (Projects) tab manages the asset library dedicated to the current Maya project, always at SquirrelLib under the project root. What the panel contains 「
items.text: The 「项目」 (Projects) tab manages the asset library dedicated to the current Maya project, always at SquirrelLib under the project root. What the panel contains 「创建」 (Create) in the toolbar: creates SquirrelLib , its sub-library folders and metadata in the project root; only needed when the project library does not exist. 「刷新」 (Refresh) in the toolbar: rescans the project library. After switching Maya projects the new path is not discovered automatically, so refresh manually. Status area: shows the full project library path, or 「项目库未创建」 (project library not created) . Using it Switch to the 「项目」 (Projects) tab and the plug-in tries to load SquirrelLib ; if it is missing the grid is emptied with a hint. Click 「创建」 (Create) to generate the project library, then create categories and import assets exactly as in the main library. Click 「刷新」 (Refresh) to reload the current project's library and restore the previously selected category. Relationship with the main library The two libraries are fully isolated: categories, assets and favorites are stored separately. To reuse an asset across libraries, 「复制」 (Copy) in the main library, switch to the 「项目」 (Projects) tab and 「粘贴」 (Paste) ; assets in the project library never appear under 「全部资产」 (All assets) of the main library. The project tree also supports creating, editing, moving and deleting categories and dragging assets, exactly like the main library. Tips When the project library does not exist, do not create an empty directory by hand; 「创建」 (Create) writes library.json and the sub-library metadata as well, so the category tree can recognize the types correctly.

items.title: Favorites
items.summary: The 「收藏」 (Favorites) tab organizes assets by collection; a star only means "belongs to the currently selected collection". What the panel contains The + to the
items.text: The 「收藏」 (Favorites) tab organizes assets by collection; a star only means "belongs to the currently selected collection". What the panel contains The + to the right of the 「收藏夹」 (Favorites) title creates a new collection. The number after each list item is the asset count in that collection; 「默认收藏夹」 (default collection) is built in. Small text at the top of the panel names the current library (main asset library or project library), because favorites are stored per library. Actions Clicking a collection shows only its assets in the grid. Dragging an asset card onto a collection: a plain drop moves it into that collection (removing it from others); holding Ctrl while dropping adds it and keeps its previous membership. Clicking the star on an asset card adds or removes it from the active collection, with the same effect as dragging. Right-clicking a collection offers new and empty; custom collections can also be renamed and deleted (the default collection cannot be renamed or deleted). Verify the result After dropping or clicking a star the count next to the collection name changes immediately and the grid refreshes within the 「收藏」 (Favorites) tab. The data is stored in favorites.json in the current library root and survives a restart. Tips 「清空收藏夹」 (Empty collection) only removes members from that collection; it never deletes the assets, which stay in their original categories.

items.title: Show or hide top-level categories
items.summary: Hiding a top-level category only affects the left column; it never deletes folders or assets on disk. Prerequisites An asset library is loaded. Steps Open 「设置」
items.text: Hiding a top-level category only affects the left column; it never deletes folders or assets on disk. Prerequisites An asset library is loaded. Steps Open 「设置」 (Settings) . Choose 「子库与分类」 (Sub-libraries and categories) on the left. Select the sub-library or top-level category to change in the list on the left. Check or uncheck 「显示在主 UI」 (Show in the main UI) at the top right. Unchecked means hidden. Click 「应用」 (Apply) or 「确定」 (OK) . Verify the result The category tree and the collapsed icon strip rebuild immediately: the hidden top-level category no longer appears, while 「全部资产」 (All assets) is always kept. If the hidden category was selected, the selection falls back to 「全部资产」 (All assets) . Tips The setting only affects the main asset library's category tree; the project library tree on the 「项目」 (Projects) tab always shows every top-level category. Assets inside hidden items remain in the library and can be reached through 「全部资产」 (All assets) or search. The setting is stored as hidden_top_categories (blacklist semantics); when it cannot be read, everything is shown. A sub-library is also a top-level node, so uncheck 「显示在主 UI」 (Show in the main UI) for it as well to hide it; re-check it and click 「应用」 (Apply) to restore.

items.title: Expand, collapse and locate
items.summary: The category tree expands level by level, collapses as a whole, and automatically expands parents and scrolls into place when an asset is located from search or
items.text: The category tree expands level by level, collapses as a whole, and automatically expands parents and scrolls into place when an asset is located from search or the wishlist. Expanding and collapsing Click the arrow in front of a category row to expand or collapse that node. Double-clicking a node with sub-categories also expands / collapses it (the native double-click is disabled and the tree decides, avoiding a double toggle under Maya). Double-clicking 「全部资产」 (All assets) expands every top-level category at once; double-clicking again collapses them. Right-clicking a sub-library root node or top-level category node : the bottom of the menu holds 「全部展开」 (Expand all) and 「全部折叠」 (Collapse all) ; the context menu of an ordinary category node only offers add sub-category, open folder, move to, edit and delete, without expand / collapse. Locating Ordinary locating: clicking a category selects it and loads its assets; expanding the tree never changes the selection. Clicking 「定位」 (Locate) from AI search or the wishlist: the plug-in switches to the asset's sub-library, expands the parent categories level by level, selects the category and scrolls the asset into view in the grid. Pressing Ctrl+F inside the grid scrolls the selected card to the center of the viewport. Verify the result When the category tree refreshes (for example after creating, deleting or moving a category), the expansion state and the current selection are kept: previously expanded nodes stay expanded and the selected category stays where it was. After a plug-in restart the previous expansions and selection are restored as well.

items.title: Create top-level categories and sub-categories
items.summary: Categories are folders on disk: a new top-level category creates an independent container in the library root, and a new sub-category creates a folder under the
items.text: Categories are folders on disk: a new top-level category creates an independent container in the library root, and a new sub-category creates a folder under the selected category. Prerequisites An asset library is loaded; the main library and the project library both work. Steps To create a top-level category: right-click empty space in the category tree or 「全部资产」 (All assets) and choose 「添加顶级分类」 (Add top-level category) . To create a sub-category: right-click any category (including a sub-library root node) and choose 「添加子分类」 (Add sub-category) . Fill in 「文件夹名」 (Folder name) : required, used as the category's internal ID, for example metal_copper . Fill in 「易读名」 (Display name) : optional; when left empty the folder name is used. A top-level category also offers 「类型」 (Type) , whose dropdown comes from the configured sub-library list; sub-categories inherit the parent type and do not show this field. Click 「确定」 (OK) . Verify the result The new category appears in the tree and is selected automatically; a top-level category also gets a 「自定义」 (Custom) sub-category. Tips and warnings The folder name cannot be empty and cannot match an ancestor category or a built-in sub-library; on a conflict the plug-in refuses to create it and asks for another name. The folder name cannot be changed through the interface after creation, so decide it carefully. Top-level categories cannot hold assets directly; assets imported into a top-level category automatically land in its 「自定义」 (Custom) sub-category.

items.title: Edit display names and folder names
path: Edit display names and folder names
items.summary: A category's display name can be changed at any time, while the folder name (its internal ID) is read-only in the edit dialog. Steps Right-click the category an
items.text: A category's display name can be changed at any time, while the folder name (its internal ID) is read-only in the edit dialog. Steps Right-click the category and choose 「编辑」 (Edit) . 「文件夹名」 (Folder name) is read-only and cannot be changed. Change 「易读名」 (Display name) ; saving an empty value has no effect. Change the 「类型」 (Type) dropdown if needed (it affects which context commands are available for assets in that category). Click 「确定」 (OK) . Verify the result The category name in the tree changes to the new display name immediately while the folder name on disk stays the same; neither asset locations nor existing assets are affected. Tips The display name is only for reading; search and locate still match by category ID and path. The plug-in offers no way to change a folder name. Do not rename category folders in Explorer, or the index will drift from disk and assets may disappear from the tree. The type field decides which sub-library a top-level category is handled as; a wrong value makes the context menu offer mismatched import / apply items, so confirm it before changing. Changes are written back to FolderMetadata.fdata in the category folder; no plug-in restart is needed. When you only want to change the category hierarchy, use 「移动到...」 (Move to...) ; do not try to rename the folder.

items.title: Move and sort
items.summary: Moving a category takes the whole folder, including sub-categories and assets, to a new location; category order follows folder names, and there is no manual or
items.text: Moving a category takes the whole folder, including sub-categories and assets, to a new location; category order follows folder names, and there is no manual ordering entry yet. Moving a category Right-click the category to move and choose 「移动到...」 (Move to...) . Choose the destination in the list: 根目录 (root) or a top-level category. Click 「确定」 (OK) . Result: the folder on disk is moved as a whole, the tree and grid refresh, and sub-categories and assets move with it. Moving assets Select one or more asset cards in the grid and drag them onto the target category in the left column (the drop target is the category itself, not 「全部资产」 (All assets) ). A multi-selection moves as a batch, and the grid jumps to the target category afterwards. Sorting The category tree is displayed in folder-name order (the source uses sorted(os.listdir(...)) ); sibling nodes have no move-up / move-down or drag-to-reorder entry (whether this will be added later is to be confirmed). Sorting in the asset grid is a separate mechanism: see "View modes and sorting". Tips The 「移动到...」 (Move to...) list only contains the root and top-level categories; a deep sub-category cannot be picked directly. Confirm the target category's type before moving; moving across types can make the context menu mismatch the assets.

items.title: Delete a category (with sub-categories and assets)
path: Delete a category (with sub-categories and assets)
synonyms: can a deleted category be recovered
items.summary: Deleting a category moves it, its sub-categories and all its assets into the recycle bin , with two confirmations; a mistake can be undone by restoring the whol
items.text: Deleting a category moves it, its sub-categories and all its assets into the recycle bin , with two confirmations; a mistake can be undone by restoring the whole branch from 「回收站」 (Recycle bin) on the left. Prerequisites Know which category you are deleting (the whole subtree goes) and make sure the recycle bin has room (100 GB limit). Steps Right-click the category and choose 「删除分类」 (Delete category) . Core sub-libraries and the automatically created 「自定义」 (Custom) sub-category do not offer this item. First confirmation: the dialog states how many sub-categories and assets will be deleted; click 「是」 (Yes) . Second, 「最终确认删除」 (Final delete confirmation) : a strong warning says the category and its contents go to the recycle bin (with counts when assets exist), the focus defaults to 「否」 (No) , so click 「是」 (Yes) to confirm. Verify the result The category disappears from the tree and the whole folder moves into the recycle bin; the parent category is selected automatically and the grid no longer shows those assets. The count on the 「回收站」 (Recycle bin) entry on the left increases. Warnings Deletion goes to the recycle bin and can be restored , but what comes back is the whole category branch, not individual assets; sub-categories and assets return together. The recycle bin is limited to 100 GB and never cleans itself; once you are sure, go in and 「彻底删除」 (Delete permanently) item by item — that step cannot be undone. Deleting a category while keeping its assets is not supported today: move the assets to another category first, or export a backup. Do not delete category folders in Explorer; index and favorite records may be left behind. Delete inside the plug-in. To be safe, export the whole library or the target assets first as described in "Backup and restore".

items.title: Sync categories from folders
items.summary: 「读取当前分类文件夹」 (Read current category folders) reads the actual folder structure of the library into settings, overwriting the 「默认分类列表」 (Default category list) con
items.text: 「读取当前分类文件夹」 (Read current category folders) reads the actual folder structure of the library into settings, overwriting the 「默认分类列表」 (Default category list) configuration without touching the disk. Prerequisites An asset library is loaded (main or project library). Steps Open 「设置」 (Settings) → 「子库与分类」 (Sub-libraries and categories) . Click 「读取当前分类文件夹」 (Read current category folders) above the editor on the right. Click 「是」 (Yes) in 「同步确认」 (Sync confirmation) . Back in settings, click 「应用」 (Apply) or 「确定」 (OK) to save. Verify the result 「分类已从当前资产库同步」 (categories synchronized from the current asset library) appears; the sub-library list on the left and the 「默认分类列表」 (Default category list) on the right are replaced by the actual folder structure, and new sub-libraries / categories show up in the list. Tips This only updates the configuration file; it neither deletes nor modifies any folder on disk. The category tree itself always mirrors the disk and needs no syncing; this button brings the 「默认分类列表」 (Default category list) configuration up to date with the library. It overwrites the existing default category configuration, so confirm beforehand that nothing hand-maintained needs to be kept. It suits the case where category folders were organized on disk first and the default categories in settings should follow; syncing itself does not change how the current category tree displays.

items.title: The custom category (AAAcustom)
synonyms: why is there a custom category
items.summary: Every top-level category has an automatically created 「自定义」 (Custom) sub-category (folder name AAAcustom ) that receives assets which cannot live directly in a
items.text: Every top-level category has an automatically created 「自定义」 (Custom) sub-category (folder name AAAcustom ) that receives assets which cannot live directly in a top-level category. Why it exists Top-level categories (sub-library roots and custom top-level categories under the library root) cannot hold .zasset packages directly. Every create or import path resolves the landing spot first: if the target is a top-level category, it is redirected to that category's AAAcustom and the asset metadata records that sub-category. This keeps the category index from containing "assets hanging directly off a sub-library root" and avoids self-referencing parent / child nesting such as materials/materials . Rules 「自定义」 (Custom) cannot be deleted: there is no delete item in its context menu, and even if a delete is triggered it only reports that this sub-category cannot be deleted. It can be edited like an ordinary category: change its display name, create sub-categories and receive dropped assets. Importing assets with a top-level category selected puts them below it, not in the top-level category itself. How to use it Treat 「自定义」 (Custom) as the default catch-all of its top-level category: assets imported into the top-level category land here. For finer structure, create sub-categories below it and move assets into them. Verify the result After importing assets with a top-level category selected, expanding that top-level category should show the assets inside its 「自定义」 (Custom) sub-category.

items.title: Asset grid and selection
items.summary: The middle grid is the main work area for assets: single-click to select, double-click to run the preset command, and multi-select to batch operate. Interface E
items.text: The middle grid is the main work area for assets: single-click to select, double-click to run the preset command, and multi-select to batch operate. Interface Every card has a square thumbnail, a favorite star at the bottom left and the name at the bottom. The top-left of the thumbnail may show a multi-version badge, a variant V badge, or L when there are several LODs; the top right shows the asset type icon. Assets with a video thumbnail play a preview on the card after the mouse rests on it for a moment. The result count is in the bottom status bar : visible / total plus the number selected; the view-control row no longer shows it. Selection Single-click: selects only that card, and the properties and preview on the right follow. Ctrl +click: toggles that card and keeps the rest. Shift +click: adds the range from the anchor to that card, which can be stretched repeatedly. Dragging on empty space: marquee select; a plain drag replaces the selection and holding Ctrl / Shift adds to it. Clicking empty space: clears the selection. Ctrl+A selects all; Ctrl+C copies; Ctrl+F scrolls the selected card to the center of the viewport. Keyboard and double-click Arrow keys move and select, Home / End jump to the first and last card, PageUp / PageDown page; Ctrl +arrow moves only the focus, and Ctrl+Space toggles the focus card's selection. Typing letters or digits jumps by Chinese name or pinyin initial; typing the same letter repeatedly cycles through candidates with that initial. A double-click follows double_click_preset.json : materials import .zmetal , models / scenes / dynamics / node trees import .ma , lights import .zlight , textures create a material, HDR creates an environment light; audio imports to the timeline, images import as a file node, and animation data runs 「导入动画（层级映射）…」 (Import animation (hierarchy mapping)…) ; unregistered categories import the first available format by default. All of this can be changed per sub-library under Settings → 右键菜单 (Context menu) , in the lower half (double-click command). Verify the result After selecting a card, the properties and preview panels on the right show the same asset and the selected count in the status bar changes.

items.title: View modes and sorting
items.summary: Two buttons at the top of the asset area: 「图标」 (Icons) on the left (click to choose icons / list) and 「名称」 (Name) on the right (the label is the current sort ke
items.text: Two buttons at the top of the asset area: 「图标」 (Icons) on the left (click to choose icons / list) and 「名称」 (Name) on the right (the label is the current sort key; click to choose the sort type and direction). Both affect display only, never the assets themselves. View modes Click the 「图标」 (Icons) button at the top of the asset area (its label follows the current view; in list view it reads 「列表」 (List) ). Choose 「图标」 (Icons) for a grid of thumbnail cards, or 「列表」 (List) for a table with the columns star, name, asset type, category and tags. Both views share the current filter and selection; the button label and icon change together when switching. Thumbnail size The 「缩略图:」 (Thumbnail:) slider at the top of the asset area: small cards with many columns on the left, large cards with few columns on the right, roughly 2–16 columns. In icon view, holding Ctrl and scrolling the wheel also zooms: up enlarges, down shrinks. Widening the window adds columns first instead of stretching the cards. Sorting Clicking the 「名称」 (Name) button opens the sort menu in two parts: Part Items Notes Sort type Name / Type / Category / Time Single choice; items are not check-marked, compare the toolbar button label instead Separator — — Sort direction Ascending / Descending The current direction has a blue arrow; picking once applies it Ascending / descending apply to all four sort keys : descending simply reverses the current order (including the name order inside each group); Names sort by Chinese display name and time sorts by file modification time; List view can also sort by clicking the 「名称 / 资产类型 / 分类」 (Name / Asset type / Category) headers, and clicking the same column toggles the direction; the star and tag columns do not participate. Verify the result After switching, the cards / table reorder immediately without losing the filter. The view mode and sorting are written into the interface state and restored after a restart.

items.title: Properties panel
items.summary: The 「属性」 (Properties) panel on the right shows the editable metadata of the current asset and lets you change fields such as the name, tags and notes directly.
items.text: The 「属性」 (Properties) panel on the right shows the editable metadata of the current asset and lets you change fields such as the name, tags and notes directly. Fields Field Description Editable Name The asset's readable Chinese name Yes Material type (node type) For example standardSurface, VRayMtl Yes Asset type The sub-library it belongs to (materials / models / textures and so on) No Category The category the asset is in No Format Format chips of the files inside the asset No Size Disk space used by the asset No Resolution Resolution of textures and similar assets No Software / renderer / color space Metadata recorded at export time Yes Creation time Export time No Tags Free-form tag chips, addable and removable Yes Notes Multi-line description Yes Actions Click 「编辑」 (Edit) in the title row to start editing; click 「保存」 (Save) to apply or 「取消」 (Cancel) to revert. While editing, clicking an asset card saves and applies the changes immediately. Right-click an editable field for 「复制 / 复制 ID / 编辑」 (Copy / Copy ID / Edit) ; 「复制 ID」 (Copy ID) copies the asset ID from meta.json . Double-click a tag chip or click 「+ 添加标签」 (+ Add tag) to open the tag dialog, where you can type a new tag or pick a common one. Tips Category and asset type are read-only in edit mode; to change the category use 「移动到」 (Move to) in the context menu.

items.title: Preview panel
items.summary: The 「预览」 (Preview) panel on the right shows the current asset's thumbnails and offers capture, import, add and switching between several images. Interface Previ
items.text: The 「预览」 (Preview) panel on the right shows the current asset's thumbnails and offers capture, import, add and switching between several images. Interface Preview area: shows the selected thumbnail; GIF/MP4 thumbnails animate. When the mouse is inside and the asset has several thumbnails, arrows appear on both sides; the wheel also switches. With several images, current / total and 「删除」 (Delete) appear below; Delete is available only for the second slot onwards, the main thumbnail cannot be deleted here. Button row: 「截取」 (Capture) , 「导入」 (Import) , 「添加」 (Add) , 「截取添加」 (Capture and add) . Actions Select an asset in the grid and the preview panel loads its thumbnail list automatically. 「截取」 (Capture) opens the screenshot tool to drag a region; 「导入」 (Import) picks a local image to replace the current one. 「添加」 (Add) imports an image as a new thumbnail slot; 「截取添加」 (Capture and add) writes a screenshot into a new slot. Right-clicking the preview opens the same 「更新缩略图」 (Update thumbnail) menu as the asset card (capture, import, Maya playblast, render, add, capture and add, background render). Double-clicking the preview opens the asset details; when the asset has several versions it opens the version browser. Verify the result Afterwards the preview refreshes immediately, the counter and arrow states follow with several images, and the thumbnail on the grid card updates too. Tips Multiple thumbnails cycle automatically (about every 2 seconds); hovering the preview pauses the cycle, and a playing video is not interrupted.

items.title: Asset details
items.summary: 「资产详情」 (Asset details) opens a separate 「资产观察」 (Asset inspector) window that gathers the large image, several thumbnails and the complete metadata. How to open
items.text: 「资产详情」 (Asset details) opens a separate 「资产观察」 (Asset inspector) window that gathers the large image, several thumbnails and the complete metadata. How to open it Right-click an asset card and choose 「资产详情」 (Asset details) at the very bottom of the menu. Double-click the preview image in the preview panel. For assets with several versions the 「版本浏览器」 (Version browser) opens instead. Window contents Two columns with a draggable divider in between: Left column (preview) A square preview area on top: the current thumbnail at full size, the wheel switches when there are several, and GIF / MP4 animate. A thumbnail strip below, shown only when there are several thumbnails ; clicking switches the main image and the current one is highlighted. The preview can be dragged straight into the Maya viewport to import, using the same path as dragging an asset card. Right column (scrollable information cards) Card Contents Title card Asset name (large heading) plus the category breadcrumb Details card Two columns of label / value: node type, asset type, size, resolution, software, renderer, color space, animation format, creation time (whichever exist) Formats card Format chips of the importable files inside the asset (such as zmetal, ma) Tags card All tags of the asset as chips; the whole card hides when there are none Notes card The note text, selectable and copyable; the whole card hides when empty Path card Full path of the asset on disk, selectable and copyable; the whole card hides when unavailable Right-clicking the preview inside this window opens exactly the same asset context menu as the grid , except that 「资产详情」 (Asset details) is no longer there, to avoid opening an identical window again. Verify the result The window title shows the asset name and the divider can be dragged to resize the columns. Switching thumbnails only changes the preview on the left; the information on the right still describes the current asset. Tips The default window size is computed from the screen and the interface scale; dragging the divider adjusts the column ratio, with the left column absorbing width changes while the right column keeps a fixed width. Asset details are read-only; change the name, tags and notes back in the properties panel.

items.title: Complete context menu
items.summary: The context menu of an asset card is generated from the sub-library plus the context menu presets in settings. Every sub-library has a different menu : the firs
items.text: The context menu of an asset card is generated from the sub-library plus the context menu presets in settings. Every sub-library has a different menu : the first few rows are specific to the sub-library, and below them come the shared items. This page gives one table for comparison; what each item actually does is described in the "Menu reference" pages 15.5.2 to 15.5.12 . Menu structure from top to bottom Section Contents Present in every sub-library ① Sub-library specific Import / add reference / apply… / convert import / create material / import texture / create environment light / import to timeline… Only some sub-libraries have them, see the table ② Favorites and selection Add to favorites, select all, copy, open folder All 11 sub-libraries ③ Organize Move to, copy to All ④ Maintain Edit, update thumbnail, update asset, delete, format conversion Almost all, a few sub-libraries lack items ⑤ View and AI Preview nodes, AI thumbnail analysis Preview nodes depends on a node file existing in the asset ⑥ Closing Asset details All, always at the very bottom 1. Sub-library specific section (different for each) Sub-library Specific items Materials (materials) Import ▶ (zmetal / ma), add reference, assign material to current selection, apply material parameters, convert import ▶ (18 target material types) Models (models) Import ma, add reference Lights (lights) Import ▶ (zlight / ma), add reference, apply light parameters to the selected light, convert import ▶ (including 「原地还原」 (in-place restore) , which rebuilds as the original type) Textures (textures) Assign material to current selection, create material ▶, import texture ▶, assign texture to material, open image Scenes (scenes) Import ma, add reference HDR (hdr) Import hdr, create environment light ▶, assign texture, open image Dynamics (ani) Import ▶ (ma / abc), add reference ▶ (ma / abc) Images (images) Import as file node, create imagePlane, assign to selected material slot, open image Audio (audio) Import to timeline, import to Time Editor, import to Trax Editor, import to camera sequencer Animation data (animation) Import animation ▶, import animation (hierarchy mapping)…, import to selected attributes ▶ Node trees (nodetree) Import ma, add reference Two points to keep in mind while reading the table: Textures, images, audio and animation data have no generic "import" / "add reference" : their imports are the specific entries of their own kind (import texture / import as file node / import to timeline / import animation), so the menu is not broken. Submenu contents follow the asset's contents : when only one format exists the entry is a single line such as 「导入 ma」 (Import ma) ; with several formats (for example zmetal + ma for materials, or ma + abc for dynamics) it becomes an 「导入 ▶」 (Import ▶) submenu. 2. Shared section (all 11 sub-libraries) Menu item Effect 「添加到收藏夹」 (Add to favorites) A submenu lists the default collection and your own collections; click to add, click again to remove 「全选 / 复制 / 打开文件夹」 (Select all / Copy / Open folder) Select every visible card / put the asset on the clipboard / open the asset directory in the file manager 「移动到 / 复制到」 (Move to / Copy to) Cascades to a target category: move takes it away, copy makes a second one 「编辑」 (Edit) Change the Chinese name, category, tags and notes 「更新缩略图」 (Update thumbnail) Submenu, see the next section 「更新资产」 (Update asset) Submenu, see the next section; images and audio do not have this row 「删除」 (Delete) Submenu: move to the recycle bin (restorable) / delete permanently (not restorable) 「AI 分析缩略图」 (AI thumbnail analysis) Let AI read the thumbnail and suggest a category, tags, a Chinese name and notes 「资产详情」 (Asset details) Opens the version browser when the asset has versions or variants, otherwise the asset inspector window 3. How shared items differ between sub-libraries Item Differences Update thumbnail Materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, dynamics, node trees: 7 items (including 「后台渲染」 (Background r

items.title: Keyword search
items.summary: Type a name, tag or ID fragment into the top search box and the grid filters matching assets within the current category immediately. Prerequisites An asset lib
items.text: Type a name, tag or ID fragment into the top search box and the grid filters matching assets within the current category immediately. Prerequisites An asset library is open and a sub-library or category is selected in the left tree; the search only covers that scope. 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) is unchecked. When it is checked, typing does not filter live and you must press Enter to run a semantic search. Steps Select the sub-library or category to search in the left tree. Type a keyword in the top search box. About 150 ms after you stop typing the grid refreshes, no Enter needed. Separate several keywords with spaces, for example metal arnold ; any matching fragment counts. Click the ✕ on the right of the search box to clear the keyword and restore every asset of the current category. What is matched Matched against Notes Asset ID Full ID or a prefix; no arbitrary substring matching Display name and name Case-insensitive Tags A hit when any tag contains the keyword Material type, asset type, sub-library Includes sub-library display names (such as 「材质」 (Materials) ) Category Includes category display names Export format, software, renderer, color space A hit when the field value contains the keyword Verify the result The status bar shows the visible count and the total. The grid keeps only matching assets and is empty when nothing matches. Clicking ✕ returns to the complete list of the current category. 提示 Keyword search combines with tag filtering: when both are active an asset must satisfy both. 警告 With 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) checked, typing a non-empty keyword does not trigger the ordinary filter; press Enter or uncheck it first.

items.title: Tag filtering
items.summary: Click a tag chip in the properties panel, or check tags in the 「编辑标签」 (Edit tags) window, and the grid keeps only assets that carry all of those tags. Prerequis
items.text: Click a tag chip in the properties panel, or check tags in the 「编辑标签」 (Edit tags) window, and the grid keeps only assets that carry all of those tags. Prerequisites An asset with tags is selected, so the properties panel on the right shows tag chips. Tags combine as "all must match" in a real asset library, not "any of them". Steps Select an asset in the grid; the properties panel lists its tags. Click a tag chip to filter by that tag only; click the same tag again to remove it. Hold Ctrl and click several tags to apply them all at once. You can also click 「编辑标签」 (Edit tags) in the toolbar to open the tag window, click chips to toggle them and click 「清除筛选」 (Clear filters) to remove them all. Clicking the ✕ in the search box, or deleting the keyword in it, also clears the tag filter. Verify the result The grid shows only assets carrying all selected tags. The 「编辑标签」 (Edit tags) toolbar button stays highlighted while a tag filter is active. The selected tag text is written into the search box and a clickable ✕ appears. 注意 In the current version the 「用标签筛选」 (Filter by tags) dropdown inside the search bar is temporarily hidden; filter tags through 「编辑标签」 (Edit tags) in the toolbar or the tag chips in the properties panel. 提示 Tag matching is case-insensitive; filtering only affects what is displayed and never changes the asset's tags.

items.title: AI semantic search
items.summary: With 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) checked, describe the asset you want in one sentence and press Enter; the plug-in searches by meaning instead of literal matches. Prere
items.text: With 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) checked, describe the asset you want in one sentence and press Enter; the plug-in searches by meaning instead of literal matches. Prerequisites An asset library is open; otherwise the status bar says 「请先打开一个资产库再使用 AI 搜索」 (open an asset library before using AI search) . 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) is checked on the right of the search box. The switch is on by default and remembers your last choice. Steps Check 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) on the right of the search box; the placeholder becomes "describe the asset you are looking for in one sentence, press Enter for AI search". Type a natural-language description, for example "old metal with some grime" or "coarse cloth that would work as a carpet". Press Enter. A spinner appears in the middle of the grid and the status bar shows 「AI 正在分析意图…」 (AI is analyzing the intent…) . Wait for the results to replace the grid. To cancel, clear the search box or click the built-in ✕. How it works Local semantic retrieval comes first: local embedding vectors and lexical results are ranked together, and no large model is called at query time. When local semantics are unavailable or return nothing, a large model extracts keywords and those are searched against names, tags and notes. If the keywords still return nothing, the original text is tokenized and searched once more, so "using AI" never makes results worse. Verify the result With local semantic hits the status bar reads 「语义检索 N 条 · 本地嵌入 模型名 · 毫秒数」 (semantic: N results · local embedding <model> · <ms>) . When a large model extracted keywords it reads 「AI 搜索「关键词」：找到 N 个资产」 (AI search "<keywords>": N assets found) . The grid keeps only the results, and the properties panel on the right clears because the selection was cleared. Scope The search scope matches the selected sub-library or category; with a specific category selected it searches only that category and its sub-categories. Typing does not filter live — you must press Enter; clearing the input restores the current category list immediately. 提示 Index status, switches and model configuration are described in "Index status and search settings". When the index is unavailable, search degrades automatically and keeps working.

items.title: Search by image (upload, screenshot, drag)
synonyms: record a clip to find music
items.summary: 注意 About the name. The entry on the left of the search box now covers images, video and audio ; "search by image" is the historical name. This page keeps the ol
items.text: 注意 About the name. The entry on the left of the search box now covers images, video and audio ; "search by image" is the historical name. This page keeps the old title but describes the buttons that actually exist. Whether you upload an image, take a screenshot, record a section of the screen or record system audio, the plug-in finds assets in the current category by visual or acoustic similarity . Prerequisites An asset library is open and 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) is checked on the right of the search box. When unchecked, the upload / capture buttons on the left of the search box are hidden . The search scope follows the selected sub-library or category; when the current category does not cover that media type, it falls back to the whole library. The first video / audio search loads the embedding model (about 10–20 seconds, then seconds per query). Buttons on the left of the search box change with the category Current category Buttons inside the box Materials / models / lights / textures / scenes / HDR / node trees / images Upload, screenshot, screen recording Dynamics / animation data Upload, screenshot, screen recording (find similar animation by picture) Audio (music) Upload, screenshot, audio recording (records what this computer is playing, not the microphone) 「上传」 (Upload) is not a single button but a small menu: upload image search / upload video search / upload audio search , and the choice decides the retrieval route. Steps Upload a file : click the upload icon on the left of the input box → choose 「上传图片搜索 / 上传视频搜索 / 上传音频搜索」 (Upload image search / video search / audio search) → pick a file. Images: png, jpg, jpeg, webp, bmp, tif, tiff Video: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, gif Audio: wav, mp3, aiff, aif, flac, ogg, m4a, aac Screenshot search : click the 「截屏搜索」 (Screenshot search) icon, drag a region on screen and release to start; hold Ctrl while dragging to lock a square, and press Esc or right-click to cancel. Screen recording search (dynamics / animation data): after dragging a region a record button appears at its bottom right — click once to start recording, click again to stop, and the search runs automatically. The limit is about 10 seconds, longest edge 960 px, 15 fps; Esc / right-click cancels. Audio recording search (audio): click 「录制系统声音搜索」 (Record system audio search) to record what this computer is playing ; the interface shows 「录音中 N 秒 / 上限 N 秒」 (recording N s / limit N s) , and 「停止并搜索」 (Stop and search) starts the search. A recording shorter than 0.5 seconds asks you to record again. Drag in : drop a local image / video / audio file, web media or a library asset card onto the search box and the matching search is chosen by actual format (an asset card uses its thumbnail; an asset without a thumbnail shows a hint). Text search for media : in the audio category typing a description such as "find some rain ambience" and pressing Enter runs "text search for music"; in the dynamics / animation data category a picture description runs "text search for video". The placeholder text changes with the category. Retrieval routes Query type Route Image ① image vector search (pixel similarity, preferred) → ② a vision model turns the image into one Chinese sentence and text semantics run → ③ a vision model extracts keywords and lexical search runs Video media vector search by picture features (frame sampling / fingerprints), hitting animation and dynamics assets with video thumbnails Audio media vector search by sound features, hitting audio assets States and results During the search the status bar shows 「AI 正在分析意图…」 (AI is analyzing the intent…) or that the embedding model is loading; afterwards it reports the route actually used, for example: Image search: 图片搜索：图像向量检索命中 N 个资产（xxx ms） / 按关键词「…」找到 N 个资产 / 按「…」识别后找到 N 个资产 ; Video / audio: 视频搜索：命中 N 个资产（xxx ms） / 音频搜索：命中 N 个资产（xxx ms） ; Text search for media: 文字搜音乐：命中 N 个音频（xxx ms） / 文字搜视频：命中 N 个动画（xxx ms） ; No results: 媒体搜索：未找到匹配资产 (or 文字搜视频：没有找到匹配的动画 ); Environment not ready: 媒体搜索暂

items.title: Search isolation and clearing
items.summary: A search only replaces what the grid currently shows; it never moves or modifies assets, and clearing it returns to the complete list of the current category. W
