items.text: A search only replaces what the grid currently shows; it never moves or modifies assets, and clearing it returns to the complete list of the current category. What isolation means Keyword search, AI semantic search and search by image all replace the grid with their result set. The existing selection is cleared, and the properties and preview panels on the right clear with it. Asset files, categories, tags and favorites never change because of a search. How to clear Search type Where to clear Result Keyword search Click the built-in ✕ in the search box, or delete the input Restores all assets of the current category AI semantic search Delete the input or click ✕ Restores the current category list immediately Search by image Click the query thumbnail, click ✕, or press Backspace with the caret at the front Restores the current category list; Backspace removes only the query image and keeps the text Steps Confirm the grid is in a search state: there is text or a query image in the search box, or the status bar shows a hit count. Click the ✕ on the right of the search box. Watch the grid return to all assets of the current category and the status bar show the new visible count. To remove only the query image and keep the keyword, put the caret at the very front of the search box and press Backspace. Verify the result The grid shows all assets of the current category again. The search box is empty, the query image is gone and the built-in ✕ is hidden. The status bar reports 「已取消以图搜图，恢复当前分类的全部资产」 (image search cancelled; restoring all assets of the current category) or the restored asset count. 注意 Switching category, switching tag filters or reloading data also ends image-search isolation automatically; no extra ✕ click is needed. 警告 Search results are only what is currently displayed. Before batch moving or batch deleting, clear the search and confirm which assets are actually selected.

items.title: Index status and search settings
items.summary: Semantic search and search by image rely on a local index maintained per asset library; confirm that the AI dependencies and the index are usable before trouble
items.text: Semantic search and search by image rely on a local index maintained per asset library; confirm that the AI dependencies and the index are usable before troubleshooting search results. Search-related settings Setting Where Default Effect AI search Checkbox on the right of the search box On When off, typing filters by plain keywords and the image-search buttons are hidden; the choice is remembered ai_search_use_global Model configuration in the AI search dialog Off When on, AI search may use the global model from Settings → AI (AI) for intent analysis ai_asset_semantic Configuration key On Master switch for asset-library semantic retrieval; off is the same as having no semantic capability ai_asset_semantic_sync Configuration key On Incrementally syncs the index automatically during search ai_asset_index_dir Configuration key Empty Empty means the index lives in the library's .squirrel_ai_index ; a local directory makes each library use its own sub-directory 注意 The three ai_asset_* keys are configuration-file entries and are not visible controls in the Settings window today; use "AI features and dependencies" below to install and check the matching dependencies. Inspecting and repairing the index Open Settings → AI → AI 功能与依赖 (AI features and dependencies) . Click 「AI 依赖检查」 (AI dependency check) to generate a report covering the asset-library index and the image index; it opens in Notepad. When dependencies are missing click 「一键安装 AI 功能与依赖」 (One-click install of AI features and dependencies) and follow the steps to add Ollama, the embedding models, the index and the optional sidecar. The command asset_semantic_status also shows the index entry count, dimensions, model, index directory, last sync and the reason it is unavailable. When the index lags or is missing, sync it with index_sync : kind=materials runs the incremental text index, kind=images runs the image index (which can be rebuilt fully) and both does both. How it runs The index is kept per library, and switching libraries warms up that library's index in the background; while warming up, search uses lexical results first and switches to semantic results when ready. Search performs lazy syncing and does not rescan the same library repeatedly within a short time; when no index exists, search degrades to lexical search. Verify the result asset_semantic_status reports the index as usable with the right entry count and model. During semantic search the status bar shows 「本地嵌入」 (local embedding) and a duration in milliseconds, meaning the local index was used. When the image index is usable, search by image reports 「图像向量检索命中」 (image vector hits) . 提示 The index is derived data and can safely be rebuilt; when several people share an asset library, point the index root at a local directory on each machine so the indexes do not overwrite each other. Changes to the index directory take effect after reopening the plug-in window.

items.title: Name, tags and notes
items.summary: Edit an asset's display name, tags and notes in the properties panel on the right; these fields decide whether keyword and semantic search can find the asset. P
items.text: Edit an asset's display name, tags and notes in the properties panel on the right; these fields decide whether keyword and semantic search can find the asset. Prerequisites An asset is selected in the grid. The fields to change are visible in the properties panel; an empty note shows a hint that it can be edited from the context menu. Steps Select the asset; the properties panel on the right shows name, type, category, format, tags and notes. Enter edit mode: click the edit button in the title row of the properties panel, or right-click a property value or empty space and choose 「编辑」 (Edit) . Change 「名称」 (Name) . This is the display name ( name_cn ), not the .zasset folder name. Change tags: click 「+ 添加标签」 (+ Add tag) , type a new tag in the dialog or click a common tag to add it; click ✖ on a tag to remove it. Change notes: write the description in the 「注释」 (Notes) box. Click save (✓) to apply or cancel (✕) to discard; clicking outside the panel while editing also applies the changes. Verify the result The grid card title updates to the new display name immediately. The properties panel shows the new tags and notes. Searching by the new name or tag finds the asset. 提示 Tag chips in display mode can be clicked to filter directly, and Ctrl selects several; no edit mode needed. 警告 Do not rename .zasset folders in Explorer. When the file name must change, use 「批量重命名」 (Batch rename) and choose 「文件名」 (File name) as the target.

items.title: Common tags
items.summary: Common tags are a shortcut tag library maintained per asset type; a tag typed in the properties panel is added automatically and can then be picked with one cli
items.text: Common tags are a shortcut tag library maintained per asset type; a tag typed in the properties panel is added automatically and can then be picked with one click in properties, batch tagging and the right-click editor. What it is Common tags are not a field on an asset but a table of candidate tags stored separately per sub-library. They are stored per sub-library: materials, models, textures, lights, scenes, HDR and dynamics each have their own list; images, audio, animation data and node trees currently have no preset common tags (tags used there are collected automatically as you type). They serve 「+ 添加标签」 (+ Add tag) in the properties panel, the batch tag dialog and the right-click edit dialog. Automatic collection Select an asset and enter property editing. Click 「+ 添加标签」 (+ Add tag) , type a tag that is not in the common tag library yet and add it. The plug-in writes it into the common tags of the current asset type and saves it to the configuration. The next time you tag an asset of the same type, the tag can be picked directly in the common tags area. Manual management Click 「编辑标签」 (Edit tags) in the toolbar to open the tag window for the current asset type. The top of the window lists every common tag of that type; clicking a chip toggles the filter. Type a new tag in the box at the bottom and click 「添加」 (Add) to add it to the common tag library. Right-click a tag chip and choose 「删除」 (Delete) to remove it from the common tag library. Verify the result Reopening the tag window still lists the newly added tag. The 「+ 添加标签」 (+ Add tag) dialog in the properties panel shows the new tag. After deleting a common tag it no longer appears among the candidates. 注意 Removing a tag from the common tag library does not remove it from assets that already carry it; remove those in the properties panel or with batch tagging. 提示 The batch tag dialog reads the common tags of the current sub-library, so maintaining common tags first makes organizing assets of the same kind much easier.

items.title: Batch tagging
items.summary: With several assets selected, open 「批量标签」 (Batch tags) in the batch operation bar to add or remove tags on all selected assets at once. Prerequisites At least t
items.text: With several assets selected, open 「批量标签」 (Batch tags) in the batch operation bar to add or remove tags on all selected assets at once. Prerequisites At least two assets are selected; the batch operation bar appears only with a multi-selection. The common tag list is most accurate when the selected assets come from the same sub-library. Adding tags Select several assets and click 「批量标签」 (Batch tags) in the batch operation bar. Keep the 「添加标签」 (Add tags) mode. Type tags in the box, separated by commas, or click common tag chips below to select them. 「全选」 (Select all) and 「取消全选」 (Deselect all) speed up working with common tags. Check 「操作预览」 (Operation preview) to confirm how many assets and tags are affected, then click 「应用」 (Apply) . Removing tags Choose 「删除标签」 (Remove tags) in the batch tag dialog. The window lists the union of the tags currently on all selected assets. Click a tag chip and it turns red to mark it for removal; click again to unmark it. Check the preview and click 「应用」 (Apply) . Verify the result When it finishes, the number of successes is shown, with failures appended to the same message. Asset cards and the properties panel show the updated tags. Filtering by a new tag finds these assets; removed tags no longer match. 注意 When adding, a tag that already exists on an asset is not added twice; removal matching is case-insensitive. 警告 Batch tagging writes straight into every selected asset; check the asset and tag counts in 「操作预览」 (Operation preview) before applying.

items.title: Adjust category and sub-library
items.summary: The category decides where an asset sits in the left category tree; the sub-library (asset type) decides whether it belongs to materials, models, textures or an
items.text: The category decides where an asset sits in the left category tree; the sub-library (asset type) decides whether it belongs to materials, models, textures or another container. Changing the category Select the asset in the grid and choose 「编辑」 (Edit) from the context menu. Choose the target category in the 「分类」 (Category) dropdown of the edit dialog. The dropdown covers the whole category tree, so pick a category in the same sub-library; moving across sub-libraries is described below. Click 「保存」 (Save) . The plug-in moves the asset's .zasset directory and writes the metadata back. The category tree and grid refresh and the asset appears in its new category. Batch changing the category Multi-select assets within the same sub-library. Click 「批量移动」 (Batch move) in the batch operation bar. Choose the target category in the list and confirm. When it finishes the grid reloads and the counts of the old and new categories change together. About sub-libraries 「资产类型」 (Asset type) in the properties panel is a read-only display showing which sub-library the asset belongs to. The current interface offers no direct way to switch sub-libraries; moving across sub-libraries can be done with the sub_library parameter of the edit command (that entry is not exposed in the UI; whether it will be added is to be confirmed). A cross-sub-library move really moves the .zasset files and can be combined with a target category. Verify the result The target category's asset count grows and the original one shrinks. The asset no longer appears in the original category. The 「分类」 (Category) field shows the new display name; after a cross-sub-library move 「资产类型」 (Asset type) shows the new sub-library. 警告 Do not move, copy or rename .zasset folders in Explorer, or the plug-in index will lose track of the assets. 提示 To view assets differently for a moment you do not need to move categories; use search or tag filtering instead.

items.title: Background render (local and headless)
items.summary: 注意 This item is called 「后台渲染」 (Background render) in both the menu and the dialog title (older versions called it 「生成缩略图」 (Generate thumbnail) ). It renders off
items.text: 注意 This item is called 「后台渲染」 (Background render) in both the menu and the dialog title (older versions called it 「生成缩略图」 (Generate thumbnail) ). It renders offscreen in a separate mayapy process, without occupying the current viewport or modifying the current scene , so you can keep working in Maya. Which sub-libraries have it Sub-library Background render inside the context menu's update thumbnail ▶ Materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, dynamics, node trees Yes HDR, animation data No (update thumbnail has only 6 items) Images, audio Not even the whole update thumbnail row If you cannot find the item, check two things: whether the current sub-library is in the "Yes" row above , and whether background render for that sub-library is switched off in Settings → 右键菜单 (Context menu) . Two ways to run it Mode Where Notes Background (headless) Context menu → update thumbnail → background render Starts a separate mayapy process to render; good for filling in many thumbnails without interrupting your work Local Capture, Maya playblast, render, render on export Runs inside the Maya process and occupies the current viewport; see the following pages Prerequisites An asset is selected in the grid; a multi-selection processes every selected item (a single selection processes the one you right-clicked). mayapy must be findable on the machine; otherwise the plug-in says so and stops. Material, texture and light assets have no geometry of their own, so a preset model must be chosen in the dialog as the subject to shoot. Steps Right-click an asset card (or select several first and then right-click) and open 「更新缩略图 → 后台渲染」 (Update thumbnail → Background render) . Choose the options in the background render dialog in order (each is described in the table below). Click 「开始生成」 (Start) . While rendering, watch the headless job progress window (see below): it shows which asset is being processed, the percentage and the image that was just produced. When everything finishes a report appears: successes / failures, failure reasons, and which renderer, environment light and quality this batch used — for materials / textures / lights it also names the preset model. Successful items are written back as thumbnails, and grid cards and the right-hand preview refresh immediately. What the dialog contains Area / control Purpose Notes Title and description "Background render" plus "Headless render: starts a separate mayapy process; does not occupy the current viewport or change the current scene." — Renderer Which renderer produces this batch Renderers unavailable on this machine are greyed out with the reason Preset model The subject to shoot for assets without geometry of their own , such as materials, textures and lights Models and scenes have their own geometry, so this block is hidden entirely; the list comes from the same source as Create asset → Create model Environment light (HDRI) Check "use HDRI environment light" and pick one, or choose "no IBL" Not shown for light assets (a light is its own source); the description says HDRI only provides environment lighting with spherical projection and never enters the background, so the render has a transparent background Size 256 / 384 / 512 / 768 / 1024 square Defaults to Settings → 常规 → 默认缩略图大小 (General → Default thumbnail size) Quality Fast / Standard / High Maps to the current renderer's own sampling settings: higher is cleaner and slower Restore defaults Restores the renderer / preset model / environment light selection / size / quality to factory values Only affects this dialog ; values are written back to settings after clicking Start Cancel / Start Abandon / start rendering — During rendering: the headless job progress window Clicking 「开始生成」 (Start) opens a non-modal progress window (it does not block your work) with three things: A status line (preparing / which asset is rendering / current stage); A progress bar (advancing by the number of assets in the batch); A preview of the most recent image

items.title: Capture a thumbnail
items.summary: Drag a region of the screen with the mouse to use as the asset thumbnail; handy for quickly recording a viewport look or an existing reference image. Two captur
items.text: Drag a region of the screen with the mouse to use as the asset thumbnail; handy for quickly recording a viewport look or an existing reference image. Two capture entry points Entry Characteristics 「截取」 (Capture) button in the preview panel Full-screen marquee and immediate capture, with no toolbar and no recording; the result is saved at the default thumbnail size Context menu → update thumbnail → capture The full screenshot tool with toolbar options such as width and height, forced resolution and screen recording Steps (quick capture from the preview panel) Select the asset and click 「截取」 (Capture) at the bottom of the right-hand preview panel. The screen dims; drag a region and release to capture; hold Ctrl while dragging to lock a square. Press Esc or right-click to cancel. The screenshot is scaled proportionally by its long edge to the 「默认缩略图大小」 (Default thumbnail size) and written as the asset's main thumbnail. Steps (full screenshot tool) Right-click the asset and choose 「更新缩略图 → 截取」 (Update thumbnail → Capture) . Marquee a region on the screenshot overlay; the toolbar lets you adjust width and height and check forced resolution. Click the capture button to confirm; the result becomes the main thumbnail and is copied to the system clipboard. For processing several assets in a row the tool stays open; 「截取添加」 (Capture and add) writes into a new extra slot. Verify the result The grid card and the right-hand preview show the new image immediately. After capturing with the full screenshot tool the same image is on the system clipboard. With 「截取添加」 (Capture and add) the thumbnail counter in the preview panel increases. 注意 The full screenshot tool also offers a screen-recording button; the recording becomes an animated .aicon thumbnail and depends on the bundled ffmpeg. 警告 「截取」 (Capture) replaces the main thumbnail. To keep the old main image, use 「截取添加」 (Capture and add) to write a new slot instead.

items.title: Rendered and playblast thumbnails
items.summary: A playblast grabs the viewport quickly, a render uses the current renderer for high quality; both can use the current frame or the timeline. Comparing the two s
items.text: A playblast grabs the viewport quickly, a render uses the current renderer for high quality; both can use the current frame or the timeline. Comparing the two sources Source Speed Quality Best for Maya playblast Fairly fast Viewport image Models, scenes, assets that need an animated preview Render Slower Current renderer quality Materials, lights, assets that need a clean cover image Steps Right-click the asset and choose 「更新缩略图 → Maya拍屏」 (Update thumbnail → Maya playblast) or 「更新缩略图 → 渲染图」 (Update thumbnail → Render) . Choose 「当前帧」 (Current frame) or 「时间轴」 (Timeline) in the frame mode dialog. Wait for the render. The current frame produces a single still thumbnail; the timeline produces a sequence compiled into an MP4 and also keeps the first frame as a still. It is written back as a thumbnail automatically and the card and preview refresh. Execution details A playblast temporarily turns off the camera gate and mask decorations and temporarily isolates the target object, restoring everything afterwards. A render creates a temporary render layer that renders only the target object, then deletes the temporary layer and restores the scene state. In the standalone edition or when driving a remote Maya, the job is delegated to the target Maya and the result is read back. Verify the result The card and the right-hand preview show the new image. With the timeline chosen the thumbnail becomes an animation or multi-frame preview that can be stepped through in the preview panel. After rendering, temporary isolated objects, render layers and camera decorations in the scene are restored. 警告 Rendering takes a while; do not operate Maya or switch scenes during a render or the output may be interrupted. 提示 Use a playblast to glance at the result quickly; use a render when you need a clean, presentable cover.

items.title: Import a thumbnail image
items.summary: Turn an existing image into an asset thumbnail: 「导入」 (Import) replaces the main image, 「添加」 (Add) puts the image into a new extra slot. Two ways to import Mode
items.text: Turn an existing image into an asset thumbnail: 「导入」 (Import) replaces the main image, 「添加」 (Add) puts the image into a new extra slot. Two ways to import Mode Where Result Import (replace) Context menu → update thumbnail → import; or 「导入」 (Import) in the preview panel Overwrites the main thumbnail Add (new slot) Context menu → update thumbnail → add; or 「添加」 (Add) in the preview panel Every file becomes a new extra slot Steps (replace the main image) Select the asset and choose 「更新缩略图 → 导入」 (Update thumbnail → Import) from the context menu, or click 「导入」 (Import) in the preview panel. Pick an image file. Supported extensions include .sicon , .jpg , .jpeg , .aicon , .bmp . After confirming, the plug-in writes the image into the main thumbnail location. Grid cards and the preview panel refresh automatically. Steps (add a new slot) Choose 「更新缩略图 → 添加」 (Update thumbnail → Add) from the context menu, or click 「添加」 (Add) in the preview panel. Several files can be chosen at once. In addition to the extensions above, .png is supported. After confirming, every file becomes a new slot and the preview panel jumps to the last one. Switch between them with the arrows, the mouse wheel or the counter at the bottom. Verify the result The preview panel shows the newly imported image. After replacing the main image the card cover changes too. After adding several images the counter changes from 1/1 to n/n and the delete button becomes available. 注意 Importing only copies the image content into the asset directory; it never moves or modifies the original file you picked. 警告 「导入」 (Import) overwrites the existing main thumbnail and does not keep the old image. Use 「添加」 (Add) when several images must be kept.

items.title: Multiple thumbnail slots and deletion
items.summary: An asset can have several thumbnails: the first is the main image and the rest are extra slots; the preview panel switches between them and deletes extra images
items.text: An asset can have several thumbnails: the first is the main image and the rest are extra slots; the preview panel switches between them and deletes extra images. Slot rules The main image is the first one, named thumb.sicon , thumb.aicon , thumb.png or thumb.mp4 . Extra images start from the second, named thumb_2.sicon , thumb_3.sicon and so on. Folder assets that are not .zasset use <asset name>.sicon , <asset name>_2.sicon and so on. The main image cannot be deleted; it can only be replaced by capture or import. Switching Select an asset with several thumbnails; the preview panel shows the counter n/n at the bottom. Click the arrows on either side of the preview, or scroll the wheel while hovering it. With several images the preview cycles automatically about every 2 seconds; hovering the preview or a playing animation pauses it. Double-clicking the preview opens the asset inspector window for a larger view. Deleting an extra image Switch to the extra image to delete and confirm the counter is not 1/n . Click 「删除」 (Delete) at the bottom of the preview panel. The image file is deleted from the asset directory immediately and the preview returns to the remaining images. Verify the result After deleting, the counter drops by one and the remaining images can still be switched. With only one image left the counter and delete button hide and the arrows disappear. The main image always exists, so the card cover is unaffected. 警告 Deleting an extra thumbnail has no second confirmation and does not go to the recycle bin; confirm that the current counter is not the main image before deleting. 提示 To use another image as the cover, use 「导入」 (Import) on the target image to overwrite the main image instead of deleting the main image.

items.title: Output size
items.summary: 「默认缩略图大小」 (Default thumbnail size) is the long-edge pixel size shared by generated and captured thumbnails; the factory value is 512. Where to set it Open Setti
items.text: 「默认缩略图大小」 (Default thumbnail size) is the long-edge pixel size shared by generated and captured thumbnails; the factory value is 512. Where to set it Open Settings → 常规 (General) . Find 「默认缩略图大小」 (Default thumbnail size) in the 「缩略图」 (Thumbnails) group. Pick one of 256, 384, 512, 768 or 1024. Save the settings. The new value applies to thumbnails generated or captured afterwards. Where it applies Scenario How the size is used Background render As the output edge length; also changeable in the background render dialog Maya playblast, render Edge length of the output image Quick capture from the preview panel The screenshot is scaled proportionally by its long edge to this value Full screenshot tool As the initial width and height, adjustable temporarily in the toolbar HDR / model / PBR to asset Used when quick tools produce thumbnails Export asset Used when the export flow produces thumbnails Verify the result Generated thumbnails are output at the chosen edge length; captured ones scale proportionally by the long edge, so the short edge follows the picture ratio and may not be square. A larger preview looks sharper, and the file size grows accordingly. Old thumbnails are not redone automatically; only regenerating or recapturing uses the new size. 注意 Changing the size in the background render dialog also writes it back to Settings → 常规 → 默认缩略图大小 (General → Default thumbnail size) ; both entries share one value. 提示 This size is the size of the thumbnail file itself, not how large cards appear in the grid; adjust card size with the toolbar slider.

items.title: Batch move and copy
items.summary: After multi-selecting assets you can move them all into another category within the same sub-library, or copy them into another category. Prerequisites At least
items.text: After multi-selecting assets you can move them all into another category within the same sub-library, or copy them into another category. Prerequisites At least two assets are selected; the batch operation bar appears with a multi-selection. The target category must already exist in the current sub-library. The target list is based on the sub-library of the first selected asset. Batch move and copy do not work across sub-libraries. Batch move Multi-select assets in the grid. Click 「批量移动」 (Batch move) in the batch operation bar. Choose a category in the 「选择目标分类」 (Choose target category) list and confirm. The plug-in moves the assets one by one, then rescans and refreshes the grid. Batch copy Multi-select assets and click 「批量复制」 (Batch copy) in the batch operation bar. Choose the target category and confirm. A copy of each asset is created in the target category; copies are renamed automatically and get new asset IDs. The originals stay in their original category. Verify the result The asset count of the target category grows. After a batch move the assets no longer appear in the original category; after a batch copy both categories hold one. The category tree and grid refresh automatically afterwards. 警告 Batch move and copy really move or copy .zasset directories. Confirm the target category before running, and never move them with Explorer. 提示 An empty target list means the current sub-library has no categories yet; create one in the category tree first.

items.title: Batch delete
items.summary: Batch delete moves the selected assets into the recycle bin , from where they can be restored through 「回收站」 (Recycle bin) on the left; still confirm the selecti
items.text: Batch delete moves the selected assets into the recycle bin , from where they can be restored through 「回收站」 (Recycle bin) on the left; still confirm the selection first, because one action affects the whole batch. Prerequisites At least two assets are selected; use the context menu for a single asset. The recycle bin has room (100 GB limit; when full, permanently delete old entries in the recycle bin first). Steps Multi-select the assets to delete in the grid. Click 「批量删除」 (Batch delete) in the batch operation bar. The confirmation lists the first 20 asset names and shows the total; the rest are summarized as "N in total". Click 「是」 (Yes) after checking, or 「否」 (No) to cancel. The plug-in moves the assets into the recycle bin one by one, clearing their favorite state and refreshing the grid and category counts. Difference from deleting one asset For a single asset use 「删除」 (Delete) in the context menu; the confirmation shows one name and lets you choose between "move to recycle bin" and "delete permanently". Batch delete has one path only: into the recycle bin , with no "delete permanently" entry; to remove something for good use 「删除 → 彻底删除」 (Delete → Delete permanently) in the context menu. Batch delete runs item by item; a failure in the middle does not roll back the part already deleted, and failure reasons go to the log. Verify the result The assets disappear from the current grid and the category's asset count drops. The count on the 「回收站」 (Recycle bin) entry on the left grows, and the entries are visible inside. Right-clicking an entry in the recycle bin and choosing 「还原」 (Restore) returns the asset to its original category, where it reappears in the grid. 警告 Batch delete goes to the recycle bin and can be restored , so unlike "delete permanently" it is reversible; but the recycle bin is limited to 100 GB and never cleans itself, so when full you must permanently delete entries one by one. "Delete permanently" is not available from this entry and cannot be undone. Still read the names and counts in the confirmation dialog carefully. 提示 Restore from the recycle bin immediately after a mistake (the whole record comes back). When unsure whether an asset is still needed, moving it to a category such as "to be sorted" is easier than deleting and restoring.

items.title: Batch rename
items.summary: Batch rename uses a prefix, a suffix or find-and-replace to change the display names or file names of several assets at once. Prerequisites At least two assets
items.text: Batch rename uses a prefix, a suffix or find-and-replace to change the display names or file names of several assets at once. Prerequisites At least two assets are selected and the batch operation bar is visible. The rename target and rule are decided; the operation writes straight into the asset metadata. Steps Multi-select assets and click 「批量重命名」 (Batch rename) in the batch operation bar. Choose the target in the 「重命名」 (Rename) dropdown: Display name ( name_cn ): changes only the name shown in the interface. File name ( name ): also renames the .zasset asset directory. Choose the mode: Add prefix: puts the typed text in front of the old name. Add suffix: puts the typed text after the old name. Find and replace: fill in the search text and the replacement text. Check every "old name → new name" row in the preview list; unchanged rows are marked 「不变」 (unchanged) . The main button shows the changeable count and the total, for example 「执行重命名 (8/10)」 (Run rename (8/10)) ; it is disabled when the changeable count is 0. Click 「执行重命名」 (Run rename) ; the number of successes is reported and failures are appended to the same message. Verify the result Grid card names update immediately. The status message reports the number of successes and failures. With 「文件名」 (File name) chosen the asset directory names change too, and the renamed assets are still visible after reopening the library. 注意 Find and replace is a literal, case-sensitive replacement; prefixes and suffixes do not add separators automatically, so type a space or underscore yourself when needed. 警告 Never rename .zasset directories outside the plug-in. Always use this dialog for file-name mode.

items.title: Batch edit fields and tags
items.summary: The batch operation bar offers batch entries for tags, names and categories; fields such as notes, renderer and color space have no shared batch form yet. Field
items.text: The batch operation bar offers batch entries for tags, names and categories; fields such as notes, renderer and color space have no shared batch form yet. Fields that can be batch edited Field Entry Notes Tags Batch operation bar → batch tags Add tags or remove tags Display name, file name Batch operation bar → batch rename Prefix, suffix or find and replace Category Batch operation bar → batch move Change category within the same sub-library Name, tags, notes, category Applying AI batch analysis results Written in bulk from AI suggestions, see the AI tools chapter Batch adding or removing tags Multi-select assets and click 「批量标签」 (Batch tags) in the batch operation bar. Choose 「添加标签」 (Add tags) : type tags (comma separated) or click common tags, then click 「应用」 (Apply) . Choose 「删除标签」 (Remove tags) : click existing tags so they turn red, then click 「应用」 (Apply) . Check 「操作预览」 (Operation preview) for the asset and tag counts before running. Batch changing names and categories Rename: use 「批量重命名」 (Batch rename) , choose display name or file name, then prefix, suffix or find and replace. Change category: use 「批量移动」 (Batch move) and pick the target category from the current sub-library's list. Both operations reload the grid when they finish. Verify the result The properties panel shows the updated tags, name and category. Searching by the new tag or name finds these assets. The asset count of the target category grows in the category tree. 注意 Notes, material type, software, renderer and color space have no batch edit dialog; change them per asset in the properties panel, or write them one by one through the edit command. 警告 Batch writes overwrite the matching fields on the selected assets directly. Confirm the selection and check the operation preview first.

items.title: Adding and removing favorites
items.summary: Favoriting puts frequently used assets into a collection; the star on a card shows whether the asset belongs to the active collection , and the data is stored p
items.text: Favoriting puts frequently used assets into a collection; the star on a card shows whether the asset belongs to the active collection , and the data is stored per library in favorites.json . Prerequisites The asset library is loaded and the 「收藏」 (Favorites) tab is available on the left. The target collection exists. A missing collection is not created automatically, and the write is ignored. Steps Open the 「收藏」 (Favorites) tab on the left and select a collection in the list (the default is 「默认收藏夹」 (default collection) ). In the asset grid or list view click the star icon on a card; its tooltip reads "click to add / remove favorite". Clicking the same star again removes the favorite. You can also right-click an asset and choose 「添加到收藏夹」 (Add to favorites) , then pick a collection in the submenu: a filled gold star means it is in that collection, an outlined grey star means it is not. Verify the result The star toggles between filled and outlined and the count next to the collection changes. With that collection selected on the 「收藏」 (Favorites) tab the grid lists only its assets. In favorites.json in the library root the asset ID appears under the collection's materials entry. Tips 注意 The star writes into the active collection . Select the collection first and then click the star so assets are not filed into the wrong one. Favorites are stored per library: the main asset library and the project library each have their own, and the top of the panel shows the current library (main asset library / project library). A plain drag moves an asset into the target collection (removing it from others); holding Ctrl while dragging adds it and keeps the previous membership. The default collection cannot be deleted; on the command side use favorite ( op=list/add/remove/toggle ), which returns COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND when the collection does not exist.

items.title: Creating, editing and deleting collections
items.summary: A collection is a top-level container in the favorites panel; the default collection always exists, and other collections can be created, renamed, emptied and d
items.text: A collection is a top-level container in the favorites panel; the default collection always exists, and other collections can be created, renamed, emptied and deleted. Creating a collection Click + on the right of the 「收藏夹」 (Favorites) title (tooltip 「新建收藏夹」 (New collection) ), or right-click empty space in the list and choose 「新建收藏夹」 (New collection) . Type a name and confirm; the new entry appears in the list and is selected. Renaming Right-click a non-default collection and choose 「重命名」 (Rename) . Type the new name and confirm. Emptying a collection Right-click the collection and choose 「清空收藏夹」 (Empty collection) . Confirm in the 「确认清空」 (Confirm empty) dialog. Emptying removes only the favorite membership; the assets themselves are not deleted. Deleting a collection Right-click a non-default collection and choose 「删除收藏夹」 (Delete collection) . Confirm in the 「确认删除」 (Confirm delete) dialog. Only the container is deleted and the assets are unaffected; if the active collection was deleted the interface falls back to the default collection. Verify the result The names and counts in the favorites list update immediately. The collections entry in favorites.json in the library root grows, changes or shrinks accordingly. The changes are still there after reopening the plug-in. Tips 警告 The default collection offers no rename or delete entry; deleting a collection never deletes assets, but it does lose that collection's favorite memberships. A new collection's internal ID looks like fav_xxxxxxxx , and its display name can be changed at any time. On the command side use collection_manage : op=list/create/rename/delete/clear , with dry_run for previewing. Collections are stored per library, so after switching libraries you see that library's own collections.

items.title: Wishlist queue
items.summary: The wishlist is a cross-session "to look at" queue on the right of the AI search dialog; it is a single linear list and a separate organization tool from favori
items.text: The wishlist is a cross-session "to look at" queue on the right of the AI search dialog; it is a single linear list and a separate organization tool from favorites. Prerequisites The AI search dialog is open and an asset library is loaded (adding an item resolves the asset ID into an entry). Steps Right-click a card in the AI search results and choose 「加入心愿单」 (Add to wishlist) . You can also drag the result card straight into the 「心愿单」 (Wishlist) panel on the right. Clicking an entry locates the matching asset in the main window. Click the close icon at the top right of an entry (tooltip 「从心愿单移除」 (Remove from wishlist) ) to remove it. Click 「清空」 (Clear) at the top of the panel and confirm in 「确定清空全部心愿单吗？」 (Clear the whole wishlist?) to empty the queue. Verify the result The count next to the 「心愿单」 (Wishlist) title increases or decreases accordingly. Closing and reopening the dialog, or even restarting the plug-in, keeps the entries (stored under the user setting key ai_search_wishlist ). Tips Adding the same asset twice reports 「已在心愿单中：资产名」 (already in the wishlist: <asset name>) . The wishlist stores only display fields such as ID, name, path, sub-library, category and tags; it does not store a preview image. It is completely independent of favorites: starring an asset does not change the wishlist, and the wishlist is not grouped by collection. On the command side use wishlist : op=list/add/remove/clear , with dry_run ; add reports existing and missing IDs honestly.

items.title: Concepts and use cases
items.summary: A version is one content iteration of the same asset and a LOD is one geometry detail level inside a version; both are stored in the same .zasset . Key nouns Ma
items.text: A version is one content iteration of the same asset and a LOD is one geometry detail level inside a version; both are stored in the same .zasset . Key nouns Main version : the content in the asset root, including meta.json , node.* , textures/ and so on; every asset has a main version. Embedded version : the V1/ , V2/ directories inside the main asset, each a complete self-contained asset. The main asset's meta.json records {id, folder, label, tag} under version_assets . LOD : lod0 is the geometry in the root, and lod1 onward live in lod{n}/ sub-directories; the manifest is lods.json , created the first time a LOD is appended. Default version / default LOD : recorded in meta.json and lods.json respectively, and read by import and version management. Directory layout Crate.zasset/ ├── meta.json # includes the version_assets registry ├── node.ma # main version geometry (lod0) ├── lods.json # LOD manifest (lod1, lod2…) ├── V1/ # embedded version (complete and self-contained) │ ├── meta.json │ └── node.ma └── V2/ ├── meta.json └── node.ma Why it is organized this way Different forms of one asset do not need to become separate grid assets: content iterations go into versions, distance-based detail goes into LODs, and when materials must differ a version can carry its own materials. Use cases Need Dimension to use Fix damage, change UVs or reshape a model Create a new version High and low poly for games or rendering Append a LOD Different textures per version of the same model Per-version materials Several shapes under one set of textures (bricks, screws) Variants Just see what a version looks like Version browser 注意 Variants and versions are two parallel models: variants are recorded in the variants section of variants.json , their geometry sits flat under variants/ , and textures and materials are inherited from the asset root; embedded versions remain complete self-contained V{n}/ directories. The versions section of older assets is kept for read-only compatibility and is listed together with embedded versions. See the "Variants" section for variant usage.

items.title: Append a LOD
items.summary: Appending a LOD exports the currently selected low-poly geometry as a new detail level of an existing asset, written into lod{n}/ and registered in lods.json .
items.text: Appending a LOD exports the currently selected low-poly geometry as a new detail level of an existing asset, written into lod{n}/ and registered in lods.json . Prerequisites The geometry to use as the new LOD is selected in the Maya viewport. The target asset can be located in the library (right-click its thumbnail). At least one geometry format is checked in the export configuration: ma, mb, fbx, obj or usd. Steps Select the decimated or simplified geometry in Maya. Right-click the asset, expand 「更新资产」 (Update asset) and choose 「追加为 LOD」 (Append as LOD) . In the export dialog that follows, check a geometry format and confirm that the asset name, category and so on stay unchanged. Click export. The system takes the highest existing non-lod0 level plus one, writes lod{n}/ and updates lods.json . Verify the result An L badge appears at the top left of the asset card (when several LODs exist). Entering the asset through 「导入变体 / 版本」 (Import variant / version) (or 「导入版本 / LOD」 (Import version / LOD) when there are no variants) shows the new LOD and its face count. The lods array in lods.json in the asset root gains an entry. Tips 警告 With no geometry format checked it reports 「追加 LOD 需要导出几何体」 (appending a LOD requires exporting geometry) ; the flow aborts when the export result contains no geometry file. The target of an appended LOD follows the current entry: operate on the main asset in the grid, or select a version / LOD in the asset versions window first and then append. lod0 is the root geometry, and new levels start at lod1 and increase. After appending, a thumbnail is captured again to show the new LOD. A LOD can target a specific V{n} : select that version in the asset versions window and click 「追加 LOD」 (Append LOD) so the LOD is written into that version (selecting the main version adds it to the main asset).

items.title: Create a new version
items.summary: Creating a new version builds a complete self-contained V{n} directory inside the main asset and fills it with this export. Prerequisites The modified model or
items.text: Creating a new version builds a complete self-contained V{n} directory inside the main asset and fills it with this export. Prerequisites The modified model or material is ready in Maya. The objects to export are selected. A new version does not require geometry; exporting only materials or textures also works. Steps Select the modified model in the Maya viewport. Right-click the asset, expand 「更新资产」 (Update asset) and choose 「创建新版本」 (Create new version) . In the export dialog that follows, check the content you need (geometry formats, .zmetal and so on). Click export. The system takes the highest existing V{n} number plus one, first clones the main asset into a complete self-contained version, then replaces it entirely with this export. When it finishes the interface reports the version label (for example V2 ) and captures a separate thumbnail for that version. Verify the result A multi-version badge appears on the asset card. Double-clicking the preview on the right opens the version browser and the new V{n} appears in the 「版本」 (Versions) list on the left. version_assets in the main asset's meta.json gains a {id, folder, label, tag} entry. Tips Version directory names are always V{n} , the label defaults to the same text, and the semantic version defaults to {n}.0 . A new version contains exactly this export: unchecked content does not appear in that version's directory. 「追加 LOD」 (Append LOD) follows the currently selected entry: with a V{n} selected the LOD goes into that version, with the main version (the asset itself) selected it goes into the main asset. When versions need different materials, check .zmetal to give the version its own materials; see 4.10.5.

items.title: Switch version and LOD
items.summary: In 「导入版本 / LOD」 (Import version / LOD) in the asset context menu, choose version, LOD and format step by step to pick what to import into the scene. Prerequisit
items.text: In 「导入版本 / LOD」 (Import version / LOD) in the asset context menu, choose version, LOD and format step by step to pick what to import into the scene. Prerequisites The asset has several versions, or the main version itself has several LODs; otherwise the submenu is not shown. A Maya scene is open and the asset library is loaded. Steps Right-click the asset thumbnail and choose 「导入版本 / LOD」 (Import version / LOD) . Choose the version: 「主版本」 (Main version) , V1 , V2 and so on. Choose the LOD. Entries show the display name, the LOD ID and the face count. When one LOD has several geometry formats, choose the format. Click to import through the normal import pipeline. You can also double-click the preview on the right to open the version browser, select a version and click 「导入此版本」 (Import this version) to import it using one of its available formats. Verify the result The imported geometry appears in the Outliner. When the version directory contains .zmetal or .mcm the version submenu additionally lists a material entry; choosing it runs a material import. The import log shows the version directory and format. Tips With only one version there is nothing to switch, and the menu still lists "main version → LOD"; with only one LOD it lists geometry formats directly. Importing does not replace existing models in the scene; delete the old model by hand when a replacement is needed. Material files inside a version directory belong to that version; versions without their own materials use the main version's materials. Version information can be reviewed together in the version browser, see 4.10.7.

items.title: Per-version materials
items.summary: Check .zmetal when creating a new version and the materials and textures are written into that version directory, becoming materials that belong only to that ve
items.text: Check .zmetal when creating a new version and the materials and textures are written into that version directory, becoming materials that belong only to that version. Prerequisites The materials and textures for the new version are set up in Maya. The 「更新资产 → 创建新版本」 (Update asset → Create new version) flow is about to be used. Steps Prepare the materials and textures the new version needs in Maya. Select the modified model. Right-click the asset, expand 「更新资产」 (Update asset) and choose 「创建新版本」 (Create new version) . In the export dialog that follows, check .zmetal (and any needed geometry formats). Click export; the materials and textures are written into that version's V{n}/ directory. Verify the result node.zmetal appears in the version directory, along with textures/ when there are textures. Entering that version through 「导入变体 / 版本」 (Import variant / version) (or 「导入版本 / LOD」 (Import version / LOD) when there are no variants) shows and imports this material. After importing, the scene uses the new version's materials and textures, while the materials in the main asset root are unchanged. Tips Without .zmetal checked the version directory has no materials of its own and importing uses the main version's materials. Textures are exported together with the material; no separate texture option is needed. Per-version materials are only produced by 「创建新版本」 (Create new version) ; a plain LOD append does not change materials. To see exactly which files a version carries, check the path card in the version browser or the asset directory.

items.title: Delete versions and LODs
items.summary: A version can be deleted in the version browser; deleting removes the whole content of that version and cannot be undone. Deleting a version Double-click the as
items.text: A version can be deleted in the version browser; deleting removes the whole content of that version and cannot be undone. Deleting a version Double-click the asset preview on the right to open the version browser. Select the version to delete in the 「版本」 (Versions) list on the left. Click 「删除此版本」 (Delete this version) at the bottom. Choose yes in the 「确定要删除版本…」 (Delete version…?) confirmation. The list and the library refresh immediately. The main version entry has no delete action (the button is disabled). Verify the result The version browser's left column loses an item and version_assets in the main asset's meta.json drops the matching folder . The V{n}/ directory inside the main asset disappears from disk. After deleting the last version, has_versions and version_assets on the main asset are cleared. Tips 警告 Deleting a version removes its geometry, materials, textures and thumbnail together, and cannot be undone; back up the whole .zasset first for important versions. Deleting a single LOD: select the LOD entry in the asset versions window and click 「删除此 LOD」 (Delete this LOD) ; the button is disabled when only one LOD is left (at least one must remain), and the main version itself cannot be deleted. Variants are a separate model; their delete entries are 「更新资产 → 更新变体 → 删除变体」 (Update asset → Update variant → Delete variant) or 「变体管理…」 (Variant management…) , see "Variant management and deletion". On the command side, version_manage op=remove_version backs up the whole version directory to squirrel_ai_undo under the system temp directory before deleting and returns the backup path; copy that directory back into the main asset root to restore it. Versions deleted through the command can also be rolled back with undo_last .

items.title: Version browser
items.summary: The version browser uses three columns to review the versions, variants, thumbnails and properties of one asset family, and to import or delete versions and var
items.text: The version browser uses three columns to review the versions, variants, thumbnails and properties of one asset family, and to import or delete versions and variants. Prerequisites The asset has versions (the card shows a multi-version badge or has_versions is true), or it has variants (the variants section of variants.json is not empty). How to open it Double-click the asset preview on the right. With versions or variants the version browser opens; with neither, the asset inspector still opens. Interface Area Contents Left column, versions / variants The main version, the V1 , V2 … entries and the variant entries (shown as "variant · name"), all with thumbnails Middle, preview The thumbnail of the current entry; for a variant it shows that variant's thumbnail ; with several thumbnails use the wheel or the thumbnail strip at the bottom Right column, information Category breadcrumb, version and tag badges, details (size, resolution, renderer…), formats, tags, notes and path Bottom buttons For versions: 「导入此版本」 (Import this version) and 「删除此版本」 (Delete this version) ; for variants: 「导入此变体」 (Import this variant) and 「删除此变体」 (Delete this variant) Steps Click a version or variant in the left column; the preview in the middle and the information on the right follow. To import, click 「导入此版本」 (Import this version) or 「导入此变体」 (Import this variant) , which imports using the first available format of that entry. To delete a non-main version, click 「删除此版本」 (Delete this version) or 「删除此变体」 (Delete this variant) and confirm. Verify the result The window title shows the main asset name. The main version entry carries a 「主版本」 (main version) marker and its delete button is disabled. After deleting a version or variant the list refreshes, and the library in the main window refreshes too. Tips Neither versions nor variants take a grid entry of their own; they are only viewed here or in the context menu. A variant stores geometry only, so deleting a variant (or its thumbnail) never affects the textures and materials shared by the asset. Entries with several thumbnails can be stepped through with the wheel, and the strip highlights the current image. The window can be resized and maximized, and the layout scales with the interface font size.

items.title: Library list and switching
items.summary: The dropdown at the top of the main window's 「分类」 (Categories) tab lists every registered asset library; switching reloads that library and refreshes the catego
items.text: The dropdown at the top of the main window's 「分类」 (Categories) tab lists every registered asset library; switching reloads that library and refreshes the category tree and asset grid. Prerequisites At least one asset library is registered (usually true when the plug-in opens by default). The library directory to switch to actually exists on disk. Steps Open the 「分类」 (Categories) tab on the left. Click the asset library dropdown above the category tree; entries read "name — path". Choose the target library. Wait for it to load. Loading happens on a background thread, so the window does not freeze. Verify the result The dropdown and the status bar show the new library, and the category tree and asset grid switch to its contents. The Script Editor prints 「已切换资产库: 路径」 (switched asset library: <path>) . On the 「收藏」 (Favorites) tab the collections follow the current library. Tips 警告 When the library directory is missing the plug-in reports 「资产库路径不存在」 (the asset library path does not exist) and stays on the previous library. Fix or remove that entry in settings first. The load priority when the window opens is: explicitly given path → default library → last used library → order in the library list. "Library" here means the main asset library; 「项目」 (Projects) is a separate tab and the project library is not in this dropdown. Collections and favorites.json are stored per library, so switching never mixes data. On the command side use library_manage op=switch ; the switch writes last_library_path , and an open window refreshes its interface as well.

items.title: Add an existing library
items.summary: Adding an existing library registers a ready-made library directory on disk in the library list; it never copies, moves or modifies any file inside the library.
items.text: Adding an existing library registers a ready-made library directory on disk in the library list; it never copies, moves or modifies any file inside the library. Steps Open the Settings window, go to the 「常规」 (General) tab and find the 「资产库管理」 (Asset library management) group. Click 「添加资产库」 (Add asset library) . Pick the library root directory in the file dialog. Type a display name; the directory name is used by default. Click 「确定」 (OK) in the Settings window to save. Go back to the 「分类」 (Categories) page in the main window and choose that library in the dropdown to start using it. Verify the result The library appears in the settings list as "name — path". The same library appears in the main window's library dropdown. After switching, the library's assets load and nothing in the library root was changed. Tips Adding the same path twice reports 「该资产库已在列表中」 (this asset library is already in the list) ; path comparison normalizes slashes and case. It only registers the directory and does not validate the standard structure; a library root usually contains library.json and sub-library directories such as materials and models . Adding does not switch to it automatically; pick it in the library dropdown. On the command side library_manage op=add is equivalent and only accepts an existing directory; an unregistered path is first added to library_paths .

items.title: Create a new library
items.summary: Creating an asset library makes a standard library directory ( library.json plus six sub-libraries) and adds it to the library list. Steps Open the Settings win
items.text: Creating an asset library makes a standard library directory ( library.json plus six sub-libraries) and adds it to the library list. Steps Open the Settings window and go to the 「资产库管理」 (Asset library management) group on the 「常规」 (General) tab. Click 「创建资产库」 (Create asset library) . Choose the parent directory for the library. Type the asset library name; the default is SquirrelLib . Confirm and wait for the 「创建成功」 (created successfully) message. Click 「确定」 (OK) in the Settings window to save the list. Verify the result A folder named after the library appears under the parent directory. It contains library.json plus the six sub-library directories materials , models , lights , textures , scenes and hdr . Each sub-library directory contains a FolderMetadata.fdata . The new library shows up both in the settings list and in the main window's library dropdown. Tips 警告 Creating is refused when the target directory already exists; choose another name or clean up the same-named directory first. The first time the new library loads it completes the standard structure such as the 「自定义」 (Custom) sub-category and merges in the remaining built-in sub-libraries from the configuration (images, audio, animation data, node trees and so on) — that is why creating a library writes only six base directories, and loading / switching to it completes all 11 built-in sub-libraries. On the command side library_manage op=create accepts path or parent_dir + name ; on failure it rolls back the half-built directory and never leaves an empty library behind. It does not switch to the new library automatically; select it in the library dropdown.

items.title: Set as default
items.summary: The default library decides which library loads first the next time the asset library window opens; it is not the same as the "current library". Steps Open the
items.text: The default library decides which library loads first the next time the asset library window opens; it is not the same as the "current library". Steps Open the Settings window and go to the 「资产库管理」 (Asset library management) group on the 「常规」 (General) tab. Select the target library in the list. Click 「设为默认」 (Set as default) . A [默认] ([default]) marker appears after the list item. Click 「确定」 (OK) to save. Verify the result Reopening the Settings window the library still carries the [默认] ([default]) marker. When the asset library window reopens, the default library ranks high among load candidates (after an explicit path, before the last used library). The default field returned by library_manage op=list is that library's path. Tips Setting the default does not switch the current library immediately; use the library dropdown at the top of the 「分类」 (Categories) page to switch. With no default set, the Settings window shows the first list item as the default, while startup actually prefers the last used library. On the command side library_manage op=set_default requires the library to be registered in library_paths already. The default library setting is stored in user settings and not written into the library directory.

items.title: Remove a library
items.summary: Removing a library only unregisters the entry from the library list; no library directory or asset on disk is deleted. Steps Open the Settings window and go to
items.text: Removing a library only unregisters the entry from the library list; no library directory or asset on disk is deleted. Steps Open the Settings window and go to the 「资产库管理」 (Asset library management) group on the 「常规」 (General) tab. Select the library to remove in the list. Click 「删除选中」 (Delete selected) . Click 「确定」 (OK) to save the settings. If the current library was removed, go back to the 「分类」 (Categories) page and switch to another library in the dropdown. Verify the result The settings list loses an item and the main window's library dropdown no longer lists that library. The library directory, its assets and favorites.json on disk stay untouched. 「添加资产库」 (Add asset library) can register it again later. Tips 警告 At least one asset library must remain; clicking delete when only one is left reports 「至少保留一个资产库」 (keep at least one asset library) . Removing the default library does not rewrite default_library ; set another library as default before removing it. After removing the current library you must switch manually; library_manage op=remove returns was_current / was_default so you can confirm. To really delete library files, remove the directory outside the plug-in; the plug-in offers no disk-delete operation.

items.title: Library health check
items.summary: A health check reports the library root, asset and category counts, duplicate UUIDs and the load-failure list in one pass; it is the first step when an asset is
items.text: A health check reports the library root, asset and category counts, duplicate UUIDs and the load-failure list in one pass; it is the first step when an asset is on disk but missing from the list. Prerequisites The asset library is loaded (a live library manager exists). Steps Open the plug-in window and confirm the target library is loaded. Call the library_health command with the default op=status . Use the table below to classify the problem. With duplicate UUIDs, run op=fix_uuids , which rewrites the duplicated IDs and rescans automatically. With load failures, read each reason , fix the asset's meta.json or run op=reload to rescan the disk. If the sub-library / category configuration looks wrong, run op=reload_config to reread config.json . Status fields Field Meaning library_root Current library root is_loaded Whether the library is loaded asset_count Number of indexed assets category_count Number of categories has_duplicate_uuids Whether duplicate UUIDs exist load_failure_count / load_failures Assets present on disk but not indexed, with reasons (at most 20 entries) Verify the result Running op=status again shows has_duplicate_uuids as false and load_failure_count at 0 or clearly reduced. Assets that were missing reappear in the grid and in search results. Tips A failing individual check is returned in its own *_error field and does not fail the whole health check. On load failures the Script Editor also prints 「⚠ 加载失败 N 个资产」 (failed to load N assets) , which can be compared with the health result. The toolbar refresh button is equivalent to rescanning the disk ( op=reload ) and also checks for leftover temporary directories. fix_uuids rewrites asset IDs, so places that reference the old IDs such as favorites may need a manual review.

items.title: Rebuild indexes
items.summary: An asset library has two rebuildable indexes: the directory index cache used at startup and the vector index used for semantic search; the first invalidates its
items.text: An asset library has two rebuildable indexes: the directory index cache used at startup and the vector index used for semantic search; the first invalidates itself, the second must be rebuilt manually. The two indexes Index Default location Purpose How to rebuild Directory index cache <library root>/.squirrel_index_cache.json Speeds up opening the library library_health op=clear_cache then op=reload , or delete the file and refresh Semantic index <library root>/.squirrel_ai_index/<official or ollama>/ AI semantic search and search by image python tools/asset_index.py --rebuild --library "<library root>" Steps: directory index Run library_health op=clear_cache to delete the cache file. Run library_health op=reload , or click the toolbar refresh button, and wait for the scan to finish. Steps: semantic index Confirm Ollama and the embedding model are available. In the plug-in package root run python tools/asset_index.py --rebuild --library "<library root>" . Use --status to see the entry count and model, and --verify for a consistency self-check. Verify the result After rebuilding the directory index the asset count matches the number of .zasset folders on disk. After rebuilding the semantic index --status shows entries and AI semantic search returns results again. Tips The directory cache invalidates itself by .zasset modification time and falls back to a full scan when incompatible. The semantic index is derived data and by default follows the library directory; use the ai_asset_index_dir setting or the SQUIRREL_ASSET_INDEX_DIR environment variable to move it locally, which takes effect after reopening the window. The index is split by backend ( official and ollama each get one): vectors from the two backends are not interchangeable, and sharing a directory makes users of different backends mark each other stale and rebuild repeatedly. When several people share one library, do not put the semantic index on a shared drive, or concurrent writes from the same backend will wait on each other. Use --sync for incremental syncing; after changing the model or the text template you must use --rebuild .

items.title: Dependency scan
items.summary: The dependency scan walks the scene nodes during export or import to collect textures, caches, proxies and referenced files; missing items are recorded in the a
items.text: The dependency scan walks the scene nodes during export or import to collect textures, caches, proxies and referenced files; missing items are recorded in the asset's meta.json . Prerequisites The objects are in the scene and cache / proxy nodes are connected. 「收集关联文件」 (Collect linked files) is checked on export; importing external files also runs a text-level collection. Steps Check 「收集关联文件」 (Collect linked files) in the export dialog. The scan runs automatically during export; it is read-only and does not modify the scene. Open <asset>.zasset/meta.json and read dependencies_missing , dependencies_out_of_scope , dependencies_unresolved_tokens and dependency_scan . Put missing files back at their original paths and export again. What is scanned Layer Notes Native registry The broken-link list from filePathEditor Attribute scan listAttr(usedAsFilename=True) , not limited to a node allowlist Special node patches Attributes of Bifrost, Yeti, nCache, file sequences and similar Expansion and classification Frame sequences and UDIM expanded and classified by extension Collected directories deps/ sub-directories such as textures, caches, proxies, volumes, references, audio Verify the result dependencies_missing is empty in meta.json . deps/ contains every needed file. The export log says 「依赖扫描: 命中 N 个源文件…缺失 0」 (dependency scan: N source files matched… 0 missing) . Tips Out-of-scope dependencies are recorded in dependencies_out_of_scope and are not packaged. Paths containing <MAYA_RESOURCES> land in dependencies_unresolved_tokens and need manual handling. Library-wide batch maintenance lives in the 「维护」 (Maintenance) menu of the top toolbar: 「补缺失缩略图…」 (Fill in missing thumbnails…) scans the whole library for missing or placeholder thumbnails ( 15.12.8 ), 「清理无效资产」 (Clean invalid assets) finds entries without meta.json or empty shells ( 15.12.9 ), and 「重建资产索引」 (Rebuild asset index) rescans the list ( 4.12.2 ).

items.title: Backup and restore
items.summary: An asset library is "the folder is the data", so copying the whole library directory is the most complete backup; deletions performed by the plug-in also leave
items.text: An asset library is "the folder is the data", so copying the whole library directory is the most complete backup; deletions performed by the plug-in also leave a temporary backup for emergencies. Backing up the whole library Stop writing: stop import / export jobs and preferably close the plug-in window or quit Maya. Copy the whole library root, including library.json , favorites.json , every sub-library and any custom top-level categories. Put the copy on another disk or a backup location. Restoring the whole library Close the plug-in and put the backup directory back in the target location. Open Settings → 常规 (General) → 资产库管理 (Asset library management) → 添加资产库 (Add asset library) and register the restored directory. Go back to the 「分类」 (Categories) page and choose that library in the dropdown. Run the library health check to confirm the asset count and the load-failure list. Single assets and recovering a mistaken delete Back up a single asset with the export_assets command (with material_ids and target_dir ), which copies the asset as a .zasset ; never rename or move a single .zasset inside the library by hand. Assets deleted through commands are backed up beforehand to squirrel_ai_undo under the system temp directory and can be rolled back with undo_last . version_manage op=remove_version backs up the deleted version to squirrel_ai_undo and returns the backup path; copy it back into the main asset root to restore it. Verify the result After restoring, the asset count matches the backup and collection names and counts are correct. The library health check shows load_failure_count at 0 and duplicate UUIDs as false. Missing thumbnails can simply be regenerated; the assets themselves are unaffected. Tips The directory index cache and the semantic index are derived data and need no backup; after restoring they rebuild automatically or manually as described in 4.12.2. The library list, default library and wishlist live in user settings ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/app_settings.json and must be backed up separately when moving machines. When several people share a library, avoid concurrent writes; the plug-in's lock only works within a single process.

items.title: Library lock and concurrency
items.summary: The plug-in puts a read-write lock ("many readers share, a writer is exclusive, writers win") on the asset library manager, so the Maya interface and the AI / c
items.text: The plug-in puts a read-write lock ("many readers share, a writer is exclusive, writers win") on the asset library manager, so the Maya interface and the AI / connector cannot corrupt the index by writing at the same time. How the lock behaves Scenario Behavior Read-only queries (listing, search, reading favorites) Several readers run in parallel Write operations (loading a library, create / update / delete, writing favorites) Exclusive; while a writer waits, new readers queue (writers win) Read lock wait limit 20 seconds by default, adjustable with the SQUIRREL_LIBRARY_READ_TIMEOUT environment variable Read wait timeout Raises LockTimeout ; the caller should report "library is busy, please retry later" Reentrancy Reads and writes reenter within the same thread; a read lock cannot be upgraded to a write lock, and upgrading raises an error When the library is busy Stop the current large batch import, export or index rebuild. Wait for the current write to finish and retry the query or command. If it still times out, check the Script Editor and the logs for a long-running job. Do not "bypass" the lock by restarting the plug-in or editing library files by hand. Verify the result After the write finishes, queries and search work normally without LockTimeout or "library is busy". The asset and category counts in the health check stay stable and nothing was lost to concurrency. Tips Write locks have no timeout by default, so long AI jobs cannot make interface writes fail; only read locks have a wait limit. The lock is a runtime patch on the manager class, shared by the interface and the AI, so there is no false sense of safety limited to AI. The lock only works inside one plug-in process; multiple processes or machines writing the same library have no cross-process coordination, so concurrent writes must be avoided by people. Developers can use coverage_report() to check whether a public method escapes the locking scope.

items.title: What a variant is
synonyms: how do variants differ from versions
items.summary: A variant is one of several geometry forms that share a single set of textures and materials under the same asset: textures and materials are stored once in the
items.text: A variant is one of several geometry forms that share a single set of textures and materials under the same asset: textures and materials are stored once in the asset root and the variant directory holds only geometry. It solves the storage duplication of "one set of dependencies, many shapes". How it differs from versions and LODs Dimension What is stored Materials and textures Typical use Version ( V1/ , V2/ ) A complete self-contained asset Independent per version, may all differ Revisitable iterations of damage, UVs or shape LOD ( lod1/ , lod2/ ) Different detail levels of one shape Inherited from the owning version High-poly display, low-poly placement Variant ( variants/ ) Geometry only Inherited from the asset root, shared by all variants Many styles of bricks, screws or tiles under one material set All three can coexist without affecting each other. Storage layout Brick.zasset/ ├── meta.json ├── variants.json # the variants section registers id / label / geometry / LOD / thumbnail per variant ├── node.ma # main version geometry ├── textures/ # textures shared by every variant ├── materials/ # materials shared by every variant └── variants/ # flat, no second-level directories ├── standard_brick.ma ├── standard_brick.sicon # thumbnail of this variant ├── broken_brick.ma ├── broken_brick.sicon └── broken_brick_lod1.ma # a variant's LOD level: <id>_lodN.<ext> Variant geometry is stored flat as <id>.<ext> under variants/ , with no per-variant sub-directory. Variants do not appear in the asset grid : they hang off their asset and are viewed through the context menu, the variant management window or the version browser; an asset with variants shows a V badge at the top left of its card. Variant thumbnails are stored separately ( variants/<id>.sicon and so on) and never overwrite the asset's main thumbnail. When to use variants Need Dimension to use Same material, slightly different shapes (a chipped brick, a screw head type) Variant Overall model revision that must keep earlier results Version High and low poly of the same model LOD Different textures per version of the same model Version (with its own materials) 注意 Variants are designed around shared textures : a variant stores geometry only and carries no textures or materials of its own. When independent materials are really needed, use a version instead.

items.title: Add a new variant
synonyms: turn the selection into a variant
items.summary: Export the object selected in the viewport as a new variant of this asset. A new variant writes geometry only; textures and materials keep using the set in the
items.text: Export the object selected in the viewport as a new variant of this asset. A new variant writes geometry only; textures and materials keep using the set in the asset root. Prerequisites Do this in the Maya plug-in edition (variant export needs a local Maya; the standalone edition reports "currently in standalone mode"). The object to use as the variant is selected in the viewport; marquee selecting only takes the topmost root object. The asset is a .zasset . Steps Right-click the target asset in the grid and expand 「更新资产」 (Update asset) . Click 「添加新变体…」 (Add new variant…) . In the export configuration: Enter the variant name (it also becomes the directory name and may be Chinese); Check at least one geometry format ( ma / mb / fbx / obj / usd ); The thumbnail source follows the setting in Create asset (screenshot / playblast / render / preview image). Confirm the export. It then reports 「已添加变体 …（共享资产贴图与材质）」 (variant added… sharing the asset's textures and materials) . How the thumbnail is generated Thumbnail source in Create asset Behavior when adding a variant Maya playblast / render Generates the variant's thumbnail automatically Screenshot Opens the screenshot window for a manual framing confirmation Preview image / imported image Follows that setting without taking another image The variant's thumbnail entries are identical to 「更新缩略图」 (Update thumbnail) (capture, import, Maya playblast, render, add, capture and add), and you can also regenerate later with 「更新资产 → 更新变体 ▶ → that variant」 (Update asset → Update variant ▶ → that variant) . Verify the result The Script Editor shows the variant export log and the asset directory gains variants/<variant name>.<ext> (plus variants/<variant name>.sicon when a thumbnail exists). The new variant can be chosen under 「导入变体 / 版本」 (Import variant / version) in the context menu. The asset grid does not gain a card; the variant hangs off the original asset. 警告 A variant stores geometry only. If only "export materials only" is checked with no geometry format, it reports 「变体只保存几何体」 (variants store geometry only) and stops.

items.title: Batch add variants
items.summary: Select several objects and export them at once, one variant per selected root object . This suits assets such as "one texture set, dozens of screw or brick type
items.text: Select several objects and export them at once, one variant per selected root object . This suits assets such as "one texture set, dozens of screw or brick types".
