items.text: One-line summary: the top two checkboxes in the right column decide whether, besides the asset itself, textures and scene dependencies are copied into the package. Item-by-item details Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Collect caches / proxies / references loaded in the scene Checkbox Copies caches (.abc and so on), proxies (.ass/.vrmesh/.rs) and referenced files into the package's deps/ Tick it when delivering "open and it works" assets Off: only a dependency list is recorded, no files are copied, so opening the asset on another machine misses references Textures textures/ Checkbox Collects the textures used by materials into the package's textures/ Ticked by default; almost always keep it Off: the asset holds no textures, and materials are empty or lost after import The two switches are independent: textures only is fine, associated files only is fine, and both give the most complete self-contained asset (and the largest package). Scanning and collecting are different things Scanning always happens : on export the plug-in always scans which external files the asset depends on, which are missing and which lie outside the allowed scope, and records the result in the export log. Only collecting copies : files are really copied into the package only when Collect caches / proxies / references is ticked; otherwise only a list is kept. So a log line such as " collect_associated=False → list only, no copy " is normal behavior, not a failure. Where the dependency strategy is changed Once textures and dependencies are copied into the package, path handling is decided by settings, not this dialog: Setting Location Effect Texture import strategy Settings → Asset library One of "copy into the project / put in the asset directory / keep the source path" Dependency import strategy Settings → Asset library Same options, applied to caches / proxies / references See 4.8.3.3 , 4.8.3.4 . A complete example (adding a material with its textures) Select the material node in Maya. Open the export dialog and confirm Textures textures/ is ticked in the right column. If the material also references external models / caches (for example it sits on a referenced model), tick Collect caches / proxies / references loaded in the scene too. Tick Material preset .zmetal (see 8.10.6). Click Create asset and finish the capture. Verify: right-click the new asset → Asset details and check the included formats and size; a clearly larger size means the textures came in. Details are in 8.11.1 . Troubleshooting Symptom Cause What to do The material has no textures after import Textures textures/ was unticked on export, or the texture paths were outside the supported scope Re-export with textures ticked, or bring the export back with Update asset → Append format The package is huge Collect associated files was ticked and a whole cache set was copied in For such assets turn Collect associated files off and manage caches separately References are lost after moving machines Only scanned, never collected Re-export with Collect caches / proxies / references ticked The log says "list only, no copy" Collect associated files is off (by design) Tick it when you need a self-contained asset Related Other right column blocks: 8.10.6 , 8.10.7 The user-guide version of dependency collection: 4.3.2.4 The dependency collection strategy: 4.3.6.5 Troubleshooting missing textures / dependencies: 4.3.5.2

items.title: Material nodes and geometry formats
synonyms: how to export a material preset
items.summary: One-line summary: the middle four blocks of the right column govern which formats materials / nodes are stored in and which formats geometry is stored in. Block
items.text: One-line summary: the middle four blocks of the right column govern which formats materials / nodes are stored in and which formats geometry is stored in. Block one: export options (material only) Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Material only (skip geometry / proxies) Checkbox Stores only the material network and skips geometry and proxies; even with .ma/.mb ticked only material nodes are written Tick it when you want materials without geometry Once ticked, a model asset becomes a "materials only" package and imports yield no model When ticked: geometry formats (.fbx/.obj/.usd and so on) are skipped internally even if ticked, and .ma/.mb are still exported but hold the material node network instead of the model. 4.3.2.7 has the full description. Block two: material formats / light formats / node formats The block title follows the category and it holds three items: Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Material preset .zmetal (materials) / light preset .zlight (lights) / node preset .zmetal (others) Checkbox Exports the material / light / node network into the plug-in's own preset format so the node network can be restored exactly on import Always tick it for materials and lights Off: the asset holds no material data and importing gives only geometry or a shell Write all materials into one .zmetal Checkbox (indented, shown only when .zmetal is ticked) Merges several materials into a single .zmetal Tick it when one asset holds the several materials of one object Off: each material gets its own .zmetal file and import picks as needed Material mapping .mcm (N materials detected) Checkbox Writes an extra "material → model" table so import can put materials back onto the right model Tick it when the asset carries a model with several materials (ticked by default) Off: a multi-material model may only be matched by name on import and easily ends up wrong Light assets have no .mcm row (lights have no material mapping) and no "write all materials into one". Block three: geometry formats (through Maya's native export) Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Maya ASCII .ma Checkbox Exports in Maya's text format, readable and easy to debug The default choice for model / scene assets Larger files; very large scenes can be slow or fail to convert to ASCII Maya Binary .mb Checkbox Exports in Maya's binary format, smaller and faster For large scenes used only locally or in the same Maya version Slightly worse cross-version compatibility FBX .fbx Checkbox For other software / engines Tick it when handing off to UE / Unity / Blender Materials / lights are not guaranteed, usually only geometry OBJ .obj Checkbox A universal mesh format Tick it for geometry only, maximum compatibility No animation, very weak material information USD .usd Checkbox Universal scene description Tick it when the pipeline uses USD Needs Maya's USD plug-in (a status of "not loaded / unavailable" means it cannot export) Why some formats are gray Formats that do not apply to the current category are gray and cannot enter the export configuration , with the tooltip "this format does not apply to the current category and is locked (adjust in Settings → Export defaults)". The built-in locking rules: Category Formats locked by default Materials / lights FBX, OBJ, USD, Alembic and every proxy format (such assets have no geometry) Textures / HDR / images / audio / animation data Almost all node and geometry formats (they are files or pure transform data) To change a lock: unlock that format on the Export defaults page (see 8.9.4 ). Suggested minimal combinations Asset type Must tick Optional Materials Material preset .zmetal Material mapping .mcm (when a model is included) Lights Light preset .zlight — Models Maya ASCII .ma FBX (cross-software) + material preset + .mcm Scenes Maya ASCII .ma .mb (size first) + textures Node tree Node preset .zmetal .ma (when you want to see node connecti

items.title: Animation, caches and proxies
synonyms: how to export a proxy model
items.summary: One-line summary: the bottom three blocks of the right column: whether animation is included, whether a point cache is stored, and whether render proxies are st
items.text: One-line summary: the bottom three blocks of the right column: whether animation is included, whether a point cache is stored, and whether render proxies are stored. Block one: animation export Three radios that only apply to time-based formats — abc / usd / ass / rs / vrmesh (the gray (abc/usd/ass/rs/vrmesh) note on the right of the block reminds you); they do not change the content of .ma/.mb/.fbx. Control Type Range actually captured Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Current frame Radio (factory default) Only the frame at Maya's current time Static assets, or models that just need a pose An animated asset will not move after export Timeline Radio The timeline / playback range (the start and end of playbackOptions ) When you want the whole action and the range is already set on the timeline If the timeline is set to 1–100 but the animation lives at frame 200, only the first part exports Keyframes Radio The start and end range of the selected objects' keyframes (falling back to the current frame when there are none) When the action is concentrated in one segment and you want no empty frames With several objects whose keyframe ranges differ, the overall captured range wins The export preset of the animation (ani) sub-library defaults to timeline ; other categories default to current frame . The preset comes from Assets/preset/export_preset.json , see 4.3.4.1 . Block two: cache formats Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Alembic .abc Checkbox Bakes the selected geometry into a point cache that works across software and renderers Tick it when delivering effects / simulation results Large files (points stored per frame), and a long range makes them huge; this checkbox is locked in material-type categories .abc uses the same frame mode as animation export above: timeline = playback range, keyframes = keyframe range, current frame = a single frame. Block three: proxy formats Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Arnold .ass Checkbox Stored as an Arnold proxy (loaded as a proxy at render time to lighten the scene) Large scenes rendered with Arnold With mtoa missing or not loaded the status shows "not loaded / unavailable" Redshift .rs Checkbox Stored as a Redshift proxy Large scenes rendered with Redshift As above; the Redshift plug-in is required V-Ray .vrscene Checkbox Stored as a V-Ray scene proxy When rendering with V-Ray As above; the V-Ray plug-in is required V-Ray .vrmesh Checkbox Stored as a V-Ray mesh proxy When you only need a geometry proxy, not the whole scene As above The status text after a proxy format is plug-in status again: ready / not loaded / unavailable . When it is "unavailable" the checkbox is disabled and cannot enter the export configuration. Materials and lights lock all proxy formats by default (they have no geometry to proxy). Models / scenes allow them. To change locks: Settings → Export defaults . Cost comparison What is ticked Export time Package size Good for .ma only (current frame) Seconds Small Static models .ma plus animation (timeline) Depends on frame count Medium to large Models with motion Plus .abc Noticeably slower (per-frame baking) Large Cache deliverables Plus a proxy (.ass/.rs/.vrmesh) Very slow (goes through the renderer) Large Large scenes that need faster rendering A complete example (adding an animated model) Select the model to export in Maya (including its animation curves). Open the export dialog and tick Maya ASCII .ma in the right column. Under animation export pick timeline or keyframes as needed — confirm with the timeline range that the animation really is in that segment. Tick Alembic .abc if a cache is part of the deliverable. To make life easier for a rendering colleague, tick one proxy format for the renderer you use (check the status reads "ready" first). Click Create asset and wait. The package is much larger than a plain model, which is normal. Verify: Asset details should list ma + abc/ass and

items.title: Main button and export results
synonyms: what happens after clicking create asset
items.summary: One-line summary: this window's confirm button is not at the bottom — it sits at the top of the left column. Clicking it is the actual export: same-name check f
items.text: One-line summary: this window's confirm button is not at the bottom — it sits at the top of the left column. Clicking it is the actual export: same-name check first, then packing, then the capture. Where the buttons are Button Position Effect Create asset (blue main button) Top of the left column (not the bottom of the window) Confirms and starts the export using the Maya selection and category at that moment Orange help icon Right of Create asset Opens the legacy export help page in a browser Close (window ×) Top right of the window Closes the dialog without exporting; changed parameters are not saved Older versions and older help called the confirm button a "bottom button", which is why this page title keeps the wording; in the current version it really is at the top of the left column. When you cannot find the button, look in the upper left of the window. What happens after clicking Create asset Validation : whether a category is selected and whether objects are selected in Maya. Either failing shows a prompt and aborts without closing the window. Live state : it re-reads the current Maya selection (not the one from when the window opened). Name conflict check : when the target category already holds an asset (or folder) with the same name, the "asset name conflict" window appears first, see 8.12.5 . Cancelling it means no export. Pack and export : writes meta, collects textures, writes material / geometry / cache / proxy files and generates the thumbnail. Thumbnail : with Screenshot tool a capture overlay asks you to frame; playblast / render image produce it automatically. Finish : the grid refreshes, the new asset card appears and is selected automatically , and the preview and properties panel switch to it. What the three outcomes look like Outcome What you see Explanation Success (single) One more card in the grid, selected, no success dialog Single asset mode finishes silently by design Success (batch of 2+) A dialog "Export finished! All succeeded: N assets" Only batch mode shows a summary Partial failure (batch) "Export finished!" with N succeeded / M failed plus failure details and Retry / Close buttons Retry reruns only the failed items Failure (single) An error prompt, with the cause also printed in the Script Editor ( [AssetExport] export failed: … ) Common causes in the table below What to check first when it fails Symptom Common cause What to do It reports that no geometry file was exported The target format really failed (an .ma text conversion failure, a plug-in not loaded) Check the Script Editor; tick .mb instead or load the plug-in and export again The asset has no material .zmetal / .zlight was not ticked Add it with Update asset → Append format The card is a gray placeholder No real thumbnail was produced Right-click → Update thumbnail → Background render or Capture It reports a missing category directory The category was deleted / renamed, so the index and disk disagree Refresh the category tree or rebuild the index ( 4.1.12.2 ) Clicking the button does nothing at all The category is on All assets, or nothing is selected in Maya Follow the prompts to pick a category or objects The progress window during batch export A batch (fully automatic / semi-automatic with more than one object) opens a batch export progress window showing which item of how many is running, with Cancel batch export . Cancellation is cooperative : the current asset finishes first and already exported assets stay in the library. In semi-automatic mode each asset also asks for its own framing. How to undo Abandon this export : just close the window (×) before exporting and nothing is written. Exported with the wrong name / formats : you cannot change it back in this window. The asset is already on disk, so delete and re-export (deleting moves it to the recycle bin and is restorable), or use right-click Update asset to overwrite with the new result. Deleted an asset by mistake : deleted assets go to the recycle bin and can be restored

items.title: Asset details window
synonyms: what opens when double-clicking the preview
items.summary: One-line summary: a window that lays one asset out for inspection — large image on the left, every piece of information on the right. The window title is not al
items.text: One-line summary: a window that lays one asset out for inspection — large image on the left, every piece of information on the right. The window title is not always "Asset details": it shows the asset's display name (or the English name when there is none), and the asset name appears in the upper left inside the window. How to open it Entry Action Result Asset context menu Right-click an asset card → Asset details Assets without versions / variants → this window; assets with them → the version browser ( 8.11.2 ) Double-click the right preview Double-click the image in the Preview panel on the right Same as above (the same path) Note: if the asset has versions or variants, this entry opens the version browser instead of this window. Left column: the image Area What it is How to use it Large preview The current thumbnail, centered and scaled inside a fixed square area The wheel switches to the previous / next image Thumbnail strip Appears only when the asset has several thumbnail slots, one row of small images Click one to switch the large image; with several there is a page or index number below Notes / tags Shown at the bottom left when the asset has notes or tags Read-only text / chips Right column: the information cards Card Fields Description Title card Asset name plus category breadcrumb The breadcrumb reads like "Materials › AAAcustom", confirming the category Details card · node type Such as VRayMtl , aiStandardSurface The main node type inside this asset Details card · asset type Such as materials , models The sub-library Details card · size Such as 140.9 KB Total bytes of the whole .zasset directory Details card · resolution Such as 2048×2048 Texture / image assets only Details card · software / renderer / color space Such as Maya 2025 / redshift / ACEScg Environment information recorded on export Details card · animation format Such as abc Only the animation formats carried in that export Details card · created A date The export time Included formats card Format chips such as zmetal , ma Which formats the package really holds; the fastest way to tell whether textures / materials are present Tags card Tag chips The asset's tags Notes card Text The asset's notes Path card Small gray text The real disk path of the .zasset , selectable and copyable A complete example (dragging the preview into the current scene) Right-click the asset → Asset details . Press the left mouse button on the large image and drag it out of the window onto the Maya viewport, then release. The plug-in imports it in the asset's default format (the same logic as dragging an asset card into the viewport). To look at another thumbnail: use the wheel or click the strip below. To do something else with this asset: right-click inside the window for the same context menu as the asset card. The window hints "drag the image out of the window → import into Maya", which is the drag-import entry. Common questions Question Explanation Why does double-clicking the preview open the version browser? The asset has versions or variants. To inspect a single asset, import its main version from the version browser, or remove the versions / variants first Why is there no ma under included formats? Geometry formats were not ticked on export, or this is a material-only asset (material categories lock geometry formats) Why is the image a gray placeholder? That export produced no real image. Right-click → Update thumbnail → Background render (see 8.12.6) or Capture Why is the size much larger than expected? Textures and associated files were collected into the package, see 8.10.5 Related The user-guide version of asset details: 4.1.4.5 The version browser (the same entry when versions / variants exist): 8.11.2 Headless rendering (filling in thumbnails): 8.12.6 Multiple thumbnail slots and deletion: 4.1.7.5

items.title: Version browser
synonyms: are variants and versions the same
how to use the version window
items.summary: One-line summary: when an asset carries several versions, LODs or variants, double-clicking the preview opens this three-column window. How to open it Entry Act
items.text: One-line summary: when an asset carries several versions, LODs or variants, double-clicking the preview opens this three-column window. How to open it Entry Action Prerequisite Double-click the right preview Double-click the image in the Preview panel The asset has versions or variants Asset context menu Right-click the asset → Asset details Same as above (this window is used when versions / variants exist) To browse inside the version / variant folders in the grid instead, use right-click → View versions / View variants / View LOD management , which expands inside the grid and does not open this window. Three-column structure Column Content How to use it Left · list The main version, each version, each variant, and their own LOD rows Click to switch; entries with LODs expand into several rows Middle · preview The large preview plus a multi-thumbnail strip below Wheel to change image, click a thumbnail to switch; the image can be dragged out of the window into Maya Right · information Title card (name / breadcrumb / badges), details card, LOD management card, included formats card, tags card, notes card, path card Read-only; the LOD management card holds Set as default LOD , Delete this LOD and Append LOD… Right · buttons Import this version / delete this version / close (the text changes when an LOD or variant is selected) See below The button text follows the current entry: Current selection Button text Main version / ordinary version Import this version, delete this version LOD row Import this LOD, delete this LOD Variant row Import this variant, delete this variant Version vs LOD vs variant: what really differs Item Version LOD (same asset, different detail) Variant In one sentence A different iteration of the same asset A different level of detail of the same asset A different form / dressing of the same asset Typical case "Chair v1 shape → v2 restyle" "LOD2 low-poly far away, LOD0 high-poly up close" "The same chair: red fabric / leather / damaged" What is stored A complete, independent set of content (geometry / materials / textures / thumbnail) Only the geometry at different detail; the rest is shared from the parent version Only geometry ; textures and materials are shared from the asset root How it appears in the library Each is an independent asset entry Rows under the version or main asset A row under the asset What you pick on import The version you want The detail level you need The form Quantity relationships Can stack: a version can also hold LODs Several under one owner Can coexist with versions One-line conclusion : a version swaps the iteration, an LOD swaps the detail, and a variant swaps the form (geometry only, with shared textures and materials). Common operations Inspect a version's content Open the version browser. Click an entry on the left; the details card and included formats on the right follow. Use the wheel in the middle column to browse that entry's thumbnails. Import a version / LOD / variant Select the target entry on the left (select a LOD row for a specific detail level). Click Import this version / Import this LOD / Import this variant on the right. The content is imported into the current Maya scene. You can also drag the middle preview into the viewport. Set the default LOD Select an entry with several LODs on the left so the LOD management card appears. Click Set as default LOD after a non-default row. A "default" mark appears after that row, and later imports at default detail use it. Append a LOD Click Append LOD… in the LOD management card on the right. Go through the append LOD detail window, see 8.11.4 . Delete Deleting a version deletes all of that version's content (geometry / materials / textures / thumbnail) and cannot be undone . Deleting a LOD removes only that detail level and leaves the other LODs and the version alone; every version must keep at least one LOD, so the last one cannot be deleted. Deleting a variant removes only that variant's geometry and thumbnail; shared t

items.title: Variant management window
items.summary: One-line summary: all variants of one asset in a single table, where you can import them one by one, bulk-add from disk, or delete them. How to open it Find an
items.text: One-line summary: all variants of one asset in a single table, where you can import them one by one, bulk-add from disk, or delete them. How to open it Find an asset that has variants in the grid (its card carries a variant badge); this only works for .zasset assets . Right-click → Update asset ▶ → Variant management… . The Variant management window opens with "Asset: <asset name>" on the line below the title. Creating variants is not done here: use right-click Update asset → Add as new variant / Batch add variants (see 8.11.4 ). Window structure Area Content Description Top "Asset: <name>" Confirms the target List One row per variant with a thumbnail icon Row text: display name (variant id) — N faces · LOD ×n [formats] Bottom hint A sharing note or an empty-state hint With variants it reads "all variants share the textures and materials in the asset root; variant directories store only geometry"; with none it points you to right-click Add new variant… Button row Import selected variant / add from files… / delete selected variants Import and delete are only enabled with a selection Bottom button Close Closes the window Item-by-item details Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Variant list Multi-select list Lists every variant of the asset — Ctrl/Shift multi-select is supported; import and delete act on every selected entry Import selected variant Secondary button Imports the selected variant geometry into the current Maya scene Select one when importing one at a time A multi-selection imports several into the same scene in a row Add from files… Secondary button Choose model files from disk; one file = one variant with an auto-generated variant id When you already have a batch of model files Allowed formats are ma/mb/fbx/obj/usd/glb/gltf/atom; other formats cannot be selected Delete selected variants Danger button (red) Deletes the selected variants' geometry and thumbnails Delete only once you are sure Deletion asks for confirmation; with a multi-selection one confirmation deletes several Close Secondary button Closes the window — Does not undo additions or deletions already made Double-clicking a row imports only that one (regardless of other selections). A complete example Bulk-add variants from files Right-click the asset → Update asset ▶ → Variant management… . Click Add from files… and multi-select model files in the chooser (its title reads "one file = one variant"). After confirming, a Add variants from files progress bar runs, importing one by one with unique variant ids. When done it reports "Added N variants from files, M failed." The list refreshes; after closing the window the variant badge count in the grid follows. Import / delete Select a row (or Ctrl/Shift multi-select). Click Import selected variant → the variant geometry enters the current scene; animation-type assets go through animation mapping import rather than geometry import. Or click Delete selected variants → the confirmation states "only that variant's geometry directory is deleted; the asset's shared textures and materials are unaffected" → confirm. The list refreshes and the grid follows. Risks and how to undo Operation Risk Undo Delete variants That variant's geometry and thumbnail are deleted; shared textures and materials are unaffected No undo. To recover, add it again with Add as new variant or Add from files Add from files One file per variant; duplicate names get a new id and never overwrite an existing variant Delete the row you added by mistake Import variant No namespace merge with existing scene objects, so names may clash This is a scene operation; clean up with Maya's Ctrl+Z / undo Troubleshooting Symptom Cause What to do No Variant management… in the context menu The asset is not a .zasset , or Update asset is switched off in the current category's context menu Confirm the asset type; check Settings → Context menu The list is empty The asset has no variants yet Use right-click Add as new variant… to expo

items.title: Append LOD / create version dialog
synonyms: how to pick a LOD slot
the new version did not ask for a name
items.summary: One-line summary: two windows appear in sequence when you add another detail level or another version to an existing asset: pick the update mode first, then bin
items.text: One-line summary: two windows appear in sequence when you add another detail level or another version to an existing asset: pick the update mode first, then bind the LOD slot. This page covers two windows: The Update asset chooser, which opens from right-click → Update asset and asks how you want to update. The Append LOD slot window, which opens when you choose Append as LOD in the first window and binds the current Maya selection to a LOD slot. Window one: update asset (choose the update mode) The text reads "Asset "<name>" already exists. Choose an update mode:", with a row of buttons: Button Effect Result Append as LOD Exports the current Maya selection as another LOD of the same asset Then opens the append LOD slot window Append format Merges this export into the existing asset, adding or replacing formats Opens the pre-filled create asset window in append-format mode (see 8.10.1) Create new version Clones the current content into a new sub-version Opens the pre-filled create asset window; when the export finishes it reports "Created new version <tag>" Add as new variant Exports the current selection as one variant (geometry only) First asks for a variant name (also the directory name, Chinese allowed), then opens the export configuration Batch add variants One variant per selected object Exports object by object and generates thumbnails Replace asset Overwrites the original asset content with this import Opens the export configuration window and overwrites the original asset Cancel Does nothing Closes the window Additional rules: The default main button is Replace asset ; if the asset has older version records the default becomes Append as LOD . When the current entry is inside a sub-version / variant / LOD, Create new version is not shown (versions cannot nest versions). Create new version does not ask for a version name : for geometry / material assets the plug-in generates the version tag (V1, V2). Only Add as new variant and "append LOD for a variant" open a small input. Window two: append LOD (slot window) The title is Append LOD with the subtitle "Target: <current asset / version name>", and a line below shows "Current selection: <model name>" live. Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does LOD0 – LOD4 slot cards Five clickable cards Clicking binds the last selected object in Maya to that slot; clicking again unbinds High detail close up (LOD0 is finest), low for distance A wrong slot: default-detail imports then give you a different model ☐ / ☑ at the top-right of a card State marker ☐ not bound, ☑ bound — — Current selection line Read-only text Shows the current Maya selection (with multiple selected it says "the last one will be bound") Select the model before clicking a card Clicking a card with nothing selected prompts "select a model in Maya first, then click a slot" Clear bindings Secondary button Clears every binding from this session to start over When the bindings are a mess It only clears this window's bindings and never touches existing LODs Cancel Secondary button Closes without writing — — Export and append (N slots) Main button Exports and writes the LODs by the current bindings; N follows the binding count Click once the slots are right Writing overwrites the geometry in a same-named slot (see the risks) State badges on the slot cards: Empty : no LOD exists at that slot yet; Exists · N faces : a LOD already exists there (N is the triangle count), and binding again overwrites it; Not bound / → object name : whether and to what this session has bound it. A complete example (adding LOD1 and LOD2 to a model) In Maya select the model intended as LOD1 first. Right-click the asset → Update asset → Append as LOD . When the Append LOD window opens, click the LOD1 card; it turns ☑ and shows "→ model name". Back in Maya select the model intended as LOD2, then click the LOD2 card. Read the warning lines at the bottom of the window: "'LOD1' already exists: its geometry will be overwritt

items.title: Import variant and version selection
synonyms: how to bring a variant into the scene
how to choose version and LOD
items.summary: One-line summary: for an asset with versions / variants / LODs, importing is not "import the asset" but "pick one first and import it" — this page covers where
items.text: One-line summary: for an asset with versions / variants / LODs, importing is not "import the asset" but "pick one first and import it" — this page covers where that choice happens and how. Two entries, remember the conclusion first Scenario Which entry to use Just drop a variant / version / LOD into the scene quickly Right-click the asset → the Import variant / version submenu and click that row (fastest) Look at the images and information before importing Double-click the preview to open the version browser , select the entry on the left and click Import this version / Import this LOD / Import this variant on the right Entry one: the right-click submenu Right-click an asset with versions / variants → the Import… submenu, whose title follows the asset content: Submenu title When it appears Import variant The asset has only variants (no multiple versions) Import version / LOD The asset has only versions / LODs (no variants) Import variant / version Both variants and versions exist (or older version records exist) The submenu lists variants / versions one by one: A variant with several LODs → another submenu level (LOD detail); A variant with several geometry formats → another format submenu ( ma , fbx …, distinguished by file name when several files share an extension); Hovering an entry pops up that entry's large thumbnail. Clicking the last level imports directly. Entry two: the version browser In the version browser ( 8.11.2 ): select an entry on the left and use the button on the right. The button text becomes Import this version / Import this LOD / Import this variant to match the selection. The source also holds a standalone selection dialog The plug-in source retains a standalone "Import variant geometry" dialog (the older selection method): it lists the asset's versions as radios plus the matching LOD detail radios and imports on OK. The current version does not attach it to any menu , so it cannot be reached through normal operation — use the two entries above. Its structure is described here so old documents and screenshots are recognizable: Control Content Title Import variant geometry Top The asset name to import Version A radio list, each row tag - display name (creation date) , with notes on their own line when present LOD detail A radio list, each row display name (LODx) plus triangle / vertex counts and available formats; a version without LODs shows "this version has no available LOD" With no variants Shows only "this asset contains no variant data" and Cancel Buttons Cancel / OK In short: seeing this window means you are using the old entry ; with the current version use right-click Import variant / version or the version browser. A complete example (importing a variant's LOD1 in ma format) Find the asset with a variant badge in the grid. Right-click → expand the Import variant / version submenu. Find the target variant row and hover to check the popup thumbnail so you click the right one. If there is a LOD level, expand it and choose LOD1 . If there is a format level, choose ma . Releasing imports the geometry into the current Maya scene. To verify which version came in, read the [VariantImport] log in the Script Editor, which states version/lod/geom. Troubleshooting Symptom Cause What to do No import variant / version submenu in the context menu The asset has no variants / multiple versions, or only one usable format so no submenu appears Use plain Import , or create variants / versions first Nothing happens after choosing That entry's geometry file is missing, or the standalone mode is not connected to Maya Check the [VariantImport] log; confirm Maya is online The imported model is wrong The wrong LOD or format was chosen Import the right entry again and undo the previous one with Ctrl+Z Importing an animation asset errors out Animation versions use ATOM mapping import rather than geometry import Use the asset's animation import path, or the matching import button in the version browser Related The version

items.title: Batch rename
items.summary: One-line summary: rename several assets at once — add a prefix, add a suffix, or replace a piece of the name — with a preview before anything changes. How to op
items.text: One-line summary: rename several assets at once — add a prefix, add a suffix, or replace a piece of the name — with a preview before anything changes. How to open it Select the assets to rename in the grid (multi-select with Ctrl+click / Shift+click). A batch bar appears below the grid; click Batch rename . The window opens with the main button showing progress as "Run rename (processed/total)". With a single asset selected the batch bar usually does not appear, so use the properties panel or right-click Edit for one name; the screenshot below is a window illustration (1 asset, button reads (0/1) ). Item-by-item details Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Rename Dropdown Which field to change: display name (name_cn) or file name (name) Usually display name File name changes the .zasset directory name on disk, see the risks below Add prefix Radio (default) Adds text before the original name Such as SM_ A wrong prefix needs another pass (no undo) Add suffix Radio Adds text after the original name Such as _low As above Find and replace Radio Replaces one piece of text in the name with another Use it to unify spelling / numbering When Find is empty nothing is replaced (and the button is gray) Input box (single) Single-line input The appended text in prefix / suffix mode Short, no spaces Empty → names do not change and the button is disabled Find / Replace with Two single-line inputs The pair for find-and-replace mode The find text must match exactly (case-sensitive) Wrong case means "nothing was replaced" Preview List One row per asset, "old name → new name"; changed rows are highlighted and unchanged rows say "(unchanged)" Scan it line by line before running Skipping it easily renames wrongly in bulk, for example prefixing assets that already have the prefix Cancel Secondary button Closes without changing anything — — Run rename (X/Y) Main button X = rows that will change, Y = total selected; clickable only when X > 0 Click after checking the preview It writes to the library immediately and cannot be undone Choosing among the three modes Desired result Mode Example Give a batch a common prefix (project / type abbreviation) Add prefix chair → SM_chair Give a batch a common suffix (detail / version) Add suffix chair → chair_low Replace words from an old naming rule Find and replace Replace SM_ with ENV_ in SM_chair , SM_table A complete example Multi-select the assets to rename (2 or more). Batch bar → Batch rename . Set Rename to display name (name_cn) . Click Add prefix and type SM_ . Check the preview: every row should read old → SM_old , all highlighted. Look for assets that already carry SM_ (they would become SM_SM_xxx ). Click Run rename (N/N) . When done it reports "Batch rename finished: N succeeded"; the grid refreshes. Verify by opening the properties panel of a couple of random assets. Risks and how to undo Operation Risk Undo Renaming the display name (name_cn) It only affects the UI; disk is unchanged Batch-change it back (no undo) Renaming the file name (name) It changes the .zasset directory name on disk and the asset path with it; external scripts or tickets that hard-code the old path break Batch-change it back; old path references must be fixed by hand Batch execution Many at once, so a mistake must be fixed one by one There is no undo; copy the assets or back up the library first ( 4.1.12.4 ) If you only want the interface to read better, prefer the display name ; the file name involves disk paths, so be careful. Troubleshooting Symptom Cause What to do Run rename is gray No name in the preview will change (empty input, or the find text never matched) Check the inputs; find-and-replace is case-sensitive Assets vanished after renaming the file name The index has not caught up with the disk rename Refresh / rebuild the index ( 4.1.12.2 ) Duplicated prefixes in names The batch included assets that already had the prefix Fix it again with find-and-replace to remove the duplicate Fewer

items.text: One-line summary: the configuration window that exports scene materials into "preset files" (titled Export material as preset) for reuse on later imports. Note on the current entry : this window's interface and logic still exist (clicking Start export really exports), but the asset context menu does not register an item for it , so it cannot be reached through normal operation. This page therefore documents from the source what the window holds and what each control does; to save presets as files today , use "Which route to take now" below. Which route to take now What you want How the current version does it Have Create asset tick certain formats by default Change the export defaults: Settings → Export defaults ( 8.9.4 ), stored in export_preset.json ( 4.3.4.2 ) Export scene materials into reusable files elsewhere Use the quick tool Material import/export ( 8.14.7 ), which writes JSON / .ma / .zmetal Export a .zmetal inside a zasset Use Create asset with Material preset .zmetal ticked ( 8.10.6 ) Window structure (per the source) Block one: export format and path Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Export directory Single-line input plus Browse Where preset files are written A dedicated directory, never inside the asset library A missing directory is created when possible; items.title: Format conversion (geometry formats)
items.summary: First, a common misunderstanding : the window behind this page is titled Format conversion , and it converts the asset's geometry formats (.ma / .mb / .fbx / .o
items.text: First, a common misunderstanding : the window behind this page is titled Format conversion , and it converts the asset's geometry formats (.ma / .mb / .fbx / .obj / .usd / .abc), not image formats . Real image format conversion is a different window (the Image format conversion tool in quick tools), see 8.14.4 . This page keeps the directory title "image format conversion" but documents the actual window. One-line summary: take the geometry already inside an asset, convert it to the formats you tick and append them to the package; existing formats are never deleted. How to open it Select the assets to convert in the grid (multi-select allowed). Right-click → Format conversion . A window opens (titled Format conversion ) whose first line reads "will run on N assets: <names…>". Prerequisite: the asset holds usable geometry files (ma/mb/fbx/abc/usd/obj). Pure material or pure texture assets have no geometry and report "no processable assets" first. Item-by-item details Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Maya ASCII .ma Checkbox Converts the asset geometry to .ma Tick it to inspect text / debug — Maya Binary .mb Checkbox Converts to .mb Tick it when size matters — FBX .fbx Checkbox Converts to FBX (engines / other DCCs) Tick it when handing off to UE / Unity / Blender Materials / lights are not guaranteed Wavefront OBJ .obj Checkbox Converts to OBJ Tick it for universal meshes only No animation USD .usd Checkbox Converts to USD For USD pipelines Needs Maya's USD plug-in Alembic .abc Checkbox Converts to an Alembic cache When delivering point caches Large and slow Exists marker Small read-only text Shown when the format already exists in the asset: "(exists: ticking will replace it with this conversion)" — Ticking replaces that format file rather than adding one Partially exists Small read-only text With a multi-selection, some assets have the format and others do not — As above; each asset is replaced according to its own case Cancel Secondary button Closes without converting — — Start conversion Main button Enabled only with at least one format ticked Click after confirming Conversion runs in a background headless process, see below The footer line "all conversion happens in a temporary directory outside the library and is verified before writing into the package; existing formats are not deleted" is key: unticked formats stay as they are , while a ticked same-named format is replaced by this result. How the conversion runs Clicking Start conversion opens a progress window (titled Format conversion ) showing which asset of how many is running, with a cancel button. The plug-in starts a separate headless mayapy process: output goes to a temporary directory outside the library → files are verified → written into the .zasset in one go. After writing it reloads the index and refreshes the grid; the included formats gain what you ticked. When finished a summary appears: "Format conversion finished. N succeeded, M failed." Failures come with reasons. A complete example (adding FBX to a model asset) Select one (or several) model assets. Right-click → Format conversion . Tick only FBX .fbx ; if the asset already has fbx the small text says "exists" — confirm you want a replacement before ticking. Click Start conversion . Wait for the progress window and read the summary. Verify: right-click the asset → Asset details → fbx should appear under included formats. Risks and how to undo Operation Risk Undo Ticking a format the asset already has The old file of that format is replaced by this conversion Export again from the original source; the old format is not kept automatically Converting many assets The headless process runs them one by one and takes a while The progress window can be cancelled and finished assets keep their results Unticked formats All other formats are preserved — Troubleshooting Symptom Cause What to do "No processable assets" The asset holds no geometry files (pure material / texture) Su

items.title: Name conflicts
synonyms: what to do with a same-name asset
items.summary: One-line summary: when exporting, if the target category already holds a folder with the same name, the plug-in stops and asks: auto rename, type another name,
items.text: One-line summary: when exporting, if the target category already holds a folder with the same name, the plug-in stops and asks: auto rename, type another name, or overwrite. When it appears Clicking Create asset (or Update asset → Replace asset ) when the target category already holds a .zasset with that name. In batch export it checks and asks one by one ; each same-name item gets one question. When Name conflicts in settings is set to auto rename / manual input , this window no longer appears and the configured policy applies directly. Window content The first paragraph is a warning: "A folder with the same name as asset '<name>' already exists; continuing the export will overwrite the existing files." Item-by-item details Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Auto rename (append _001, _002 …) Radio ( selected by default ) Keeps the old asset and renames the new one to name_001 , name_002 … When you want to keep the old version without typing names Repeated exports pile up _001 , _002 … and need periodic cleanup Manually enter a new name Radio plus input Exports under a different name; the input is editable only when selected When the name must last and you want to choose it Confirming with an empty input reports "please enter a new asset name" and stays open Remember my choice, do not ask again Checkbox Stores this policy in the configuration and applies it to future conflicts Tick it when exporting many with a fixed policy Afterwards no window appears; change the policy in settings Cancel Secondary button Aborts the whole export — Assets already exported earlier in the batch are not rolled back OK Main button Continues with the current choice Click after deciding Any choice other than auto rename may touch existing assets, see the risks Results of the three handling options Choice Old asset New asset When to choose it Auto rename Kept as is Named xxx_001 The default recommendation: nothing is lost and no name must be invented Manually enter a new name Kept as is Uses your name You have a strict naming convention (Delete the old asset, then export) Deleted first Uses the original name When you clearly want a replacement; but the overwrite path needs no deletion, see below To overwrite an old asset: this window offers no direct "overwrite" radio — the overwrite path is Update asset → Replace asset , which has its own confirmation ("overwrite it with this export? the original content will be replaced"). A complete example Click Create asset . The asset name conflict window appears. Keep the default auto rename (append _001, _002 …) . Click OK . The export continues and the grid gains an xxx_001 asset while the original xxx is untouched. Changing a remembered choice back Open Settings → Asset library page → Name conflicts : Ask every time (ask how to handle same-name assets during export) Auto rename (append _001, _002 …) Manual input (open a dialog to type a new name) Choosing Ask every time restores the window. Details are in 4.8.3.2 . Risks and how to undo Operation Risk Undo Manually entering a new name None (the old asset is untouched) — Remembering auto rename No more prompts and asset names keep carrying _001 Change it back to ask every time in settings Overwriting through Update asset → Replace asset The original content is replaced by this result and the plug-in keeps no backup Copy the asset or back up the library first ( 4.1.12.4 ) Cancel Later assets are not exported Click Create asset again Troubleshooting Symptom Cause What to do No window appeared and an _001 asset showed up The settings policy is auto rename and was remembered Change it back to ask every time in settings After typing a new name it reports that it exists too The new name collides as well Choose another, or switch to auto rename Batch export asked many times One question per same-name item (by design) Tick remember my choice to settle it at once Existing assets changed after cancelling Cancel only aborts what follows

items.title: Headless thumbnail options
synonyms: how to re-render a gray thumbnail
items.summary: One-line summary: the settings window that opens first when you right-click Background render. It decides which renderer, which model, which light, what size an
items.text: One-line summary: the settings window that opens first when you right-click Background render. It decides which renderer, which model, which light, what size and what quality, and renders the thumbnail in a separate mayapy process. The window is titled Background render and its first line reads: "Headless rendering: starts a separate mayapy process, which does not occupy the current viewport and does not change the current scene." How to open it Select the assets needing thumbnails (several are fine). Right-click → Update thumbnail ▶ → Background render . Do not pick Capture (a screen rectangle) or Import (an image from disk) by mistake. The Background render options window opens. With a multi-selection: a single selection processes only the right-clicked asset, while a multi-selection processes all selected assets. Block one: renderer Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Renderer radio list Radios ×N Which renderer renders this time The one shown as available on this machine (Arnold / Redshift / V-Ray / Maya software / Hardware 2.0 and so on) Unavailable entries are disabled with the reason on the right (missing kick.exe / missing mayapy and so on) Common reasons an entry is unavailable: Arnold needs kick.exe / oiiotool.exe (installed with Arnold), while Maya software / Hardware 2.0 need a mayapy.exe of the same version as the current Maya. When none is available, Start generating reports "this machine has no usable headless renderer…". Block two: preset model (only shown when needed) Materials, textures and lights have no mesh of their own , so a demo model must be built and the material applied before rendering. Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Preset model dropdown Button plus a popup list (with large previews on hover) Chooses a model from the plug-in's Assets/Meshes A sphere / box / cloth example matching the asset type When the directory has no usable model it reports "no usable model files in the preset model directory" Model and scene assets come with geometry , so this block is not shown at all. Light assets do show this block: the model is what gets lit. Block three: environment light (HDRI) Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Use HDRI environment light Checkbox (ticked by default) Whether HDRI lighting is used Usually ticked; untick for pure studio lighting Unticked means plain studio lights, which look much worse on metal / reflective materials HDRI dropdown Button showing the current choice plus a 2:1 preview on the left Chooses an HDRI from Assets/IBL ; hover a list item for a large preview An environment close to the asset's intended use With none chosen it shows "(none)" Description text Read-only "The HDRI is only environment lighting (spherical projection, no deformation) and does not become the background — the thumbnail has a transparent background." — — Light assets do not show this block : the light is the source itself and adding environment light would wash it out. Block four: size and quality Control Type Effect Suggested value What filling it in wrongly does Size Dropdown (256×256 / 384 / 512 / 768 / 1024) Output thumbnail side length (square) The default 512×512 is enough Too large is clearly slower; too small looks blurry on cards Quality Dropdown (fast / standard / high) Maps to each renderer's own sampling level Fast for small images, standard for finals High is very slow on complex materials; fast is noisy Description text Read-only "The quality level maps to the current renderer's own sampling settings (higher is cleaner and slower)." — — Bottom buttons Button Effect Description Restore defaults Returns renderer / preset model / environment light / size / quality to factory values It only changes this dialog ; the values are written back when you click Start generating Cancel Closes without doing anything — Start generating Starts the headless job with the current settings Opens the Background rend

items.title: Headless job progress window
items.summary: One-line summary: when the plug-in starts separate mayapy / kick processes to render, this small non-modal window lets you keep working while watching which ite
items.text: One-line summary: when the plug-in starts separate mayapy / kick processes to render, this small non-modal window lets you keep working while watching which item is running, which stage it is in, and what was just rendered. The window is titled Background render · progress . When it appears Job Uses this window Background thumbnail rendering (right-click Update thumbnail ▶ Background render ) Yes , rendering jobs use it Format conversion (right-click Format conversion ) No; it uses a modal progress dialog ( 8.12.4 ) The window is non-modal and stays on top : it does not block you and does not steal focus; closing it does not stop the job. What the window contains Area Content Description Title line "Preparing…" → "Asset 1/5: <name>" Shows preparing until processing starts Stage line "Stage: <stage name>" Which step is running (building, applying materials, rendering, writing back and so on) Progress bar 0% → 100% with a percentage It advances per asset , not per rendered frame Counter line "Done 3/5" Same source as the progress bar Preview card A 256×256 square preview showing "(nothing rendered yet)" when empty Takes the newest PNG in the job directory Render note "Latest image: <file name>" The file name behind the preview card Cancel Red danger button The only way to stop, see below Close Secondary button Only closes the window; the job keeps running What happens on completion The progress bar fills and the title line becomes "Job finished". The stage line clears and the counter becomes "N succeeded · M failed · K skipped". Cancel turns gray and unclickable. The window closes itself after about 2 seconds — that delay lets you look at the last thumbnail. The job also produces a summary dialog (success / failure / skipped details), so nothing is lost when the window closes. What cancelling means After clicking Cancel the stage line immediately reads "Cancelling (waiting for the current asset to finish)…" and the button turns gray. This is cooperative cancellation : the asset currently being processed finishes first, then the whole job stops. Images already rendered are kept and are never rolled back. On Windows the cancel kills the whole process tree (mayapy plus the kick and other child processes it started) so no zombie renderer is left behind. A complete example Right-click an asset → Update thumbnail ▶ → Background render → choose the settings → Start generating . The progress window appears with "Preparing…". It runs "Asset 1/3" with the stage line showing the current step. The first image appears in the preview card. If the settings were wrong (the wrong renderer, for example) click Cancel and wait for "Cancelling…" to finish. When everything is done the window closes itself after 2 seconds; reopen it with the correct settings if needed. Common questions Question Explanation Does closing the window stop rendering? No. Closing only stops watching; you must click Cancel to stop the job Why does the progress bar advance per asset? The job queues assets and produces one image per asset; the internal frame progress of a single render is not reflected on that bar The preview card stays on "(nothing rendered yet)"? The first image has not been written yet, or rendering failed (the counter shows failures when the job ends) Why did the window close by itself? It closes about 2 seconds after completion, by design Why is there no such window for format conversion? Format conversion uses a modal progress dialog and is not a rendering job Troubleshooting Symptom Cause What to do Cancel appears to do nothing The current asset is finishing (cooperative cancellation); wait It ends naturally once the stage line reads "Cancelling…" The job stays on "Preparing…" mayapy will not start (path / environment issue) Cancel and check the headless dependencies, see 8.12.6 Everything failed The renderer is unavailable, or models / textures are missing Read the summary dialog and the Script Editor log A few assets were skipped Those assets have no

items.title: Fill missing thumbnails window
synonyms: fill thumbnails for the whole library at once
items.summary: One-line summary: the whole-library scan window opened from Maintenance → Fill missing thumbnails…: it first lists assets missing a thumbnail or holding only a
items.text: One-line summary: the whole-library scan window opened from Maintenance → Fill missing thumbnails…: it first lists assets missing a thumbnail or holding only a placeholder, lets you choose, then hands the selection to headless batch rendering. How to open it Top toolbar → Maintenance ▾ → Fill missing thumbnails… ; It scans the current library immediately on opening (reading every meta in the library, so large libraries take a moment and the cursor becomes a wait cursor). Prerequisite: an asset library is loaded; when none is loaded it asks you to open one first. What the window contains Area Content Summary line "Scanned N assets that need images (missing thumbnail or placeholder only)"; with none it reads "No assets need images: the whole library has thumbnails." Hint line Explains multi-select, the context menu and what Start generating will do Asset list Each row shows "name / asset path · status", with only two statuses: missing thumbnail and placeholder only ; selected entirely by default Bottom buttons From the left: Rescan , Start generating (N) , Cancel How to choose Everything is selected by default, which suits routine maintenance; To fill only some: Ctrl+click / Shift+click to deselect the rest; Right-clicking a row (it opens on press) offers three items: Item Effect Description Locate asset Switches the main window to the asset's sub-library / category, selects it and brings it forward Falls back to selecting by path when the record cannot be found; this window changes no library state Open asset path Opens the asset's disk directory in Explorer For checking the asset content by hand Remove from list Takes the row out of this list only UI only, nothing on disk; Rescan brings it back After clicking Start generating The Background render options window appears first: renderer, preset model, environment light, size and quality ( 8.12.6 ); After confirming, a separate mayapy process renders the selected assets one by one; the progress window is in 8.12.7 ; The job runs in the background and does not occupy the current viewport or change the scene , so you can keep working in Maya; When it finishes the main window refreshes and the card images update. Risks and how to undo Operation Risk Undo Start generating It overwrites those assets' existing thumbnails (placeholders are replaced too) Render again; the old image has no backup, so first save important images with Update thumbnail → Import Remove from list Only skipped this time Rescan restores it Cancel midway Cooperative cancellation: it stops after the current asset finishes Finished images are kept, so fill in the rest next time Troubleshooting Symptom Cause What to do The scan result is empty The whole library really does have thumbnails Use Update thumbnail → Background render on individual assets It reports no usable headless renderer kick / oiiotool is missing, or no same-version mayapy See "Troubleshooting" in 8.12.6 The image is still gray afterwards The asset lacks geometry, or rendering failed Read the progress window log, or capture / import an image manually Related Other Maintenance menu items: 8.2.8 Background render options: 8.12.6 ; headless job progress: 8.12.7 The single-asset thumbnail flow: 4.1.7.1 Batch rendering and cancelling jobs: 4.7.6.2

items.title: Clean invalid assets window
items.summary: One-line summary: the scan window opened from Maintenance → Clean invalid assets: it lists assets missing meta.json or holding only an empty directory so you ca
items.text: One-line summary: the scan window opened from Maintenance → Clean invalid assets: it lists assets missing meta.json or holding only an empty directory so you can verify, repair, clear from the list, or move them to the recycle bin. How to open it Top toolbar → Maintenance ▾ → Clean invalid assets . It scans the current library as soon as it opens; the cursor becomes a wait cursor while scanning. Prerequisite: an asset library is loaded; with none loaded it asks you to open one first. items.text: One-line summary: describe what you want in one sentence (or just send a reference image) and it finds the closest assets in the current library. This is not ordinary file-name search. It first turns your sentence into intent keywords and then runs a vector search in the library with them; with use global model ticked, the understanding step is handed to the large model. That is why it can find words that are not in any name (for example "gray frosted sphere" still hits). How to open it Two routes open the same interface: Standalone window : top toolbar AI tools → click AI search preview assets in the menu. As a panel inside the main interface : top toolbar Panels and layout → New panel → AI search preview assets ; you can also switch an existing area's header dropdown to this panel type. Also note the AI search checkbox to the right of the main window's search box is not this window — that one searches the asset grid semantically, see 8.2.3 . Three prerequisites Open an asset library first . With no library nothing typed into this window works; it reports "open an asset library before using AI search". To use the large model for intent analysis : configure the global model in Settings → AI settings first, then tick use global model back in this window. Unticked also works, using only local vector retrieval (no model calls, no cost, no network). To make search-by-image work : the local AI dependencies (embedding model) must be installed. On the first search the status bar shows "loading embedding model… (about 10–20 seconds the first time, seconds afterwards)", which is normal. items.text: One-line summary: a separate model configuration for AI search — choose a provider, enter a key and address, pick a model. It is the small window behind the ⚙ button at the top right of the AI search window and only governs AI search . Note that it is a different configuration from the global model in Settings → AI settings : changing this does not affect AI thumbnail analysis, and vice versa. The reason is practical — search needs to be fast and cheap while analysis needs to understand images, so they naturally pick different model tiers. How to open it Open the AI search window (see 8.13.1 ); Click the ⚙ (AI service configuration) button at its top right. The four fields Control Effect How to fill it Provider Which vendor's model API to use. Options: Ollama (local), DeepSeek, Qwen (Alibaba Cloud DashScope), Zhipu (BigModel), OpenAI, custom (OpenAI compatible) With Ollama installed locally choose Ollama (local) — no key and no network; for cloud choose the matching vendor API key The key for a cloud provider; local services do not need one Required for cloud providers; the input is a password field showing dots. With Ollama the row grays out and clears API address The endpoint. When switching providers, if the current value is still some default address it is automatically replaced by that provider's default Usually leave it; change it only for a proxy / relay (custom must be filled in) AI model The model actually used for intent analysis. The dropdown is fetched live from the provider , and you can also type a model name directly Pick one from the list, or type the model when you know it Behaviors to know The model list is fetched live, not hard-coded. Opening the window, switching provider, or changing the API key / address and pressing Enter all refetch it; while loading it shows "fetching model list…". When the list cannot be fetched the dropdown holds only "(cannot fetch model list, check the address / API key)" — the address or key is wrong, fix those first. Choosing a model saves immediately (still there after restarting the plug-in) and does not wait for OK. Clicking OK before the list finishes loading is blocked with "the model list has not finished loading, please wait" — this prevents storing an empty model name. Cancel only discards this session's page changes , while model selections already saved live stay on disk. To truly return to the old state, select the previous provider / model again. This configuration only affects AI search's intent analysis . It does not take part in retrieval when use global model is unticked in the AI search window. How it relates to the global model in Settings → AI settings AI search settings (this page) Settings → AI settings (global model) Governs Only AI search intent analysis AI thumbnail analysis, AI assistant and other global calls Storage AI search's own namespace, saved independently Plug-in settings (applied as a whole on OK) Do they affect each other No: changing one leaves the other alone Same When it applies When the AI search window has use global model ticked All AI features use it by default Troubleshooting a model list that will not load Symptom Likely cause What to do The dropdown shows only "(cannot fetch model list…)" Wrong or expired API key, or a wrong API address First confirm the key belongs to this provider, then reset the address to that provider's default Ollama cannot list models either Local Ollama is not running, or the port is not the default 11434 Start Ollama, then switch provider once in the window to trigger a refetch The list loads but sending reports "model does not exist" The chosen model is unavailable / retired for that provider Pick another from the list, or type a model name that really exists OK is blocked with "model list has not finished loading" The list is still fetching in the background Wait two seconds or select an existing entry first A complete configuration flow AI search window → ⚙; Choose the provider (on first use, validate the

items.text: One-line summary: let AI look at an asset thumbnail and suggest a name, category, tags and notes; you tick what you accept and write it into the asset metadata. It is "describe what you see": the input is the thumbnail and the output is four metadata suggestions. That is why assets without a thumbnail cannot be analyzed (they are skipped with a message). AI only suggests; nothing is written until you tick fields and click Apply to metadata — that review step is your chance to fix mistakes. How to open it There are two entries, differing in how many assets are analyzed and whether the configuration window comes first: Entry Location Behavior Single asset (straight to results) In the asset grid right-click one asset → AI thumbnail analysis Analyzes directly with the analysis configuration in Settings → AI settings and then shows the results window described here One or more assets (configure first) Top toolbar AI tools → the first menu item "AI thumbnail analysis (N selected assets)" First shows the AI analysis configuration window to confirm provider / model / language, then runs a progress bar after Start analysis ; with "show a window for review and editing when done" ticked, results windows follow per count One selected: the AI analysis results window described here appears afterwards. Several selected: the batch results window appears, see 8.13.4 . text-only models cannot analyze thumbnails Output language Chinese / English, deciding the language of the generated names, tags and notes Follow the team's convention Yellow hint line Per-provider reminder about which models cannot handle images; finished assets are kept) — Step two: the AI analysis results window Asset information (read-only) Control Effect Original name The asset's current name, to compare against the suggested name below Top-level category Which sub-library the asset belongs to (such as materials) AI analysis results (tick field by field) Control Effect Suggested value Name checkbox plus input The AI-suggested readable name Tick only what you accept; items.text: One-line summary: after analyzing many assets at once, this window lines the results up so you can review and tick them one by one, then write them into the library in one go. It uses the same fields as the single-asset results window ( 8.13.3 ) with two differences: several cards on one screen , and an extra "apply selected assets (N)" button at the bottom (N shows how many are ticked). How to make it appear Select several assets in the grid (Ctrl / Shift multi-select, or select all in the batch bar, see 8.5.21 ); Top toolbar AI tools → "AI thumbnail analysis (N selected assets)"; In the AI analysis configuration window keep "show a window for review and editing when done" ticked and click Start analysis ; When the progress bar finishes this window opens automatically. Without that review option there is no window — results are written straight into the library. On the first batch use, always keep the review option. What each part does Top row Control Effect Suggested value Title "N assets analyzed, edit then tick to apply:" Says how many are in this batch and that confirmation is manual — Select all Ticks every field of every asset (equal to "accept all AI suggestions") Only when you deeply trust this batch Clear all Clears every field's checkbox so you can pick per item The recommended starting point One card per asset Each card corresponds to one asset and holds checkbox-plus-input fields (with Category and Tags on the same row , tags to the right); a preview panel on the right shows the current card's image, name and category: Control Effect Suggested value Card title row (original name + sub-library) Which asset this is and which sub-library it belongs to First check that the name matches Name checkbox plus input The AI-suggested new name Edit it in the box before ticking Category checkbox plus input The AI-suggested sub-category If unsure, leave the category unticked and use the other fields Tags checkbox plus input (placeholder "tags", same row as category, on the right) The AI-suggested tags, comma separated Applying tags first is the lowest-risk approach Notes checkbox plus input A description Useful for search Right preview panel (image + name + category) Confirms at a glance what the asset was judged as Scan it to spot obviously wrong ones Bottom Control Effect Notes Checkbox "move into the analyzed category" Ticked = moves the asset files into each analyzed category directory when applying Batch moving is the riskiest item, see the risks below Cancel button Writes none of the batch and closes Results are discarded but the library is untouched Apply selected assets (N) button Writes the assets with at least one field ticked into the library; N is the number of ticked assets Scan the ticks once more before clicking A complete flow Multi-select assets → AI tools menu → analyze → this window appears; Click Clear all first (unless you fully trust this batch); Go through the cards top to bottom: name, category, tags, notes; Tick the fields you accept; edit anything you want changed inside the input before ticking; Use each card's summary to see "what the AI understood"; skip the whole card when it is clearly off; If the files should not move around, leave "move into the analyzed category" unticked at the bottom; Click Apply selected assets (N) ; Refresh the grid and verify the names / tags / notes changed as expected. What you see afterwards The ticked fields are written into the matching assets' metadata; assets with no ticked field are completely untouched. If "move into the analyzed category" was ticked, those assets move from their original category into the new one (visible after the tree refreshes). A large batch is processed asset by asset, and the main interface returns when it finishes. Risks and how to undo (the most important part of this page) Changing many assets at once has no one-click undo. Split it into two rounds: apply tags only first, and handle names and notes once that looks right. Ticking "move in

items.text: One-line summary: connect Squirrel Asset Manager's capabilities (skill docs plus the MCP tool entry) to external AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex and Trae, so they know you have an asset library and Maya. For an external tool to really do work, both halves are needed; with only one, "the model knows this exists but cannot call it": Skill landing : copying our skill docs into the other tool's skill directory; MCP channel : writing this plug-in's MCP entry into the other tool's configuration — that is what makes the squirrel_* tools mentioned in the skills actually exist. That is why the window shows the state of the two halves separately for each tool. How to open it Settings → AI settings → the "External AI tools…" button . Note: actions in this window persist on the spot (copying skills / writing the other tool's config) and do not follow the settings window's OK / Cancel semantics — clicking Cancel does not roll back an install already done.
