Causes and rules Situation Rule Adding from files, textures, HDR or a .zasset When the target category already has a same-named asset, the new name gets _001 , _002 Importing into the scene By default into an isolated namespace named after the asset ( _1 / _2 on clashes); this can be turned off in Settings → 常规 → 导入命名空间 (General → Import namespace) , after which everything goes into the root namespace : and Maya renames duplicate nodes Adding a reference The namespace uses the asset name, appending _1 , _2 when it already exists MCM name mapping When Maya appends a numeric suffix to a scene material, matching falls back to the name with the trailing number removed Importing audio to the timeline A same-named sound node would be replaced, so the plug-in first gives the new sound a unique name Importing images Importing the same image several times creates several file nodes, with Maya numbering the node names Importing animation data Written by node name / hierarchy mapping; when names do not match nothing is written (see 5.7.1) Steps Check the final asset name in the grid and rename it in the properties panel if needed. When the scene needs fixed names, create an isolated namespace with a Reference first and then work inside it. When a name gets an automatic suffix, check whether a same-named node or material already exists and was not cleaned up. When MCM matching fails, check the selected object's topology instead of relying on names. Verify the result The new asset name matches expectations and nothing in the grid is overwritten or lost. Node names in the Outliner carry the expected namespace or number. Material assignments correspond to the selected objects. Tips The plug-in never overwrites an existing asset or an existing scene node. When unique names are required, clean up same-named nodes in Maya first or isolate them with a Reference.

items.title: Material mismatch
items.summary: A material mismatch means the imported material belongs to another renderer, or the cross-renderer conversion has no usable mapping path, so the material does n
items.text: A material mismatch means the imported material belongs to another renderer, or the cross-renderer conversion has no usable mapping path, so the material does not take part in the current render. Symptoms The material node type in the Hypershade does not match the current renderer. The material renders black, loses highlights, or only a default material shows. The log says 「无 … 映射路径，保留原材质」 (no mapping path for …, keeping the original material) . The 「转换导入」 (Convert import) submenu is missing the target type. Common causes Cause Notes The asset material belongs to another renderer For example an Arnold asset imported into a V-Ray scene The current renderer is not supported Automatic conversion only supports Arnold, V-Ray and Redshift A .mmap mapping file is missing The target type has no direct or intermediate path The target renderer plug-in is not installed The target material node cannot be created Native Maya materials Not converted automatically, kept as their original type Steps Check the actual material node type in the Hypershade. Confirm that defaultRenderGlobals.currentRenderer matches the target renderer. Right-click the material asset and use 「转换导入」 (Convert import) to choose a target type; a type missing from the submenu has no mapping path. To sync attributes only between materials of the same type, use 「应用材质参数」 (Apply material parameters) instead of a full conversion. If the target plug-in is not installed, install and load the renderer plug-in and then convert. Verify the result The material node type matches the current renderer. Renders are no longer black and textures and highlights look right. The log no longer says 「无 … 映射路径」 (no mapping path) . If it still fails Use 「应用材质到选中」 (Apply material to selection) to rebuild the material network and rule out leftovers from the old material. Use MCM to reassign materials by topology and rule out material name mapping issues. Note the source and target types and report the missing mapping path.

items.title: Import from files
items.summary: 「从文件导入」 (Import from files) packages each asset file on disk into its own .zasset inside the current category; it never imports directly into the Maya scene. Pr
items.text: 「从文件导入」 (Import from files) packages each asset file on disk into its own .zasset inside the current category; it never imports directly into the Maya scene. Prerequisites A specific category is selected on the left. On 「全部资产」 (All assets) or across top-level categories the whole 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) menu is disabled and shows one grey line: 「当前分类不支持从外部导入」 (this category does not support importing from files) ; dropping files onto the grid is blocked the same way with 「请先在左侧选中一个分类，再把文件拖进来。」 (select a category on the left first, then drag the files in.) . The current category supports 「从文件导入」 (Import from files) : materials, models, lights, scenes, dynamics, node trees. The textures and HDR sub-libraries only have 「导入 .zasset 资产」 (Import a .zasset asset) plus their own imports (import texture / import HDR); the images, audio and animation data sub-libraries only have their own loose-file entries. The files to import are readable on disk. Steps Click 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) in the toolbar above the asset area (tooltip 「导入外部资产（支持文件夹或单个文件）」 (import external assets; folders or single files) ). Choose 「从文件导入」 (Import from files) . Select one or more files in the file dialog; the filter covers the configured asset extensions. On confirm the plug-in creates one independent .zasset per file inside the current category. When the target category already has a same-named asset, the new name gets _001 , _002 suffixes automatically. Verify the result New assets appear in the grid, matching the number of files chosen. Opening the asset directory shows same-named .zasset folders containing the source files. 「未能导入任何资产」 (no asset could be imported) means not one file succeeded; check that the files are readable. Tips This only adds to the library and never changes the Maya scene; to put an asset into the scene, right-click 「导入」 (Import) or double-click it afterwards. The asset name comes from the file name without extension and can be changed in the properties panel on the right. The menu is trimmed by the current top-level category: 「从文件导入」 (Import from files) does not appear under the textures, HDR, images, audio or animation data sub-libraries, which is intentional (those sub-libraries only accept their own kind of file); not finding the entry elsewhere is not a broken plug-in.

items.title: Import textures
items.summary: 「导入贴图」 (Import texture) merges the selected textures into one PBR texture asset inside the current category. Prerequisites A specific category is selected on th
items.text: 「导入贴图」 (Import texture) merges the selected textures into one PBR texture asset inside the current category. Prerequisites A specific category is selected on the left. On 「全部资产」 (All assets) the whole 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) menu is disabled and only the grey line 「当前分类不支持从外部导入」 (this category does not support importing from files) is shown. The current top-level category is materials or textures : 「导入贴图」 (Import texture) only appears in 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) of those two sub-libraries and not in the others. The texture file names indicate their role (such as _basecolor , _normal , _roughness ). Steps Click 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) in the toolbar above the asset area. Choose 「导入贴图」 (Import texture) . Select several textures of one PBR set in the file dialog; png, jpg, jpeg, tga, tif, tiff, bmp and exr are supported. On confirm the plug-in creates one .zasset and puts all textures into its textures/ . The asset name comes from the color texture's file name: the PBR role suffix is removed first, then resolution suffixes such as _1k , _2k and _4k . Verify the result One texture asset appears in the grid, with a thumbnail generated from the color texture. textures/ in the asset directory contains every texture selected. It reports 「成功导入 N 个贴图资产」 (imported N texture assets) ; when no color role is recognized the thumbnail uses the last file. Tips A multi-selection is treated as one PBR set; import different sets separately. Role detection relies on the alias rules in Assets/preset/pbr_mapping.json ; non-standard names affect channel matching. After it is in the library, right-click 「创建材质」 (Create material) to connect the textures to the material channels by role.

items.title: Import HDR
synonyms: put an HDR in the library
items.summary: 「导入HDR」 (Import HDR) packages .hdr and .exr files into separate HDR assets inside the current category; it never creates a dome light automatically. Prerequisit
items.text: 「导入HDR」 (Import HDR) packages .hdr and .exr files into separate HDR assets inside the current category; it never creates a dome light automatically. Prerequisites The left column is switched to the HDR sub-library and a target category is selected. 「导入HDR」 (Import HDR) only appears in 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) of the HDR sub-library, where the menu has just 「导入 .zasset 资产」 (Import a .zasset asset) and 「导入HDR」 (Import HDR) . On 「全部资产」 (All assets) the whole 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) menu is disabled and only the grey line 「当前分类不支持从外部导入」 (this category does not support importing from files) is shown. The HDR files are readable on disk. Steps Switch the category tree on the left to the HDR sub-library and select the target category. Click 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) in the toolbar above the asset area. Choose 「导入HDR」 (Import HDR) . Select one or more .hdr and .exr files in the file dialog. On confirm each file becomes its own .zasset with the HDR stored in its textures/ . The plug-in generates a thumbnail from the HDR content. Verify the result The matching number of HDR assets appears in the grid with visible thumbnails; when thumbnail generation fails the asset is still added. textures/ in the asset directory contains the original HDR file. It reports 「成功导入 N 个HDR资产」 (imported N HDR assets) , matching the number of files chosen. Tips This only adds to the library. To build an environment light in the scene, right-click the HDR asset and choose 「创建环境光」 (Create environment light) , or drag the HDR straight into the viewport. To change the texture of an existing dome light, select the dome light and then right-click the HDR asset and choose 「指定贴图」 (Assign texture) . Not finding 「导入HDR」 (Import HDR) in other sub-libraries is normal: the entry belongs only to the HDR sub-library, which keeps environment images from being filed into material or model categories by mistake.

items.title: Import .zasset
items.summary: 「导入 .zasset 资产」 (Import a .zasset asset) copies .zasset assets from an external folder into the current category in bulk and gives them new asset IDs. Prerequis
items.text: 「导入 .zasset 资产」 (Import a .zasset asset) copies .zasset assets from an external folder into the current category in bulk and gives them new asset IDs. Prerequisites A specific category is selected on the left. On 「全部资产」 (All assets) the whole 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) menu is disabled and only the grey line 「当前分类不支持从外部导入」 (this category does not support importing from files) is shown. The current sub-library is not images or audio: those two only have loose-file entries and no 「导入 .zasset 资产」 (Import a .zasset asset) . The external folder directly contains one or more .zasset sub-folders. Steps Click 「从外部导入」 (Import from Files) in the toolbar above the asset area. Choose 「导入 .zasset 资产」 (Import a .zasset asset) . Select the folder containing the .zasset folders in the directory dialog. The plug-in scans only the .zasset sub-directories one level down in that folder and copies them one by one into the current category. After copying it rewrites the asset IDs and redirects paths in meta.json that pointed at the source directory to the new directory. When the target category already has a same-named asset, the new name gets _001 , _002 suffixes. Verify the result 「导入完成」 (import finished) appears with 「成功导入 N 个 .zasset 资产」 (imported N .zasset assets) . When some copies fail the same message appends 「跳过 N 个（复制失败）」 (skipped N, copy failed) . New assets appear in the grid and the category tree locates the import target category automatically. Tips When no .zasset is found it reports 「在选定文件夹中未找到 .zasset 资产」 (no .zasset asset found in the selected folder) ; check which directory level you picked. Prefer this entry for migrating assets instead of copying .zasset folders by hand, which leaves assets outside the library index. Metadata such as texture_map and formats in the source asset is preserved; only identity and ownership fields are replaced.

items.title: Dependency collection policy
items.summary: Where textures and linked files land on import is decided by two settings in Settings → 常规 (General) : the texture import policy and the dependency file import
items.text: Where textures and linked files land on import is decided by two settings in Settings → 常规 (General) : the texture import policy and the dependency file import policy. Option Texture location Linked files and references Copy textures into the project / copy into the project Project sourceimages/squirrel_asset/<asset name>_<last 4 of ID>/ Project cache/squirrel_asset/<asset name>_<last 4 of ID>/ ; references go to references/squirrel_asset/<asset name>_<last 4 of ID>/ Current asset directory Reads the files inside .zasset/textures/ directly, no copy Reads the files inside .zasset/deps/ directly, no copy Source file directory Keeps the original absolute paths recorded at export, unmodified Keeps the original absolute paths recorded at export, unmodified Where they apply The texture policy applies to ma/mb import, zmetal material import, zlight light import, texture import, HDR texture assignment and environment light creation. The dependency policy applies to ma/mb import and 「添加引用」 (Add reference) , preferring a full source-path match against meta.dependency_map and falling back to file-name matching. Both policies are persisted in Assets/preset/config.json ; the current repository default is asset_directory , and the Settings window shows the effective value. Recommendations Library and project on the same machine, with asset directories often reorganized: choose 「当前资产目录」 (current asset directory) so no copies are made. The project must be copied elsewhere or handed to someone else: choose 「拷贝到项目」 (copy into the project) , which gives the most stable paths. Source files live at fixed locations and disk space is tight: choose 「源文件目录」 (source file directory) ; once a source file moves, textures and dependencies break.

items.title: The three export modes
items.summary: The export mode answers one question only: do the objects selected at once merge into one asset or does each object become its own asset, and does the program c
items.text: The export mode answers one question only: do the objects selected at once merge into one asset or does each object become its own asset, and does the program capture the thumbnail automatically or do you capture it by hand. Mode comparison UI option Result Thumbnail Best for Single asset (merge into one asset, manual capture) All selected objects merge into one .zasset Manual marquee each time A combined model, a whole material set Full-auto (each object a separate asset, automatic capture) One .zasset per object Frame the first one manually and reuse that region automatically Batch organizing similar models Semi-auto (each object a separate asset, manual capture) One .zasset per object Manual marquee every time Every asset needs its own framing Single asset Every selected DAG object is written into the same asset; the material comes from the first material node that can be resolved. This mode does not hide or isolate unselected objects automatically, so isolate the view yourself when needed (viewport isolate display, shortcut Shift+I ) and restore it after capturing. Full-auto Each DAG object is exported separately. The program isolates the current target automatically; you position the framing and marquee the capture region for the first asset, and later assets reuse the same framing and region with the target moved to the center of the image — it never auto-frames or changes the camera distance. 「截图延迟」 (Capture delay) in the left column appears only in full-auto mode and waits for the viewport to refresh before capturing. Semi-auto Each object is exported separately, but every export opens the screenshot overlay so you can re-frame and capture manually. The program also isolates the current target automatically and never auto-frames. Notes on the current version Older help called the button 「导出资产」 (Export asset) ; in the current version the toolbar and dialog button are 「创建资产」 (Create asset) . Older help also put naming and tags in the right column; the current left column holds "create asset + export mode + naming information + thumbnail source + tags", and the right column holds "collect linked files + per-format sections". The current interface is authoritative. In single-asset mode, if only material nodes are selected, only the first material node is written as the material source. To give every material its own asset, use full-auto or semi-auto.

items.title: Full export workflow
synonyms: how to store a model in the library
items.summary: One export goes from selected objects to an asset in the grid through five groups of settings: category, mode, format, naming and capture. Prerequisites Maya ha
items.text: One export goes from selected objects to an asset in the grid through five groups of settings: category, mode, format, naming and capture. Prerequisites Maya has the scene to export open and the plug-in main window is connected to the library. A writable category is selected in the left tree. 「全部」 (All) and sub-library roots cannot hold assets directly, and a top-level category redirects to its 「自定义」 (Custom) sub-category automatically. The DAG objects or material nodes to export are selected in the Maya viewport. At least one content source is checked (material preset, geometry, cache, proxy, or 贴图 textures/ (textures) ); with none checked the result is only meta.json and a thumbnail. Steps Select the target sub-library and category in the left tree. Select objects in the Maya viewport; export reads the current selection live rather than the selection captured when the dialog opened. Click 「创建资产」 (Create asset) in the toolbar to open the export dialog. It is non-modal, so the rest of the interface stays usable during the export. Choose the export mode in the left column: single asset, full-auto or semi-auto; full-auto also lets you set 「截图延迟」 (Capture delay) . Choose the thumbnail source in the left column: screenshot tool, Maya playblast or render. Check the export content in the right column. Check 「收集场景中已挂载的缓存/代理/引用文件」 (collect caches / proxies / references attached in the scene) when those files are needed, and keep 「贴图 textures/」 (textures) when material textures are needed. When animation is needed, choose current frame, timeline or keyframes under 「动画导出」 (Animation export) . In 「命名信息」 (Naming information) fill in the name (English, used in the file name) and the display name (Chinese, optional); pick or type tags in the tag area. Click 「创建资产」 (Create asset) . In screenshot-tool mode marquee a region on the screen overlay and confirm; in batch mode wait for the progress window. When it finishes the asset appears in the grid and is selected automatically. Verify the result A <name>.zasset folder appears in the category directory and the grid shows the matching card and thumbnail. Opening .zasset/meta.json shows formats matching the formats actually checked. After a batch export a result dialog appears: on full success it shows the count; with failures it lists the asset names and reasons plus a 「重试」 (Retry) button that reruns only the failed items. Tips and warnings Tip : the screenshot tool is fastest; playblast and render generate thumbnails after the whole batch finishes, without blocking the geometry export. Tip : a same-named asset opens a conflict dialog where you can auto-rename or type a new name, and optionally remember the choice for this run. Warning : timeline plus render renders frame by frame, so Maya becomes unresponsive for a while; this is normal, just wait for it to finish.

items.title: Export output structure
items.summary: A .zasset is a folder holding metadata, geometry, materials, textures, thumbnails and dependencies; the folder itself is the complete asset. Directory layout My
items.text: A .zasset is a folder holding metadata, geometry, materials, textures, thumbnails and dependencies; the folder itself is the complete asset. Directory layout MyAsset.zasset/ ├── meta.json # metadata ├── node.ma / node.mb / node.fbx / node.obj / node.usd ├── node.zmetal # material node network (material / model assets) ├── node.zlight # light preset (light assets) ├── node.mcm # material → model mapping ├── textures/ # material and light textures ├── deps/ # collected linked files (optional; associated/ in older versions) │ ├── textures/ caches/ proxies/ volumes/ │ ├── references/ audio/ movies/ imageplanes/ others/ ├── thumb.sicon # static thumbnail ├── thumb.aicon / thumb.mp4 # animated or video thumbnail ├── lods.json # current LOD index (lod0 = root geometry) ├── lod1/ # LOD1 and later geometry ├── variants.json # variant registry (variant geometry / thumbnails, legacy versions and version materials) ├── variants/ # variant geometry (<id>.ma flat; older layout <version>/lod*/) └── V1/ V2/ … # new versions: each a self-contained version asset (registered in meta.json) Key files File Purpose meta.json Asset identity and index: id , name , name_cn , tags , category , asset_type , formats , ani and so on node.<ext> Root geometry, equivalent to lod0 ; several formats can coexist node.zmetal / node.zlight Material or light node network, rebuilt on import node.mcm Vertex / face / edge counts and per-face material assignments, used to match models on import textures/ Textures stored flat; same name and content keeps one copy, same name with different content gets a number appended deps/ Copied only when "collect linked files" is checked; sub-directories classify by file type (the older name associated/ is still read) lods.json Current LOD index: default_lod and the lods list; lod0 points at the root geometry variants.json Registry for variants and legacy versions: variants[] (geometry and thumbnail entries per variant) and versions[] (legacy version labels, LOD lists, per-version material paths) variants/ Variant geometry: the new layout is flat variants/<variant id>.ma (with several LODs variants/<id>_lod1.ma ); the older layout is variants/<version>/lod*/ ; variant thumbnails also live here V1/ , V2/ Embedded self-contained versions created by Update asset → Create new version , each with its own meta.json ; the main asset's version_assets registers these sub-versions The dependency ledger in metadata Whether or not collection is checked, export scans dependencies and records the result in meta.json : dependencies_missing lists files that could not be found, dependencies_out_of_scope lists dependencies not packaged this time, and dependencies_unresolved_tokens lists unparsable tokens in paths. texture_map records the mapping from original texture paths to in-package paths, which import uses to remap them. Two indexes: lods.json and variants.json coexist lods.json and variants.json are two indexes used together , each covering one area, rather than "the new structure replacing the old": lods.json covers the current LODs: default_lod plus the lods list, with lod0 pointing at the root geometry and lod1/ … holding progressively lower detail. variants.json covers variants and legacy versions : Variants: one entry per variant in variants[] , geometry stored flat as variants/<id>.ma (or variants/<id>/lod*/ in the older structure), thumbnails also under variants/ ; Legacy versions: versions[] records the version id, label and LOD list, with geometry in variants/<version>/lod*/ ; per-version materials for those versions are exported to variants/<version>/node.zmetal and written into that version's material field. These are still being written today : adding and removing variants ( add_variant / add_variant_lod / remove_variant in core/zasset_builder.py ) and per-version materials ( _export_variant_material in core/export_orchestrator.py ) all update variants.json . So finding a variants.json in an asset is not legacy residue — it means th

items.title: Left-side export controls
synonyms: left side of the export panel
how to fill the asset name
items.summary: The left column decides "how this export runs": the start button, export mode, capture method, naming and tags. Control Label in the UI Notes Start button 创建资产
items.text: The left column decides "how this export runs": the start button, export mode, capture method, naming and tags. Control Label in the UI Notes Start button 创建资产 (Create asset) Reads the current Maya selection and starts exporting; the dialog is non-modal, so the rest of the interface stays usable Help button Orange help icon Opens the legacy export help page Export mode 全自动（各物体独立资产，自动截图） / 半自动（各物体独立资产，手动截图） / 单资产（合并为一个资产，手动截图） Single asset is the default; the differences are described in "The three export modes" Capture delay 截图延迟: plus a seconds field Range 0–60 seconds, 2 by default, 0 meaning no wait; shown only in full-auto mode Naming information 名称（英文，Maya 节点用） / 易读名（中文显示，可空） The name goes into the .zasset file name; the display name only affects the interface Thumbnail source 截屏工具 / Maya 拍屏 / 渲染图 Pick one of three; see "Thumbnail source and capture delay" for details Create model 创建模型 dropdown Lists the models under the plug-in's Assets/Meshes ; choosing one imports it into the current scene and hovering an entry shows a same-named PNG preview Create light 创建灯光 dropdown Lists the HDRs under the plug-in's Assets/IBL ; choosing one creates a dome light for the current renderer, and hovering shows a same-named PNG preview Selected tags 已选标签 Shows the tags to be written for this export; click a chip to remove it Common tags 常用标签 Clicking a tag adds it to the selected tags; the box below accepts a new tag on Enter or via + 添加 (+ Add) Info line 目标分类 / 源节点 / 关联物体 / 检测到 N 个材质 Read-only hints that follow the category and selection captured when the dialog opened Naming rules in batch modes In full-auto and semi-auto the name box placeholder reads "name the first asset manually → later assets use their node names", and the display name hint reads "leave later assets empty". When the name is left empty each asset uses its own object or material node name, and only the display name typed for the first asset takes effect. Append-format mode Entering from Update asset → Append format adds a yellow hint at the very top of the right column : no format is checked by default, formats the asset already has are marked (已存在) (already present) , checking one replaces that format's original file with this export, and unchecked formats stay as they are. Notes on the current version Older help put "export mode, thumbnail source and capture delay" on the left and "asset name, Chinese name and tags" on the right; the current version has "create asset + export mode + naming information + thumbnail source + tags" on the left and "collect linked files + export options + per-format sections" on the right. The current interface wording is authoritative.

items.title: Right-side export configuration
synonyms: right side of the export panel
items.summary: The right column decides "what gets packaged": linked files, material and light nodes, geometry, animation, caches and proxies are all checked per section. Sect
items.text: The right column decides "what gets packaged": linked files, material and light nodes, geometry, animation, caches and proxies are all checked per section. Section Control Notes Collect linked files 收集场景中已挂载的缓存/代理/引用文件 (collect caches / proxies / references attached in the scene) When checked, caches, proxies and references already on disk are copied into deps/ ; unchecked only scans and records the list Collect linked files 贴图 textures/ (textures) Checked by default; copies the textures linked to materials and lights into textures/ Export options 仅导出材质（跳过几何体/代理） (export materials only, skipping geometry / proxies) Packages only material nodes and textures; checked by default for the materials sub-library, see "Exporting materials only" Material format / light format / node format 材质预设 .zmetal / 灯光预设 .zlight / 节点预设 .zmetal The section title follows the current sub-library: .zmetal for materials and most other sub-libraries, .zlight for the lights sub-library As above 全部材质写入一个 .zmetal (write all materials into one .zmetal) When checked everything merges into one file; unchecked with material nodes selected writes one file per material; not shown for light assets As above 材质映射 .mcm (检测到 N 个材质) Records the models and per-face assignments the materials correspond to; not shown for light assets Geometry formats (native Maya export) Maya ASCII .ma / Maya Binary .mb / FBX .fbx / OBJ .obj / USD .usd Multi-select; exported natively by Maya, and .ma / .mb keep references without baking Animation export 当前帧 / 时间轴 / 关键帧 Decides the frame range for abc/usd/ass/rs/vrmesh ; current frame is a still Cache formats Alembic .abc Exports an Alembic cache; the frame range follows animation export Proxy formats Arnold .ass / Redshift .rs / V-Ray .vrscene / V-Ray .vrmesh Renderer proxies; the matching plug-in must be loaded Plug-in status To the right of the geometry, cache and proxy checkboxes the plug-in status is shown: 已就绪 (ready) , 未加载 (not loaded) or 不可用 (unavailable) . When it says unavailable the checkbox is greyed out and cannot be chosen for this export; when it says not loaded, load the plug-in in Maya's plug-in manager first and then close and reopen the export dialog. Locked formats Formats that do not apply to the current category are greyed out and cannot be checked ; hovering says 「该格式不适用于当前分类，已锁定（可在 设置 → 导出默认值 中调整）」 (this format does not apply to the current category and is locked; adjust it in Settings → Export defaults) . Default locking rules: materials and lights lock geometry and all proxy formats (such assets have no geometry); textures, HDR, images, music and animation data lock almost every node and geometry format. To unlock, turn off that format's lock on the Settings → 导出默认值 (Export defaults) page (see 6.4.1 ). Hint in append-format mode Entering from Update asset → Append format adds a yellow hint at the top of the right column : no format is checked by default, formats the asset already has are marked (已存在) (already present) , checking one replaces that format's original file with this export, and leaving it unchecked keeps it as is. A normal Create asset preselects formats from the export defaults instead, which is different. What the combinations produce Only .zmetal + 贴图 textures/ (textures): a material asset whose material network is rebuilt on import. A geometry format: a model asset; check .zmetal or .mcm as well when the material should travel with the model. A cache or proxy: animation or renderer-specific files whose import depends on the target Maya having that plug-in installed. Notes on the current version Older help also drew "asset name, Chinese name and tags" on the right; in the current version they are on the left and the right column starts with collect linked files. The section names and checkbox wording in the current interface are authoritative.

items.title: Thumbnail source and capture delay
synonyms: where does the preview come from
items.summary: The thumbnail source decides how the image is produced and how fast; the capture delay only affects automatic captures of later assets in full-auto mode. Prereq
items.text: The thumbnail source decides how the image is produced and how fast; the capture delay only affects automatic captures of later assets in full-auto mode. Prerequisites The objects to capture or playblast are visible in the viewport; single-asset mode does not isolate automatically, so isolate manually when needed. With Render the scene needs a renderable camera and the current renderer installed. The thumbnail edge length comes from Settings → 常规 → 缩略图大小 (General → Thumbnail size) , 512 pixels by default. Steps Choose one under 「缩略图来源」 (Thumbnail source) in the left column: 截屏工具 (Screenshot tool) : after export a screen overlay appears; drag a rectangle and release to capture (hold Ctrl to lock a square, Esc or right-click to cancel), capturing the viewport image. Fastest, but produces a still only. Maya 拍屏 (Maya playblast) : playblasts the viewport. With animation frame mode set to current frame it produces a still; with timeline or keyframes it produces thumb.mp4 (the first frame is also saved as a still). 渲染图 (Render) : renders with the current renderer. Highest quality and slowest; timeline or keyframes also compile thumb.mp4 . Only full-auto mode shows the 「截图延迟」 (Capture delay) box. It sets how many seconds to wait after each asset export before capturing: 0–60, 2 by default, 0 meaning no wait. Assets without geometry of their own, such as materials, textures and lights, can first get a carrier object placed in the scene via the 创建模型 (Create model) or 创建灯光 (Create light) dropdown, and then be captured. Finish the remaining format settings and click 「创建资产」 (Create asset) . Verify the result The grid card shows the new thumbnail; a still is thumb.sicon , an animation or video is thumb.mp4 . In a batch export, playblast and render thumbnails are generated after all assets are exported, so cards switch to the final image only when the progress finishes. Tips and warnings Tip : the first capture in full-auto mode fixes the framing and capture region for every later asset; afterwards only the target is moved to the center of the image, with no auto-framing or distance changes. Tip : the capture delay only applies to automatic captures with the screenshot tool; semi-auto and single asset are confirmed by you every time, so no delay is needed. Warning : timeline plus render renders frame by frame and Maya becomes unresponsive for a while; with many assets this takes noticeably longer, so confirm the framing with a playblast first. Tip : to change the thumbnail of an existing asset use the context menu's 「更新缩略图」 (Update thumbnail) ; 「后台渲染」 (Background render) is headless offscreen rendering (a separate mayapy / renderer process that does not occupy the current viewport) and is a different entry from the export thumbnail here.

items.title: Collecting linked files
items.summary: When checked, caches, proxies, references and volume files already attached in the scene are copied into the asset's deps/ directory, so they travel with the pa
items.text: When checked, caches, proxies, references and volume files already attached in the scene are copied into the asset's deps/ directory, so they travel with the package when the asset is delivered. Prerequisites The selected objects carry file-based nodes, such as Alembic, gpuCache, nCache, various proxies or Maya references. Those files really exist on disk; files with broken paths cannot be copied. Steps In the right column's 「收集关联文件」 (Collect linked files) section check 收集场景中已挂载的缓存/代理/引用文件 (collect caches / proxies / references attached in the scene). Keep 贴图 textures/ (textures) when material textures are needed. Textures go into textures/ , not deps/ . Check the other formats as needed and click 「创建资产」 (Create asset) . Verify the result .zasset/deps/ gains sub-directories by type: caches/ , proxies/ , references/ , volumes/ , textures/ , audio/ , movies/ , imageplanes/ , others/ . The dependency list is visible in meta.json ; when everything was found dependencies_missing is empty. The export result or log reports how many were collected, missing and out of scope. Main supported nodes Category Example nodes Common formats caches AlembicNode , gpuCache , cacheFile , geometryCache , XGen, Yeti .abc , .mc , .xml , .bif proxies aiStandIn , VRayProxy , VRayMesh , VRayScene , RedshiftProxyMesh , mayaUsdProxyShape .ass , .vrmesh , .vrscene , .rs , .usd volumes aiVolume , VRayVolumeGrid , RedshiftVolumeShape .vdb , .vol references Maya reference nodes .ma , .mb textures file , aiImage and others .png , .exr , .tx and others Tips and warnings Tip : scanning always runs; even with collection unchecked, missing and out-of-scope dependencies are recorded in meta.json and reported in the log. The checkbox only decides whether they are copied to disk. Tip : frame sequences containing # , #### , <f> or <UDIM> are expanded into actual files; same-named files from different directories get a short hash appended so they do not overwrite each other. Tip : files already copied into textures/ as textures are not stored a second time under deps/ . Warning : out-of-scope dependencies (for example shared libraries on a system or network location) are not copied and are only recorded in dependencies_out_of_scope ; confirm before delivery that the recipient's environment can reach them.

items.title: Material nodes and geometry formats
items.summary: Node formats store the connection network of materials or lights, while geometry formats store model files that can be imported again; both can be checked toget
items.text: Node formats store the connection network of materials or lights, while geometry formats store model files that can be imported again; both can be checked together and neither replaces the other. Node formats Format Contents Notes 材质预设 .zmetal (material preset) Maya material node network (JSON) Material assets normally check this; with "write all materials into one .zmetal" checked they merge into one file, and unchecked with material nodes selected it writes one file per material 灯光预设 .zlight (light preset) Renderer-independent light parameters plus upstream texture, IES and HDR nodes Shown in the lights sub-library; the merge sub-option is not shown 材质映射 .mcm (material mapping) Material → model mapping: vertex / face / edge counts, object list, per-face material assignments An independent option that does not depend on .zmetal ; on import models are matched by topological signature and receive the material .mcm matching requires the target model's vertex, face and edge counts to be exactly those at export; triangulation, point merging or topologies changes make matching fail. Geometry formats Format Extension Notes Maya ASCII .ma Text format; preserveReferences keeps references without baking; when the export fails and .mb is unchecked it falls back to exporting .mb Maya Binary .mb Binary format that also keeps references; triggers no file format conversion FBX .fbx Common exchange format; needs the FBX plug-in OBJ .obj Classic polygon format USD .usd Exported through mayaUSDExport with UVs, display color, materials and visibility; the frame range is written for timeline or keyframes Native Maya export Geometry files are always named node.<extension> and placed in the .zasset root; several formats can coexist. For .ma / .mb export the shadingEngine associated with the materials is included in the selection set, so networks such as displacement are not lost. Why some formats are greyed out Geometry and proxy formats are locked by current category : formats that do not apply to the category are greyed out and cannot be checked, with the tooltip 「该格式不适用于当前分类，已锁定（可在 设置 → 导出默认值 中调整）」 (this format does not apply to the current category and is locked; adjust it in Settings → Export defaults) . Default rules: Category Formats locked by default Materials / lights FBX, OBJ, USD, Alembic and all proxy formats (such assets have no geometry) Textures / HDR / images / music / animation data Almost every node and geometry format (they are files or pure transform data) To change the locks, go to Settings → 导出默认值 (Export defaults) and turn off that format's lock (see 6.4.1 ). Relationship with "export materials only" With 「仅导出材质（跳过几何体/代理）」 (export materials only, skipping geometry / proxies) checked, fbx , obj , usd , abc and every proxy format are skipped; ma / mb can still be exported, but they contain only material nodes and no model meshes. Tips Tip : when only materials are needed prefer .zmetal + 贴图 textures/ (textures); add geometry formats only when the model should travel with them. Tip : proxy formats ( .ass / .rs / .vrscene / .vrmesh ) are renderer products and not among the geometry formats on this page; see "Animation, caches and proxies".

items.title: Animation, caches and proxies
items.summary: 「动画导出」 (Animation export) decides the frame range for every animation format; caches and proxies are two different products and can both be checked. Frame range
items.text: 「动画导出」 (Animation export) decides the frame range for every animation format; caches and proxies are two different products and can both be checked. Frame range Option Behavior Best for 当前帧 (Current frame) Exports only the current frame as a still Static assets, single-frame proxies 时间轴 (Timeline) Exports over the Maya playback range Full animation 关键帧 (Keyframes) Takes the minimum to maximum keyframe over the selected objects' animation curves; falls back to the current frame when there are no keys Exporting only the animated interval The interface labels the animation section with (abc/usd/ass/rs/vrmesh) . Playblast thumbnails capture only the first 240 frames when the range exceeds that; render thumbnails have no such cutoff. Cache formats Format Product Notes Alembic .abc <name>.abc Vertex animation cache written with -uvWrite -writeVisibility and the ogawa data format; the frame range follows the option above Proxy formats Format Extension Required plug-in Product with timeline / keyframes Arnold .ass mtoa One file per frame in a sequence such as ass/<name>_0001.ass Redshift .rs redshift4maya One file per frame in a sequence such as rs/<name>_0001.rs V-Ray Scene .vrscene vrayformaya A single file with the frame range passed at export V-Ray Mesh .vrmesh vrayformaya A single file whose animation is written in one pass through animOn In still mode each of the four proxies produces one same-named file ( <name>.ass , <name>.rs , <name>.vrscene , <name>.vrmesh ). Tips and warnings Tip : caches and proxies are "re-baked" products and are not the same as "collect linked files", which copies files already on disk; one asset can check both. Tip : proxy formats only export when the matching plug-in is loaded. The checkbox is greyed out when the plug-in is unavailable; if the plug-in state is not "loaded" at export time the format is skipped silently, so afterwards check that proxy files really appeared inside the .zasset . Warning : timeline plus render renders frame by frame and Maya becomes unresponsive for a while; proxy sequences create many files, so check free disk space before exporting.

items.title: Export materials only
synonyms: add a material to the library
items.summary: 「仅导出材质」 (Export materials only) packages only material nodes and textures, skipping model meshes, caches and proxies; it is checked by default when creating an
items.text: 「仅导出材质」 (Export materials only) packages only material nodes and textures, skipping model meshes, caches and proxies; it is checked by default when creating an asset in the materials sub-library. Prerequisites Material nodes are selected in Maya, or objects that already carry materials. At least 材质预设 .zmetal (material preset) or 材质映射 .mcm (material mapping) is checked so the material is stored with the asset. Keep 贴图 textures/ (textures) when textures are needed. Steps Check 「仅导出材质（跳过几何体/代理）」 (export materials only, skipping geometry / proxies) in the right column's 「导出选项」 (Export options) . It is already checked by default for the materials sub-library. Check 材质预设 .zmetal (material preset) under material formats; also check .mcm when materials should be assigned by model matching. Keep 贴图 textures/ (textures) when textures are needed. For a snapshot of the material nodes you can additionally check Maya ASCII .ma or Maya Binary .mb ; those formats still export in this mode but contain only material nodes, no mesh. Choose the thumbnail source and click 「创建资产」 (Create asset) . Verify the result The .zasset contains node.zmetal (and/or node.mcm ) and textures/ , and no node.fbx , node.obj , node.usd , .abc or proxy files. Importing the asset rebuilds the material network; a .mcm asset can assign materials by topology matching when a target model is selected. If no material node was resolved this time, no material file is produced and the asset keeps only meta.json and a thumbnail. Tips and warnings Tip : this mode does not isolate objects automatically, so the screenshot overlay captures whatever the viewport currently shows; to give a material a preview, place a carrier with 创建模型 (Create model) first. Tip : ma / mb are not part of the "skipped geometry": they still write files in materials-only mode, but the file contains material nodes instead of a mesh. Warning : when entering from Update asset with materials-only checked, if no material node can be resolved from the selection the program stops before exporting and says so; creating a new asset has no such precheck, so confirm yourself that material nodes or material-carrying objects are selected.

items.title: Append a LOD
items.summary: 「追加为 LOD」 (Append as LOD) writes the model currently selected in Maya as one detail level (LOD0–LOD4) of an existing asset without touching the other levels or
items.text: 「追加为 LOD」 (Append as LOD) writes the model currently selected in Maya as one detail level (LOD0–LOD4) of an existing asset without touching the other levels or the materials. Prerequisites The target .zasset already exists and its card is visible in the grid. The asset already has a geometry format that can be reused ( ma / mb / fbx / obj / usd / abc ); appending a LOD reuses the asset's existing format , so no format needs choosing. The model to use for that level can be selected in Maya. You do not need to select everything before opening the window — the level window is non-modal, so you can select as you bind. Steps Select the model to use for a LOD level in the Maya viewport. Right-click the asset card → 「更新资产 ▶」 (Update asset ▶) → 「追加为 LOD」 (Append as LOD) . The append LOD level window opens; its subtitle names the target asset / version and a line below shows 「当前选择：<model name>」 (current selection: <model name>) live. Click the matching level card ( LOD0 – LOD4 ) to bind it: the card becomes ☑ and shows → <model name> . In Maya select another model → click another level card to bind several levels at once; clicking a bound card unbinds it, and 「清空绑定」 (Clear bindings) starts over. Read the warning lines at the bottom of the window and confirm: 「「LODn」已存在：将覆盖它的几何体，其它 LOD 不受影响。」 (LODn already exists: its geometry will be overwritten, other LODs are unaffected.) 「LOD0 是版本默认几何体，覆盖后双击卡片导入的就是新模型。」 (LOD0 is the version's default geometry; after overwriting, double-clicking the card imports the new model.) 「将一次写入 N 条 LOD。」 (N LODs will be written in one go.) Click 「导出并追加（N 档）」 (Export and append, N levels) to export and write each level. It then reports 「已追加 N 档 LOD。」 (appended N LOD levels.) ; failed levels are noted in parentheses after the message. The current version no longer opens the create-asset export configuration window : appending a LOD reuses the target asset's existing format, exporting to a temporary directory outside the library → verifying → writing the LOD ( lods.json or the older variants.json ). When the asset has no reusable geometry format it reports 「该资产没有可沿用的几何体格式（ma/mb/fbx/obj/usd/abc），无法追加 LOD。」 (this asset has no reusable geometry format (ma/mb/fbx/obj/usd/abc), so a LOD cannot be appended.) Verify the result The message 「已追加 N 档 LOD。」 (appended N LOD levels.) appears. Right-click the asset → 「资产详情」 (Asset details) (the version browser when versions or variants exist) → the new LOD row can be selected on the left and the 「LOD 管理」 (LOD management) card on the right lists that level. lod{n}/node.<ext> is added inside the .zasset and the lods list in lods.json gains the entry ( lod0 is always the root geometry). Tips and warnings Tip : the level is chosen by you on the level cards (LOD0–LOD4), not computed as the current maximum plus one; several levels can be written at once. Tip : appending a LOD writes geometry only and never replaces materials or textures; for new materials use Create new version . Tip : while the level window is open you can switch back to Maya and change the selection, and the window follows with 「当前选择」 (current selection) ; with several objects selected it binds the last one (the active object). Warning : writing into an existing level overwrites that level's geometry (other LODs and versions are unaffected); overwriting LOD0 changes "the model that a double-click imports by default". Current version : appending a LOD acts directly on the main asset you right-clicked; the "choose target version" dialog no longer appears, and sub-versions are independent V{n} assets. Appending a LOD for a variant uses a separate small input box ( 「为变体「X」追加 LOD 级别（1-9）」 (append a LOD level to variant "X", 1-9) ), not this level window. Related interface (historical screenshot) The image above is a historical screenshot of the export interface; appending a LOD now happens in the separate append LOD level window, and the screenshot is to be recaptured. Related Create a new version: 6.3.2 Delete version

items.title: Create a new version
items.summary: 「创建新版本」 (Create new version) builds a complete sub-version V{n} inside the main asset and fills it with this export, leaving the main version unchanged. Prerequ
items.text: 「创建新版本」 (Create new version) builds a complete sub-version V{n} inside the main asset and fills it with this export, leaving the main version unchanged. Prerequisites The main .zasset already exists. Select the modified geometry, material nodes or texture nodes as needed; a new version does not require geometry, exporting only materials also works. To give the version its own materials, be ready to check 材质预设 .zmetal (material preset). Steps Select what the new version should export in Maya. Right-click the main asset card, expand 「更新资产」 (Update asset) and choose 「创建新版本」 (Create new version) . In the export dialog that opens, check this export's content: geometry, 材质预设 .zmetal , 贴图 textures/ and so on. Click 「创建资产」 (Create asset) . Wait for it to finish; the program runs a separate thumbnail capture for the new version. Verify the result 「「资产名」已创建新版本 V1」 (asset "…" got new version V1) appears; the number is the highest existing V{n} plus one. Double-clicking the main asset's preview on the right opens the asset versions window, where 「主版本」 (main version) and V1 are listed. Right-click the asset → 「导入变体 / 版本」 (Import variant / version) (or 「导入版本 / LOD」 (Import version / LOD) when there are no variants) → a V1 submenu appears. V1/ has its own meta.json ; the main asset's meta.json records it under version_assets and has_versions is true. Tips and warnings Tip : a sub-version is a self-contained version asset: creation first copies the main version's content as a skeleton, then replaces it entirely with this export while keeping the sub-version identity fields ( is_version , version_of , version_label , version_tag ). Tip : when the V{n} directory already exists the number moves up automatically instead of overwriting the old version. Warning : a failed sub-version export reports 「子版本导出失败，内容可能不完整」 (sub-version export failed; the content may be incomplete) ; that directory already exists, so check it and retry or delete it. Current version : version directories are V1/ , V2/ inside the main asset, not the variants/v2/ structure described in older help.

items.title: Per-version materials
items.summary: Every version is a self-contained version asset; checking .zmetal when creating a new version gives it its own materials and textures instead of sharing the mai
items.text: Every version is a self-contained version asset; checking .zmetal when creating a new version gives it its own materials and textures instead of sharing the main version's. Prerequisites The main asset exists and already has one or more V{n} sub-versions, or a new version is about to be created. Materials and textures for the new version are set up in Maya. Be ready to check 材质预设 .zmetal (material preset) in the export dialog; keep 贴图 textures/ (textures) when textures are needed. Steps Assign materials and textures to the new version's model in Maya. Select that model. Right-click the main asset card → 「更新资产」 (Update asset) → 「创建新版本」 (Create new version) . In the export dialog check 材质预设 .zmetal and the needed geometry formats; keep 贴图 textures/ when textures are needed. Click 「创建资产」 (Create asset) . Verify the result node.zmetal and textures/ appear inside V1/ . Right-click the asset → 「导入版本 / LOD」 (Import version / LOD) → V1 and the menu lists that version's zmetal (or mcm ) entry; choosing it runs a material import. The main version root's node.zmetal and textures/ stay unchanged. Tips and warnings Tip : a version's "independence" comes from the complete V{n} directory rather than a shared variants/ material directory; each version can have its own materials and textures. Tip : with only geometry formats checked and .zmetal unchecked, the new version gets no material file of its own; whatever materials the imported ma / mb carries is then authoritative. Check .zmetal explicitly when stable reuse matters. Warning : checking .zmetal writes the current scene's material network into the new version; changing the main version's materials afterwards does not propagate to the sub-version, and vice versa. Current version : the variants/v2/node.zmetal described in older help is a historical structure; the current version uses V1/node.zmetal .

items.title: Delete versions and LODs
items.summary: Deleting a version happens in the asset versions window; the entry for deleting a single LOD cannot be found in the current interface, and the context-menu dele
items.text: Deleting a version happens in the asset versions window; the entry for deleting a single LOD cannot be found in the current interface, and the context-menu delete described in older help no longer exists. Deleting a version Prerequisites The main asset has sub-versions ( V1/ , V2/ …). Confirm the version is no longer needed; deletion cannot be undone. Steps Select the main asset in the grid and double-click the preview on the right to open the asset versions window. Select the sub-version to delete (such as V1 ) in the 「版本」 (Versions) list on the left, not 「主版本」 (main version) . Click 「删除此版本」 (Delete this version) . Click 「是」 (Yes) in the confirmation dialog. Verify the result The version disappears from the list and its V{n}/ directory is removed entirely. The main asset's meta.json drops the matching version_assets entry; with no versions left, has_versions and version_assets are cleared together. The main version cannot be deleted: with 「主版本」 (main version) selected the delete button is greyed out. Warning : the confirmation states explicitly that all content of that version (geometry, materials, textures, thumbnail) is deleted and cannot be undone. Back up the .zasset first. Deleting a LOD A single LOD can be deleted in the asset versions window: select the LOD entry → 「删除此 LOD」 (Delete this LOD) ; the button is greyed out when only one LOD is left (at least one must remain) and the main version cannot be deleted. The asset context-menu delete described in older help no longer applies. Only when the interface cannot delete it (for example the file is locked by another program) is manual handling needed: Back up the whole .zasset first. Delete the matching lodN/ directory ( N ≥ 1). Remove the entry with id lodN from the lods list in lods.json . Warning : never delete the root node.* geometry — it is lod0 ; the default detail level breaks without it. Tips Tip : the append LOD window lets you pick a level that is already taken; confirming warns that its geometry will be overwritten, which replaces that same LOD level. To add a level, pick an empty one.

items.title: Save defaults per sub-library
items.summary: Settings → 导出默认值 (Export defaults) stores the formats and options checked by default when creating a new asset, per sub-library, in Assets/preset/export_preset.
items.text: Settings → 导出默认值 (Export defaults) stores the formats and options checked by default when creating a new asset, per sub-library, in Assets/preset/export_preset.json in the plug-in directory. Prerequisites The plug-in Settings window can be opened. It is clear which sub-library's defaults should change. The list on the left comes from sub_libraries in Assets/preset/config.json : 11 built-in sub-libraries — materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, HDR, dynamics, images, audio, animation data, node trees — plus any custom sub-libraries. Steps Open 「设置」 (Settings) and switch to the 「导出默认值」 (Export defaults) tab. Choose a sub-library in the list on the left, for example materials . Check the defaults on the right: Material formats: 材质节点 (.zmetal) , 合并材质 (.zmetal_merge) , 材质→模型映射 (.mcm) . Geometry formats: ma , mb , fbx , obj , usd . Caches and proxies: abc , arnold , vray , redshift , vrmesh . Collect linked files: whether caches / proxies / references and textures are collected by default. Export options: whether "export materials only" is the default. Switch to another sub-library and continue; the current sub-library's checks are held in memory first. Click 「应用」 (Apply) or 「确定」 (OK) to write export_preset.json . Verify the result After closing and reopening Settings the 「导出默认值」 (Export defaults) tab still shows the checks you made. Clicking 「创建资产」 (Create asset) in that sub-library opens a dialog whose format checks match the defaults. The booleans for that sub-library in Assets/preset/export_preset.json are updated. Tips and warnings Tip : the defaults only affect Create asset ; Update asset restores checks from the asset's existing formats, and choosing Append format starts with everything unchecked. Tip : checks changed temporarily in the export dialog apply to that one export only and are not written back to the defaults. Tip : when a sub-library has no entry in the preset file, _default is read; when _default is missing too it falls back to the materials section. Current version : the buttons on this tab are 「应用」 (Apply) and 「确定」 (OK) ; there is no separate 「保存」 (Save) button.

items.title: Importing and exporting preset files
items.summary: The export preset file is Assets/preset/export_preset.json ; to back it up, move machines or standardize default formats across a team, simply copy this JSON. P
items.text: The export preset file is Assets/preset/export_preset.json ; to back it up, move machines or standardize default formats across a team, simply copy this JSON. Prerequisites The current machine has been configured as described in "Save defaults per sub-library". The plug-in install directory's squirrel_asset_manager/Assets/preset/ is accessible. Steps Export the preset file Locate squirrel_asset_manager/Assets/preset/export_preset.json . Copy it to a backup directory or a shared location. Include a date or project name in the file name, for example export_preset_20261019.json . Import a preset file Close any open export dialog and Settings window first. Back up the current machine's export_preset.json . Overwrite export_preset.json at the same path with the target file. Reopen Create asset or Settings → 导出默认值 (Export defaults) ; the new defaults apply immediately. Verify the result Reopening Settings → 导出默认值 (Export defaults) shows checks matching the replaced file. Opening Create asset in that sub-library preselects the format checkboxes per the new defaults. Opening export_preset.json in a text editor shows the replaced sub-library entries and booleans. File structure { "_default": { "ma": true, "zmetal": false }, "materials": { "zmetal": true, "ma": true, "material_only": true }, "models": { "ma": true, "material_only": false } } Key Purpose _default Fallback when a sub-library has no entry of its own materials / models / lights / textures / scenes / hdr / ani / images / audio / animation / nodetree Defaults for each built-in sub-library (one-to-one with sub_libraries in config.json , 11 in total) zmetal / zmetal_merge / mcm Material nodes and material mapping ma / mb / fbx / obj / usd Geometry formats abc / arnold / vray / redshift / vrmesh Caches and proxies material_only / collect_associated / textures Materials only, collect linked files, package textures ani_frame_mode current / timeline / keyframe delay_ms Capture delay in milliseconds; 2000 means 2 seconds thumb_source screenshot / playblast / render Tips and warnings Tip : the file is read only when the new-asset dialog opens; no Maya restart is needed after replacing it, just reopen the dialog. Tip : creating assets on the AI side reads export_preset.json as well, so this file is the shared default source for both the UI and the AI. Warning : on invalid JSON the plug-in logs a load failure and falls back to built-in defaults, which looks like "every format is unchecked". Validate with any JSON checker before replacing. Current version : the Settings window has no 导入预设 / 导出预设文件 (import preset / export preset file) buttons (verified 2026-11-03); importing and exporting here is done by copying the file, which is the most direct and reliable route. Do not confuse it with "export material as preset" : the plug-in also has an 「导出材质为预设」 (Export material as preset) dialog that exports scene materials into a .zmetal / JSON preset, which is not the same thing as export_preset.json here ("what is checked by default for a new asset"); that dialog is not wired to any menu entry today (see 15.12.3 ), so there is nothing to look for here.

items.title: Empty shell assets
items.summary: An empty shell asset is a .zasset containing only meta.json and a thumbnail, with no geometry, material or textures. Symptoms The asset appears in the grid, but
items.text: An empty shell asset is a .zasset containing only meta.json and a thumbnail, with no geometry, material or textures. Symptoms The asset appears in the grid, but opening its folder shows only meta.json and thumb.sicon , with no node.* , node.zmetal or textures/ . Or the export fails outright: 几何体一个文件都没导出（...） (not a single geometry file was exported). formats in meta.json only lists sicon / aicon . Common causes Cause How to tell Fix No content source checked formats only has sicon / aicon and there is no textures/ or deps/ Check at least one format, or keep 贴图 textures/ (textures) "Export materials only" checked without material nodes No node.zmetal / node.mcm Select material nodes or objects carrying materials; uncheck it when materials-only is not needed Geometry format checked but the selection has no mesh The log says 「找不到可导出对象」 (no exportable object found) Select models with a shape in the viewport, not empty groups or pure transforms Format plug-in unavailable The format's status shows 不可用 (unavailable) and the checkbox is greyed out Install or load the plug-in, or use .ma / .mb .ma export failed notes contains ma: 导出失败 Check .mb and re-export; without .mb checked the program falls back to .mb automatically, and if that also fails see the next section Steps Open .zasset/meta.json and check whether formats contains the expected formats. Back in Maya, confirm the selected objects really are nodes with a mesh or a material. In the export dialog check at least one content format and confirm the format status reads 已就绪 (ready) . For material assets prefer 材质预设 .zmetal + 贴图 textures/ ; for model assets check at least Maya ASCII .ma or Maya Binary .mb . Export again. If geometry formats were checked but not one file was produced, the export stops instead of overwriting an existing asset with empty content. If it still fails Open the Maya Script Editor and search for [Export] , [Export::zmetal] and [Perf] to see which format failed. Try a fresh scene containing only the target object, ruling out unknown nodes or data breaking format conversion. Export with only .mb checked first to confirm the geometry itself is writable, then add the other formats back one by one. Whether specific format keys differ from Maya's actual plug-in names is still to be confirmed (for example abc and obj ).

items.title: Missing textures or dependencies
items.summary: If textures turn pink or black after import, or the asset has no textures/ or deps/ , first confirm whether the files were actually packaged at export time. Sym
items.text: If textures turn pink or black after import, or the asset has no textures/ or deps/ , first confirm whether the files were actually packaged at export time. Symptoms After importing, the material shows pink or black and texture nodes point at empty paths. The .zasset has no textures/ , or deps/ lacks the matching cache, proxy or reference files. dependencies_missing in meta.json is not empty and the export log reports missing dependencies. Common causes Cause How to tell Fix Texture paths were already broken at export The file node's path does not exist in Maya Relocate the textures with the File Path Editor, then export 贴图 textures/ (textures) was not checked No textures/ inside the asset Export again keeping that checkbox "Collect linked files" was not checked Caches / proxies / references are not in deps/ Check it and export again Dependencies are outside the collection scope dependencies_out_of_scope has entries Put the dependencies on an accessible local path or deliver them alongside the asset Paths contain unparsable tokens dependencies_unresolved_tokens has entries Expand the paths into real file paths and export again Referenced files are not loaded The reference node state is unloaded Load the reference in Maya first, then export or collect Steps In Maya check the selected objects' file , aiImage and similar texture nodes and confirm the paths point at real files. When exporting again keep 贴图 textures/ (textures), and check 收集场景中已挂载的缓存/代理/引用文件 (collect caches / proxies / references) when caches, proxies or references exist. After export check whether the matching files appear in .zasset/textures/ and .zasset/deps/ . Open meta.json and read texture_map , dependencies_missing , dependencies_out_of_scope and dependencies_unresolved_tokens . On import use the asset's own import entry, which remaps the original paths to in-package paths through texture_map . If it still fails Search the Script Editor for [StageTextures] , [Export] 依赖 and [Export] 依赖警告 to see whether collection failed or the path itself is broken. Verify on another machine: if the other machine sees the textures, the problem was the path on the original machine rather than the asset structure. A .ma file keeps the original absolute texture paths from export time, so you cannot judge missing textures from the .ma text alone; trust textures/ and texture_map .

items.title: Export interrupted
items.summary: An interrupted export falls into two kinds: a long job that makes Maya temporarily unresponsive, and a real failure or a manual cancel; the handling differs. Sy
items.text: An interrupted export falls into two kinds: a long job that makes Maya temporarily unresponsive, and a real failure or a manual cancel; the handling differs. Symptoms The batch progress stops at one asset and the Maya interface does not respond. You clicked 「取消批量导出」 (Cancel batch export) or 「跳过当前」 (Skip current) . A failure list appears at the end and some assets were not created. With timeline plus render the wait is long and looks like a hang. Common causes Cause How to tell Fix Rendering or playblasting right now The progress window is still there and Maya is merely unresponsive Wait for it to finish; do not click repeatedly Timeline plus render Many frames, slow render Use a playblast to confirm framing first, or shorten the playback range The user cancelled The progress window says 「正在取消」 (cancelling) Finished assets are kept and later ones are not exported One asset failed The failure list names the asset and the error Fix the cause and click 「重试」 (Retry) to rerun only the failures Not enough disk space or permissions The log reports write failures or access denied Free space or switch to a writable category directory A format plug-in became unavailable during the export The asset lacks that format's file Load the plug-in and export that asset again Steps First check whether Maya is only rendering: if the progress window is alive and CPU/GPU are busy, keep waiting. When you really want to stop, use 「跳过当前」 (Skip current) or 「取消批量导出」 (Cancel batch export) in the progress window; cancelling stops later assets from exporting. After the batch ends read the result dialog: note the success count plus the failed asset names and reasons. Fix the failure cause (plug-in, selection, permissions, disk) and click 「重试」 (Retry) to rerun only the failures. Finished assets are never rolled back by a cancel; asset updates go through a temporary directory, so a failure never overwrites the original asset. If it still fails Open the Script Editor and search for [AssetExport] , [Export] and [Perf] to see which stage it stopped at. Check that the category directory is writable and the disk has space; a disconnected network drive also shows up as a write failure. Select the failed asset alone and re-export with only one format checked to narrow the problem down. If Maya is completely unresponsive for a long time, follow the crash recovery workflow; already exported assets are unaffected.

items.title: Format unavailable
items.summary: An unavailable format is usually not an asset problem: the Maya plug-in that format needs is not loaded or not installed. Symptoms The geometry or proxy format
items.text: An unavailable format is usually not an asset problem: the Maya plug-in that format needs is not loaded or not installed. Symptoms The geometry or proxy format checkbox is greyed out and the right side says 未加载 (not loaded) or 不可用 (unavailable) . The export succeeds but the .zasset has no file for the checked format. Only a geometry format was checked yet it reports that no geometry was produced. Common causes Cause How to tell Fix Plug-in registered but not loaded The status says 未加载 (not loaded) Load it in Maya's plug-in manager and reopen the dialog Plug-in not installed The status says 不可用 (unavailable) and is greyed out Install the renderer or format plug-in, or use another format "Export materials only" is checked In that mode fbx / obj / usd / abc and proxies are skipped Uncheck it and export again Proxy does not match the renderer For example Arnold .ass checked without mtoa Load the matching plug-in or check a proxy the current renderer supports .ma failed on unknown data The log reports a format conversion failure Use .mb ; the program falls back to .mb once when it is unchecked Steps Read the status text next to the format checkbox to see whether it is "not loaded" or "unavailable". Open Maya's plug-in manager and load the plug-in for that format: Arnold .ass : mtoa V-Ray .vrscene / .vrmesh : vrayformaya Redshift .rs : redshift4maya FBX .fbx : the FBX plug-in Close and reopen the export dialog so the status is detected again. Uncheck 「仅导出材质」 (Export materials only) when geometry is needed; use .zmetal when only materials are needed. Export again and confirm inside the .zasset that the target format's file now exists. If it still fails .ma / .mb are built into Maya and need no third-party plug-in; check only .mb first to verify the geometry is writable. Open the Script Editor and search for [Export] to see whether the format was skipped, failed, or never reached the export flow. Whether the format keys for abc , obj and similar match Maya's actual plug-in names is still to be confirmed; when the status looks wrong, check the real plug-in name in the plug-in manager first. After a renderer upgrade or a fresh install, restart Maya before retrying so the plug-in registration is refreshed.

items.title: zmetal assets
items.summary: zmetal is the node network data of a material asset, stored inside the .zasset ; import rebuilds the whole shading network from it. Prerequisites A material ass
items.text: zmetal is the node network data of a material asset, stored inside the .zasset ; import rebuilds the whole shading network from it. Prerequisites A material asset (a .zasset folder) exists. The asset directory can be opened in a file manager. Steps Right-click the material asset in the library and choose 「打开文件夹」 (Open folder) . Open meta.json and check name , name_cn , node_type , renderer , color_space and formats . Find node.zmetal . It is JSON, not a Maya scene file; some external assets name the .zmetal after the asset, and import looks for node.zmetal first and only then takes any .zmetal . Open node.zmetal and confirm it has root_materials and nodes at the top level; material and texture nodes all live in nodes . When the asset carries textures, look at textures/ ; fileTextureName inside node.zmetal has been rewritten to a relative textures/... path. Verify the result Open the same .zmetal with the context menu's 「预览节点」 (Preview nodes) and the canvas shows the material nodes matching root_materials plus their upstream connections; importing it into the scene creates the same-named material in the Hypershade. Tips .zmetal records only material nodes and connections; it contains no geometry, cameras or lights. node.mcm records the topological correspondence between materials and objects, which is separate data from zmetal. Prefer .zmetal when importing materials, because it stores node attributes and connections; only when it is missing does import fall back to the material network in .ma/.mb . The file exists only if the zmetal format was enabled at export time.

items.title: Material types and renderers
items.summary: A material asset records a concrete node type, and whether it can be rebuilt directly depends on the current Maya having the matching renderer plug-in loaded. C
items.text: A material asset records a concrete node type, and whether it can be rebuilt directly depends on the current Maya having the matching renderer plug-in loaded. Common mappings Renderer Common material nodes Default material created by double-click Required plug-in Arnold aiStandardSurface , aiStandardHair , aiVolume aiStandardSurface mtoa V-Ray VRayMtl VRayMtl vrayformaya Redshift RedshiftStandardMaterial , RedshiftOpenPBRMaterial , RedshiftMaterial RedshiftStandardMaterial redshift4maya Native Maya standardSurface , openPBRSurface , lambert , phong , blinn Not switched automatically per renderer None Steps In Maya confirm the current renderer ( defaultRenderGlobals.currentRenderer ) and that the matching plug-in is loaded. In the library check the material asset's node_type and renderer and use the table above to judge whether the target machine can create it directly. Double-click to import, or right-click 「转换导入」 (Convert import) and choose a material type common for the current renderer. If the plug-in is not loaded or this version has no such node type, deleting that material node fails; load the plug-in and retry. Verify the result After import the matching type appears in the Hypershade and the attribute editor title shows the correct node type; the material created by a double-click matches the current renderer. Tips Whether import converts automatically depends on the entry : Double-clicking a zmetal : converts straight to the current renderer's default material, without a confirmation ; Right-click 「导入」 (Import) : builds the asset's original material first and then asks once for the whole batch (all materials in one asset are asked once, never per material), converting only after confirmation; Other formats (such as ma ) ask before converting whether double-clicked or right-clicked. Automatic conversion only recognizes Arnold, V-Ray and Redshift; native Maya materials and the current renderer's materials are not converted, so use the material conversion tools manually when needed. Importing the same asset on machines with different renderers may yield different node types; that is the result of conversion, not a damaged asset.

items.title: Material network structure
items.summary: The material network structure is zmetal 's complete description of a Maya shading network: which nodes exist, each attribute's value, and who connects to whom.
items.text: The material network structure is zmetal 's complete description of a Maya shading network: which nodes exist, each attribute's value, and who connects to whom. The top level has two parts { "root_materials": ["Gold_ai"], "nodes": { "Gold_ai": { "node_type": "aiStandardSurface", "attrs": { "base": {"type": "value", "value": 1.0}, "baseColor": { "type": "connection", "source_node": "file1", "source_attr": "outColor" } }, "displacement_node": "displacementShader1" } } } root_materials are the material node names to build on import; nodes is the node table keyed by node name. What a single node contains node_type : the Maya node type, such as aiStandardSurface , file or place2dTexture . attrs : the attribute table. Plain values are written as {"type": "value", "value": ...} ; connections are written as {"type": "connection", "source_node": ..., "source_attr": ...} , and upstream nodes are written recursively into nodes . displacement_node : the displacement node associated with the material; on import the plug-in creates the shading engine and links it instead of serializing the SE directly. Why it is designed this way Import does not depend on the original .ma : as long as the node types exist in the current Maya, the network can be rebuilt from attribute values. Textures are not embedded; they are collected into textures/ and fileTextureName is rewritten to a relative path, so the asset can be moved as a whole. Array element attributes (such as a ramp 's colorEntryList[i].color ) are collected separately to avoid falling back to defaults after import. Scene global nodes ( time1 , defaultColorMgtGlobals and similar) are not written, avoiding duplicate globals at import time. Notes A connection attribute's static value is only a reference; import honors the connection. Same-named attributes do not imply the same semantics, and cross-renderer work still needs a .mmap to define the mapping explicitly. On import every node is rebuilt under the key names in nodes , and root_materials then decides which materials to assign to objects. When names clash Maya adds numbers automatically, and the plug-in keeps reconnecting through an old-name to new-name map, so the original node names in the asset need not match the scene exactly.

items.title: Material node preview
items.summary: The material node preview draws the asset's .zmetal or .ma in a node editor so you can confirm that nodes and connections are complete. Prerequisites The asset
items.text: The material node preview draws the asset's .zmetal or .ma in a node editor so you can confirm that nodes and connections are complete. Prerequisites The asset is a .zasset folder containing a .zmetal or .ma node file. The plug-in is installed and its window can be opened in Maya. Steps In the library right-click the material asset and point at 「预览节点」 (Preview nodes) . The submenu lists the .zmetal and .ma files in the asset root ( node.ma as geometry is not listed) plus node files under variants/... .
