Choose one; the node editor opens and lays the graph out hierarchically. Pan with the middle mouse button or Ctrl +left drag, zoom with the wheel (10%–1000%); 「层级布局」 (Hierarchical layout) in the toolbar rearranges the graph. To compare, click 「打开文件」 (Open file) and pick another .ma / .zmetal , or drop a file straight into the window. Verify the result Node cards and connection lines appear; the node names shown for a .zmetal match the asset's root_materials and nodes ; green lines are single-attribute connections and yellow lines mean several connections between the same pair of nodes. Tips Viewing the structure read-only in the node editor is safest; saving overwrites the original file, so back up the asset before editing. The current version does not support adding new nodes by hand; to add nodes, create them in Maya first, save as .ma and then open it. If nothing appears after opening, first confirm the file really contains createNode / connectAttr ( .ma ) or nodes ( .zmetal ).

items.title: The .mmap mapping table
items.summary: A .mmap is the attribute correspondence table for "source material type → target material type"; conversion writes each source attribute onto its target attribu
items.text: A .mmap is the attribute correspondence table for "source material type → target material type"; conversion writes each source attribute onto its target attribute row by row. Prerequisites The plug-in is installed and Assets/material_mapper_presets is reachable in the plug-in directory ( Assets/light_mapper_presets for lights); the tool shows the 「预设路径」 (preset path) in use at the bottom, which is authoritative. The node type names of the source and target materials or lights are known (case-sensitive). Steps Open the mapping directory and find a file shaped like lambert_aiStandardSurface.mmap ; the file name is source type_target type . Open the file and check the top-level source_type , target_type and mappings ; every row in mappings has source_attribute , target_attribute , transform and default_value , plus parameters when arguments are needed. Load the whole mapping folder into the material conversion tool: click 「加载预设」 (Load presets) (or 「打开文件夹」 (Open folder) first to confirm the directory) and the tool scans every .mmap inside. Check the row count and mapping contents in the table (material attribute / target attribute / transform function / parameters / default value). Verify the result The conversion tool's status bar shows how many mapping files were loaded; the preview table lists source attributes, target attributes, transform functions and defaults; during conversion the Script Editor no longer reports missing mappings. Tips Lookup order: A_B.mmap in the root → the B/ sub-directory → any first-level sub-directory; light mappings and material mappings are physically isolated and must not be mixed. An empty source_attribute means only default_value is written; a missing source attribute also falls back to the default. transform holds the conversion function name (such as transparency_to_transmission ), with JSON arguments passed through parameters when needed. .mmap only describes attribute rules and is not the same as the type mapping configuration preset .mlist , which only records which types convert into which.

items.title: Type conversion paths
items.summary: Conversion first looks for a direct .mmap from the source type to the target type; without one it converts in two steps through an intermediate type such as ope
items.text: Conversion first looks for a direct .mmap from the source type to the target type; without one it converts in two steps through an intermediate type such as openPBRSurface . Prerequisites The scene already contains materials to convert, or objects using them are selected. The mapping directory has at least one direct or intermediate .mmap . Steps Open 「材质转换工具」 (Material conversion tool) . Fill in the source and target material types under 「材质类型映射配置」 (Material type mapping configuration) ; 「加载源」 (Load source) and 「加载目标」 (Load target) read the types from the current selection. Click 「浏览...」 (Browse...) and pick the mapping folder (the plug-in's built-in material mapping directory by default). Select the materials or objects in Maya and click 「转换选择」 (Convert selection) ; use 「转换全部」 (Convert all) for the whole scene. Without a direct mapping the tool goes A → openPBRSurface → B automatically and deletes the intermediate materials when it finishes. Verify the result The target type's new material appears in the Hypershade; a dialog shows the number of converted materials, succeeded / failed attributes and a failure list. Use 「在Maya中选中失败材质」 (Select failed materials in Maya) to locate failures. Tips Try 「转换选择」 (Convert selection) on one or two materials before running 「转换全部」 (Convert all) . Intermediate materials from multi-hop conversions are cleaned up automatically, leaving only the target type. To cover several source types at once, add several rows to the configuration table, one source / target pair per row. Warnings Conversion creates new materials and replaces the source ones according to the options, so save the scene first; when there is neither a direct mapping nor a usable intermediate, that material counts as a failure.

items.title: In-place replacement
items.summary: In-place replacement puts the converted material in place of the source one: the source material is deleted, the new material is renamed back to the source name
items.text: In-place replacement puts the converted material in place of the source one: the source material is deleted, the new material is renamed back to the source name, and the shading engines are reconnected, so the material name and assignment on objects stay unchanged. Prerequisites One material conversion has completed and the mapping path is usable. The scene is saved, or you accept losing the current material changes. Steps In 「转换选项」 (Conversion options) of the material conversion tool confirm that 「保留原始材质」 (Keep original material) is unchecked (unchecked by default). Keep 「复制纹理连接」 (Copy texture connections) and 「自动应用到选择对象」 (Apply to selected objects automatically) checked. Select the materials or objects and click 「转换选择」 (Convert selection) . The tool records the source material's connections to each shadingEngine , deletes the source material, renames the new material to the source name, and reconnects the new material's outColor to the original shading engine input. Verify the result Only one material remains in the Hypershade, with the same name and the target type; the original objects still use that material name and nothing is lost in the viewport; the Script Editor reports success. Tips To keep the old material for rollback, check 「保留原始材质」 (Keep original material) . The new material then keeps a suffixed name ( _ai , _vr , _rs , _opb or _cvt ) and is assigned to the original objects automatically. Intermediate materials from multi-hop conversions are deleted automatically and never left in the Hypershade. Warnings Replacement deletes the source material node; save the scene before converting, or validate the mapping on a test material first.

items.title: Convert import
items.summary: Convert import merges "import the asset" and "convert to the target type" into one step: import first, then convert the newly created materials or lights to the
items.text: Convert import merges "import the asset" and "convert to the target type" into one step: import first, then convert the newly created materials or lights to the chosen type. Prerequisites The target is a .zasset with an importable format ( zmetal preferred for materials). A matching .mmap mapping exists, or a usable intermediate path does. Steps Right-click the material or light asset in the library and point at 「转换导入」 (Convert import) . Choose the target type in the submenu: for materials the reachable material types, for lights the target light node types. The tool imports the asset ( zmetal first for materials) and finds the materials or lights created this time. Materials are converted through the mapping and replace the source in place; lights are rebuilt as the target light type. Verify the result The target type material appears in the Hypershade and the original objects keep their material assignment; a light asset produces a light of the target type in the Outliner and it is selected. The Script Editor reports the number of nodes imported and converted. Tips Convert import only supports .zasset ; import an ordinary .ma into the library first and then convert. When the asset has no importable format or no new material is created after import, it reports an error with the reason. A light asset without .zlight cannot be rebuilt from generic parameters and takes the ordinary .ma/.mb import path. Warnings When conversion fails, read the Maya Script Editor log; a missing mapping is the most common cause, so verify the mapping file first as described in 7.2.1.

items.title: Two-column attribute mapping
items.summary: Two-column attribute mapping is the row-by-row correspondence of "source material attribute → target material attribute"; conversion copies or converts values a
items.text: Two-column attribute mapping is the row-by-row correspondence of "source material attribute → target material attribute"; conversion copies or converts values according to these rows. Prerequisites The source and target material nodes can be selected in the Maya scene. 「材质节点属性映射工具」 (Material node attribute mapping tool) is open. Steps Select the source material node in Maya and click 「加载源材质」 (Load source material) in the tool. Select the target material node and click 「加载目标材质」 (Load target material) . Click 「添加行」 (Add row) , pick the source attribute in the left column and the target attribute in the right column. When a conversion is needed, pick a function in the 「转换函数」 (Transform function) column (such as glossiness to roughness or transparency to transmission (weight) ); functions with arguments take JSON in the 「参数(JSON)」 (Parameters (JSON)) column, for example {"scalar": 2.0} . Fill 「默认值」 (Default value) for a fallback; you can also select a target material first and click 「载入默认值」 (Load defaults) to batch-fill the column with its current values. When an attribute is unclear, click 「属性浏览器」 (Attribute browser) and pick from the selected node's readable, writable and visible attributes. Verify the result The row count matches the intended mapping and both columns show attribute names; the status bar shows the row count; after converting to a new material the target values match the source values or the selected function's conversion result. Tips Do not map color sub-channels (such as diffuseColorR ) individually; a color is written through its parent attribute, and writing sub-channels separately often yields wrong results. When the same source attribute appears again, the later row is cleared and a duplicate is reported. The search box filters rows live by keyword, which helps in large tables.

items.title: Saving and loading presets
items.summary: An attribute mapping can be saved as an .mmap preset, loaded again next time and reused by the material conversion tool. Prerequisites The source / target node
items.text: An attribute mapping can be saved as an .mmap preset, loaded again next time and reused by the material conversion tool. Prerequisites The source / target node types are loaded in the mapping tool and the mapping rows are filled in. Write access to the plug-in directory Assets/material_mapper_presets . Steps Click 「保存预设」 (Save preset) ; the tool names the file source node type_target node type by default and saves it to Assets/material_mapper_presets . When the file name does not end in .mmap the tool appends it; the saved content includes source_type , target_type , created_date and the complete mappings . Next time click 「加载预设」 (Load preset) , choose the .mmap , and the tool restores the source / target types and all mapping rows. For a reverse mapping click 「反向映射」 (Reverse mapping) ; the tool swaps the source / target node types and attributes and tries to replace transform functions with their reverse counterparts. Verify the result After reloading, the source / target node types and the row count match what was saved; after placing that .mmap in the material mapping directory, 「浏览...」 (Browse...) in the material conversion tool finds and loads it. Tips Closing the window saves the current configuration to _last_preset.mmap automatically and restores it next time. For the conversion tool to find a mapping automatically by "source → target", the file must be named source type_target type.mmap and live in Assets/material_mapper_presets . What is saved is an attribute rule, not a material instance; changes to a preset only take effect after converting again.

items.title: Batch mapping
synonyms: convert several material kinds at once
items.summary: Batch mapping means configuring several "source → target" rows in one type mapping table so one conversion covers several source materials. Prerequisites Every
items.text: Batch mapping means configuring several "source → target" rows in one type mapping table so one conversion covers several source materials. Prerequisites Every "source type → target type" pair has a matching .mmap , or can route through openPBRSurface . The scene is saved. Steps Add several rows to the 「材质类型映射配置」 (Material type mapping configuration) table in 「材质转换工具」 (Material conversion tool) . Use the dropdowns on each row to pick the source and target material types; you can also select materials in Maya and click 「加载源」 (Load source) / 「加载目标」 (Load target) to read their types. With only one row and 「源」 (Source) left empty, every material is converted to that target type. Click 「浏览...」 (Browse...) and choose the folder containing every needed .mmap . Select the scope and click 「转换选择」 (Convert selection) , or click 「转换全部」 (Convert all) to process the whole scene. To infer attribute rows automatically, configure an AI service in the mapping tool and click 「一键映射」 (One-click mapping) , then fine-tune by hand and save as .mmap . Verify the result The converted material count and applied object count in the dialog match the scene, and the failure list is empty or can be located item by item with 「在Maya中选中失败材质」 (Select failed materials in Maya) . Tips 「一键映射」 (One-click mapping) only fills attribute rows; the type mapping table still has to be configured in the conversion tool. A multi-row configuration can be saved as an .mlist preset and restored later with 「加载预设」 (Load preset) . Materials of the same type are skipped and never converted twice. Warnings Batch conversion creates and replaces many materials in a row, so always save the scene first; when one pair lacks a mapping those materials count as failures while the rest keep converting.

items.title: Preview .ma node connections
synonyms: see the node connections of an ma
items.summary: The node editor can open a .ma or .zmetal and draw the createNode / connectAttr data or the JSON node network as a readable node graph. Prerequisites A Maya ASC
items.text: The node editor can open a .ma or .zmetal and draw the createNode / connectAttr data or the JSON node network as a readable node graph. Prerequisites A Maya ASCII .ma or a .zmetal from an asset is available. The file is not a binary .mb . Steps In the library right-click the asset, point at 「预览节点」 (Preview nodes) and choose the .zmetal or a .ma other than node.ma . You can also click 「打开文件」 (Open file) in the editor, or drop a .ma / .zmetal into the window. Pan with the middle mouse button or Ctrl +left drag, zoom with the wheel; 「层级布局」 (Hierarchical layout) rearranges left to right. To connect, click the orange output port on the right of a node and then the grey input port on the left of the target node; the direction cannot be reversed. Select a node or link and press Delete to remove it; Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo. Click 「保存文件」 (Save file) to overwrite the original; 「另存为...」 (Save as...) lets you save as .ma or .zmetal . Verify the result The node count on the canvas matches the file, and the connections match connectAttr (or source_node / source_attr ); after saving and reopening, the changes are still there. Tips Saving a .ma keeps the original file as the base and only removes the nodes you deleted, preserving geometry, cameras and other data; saving a .zmetal keeps the original JSON as the base and only updates changed nodes and connections. The current version does not support adding new nodes by hand; to add nodes, create them in Maya first, save as .ma and then edit. Warnings Saving overwrites the original file. Back up the whole .zasset before editing a .zmetal inside an asset.

items.title: zlight assets
items.summary: A .zlight is a renderer-independent light preset: it records the light's physical parameters and its complete upstream node network, and import builds the light
items.text: A .zlight is a renderer-independent light preset: it records the light's physical parameters and its complete upstream node network, and import builds the light for the target renderer. Prerequisites A light asset (a .zasset folder) exists. The asset directory can be opened in a file manager. Steps Right-click the light asset in the library and choose 「打开文件夹」 (Open folder) . Find the .zlight file (normally node.zlight ; the import side also recognizes other .zlight file names). Open it and confirm the structure: the new format is nodes + root_lights , the old format is a lights list. Check the common fields per light: light_type , source_node_type , color , intensity , exposure , temperature , normalize , visible , transform , plus hdr_path and ies_file . When a light carries textures or IES, look at connected_files , connections and node_network ; the matching files live in the asset's textures/ and their paths have been rewritten as relative paths. Verify the result After importing the asset the light node appears in the Outliner with a type matching the current renderer; a dome light's HDR, an IES light's profile and upstream texture nodes all connect back to the light. Tips light_type supports area , point , spot , directional , dome , disk , cylinder and ies . The new format records source_node_type per light so import can reconstruct it for the source renderer first and then decide whether to convert. The old format has only a lights list without per-light source node types; when "build first, then ask" is needed it infers from meta.node_type . The file exists only if the zlight format was enabled at export; a light asset with only .ma goes through the ordinary scene import.

items.title: Light category
items.summary: The light category is the lights sub-library of the asset library, holding .zlight or .ma/.mb light assets; the context menu can import them, apply parameters o
items.text: The light category is the lights sub-library of the asset library, holding .zlight or .ma/.mb light assets; the context menu can import them, apply parameters or convert on import. Prerequisites The current Maya has the target renderer plug-in loaded (Arnold / V-Ray / Redshift or native Maya). The light asset is already in the light category. Steps In the library go to the light category on the left. Right-click the light asset, choose 「导入」 (Import) and then a format such as .zlight or .ma . Import first builds each light for its own source renderer; when that differs from the current renderer a 「灯光与渲染器不匹配」 (light and renderer do not match) prompt asks whether to convert. To land directly on a specific type, right-click 「转换导入」 (Convert import) and choose the target light node type in the submenu. To reuse an asset's parameters on an existing light, use 「应用灯光参数到选中灯光」 (Apply light parameters to the selected light) . Light type mapping Generic type Arnold V-Ray Redshift Native Maya area aiAreaLight VRayLightRectShape RedshiftPhysicalLight areaLight point aiPhotometricLight VRayLightSphereShape RedshiftIESLight pointLight spot aiPhotometricLight (approximate) VRayLightSpotShape RedshiftPhysicalLight spotLight directional aiSkyDomeLight (approximate) VRayLightDistantShape RedshiftSunAndSky directionalLight dome aiSkyDomeLight VRayLightDomeShape RedshiftDomeLight directionalLight (approximate) ies aiPhotometricLight VRayLightIESShape RedshiftIESLight pointLight Verify the result After import the light appears in the Outliner and is selected, its node type matches the current renderer or the chosen target type, and the light's illumination is visible in the render viewport. Tips Double-clicking a .zlight converts directly to the current renderer without asking; right-click 「导入」 (Import) builds first and asks afterwards. The automatic conversion prompt only covers Arnold, V-Ray and Redshift. Arnold has no native spot or distant light, so photometric / dome lights are used as approximations; native Maya has no dome light and uses a directional light instead.

items.title: Apply light parameters
synonyms: copy light parameters onto an existing light
how to use a light asset
items.summary: Apply the parameters from a light asset onto lights already in the scene, without creating a new light or moving the existing ones. Prerequisites The target lig
items.text: Apply the parameters from a light asset onto lights already in the scene, without creating a new light or moving the existing ones. Prerequisites The target lights exist in the scene (transform or shape both work). The light asset contains .zlight , or at least a .ma/.mb light network to fall back on. Steps Select one or more lights in Maya that should receive the parameters. Right-click the light asset in the library and choose 「应用灯光参数到选中灯光」 (Apply light parameters to the selected light) . Same-type lights: the tool writes back the serialized source attributes exactly. Cross-type lights: it maps source attributes to target attributes through .mmap and migrates texture and IES connections as well. When the asset has no .zlight , the tool imports its .ma/.mb , uses the lights inside as the parameter source, and cleans up the temporary imported nodes afterwards. Verify the result The Script Editor reports 「已应用 N 处灯光参数」 (applied N light parameter groups) and the modified lights stay selected at the end. The target lights' color, intensity, exposure, HDR / IES and so on match the asset. Tips When the source light has no texture slot, leftover texture connections on the target are disconnected so old textures do not occupy the attribute and block the color value. Some plug-in attributes are read-only; an ineffective write prints 「属性写入未生效（可能只读）」 (attribute write had no effect; it may be read-only) . Texture nodes are kept and the temporary source light is deleted. Warnings With no light selected the tool reports an error straight away; cross-type application needs the matching light .mmap , otherwise nothing is written.

items.title: Create a dome light
synonyms: how to create a dome light
items.summary: Creating a dome light picks a template for the current renderer, builds a dome light and connects the selected HDR to it. Prerequisites The current renderer is
items.text: Creating a dome light picks a template for the current renderer, builds a dome light and connects the selected HDR to it. Prerequisites The current renderer is Arnold, V-Ray or Redshift. A usable HDR is available: an HDR asset in the library, or one in the plug-in's Assets/IBL directory. Steps Open the 「创建资产」 (Create asset) dialog and click 「创建灯光」 (Create light) in the thumbnail source area. The menu lists the environment images ( .hdr , .exr and so on) under Assets/IBL ; hovering an entry shows a same-named PNG preview. Pick an HDR and the tool chooses a template for the current renderer: aiSkyDomeLight.ma for Arnold, VRayLightDome.ma for V-Ray and rsDomeLight.ma for Redshift. You can also double-click an HDR asset in the library or drag it into the viewport; the same template logic applies. After creation adjust rotation, intensity and exposure in the attribute editor as needed. Verify the result A dome light appears in the Outliner and is selected; the attribute editor shows the HDR connection (Arnold's file , V-Ray's VRayPlaceEnvTex or Redshift's tex0 path); the render background shows environment lighting. Tips The template directory is Assets/HDR_ligt (containing aiSkyDomeLight.ma , VRayLightDome.ma and rsDomeLight.ma ); the default template can be changed per sub-library in Settings → 右键菜单 (Context menu) , in the double-click command area in the lower half of the right column , and dragging an HDR follows it. The created light locks visibility to prevent accidental hiding; to switch it off temporarily change intensity or exposure rather than unlocking visibility. Arnold sets camera=0 , Redshift sets cameraRayContributionScale=0 and V-Ray sets domeSpherical=0 , so the render background keeps its alpha while lighting and reflections still work. Warnings Only Arnold, V-Ray and Redshift can create a dome light automatically today; the native Maya renderer does not.

items.title: HDR connections
items.summary: The HDR connection is made automatically by creating an environment light; each renderer connects it to the dome light differently, but all of them use the Raw
items.text: The HDR connection is made automatically by creating an environment light; each renderer connects it to the dome light differently, but all of them use the Raw color space. Prerequisites A dome light already exists, or an HDR asset is about to be used to create one. The HDR file exists and its path is reachable. Steps Right-click the HDR asset in the library and choose 「创建环境光」 (Create environment light) , or pick an IBL under 「创建灯光」 (Create light) in Create asset . The tool builds the connection for the current renderer: Arnold: a file node with outColor → dome light color . V-Ray: file + VRayPlaceEnvTex with useDomeTex=1 and the file output → dome light domeTex . Redshift: the HDR path is written directly into the dome light's tex0 string attribute. To confirm, open the attribute editor and look at the dome light's texture attribute or connection. Rotate the environment with the dome light or its environment tool's rotation parameter, not by changing the HDR file name. Verify the result The dome light's texture attribute has a connection or path; the render background and reflections show the HDR content; the Arnold / V-Ray file node's colorSpace is Raw . Tips HDR is linear data and must use Raw ; setting sRGB darkens the environment and distorts colors. Redshift's tex0 stores only a path and creates no file node, which is expected. Re-importing a .zlight re-resolves the texture paths against the asset's textures/ . Warnings When the HDR file is missing the tool only logs it: the light is still created but has no environment texture. After moving or deleting an HDR file, reconnect it.

items.title: Supported formats
items.summary: The image format conversion tool reads and writes through OpenCV, converting between floating-point HDR/EXR and the common 8-bit formats; converting float to 8-
items.text: The image format conversion tool reads and writes through OpenCV, converting between floating-point HDR/EXR and the common 8-bit formats; converting float to 8-bit applies tone mapping automatically. Supported formats Format Extension Data mode Notes Radiance HDR .hdr Float High dynamic range environment image OpenEXR .exr Float Production-grade high dynamic range image PNG .png 8-bit Lossless, supports an alpha channel JPEG .jpg , .jpeg 8-bit Lossy compression, small files TIFF .tif , .tiff Float or 8-bit Supports several compressions BMP .bmp 8-bit Uncompressed bitmap WebP .webp 8-bit High compression ratio TGA .tga 8-bit Common in games Output options Output format Available options JPEG Quality 1–100, 95 by default PNG Compression level 0–9, 5 by default TIFF Compression NONE / LZW / DEFLATE, LZW by default EXR Compression mode, ZIP by default HDR / others No extra options Use and verify Choose files or a folder in the tool and set the output format and options. Click 「开始转换」 (Start conversion) ; the log shows each file's result. When it finishes, confirm in the output directory that the files exist, have the right extension and can be read by a Maya file node. Tips Requires opencv-python and numpy ; imageio is not required but improves EXR compatibility. TIFF can keep float data or output 8-bit; once TIFF is chosen, decide the compression by purpose. Converting HDR/EXR to PNG/JPEG applies Reinhard compression and 2.2 gamma, so it is only suitable for previews or thumbnails. When the full dynamic range must be kept, output .exr or .hdr again.

items.title: Batch conversion
items.summary: Batch conversion can process every image in a folder recursively, convert them all to the target format, and resize or preserve the directory hierarchy as neede
items.text: Batch conversion can process every image in a folder recursively, convert them all to the target format, and resize or preserve the directory hierarchy as needed. Prerequisites opencv-python and numpy are installed. The input directory is readable and the output directory is writable. Steps Open 「图像格式转换工具」 (Image format conversion tool) . Set the input mode to 「选择文件夹」 (Choose folder) and click 「浏览...」 (Browse...) to pick the directory; the tool collects the images inside recursively. To limit the source formats, fill 「输入格式过滤」 (Input format filter) such as exr or png, jpg ; empty means every supported format. Choose 「输出格式」 (Output format) and set JPEG quality, PNG compression level or TIFF compression as needed. Set 「输出位置」 (Output location) ; empty means the input directory. To resize, fill the width / height under 「输出分辨率」 (Output resolution) ; empty keeps the original size. Check 「保持宽高比」 (Keep aspect ratio) to avoid stretching. Choose 「保持层级结构」 (Keep hierarchy) or uncheck it so every file lands in one directory. Click 「开始转换」 (Start conversion) and watch the log and progress. Verify the result The log shows "processing" and the output path for each file, and the converted count at the end; the number of files in the output directory matches the filtered input count and their extensions match the target format. Tips Setting only the width or only the height computes the other side proportionally; setting both with keep-aspect-ratio scales by the smaller ratio. The tool creates the output folder when it does not exist. Large-resolution EXR decodes slowly; converting in batches reduces memory pressure. Warnings When a source file name does not follow Maya's rules (letters, digits, underscore and dot only, starting with a letter), the interface batch conversion renames the source file and the log says 「源文件已重命名」 (source file renamed) . The command channel convert_image_format explicitly does not rename; if the source must stay untouched, copy it first and then convert.

items.title: Color spaces
items.summary: The color space decides whether texture values are converted to linear: color textures use sRGB , while data textures such as normal, roughness and metalness us
items.text: The color space decides whether texture values are converted to linear: color textures use sRGB , while data textures such as normal, roughness and metalness use Raw . Texture types and color spaces Texture type Color space baseColor / albedo / diffuse / color sRGB emissive / subsurface color sRGB normal Raw roughness / metallic / ao / arm / orm Raw height / opacity / clearcoat / specular / anisotropy / ior Raw When creating a material from PBR textures the plug-in reads these rules from Assets/preset/pbr_mapping.json and sets each file node's colorSpace automatically. Steps Create the material with a texture asset or the PBR texture workflow; the tool sets the color space of every file node per the rules. Select the file node in the attribute editor and check that colorSpace matches the table above. Do not change an HDR connected to a dome light to sRGB by hand; the plug-in treats it as Raw when connecting and also enables ignoreColorSpaceFileRules on import. If textures look off after importing an asset, check file.colorSpace first and then whether Maya's file rules re-derived it. Verify the result Color textures show sRGB and normal and data textures show Raw ; normal maps no longer look grey or off-color, roughness values match the source file and the HDR environment has a normal brightness. Tips When importing .zmetal / .ma the plug-in protects existing colorSpace values while rewriting texture paths, so the png/jpg defaults do not override them. The image format conversion tool only converts pixels and bit depth and never writes color space metadata; HDR/EXR to 8-bit also applies tone mapping. Setting a color texture to Raw makes it darker and oversaturated; setting a data texture to sRGB distorts normals and roughness.

items.title: Cross-renderer confirmation
items.summary: When the imported materials or lights differ from the current renderer, the plug-in asks whether to convert; choosing No keeps the asset's original renderer nod
items.text: When the imported materials or lights differ from the current renderer, the plug-in asks whether to convert; choosing No keeps the asset's original renderer nodes. Symptoms After importing an asset a 「材质与渲染器不匹配」 (material and renderer do not match) or 「灯光与渲染器不匹配」 (light and renderer do not match) dialog appears, saying the asset belongs to one renderer while the current renderer is another, and asks whether to convert to the current renderer's type. Cause The asset records the concrete node types from export time (commonly Arnold, V-Ray or Redshift). The current Maya's defaultRenderGlobals.currentRenderer differs, and creating the nodes directly would produce nodes another renderer cannot use. Steps Confirm the current renderer and its plug-in are loaded so the conversion target type exists. Choose 「是」 (Yes) : materials convert to the current renderer's default material and lights to the matching type; the original nodes are replaced. Choose 「否」 (No) : nodes stay as the asset's original type, and you can right-click 「转换导入」 (Convert import) later to pick a target type. If the Script Editor says 「无 xxx -> yyy 的映射路径」 (no mapping path from xxx to yyy) , a .mmap is missing; nodes stay as they are and nothing aborts with an error. Verify the result After conversion the node types in the Hypershade / Outliner belong to the current renderer; renders no longer report unknown nodes; scene materials or lights look right. If it still fails Check that the target .mmap is in Assets/material_mapper_presets or Assets/light_mapper_presets and named source type_target type.mmap . Only Arnold, V-Ray and Redshift ask automatically; convert native Maya materials manually with the material conversion tool. Right-click 「导入」 (Import) builds first and asks afterwards; double-clicking a .zlight converts directly to the current renderer without asking.

items.title: Missing textures
items.summary: When a material becomes a flat color or black after import, usually the asset has no textures, the paths still point at the original machine, or fileTextureName
items.text: When a material becomes a flat color or black after import, usually the asset has no textures, the paths still point at the original machine, or fileTextureName was not rewritten successfully. Symptoms file node paths in the Hypershade show yellow / red or point at directories that do not exist; viewport materials have no pattern; a light asset's HDR / IES is not connected either. Common causes Textures were not checked at export, so the .zasset has no textures/ at all. The import policy is 「源文件目录」 (source file directory) , so paths are still the absolute paths of the export machine. The asset was moved or renamed and the original paths in meta.texture_map no longer work. Light textures / HDR / IES were not collected, or those files were deleted outside the asset. For multi-resolution textures only the currently selected resolution was imported and the others are missing. Steps Open the .zasset and confirm the matching files really exist under textures/ . Change the texture import policy in settings to copy into the project or the asset directory, then import again. Go back to the source scene, export again with textures checked, and avoid exporting material nodes alone. Read the Script Editor for logs such as 「贴图路径已解析」 (texture path resolved) or 「复制依赖失败」 (dependency copy failed) to locate the file. When only a few are missing, point file.fileTextureName back at the correct file in the attribute editor. Verify the result The file node paths point at existing files; the viewport shows the textures; the dome light's environment texture and an IES light's photometric profile work again. If it still fails Check whether meta.texture_map records "original path → textures/... "; without it the import side cannot match precisely. Do not rename files inside textures/ by hand, or the relative paths inside .zmetal / .zlight no longer match. When the asset's source files are gone, the only option is exporting again from the original project.

items.title: Parameter mismatch
items.summary: When some attributes fall back to defaults or clearly wrong values after conversion, it is usually a missing mapping row, a target attribute that does not exist
items.text: When some attributes fall back to defaults or clearly wrong values after conversion, it is usually a missing mapping row, a target attribute that does not exist, or differing units / semantics on the two sides. Symptoms The new material's color, roughness or metalness differs from the source; a light's color is right but its intensity is far off; the Script Editor prints 「目标属性不存在」 (target attribute does not exist) , 「使用默认值」 (using the default value) or 「属性写入未生效」 (attribute write had no effect) . Common causes The .mmap has no row for that source attribute, or the row has no target_attribute . The source attribute does not exist on the current source node, so the tool falls back to default_value . The target node does not have that attribute (different renderer version or plug-in). The semantics differ: glossiness versus roughness, transparency versus transmission and light intensity units are not equivalent. The attribute is read-only: setAttr reports no error but the value never changes. Steps In the Maya Script Editor read the exact attribute names and messages to tell "missing mapping" from "target attribute missing". Add rows with the material node attribute mapping tool: source attribute on the left, target attribute on the right; pick a transform function and fill parameters when a conversion is needed. Save the .mmap into Assets/material_mapper_presets and run the conversion again. For lights across renderers note that only intensity is copied directly by default; when conversion is needed use light_intensity_scale in the mapping with a scale factor. Read-only attributes can only be replaced by attributes the target supports, or by writable attributes on the renderer side. Verify the result After converting again the succeeded attribute count grows and default-value rows shrink; the target values match the source material or the conversion rules. If it still fails Use 「属性映射预览」 (Attribute mapping preview) in the material conversion tool to check every row. Same-named attributes do not imply the same semantics; never rely on name-only copying. When the target attribute really does not exist, change the target material type or add a mapping to a similar attribute.

items.title: Unsupported light types
items.summary: Exporting a .zlight reports 「不支持的灯光类型」 (unsupported light type) , or after import fewer lights exist or types were replaced by approximations. Symptoms The Scri
items.text: Exporting a .zlight reports 「不支持的灯光类型」 (unsupported light type) , or after import fewer lights exist or types were replaced by approximations. Symptoms The Script Editor prints 不支持的灯光类型: <node type> ; the asset has fewer lights than the scene; after import a dome light became a directional light, or a spot became a point light. Common causes The light type is not registered as a generic type, for example ambientLight , volumeLight , aiLightBlocker , VRaySunTarget , RedshiftPortalLight or RedshiftNightSky . The target renderer has no equivalent: Arnold has no native spot or distant light, and native Maya has no dome light. The current renderer is not Arnold, V-Ray or Redshift, so the automatic conversion on import never triggers. The light is nested under other nodes and was not collected as a light shape at export. Steps Select the light, confirm its node type and check the light type table in 7.4.2 to judge whether it is supported. Switch to a supported light: area , point , spot , directional , dome , disk , cylinder or ies . When the approximate effect must be kept, choose the replacement for the target renderer: aiPhotometricLight for an Arnold spot and aiSkyDomeLight for an Arnold distant light. Confirm the renderer plug-in is loaded, then export or import again. Verify the result Re-exporting logs 「找到 N 个灯光 shape」 (found N light shapes) with N matching the number of supported lights in the scene; after import the Outliner's light count matches the asset and no unsupported-light-type message appears. If it still fails Helper lights (portal, blocker, night sky) never enter a .zlight and must be saved as a separate .ma asset. An approximate type does not preserve every physical property of the original; add parameters manually in the target renderer when needed. Cross-renderer conversion needs the matching .mmap ; without one the original light is kept and a message is printed.

items.title: Which features use AI
items.summary: The plug-in's AI capability has three layers: local retrieval (embedding model and index), visual understanding (look at an image and suggest), and conversation
items.text: The plug-in's AI capability has three layers: local retrieval (embedding model and index), visual understanding (look at an image and suggest), and conversation plus external agents. If any layer is unavailable, browsing, importing and exporting assets are unaffected. Features that use AI Feature Capability used Entry AI search Local embeddings fused with lexical results; optionally a large model for intent Check 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) in the search bar and press Enter AI search preview Local retrieval first, optionally a large model for intent and a vision model for image search AI tools → AI search preview Search by image / video and sound Image / video / audio vectors (sidecar) → vision or audio model description → keywords, degrading step by step The upload button in the search bar (menu: upload image / video / audio search), screenshot search, screen-recording search; under audio, system-audio recording search; a reference image can also be added in the AI search preview AI thumbnail analysis A vision chat model reads the thumbnail Right-click an asset → AI thumbnail analysis, or the AI tools menu AI assistant The dsh chat surface; its model is configured inside dsh AI tools → AI assistant Maya documentation knowledge base Local lexical plus optional semantic search; official online help when local data is missing Use maya_docs in the AI assistant External AI access Skill bundles and the MCP channel, handing the command surface to external tools Settings → AI → the 「外部 AI 工具」 (External AI tools) group → 「外部 AI 工具…」 (External AI tools…) What works without AI Asset browsing, categories, tags, thumbnails, import and export, and material conversion do not need a model. When semantic search is unavailable it falls back to keyword search; when AI analysis is unavailable you can fill in the name, category and tags by hand. Notes Checking 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) only changes how the search runs; it never uploads asset files. Whether the network is used depends on the model you choose; see "Local and cloud".

items.title: Local and cloud
synonyms: do I need an API key
items.summary: By default everything runs locally: Ollama provides embedding and vision capability and the index files live in the asset library or a local directory you choos
items.text: By default everything runs locally: Ollama provides embedding and vision capability and the index files live in the asset library or a local directory you choose. Requests only reach a provider when you actively configure a cloud model. The local part Ollama : a local service, http://127.0.0.1:11434 by default, which the plug-in uses for embeddings and image understanding. Embedding model : embeddinggemma-2:740m (768 dimensions) by default, shared by the asset text index, the Maya documentation index and the image index. Vision chat model : AI asset analysis and the "image to description" step of image search need a chat model that can see images; the dependency check recommends qwen3.5:9b (about 5–6 GB), and any other pulled vision model also works. Image sidecar : a separate venv installing only numpy and Pillow (about 30 MB); image vectors are still encoded by the Ollama embedding model. dsh : the AI assistant runtime, which manages its own model credentials. The cloud part Settings → AI → 全局大模型（默认） (Global model (default)) offers Ollama (local), DeepSeek, Qwen (Alibaba Cloud DashScope), Zhipu (BigModel), OpenAI and Custom (OpenAI compatible). AI analysis uses it by default, and 「使用全局大模型」 (Use the global model) at the top of the AI search preview panel reads it as well. AI search has its own configuration (the settings at the top right of the preview panel) and by default calls no large model, doing local vector retrieval only. How the work is split Everyday asset search and search by image: local, fast and requiring no key. Thumbnail analysis and stronger semantic understanding: a local vision model or a cloud configuration. Long conversations and cross-tool orchestration: dsh or an external AI tool. Whether a cloud model supports images varies by provider, and the configuration box shows the matching hint.

items.title: Privacy and data
items.summary: By default assets and thumbnails never leave this machine. Requests only leave it when a cloud model is enabled, when the Maya online help fallback is used, or
items.text: By default assets and thumbnails never leave this machine. Requests only leave it when a cloud model is enabled, when the Maya online help fallback is used, or when dsh connects to a cloud model. Data that stays local Indexes : the text semantic index defaults to <asset library>\.squirrel_ai_index\<official|ollama>\ (split by backend), the image index to img\ and the media index to media\ in the same directory; with ai_asset_index_dir set they live under that root in sub-directories split by "library + backend". Image sidecar : <plug-in directory>\.venvs\asset-vision and its cache. Run records : <plug-in directory>\dsh_home\ (dsh sessions, install logs, reuse records); AI dependency reports and install logs are in %TEMP%\squirrel_asset_manager\ . Online help cache : ~\.squirrel_asset_manager\help_cache (directory tree for 7 days, pages for 30 days). Data that leaves this machine With a cloud model selected, prompts and the thumbnails being analyzed are sent to that provider. When the local knowledge base is missing or has no hit, the "online fallback" sends the query to help.autodesk.com and only reads public help pages. Which model dsh uses is decided by dsh's own settings, and it may connect to the cloud. Credentials API keys are stored in the plug-in settings file ~\.squirrel_asset_manager\app_settings.json , which is not an encrypted vault, so protect it like any configuration file. AI search keys and global model keys are stored separately. Recommendations On confidential projects turn off cloud models and keep only local Ollama; to work fully offline set MAYA_KB_ONLINE=0 before starting to disable the online help fallback.

items.title: Dependency check
items.summary: One check inspects Ollama, the embedding model, the documentation and asset-library indexes, image retrieval, the vision model, dsh and cloud keys, and produces
items.text: One check inspects Ollama, the embedding model, the documentation and asset-library indexes, image retrieval, the vision model, dsh and cloud keys, and produces a report you can follow directly. Prerequisites The plug-in main window is open; to check the indexes and the current library, open the target asset library first. Steps Open Settings → AI 设置 (AI settings) . In the top 「AI 功能与依赖」 (AI features and dependencies) group click 「AI 依赖检查」 (AI dependency check) . Wait for the background check. The report is written to disk and opened in Notepad automatically, and the status line also gives a summary. Work through the report in order: first the items marked unavailable, then the optional ones not installed; every item states the current state, what is missing, which feature it affects and how to fix it. Verify the result Notepad opens %TEMP%\squirrel_asset_manager\AI依赖检查报告.txt , listing each item as available, optional and not installed, or unavailable; the entries should agree with the hints on the settings page. Tips The check connects to Ollama once and asks about each model's capabilities, which takes a few seconds on a slow machine. To inspect local files quickly without contacting services, run the read-only command ai_deps_status(probe=false) . The report only diagnoses and never installs; use 「一键安装」 (One-click install) to fill gaps (next page).

items.title: One-click install
items.summary: Installs the AI dependencies in a fixed sequence, skipping whatever already exists; after a failure, clicking again only fills in the failed or missing parts. P
items.text: Installs the AI dependencies in a fixed sequence, skipping whatever already exists; after a failure, clicking again only fills in the failed or missing parts. Prerequisites Network access; enough free disk space (about 1.3 GB for the embedding model and 5.6 GB for the vision model); installing Ollama may need system permissions. Steps Open Settings → AI 设置 (AI settings) → AI 功能与依赖 (AI features and dependencies) and click 「一键安装 AI 功能与依赖」 (One-click install of AI features and dependencies) . In the confirmation dialog check the steps and sizes. When AI asset analysis is needed, check 「同时安装图像检索」 (Also install image retrieval) and confirm the vision model name. Start it. The progress window shows the current step, live logs and a cancel button; Maya stays usable during the install. Afterwards read the success or failure list. On failure click the same button again, which only fills the failed or missing steps; check 「强制重装」 (Force reinstall) to reinstall over existing parts. The install order is: Ollama → start the service → embedding model → documentation vector index → asset library semantic index → (optional) image sidecar → vision chat model. Verify the result After installing, run 「AI 依赖检查」 (AI dependency check) again and the related items should show as available; you can also try a natural-language Chinese semantic search or an AI thumbnail analysis. Tips and warnings After cancelling, the parts already installed are kept and only the missing ones are installed next time. The full log is %TEMP%\squirrel_asset_manager\ai_install.log . This step does not install dsh; use the one-click install offered by 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) for the assistant runtime.

items.title: Ollama, embedding models and vision models
path: Ollama, embedding models and vision models
items.summary: Ollama is the local model service, the embedding model turns text and images into vectors, and the vision chat model looks at images and gives suggestions; the
items.text: Ollama is the local model service, the embedding model turns text and images into vectors, and the vision chat model looks at images and gives suggestions; the three serve different purposes and cannot replace each other. The three roles Component Default Purpose Size reference Ollama http://127.0.0.1:11434 Provides the local model service About 1 GB Embedding model embeddinggemma-2:740m (768 dimensions) Asset text index, Maya documentation index, image vectors About 1.3 GB Vision chat model qwen3.5:9b recommended by the check AI thumbnail analysis and the image-to-description step of image search About 5–6 GB Image sidecar Separate venv (numpy + Pillow) Schedules image encoding and retrieval About 30 MB dsh 0.2.2-rc.3 The AI assistant chat surface About 220 MB How the model is chosen AI analysis does not hard-code a model name: it uses your choice first, then picks a model from the provider's live list that can chat and see images, and only then reports an error. When the configured model is not installed or is text-only, the plug-in substitutes an available model and records why. Switching models Changing the embedding model changes the vector space, so the old indexes must be rebuilt: Asset text index: python tools\asset_index.py --rebuild --model <model name> Maya documentation index: python tools\build_semantic_index.py --model <model name> Image index: python tools\asset_vision_encode.py sync --library "<library root>" --rebuild --model gemma2 Each index records the model it used, and a mismatch marks it unavailable with the rebuild command. Verify the result ollama list shows the model; running 「AI 依赖检查」 (AI dependency check) again shows both the embedding and vision model items as available.

items.title: Handling installation failures
items.summary: Install failures are usually network, permission or Node version problems; read the report and logs first, then fix only the step that failed instead of reinsta
items.text: Install failures are usually network, permission or Node version problems; read the report and logs first, then fix only the step that failed instead of reinstalling everything. Symptoms and fixes Ollama did not install : confirm the ollama command exists, or install it manually from ollama.com and rerun the one-click install. Automatic install on Windows relies on winget and fails when a policy blocks it. The service did not start : confirm port 11434 is free, run ollama serve manually and then open http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags . If the system or environment sets a proxy ( HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY ) without putting 127.0.0.1 in NO_PROXY , even loopback requests are intercepted. Model pull interrupted : rerun the one-click install, which skips finished steps. On a slow network switch mirrors or try later. Image sidecar half installed : a venv without numpy / Pillow counts as incomplete. Rerun the install, or run python tools\asset_vision_env.py --install --self-check . Index build failed : mostly Ollama is not running or a model is missing. Run the dependency check first and confirm the library path exists; on the command line python tools\asset_index.py --status and --doctor show the reason. dsh install failed : close any open AI panel and retry so files are not locked; Node must be ^22.19 || >=24 . Reading the logs AI dependency install: %TEMP%\squirrel_asset_manager\ai_install.log dsh install: <plug-in directory>\dsh_home\dsh_install.log dsh startup: <plug-in directory>\dsh_home\squirrel_web_<instance>.log If it still fails Report the report, the last 40 log lines and the OS version together; do not delete a half-built venv or index directory by hand — rerunning the install overwrites and repairs them.

items.title: The dsh chat panel
items.summary: 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) is not a separate model: it docks the chat surface of the locally installed dsh (DeepSeek Harness) into Maya and lets it drive the asset
items.text: 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) is not a separate model: it docks the chat surface of the locally installed dsh (DeepSeek Harness) into Maya and lets it drive the asset library and scene through the plug-in's command surface. What it is dsh is both a chat front end and a runtime; releases no longer bundle it, and the plug-in uses the copy installed on your machine (verified version 0.2.2-rc.3 ). The panel opens dsh's web client; inside Maya it docks to the right by default with a tab such as dsh — <scene name> , so it is easy to tell apart from a dsh you opened in a browser yourself. When embedding is unavailable (for example a missing WebView component) it falls back to the system browser, and no functionality is lost. How it connects to the plug-in Before opening the panel the plug-in starts the local backend (broker) and registers the current Maya as an instance. The squirrel_* tools inside dsh find that instance through the broker and act on this Maya process only by default. In addition, the bundled skill set lands in <dshHome>/skills and user-level instructions in <dshHome>/AGENTS.md , so the assistant knows to consult the help first and touch the scene afterwards. State The toggle recognizes exactly three states: off, starting and on. "On" means the panel is visible, the dsh service started by this process still runs, or the front end recorded in the reuse log is still alive. Notes The AI assistant, 「AI 搜索预览资产」 (AI search preview) and 「AI 分析缩略图」 (AI thumbnail analysis) are three independent paths: the first is a chat surface, the other two are asset retrieval and metadata suggestions, and each can be used alone.

items.title: Embedded and browser modes
items.summary: The chat surface can dock inside Maya or be handed to the system browser; both start the same dsh with the same sessions and tools, and only the window location
items.text: The chat surface can dock inside Maya or be handed to the system browser; both start the same dsh with the same sessions and tools, and only the window location differs. Prerequisites The AI assistant starts normally and dsh is installed. Steps Open Settings → AI 设置 (AI settings) . In the 「AI 对话面」 (AI chat surface) group find 「在 Maya 内嵌 AI 对话面（取消则用系统浏览器打开）」 (embed the AI chat surface in Maya; uncheck to open it in the system browser) . Checked means it docks inside Maya next time; unchecked means the system browser. Close Settings and reopen AI 工具 (AI tools) → AI 助手 (AI assistant) . The setting applies on the next click. Verify the result Embedded mode: a docked panel appears on the right of Maya with the scene name in its title. Browser mode: the system browser opens the dsh page and Maya shows no docked panel; while the assistant runs, the 「AI 工具」 (AI tools) menu gains 「召回AI面板」 (Recall the AI panel) . Tips and warnings When the Maya layout swallows the embedded panel, the plug-in recalls it automatically as long as the service is running; a panel you hid yourself is never forced back. In browser mode the tab belongs to the browser and the plug-in cannot see you closing it; clicking the toggle then may stop the service, so use 「召回AI面板」 (Recall the AI panel) to recover. When the embedded component is unavailable it falls back to the browser even if embedding is still checked. The 「AI 工具」 (AI tools) menu is rebuilt per state : while the assistant is not running it contains only AI thumbnail analysis / AI search preview / AI assistant / stop the AI backend service; 「关闭 AI 助手」 (Close the AI assistant) and 「召回AI面板」 (Recall the AI panel) appear only while it runs (open the assistant once and look at the menu again).

items.title: Open, recall and stop
items.summary: The AI assistant is a toggle: clicking while it is off starts dsh and shows the chat surface, clicking again while it is on closes the panel and ends the dsh pr
items.text: The AI assistant is a toggle: clicking while it is off starts dsh and shows the chat surface, clicking again while it is on closes the panel and ends the dsh process. Prerequisites The plug-in main window is open and dsh is installed; without a local dsh an install guide appears first (see 8.3.5). Steps Click 「AI 工具」 (AI tools) in the toolbar and choose 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) . Wait for the state to change from 「正在启动 AI 助手…」 (Starting the AI assistant…) to 「关闭 AI 助手」 (Close the AI assistant) . The first start takes a few seconds; when the main window opens the plug-in warms up in the background, so it is usually faster. Once the panel appears you can chat. If the panel is collapsed while the service still runs, open AI 工具 (AI tools) → 召回AI面板 (Recall the AI panel) to bring it back. To end the conversation click AI 工具 (AI tools) → 关闭 AI 助手 (Close the AI assistant) , which closes the panel and ends the dsh process. When the menu items appear The 「AI 工具」 (AI tools) menu is rebuilt per state each time it opens, so the wording in the same position changes: Assistant state That menu item Related items Off (or closed) 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) Neither recall nor close appears Starting 「正在启动 AI 助手…」 (Starting the AI assistant…) Same as above; no chat surface to recall yet On 「关闭 AI 助手」 (Close the AI assistant) 「召回AI面板」 (Recall the AI panel) appears as well So "close is missing from the menu" usually means the assistant is not running — that is by design, not a missing item. Verify the result After opening: the menu item becomes 「关闭 AI 助手」 (Close the AI assistant) and a chat panel appears on the right of Maya, or the system browser opens the page. After recalling: the panel reappears with the previous session intact. After stopping: the menu returns to 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) and Task Manager no longer shows the dsh process started this time. Tips and warnings Clicking again while it is starting cancels that start and never leaves a half-open panel. Closing Maya also ends dsh, so no orphan process is left behind. AI 工具 (AI tools) → 停止 AI 底座服务 (Stop the AI backend service) only stops the local backend and never closes Maya; the backend starts again the next time the assistant opens.

items.title: Conversation and tool calls
items.summary: The assistant in the chat surface does more than talk: it calls the tools the plug-in registers to search assets, read the scene and run scripts, and those tool
items.text: The assistant in the chat surface does more than talk: it calls the tools the plug-in registers to search assets, read the scene and run scripts, and those tools are routed to the current Maya through the local backend. What the assistant can use Command surface tools : squirrel_list_instances , squirrel_list_commands , squirrel_execute_command , squirrel_execute_batch . Long jobs : squirrel_execute_async returns a job ID that squirrel_jobs can query or cancel; results that miss the timeout are fetched with squirrel_late_results . Fallback channel : squirrel_maya_bridge , which goes straight to Maya's commandPort when the backend or instance is unavailable. Documentation and dependencies : maya_docs looks up commands, nodes and the API; squirrel_ai_deps checks or installs AI dependencies. Knowledge : the bundled skill set provides operating discipline and scene recipes, landing in <dshHome>/skills . Instance binding By default it binds to the Maya instance this conversation belongs to, so commands may omit the instance ID. With several Maya sessions open, operating another one requires explicitly allowing cross-instance work; the assistant will not switch for you. Models and credentials Which model the conversation uses is managed by dsh itself; on the first chat follow its prompt to sign in or enter an API key. The plug-in does not manage those credentials. Boundaries Tool calls respect command risk levels; high-risk commands should be previewed before running. When squirrel_* tools are missing from the panel, first confirm the skills landed, the backend is running and the current Maya is registered; dsh_status lists all of these states at once.

items.title: Install guide when dsh is missing
path: Install guide when dsh is missing
items.summary: If dsh is not installed when 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) is clicked, the plug-in shows an actionable install guide; installing once that way needs no Maya restart. P
items.text: If dsh is not installed when 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) is clicked, the plug-in shows an actionable install guide; installing once that way needs no Maya restart. Prerequisites Network access. dsh requires Node.js ^22.19 || >=24 ; 22.18 and below as well as 23 do not work. Steps In Maya click AI 工具 (AI tools) → AI 助手 (AI assistant) . In the prompt choose 「一键安装（推荐）」 (One-click install, recommended) . The plug-in checks Node first, downloads portable Node into <plug-in directory>\node when needed, uses it to install dsh into <plug-in directory>\dsh and opens the assistant when it finishes. On a restricted network, or to control the version yourself, choose 「复制安装命令」 (Copy the install command) and run the npm command with full paths in a terminal; install into the plug-in's dsh sub-directory so the system-wide install is not overwritten. After a manual install, return to Maya, reopen the asset window and click 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) ; no Maya restart is needed. Verify the result Run python squirrel_asset_manager/install_ai_dsh.py --list : the dsh runtime line should show 0.2.2-rc.3 with an in-package path, and the node line should show a qualifying interpreter. Tips and warnings The one-click install downloads about 38 MB of Node and 60–80 MB of dsh dependencies, preferring a domestic mirror first. Close any open AI panel before a manual install, or files are locked and it reports EBUSY. pip install deepseek-harness-sdk installs the single-file SDK runtime without the web profile, so it cannot serve as the chat surface. When dsh lives elsewhere, point at it with SQUIRREL_DSH_BIN or SQUIRREL_DSH_ROOT .

items.title: Analyzing thumbnails
items.summary: Hand the thumbnails of one or more assets to a vision model; it returns a display name, suggested category, tags and notes, and writes them back into the asset
items.text: Hand the thumbnails of one or more assets to a vision model; it returns a display name, suggested category, tags and notes, and writes them back into the asset metadata once you confirm. Prerequisites The assets have usable thumbnails; assets without one are skipped. A model that accepts image input is configured, or a local vision chat model is installed. Steps Select the assets to analyze in the asset grid. Right-click an asset and choose 「AI 分析缩略图」 (AI thumbnail analysis) , or pick 「AI 分析缩略图」 (AI thumbnail analysis) with the selected count from the 「AI 工具」 (AI tools) menu. In the analysis configuration choose the provider, model and output language, and decide whether to 「分析完成后弹出窗口供我审查和编辑」 (open a window for review and editing after analysis) and whether to translate existing tags. Click 「开始分析」 (Start analysis) and wait for progress. Check each item in the result window, edit as needed and click 「应用到元数据」 (Apply to metadata) . Verify the result The result window shows the thumbnail, the original asset name, the top-level category and four checkable results: display name, sub-category, tags and notes. After applying, the names and tags in the asset grid update. Tips and warnings When the current model cannot see images it says so directly instead of silently returning an empty result. DeepSeek's default model is text-only and needs a vision experimental model; Zhipu needs a vision model; OpenAI's o series does not support images. When a model is unavailable the plug-in tries an available vision model from the list and states the substitution reason in the results.

items.title: Suggested categories, tags and Chinese names
path: Suggested categories, tags and Chinese names
items.summary: AI analysis produces four results: a display name, a suggested sub-category, tags and notes. All of them are suggestions that can be edited or unchecked before
items.text: AI analysis produces four results: a display name, a suggested sub-category, tags and notes. All of them are suggestions that can be edited or unchecked before applying. What the four results mean Field Where it is written Effect Display name The asset's name_cn Shows a friendlier Chinese name in the interface Suggested sub-category The asset's category Picked from the existing sub-categories under that top-level category in the current library Tags The asset's tags Keywords such as material, color and purpose, used by search Notes The asset's notes A short description that is also included in keyword search Tags merge with the asset's existing tags rather than replacing them; category candidates come from the real sub-categories of the current library, not a list the model invented. Why human confirmation matters The model only sees the thumbnail and cannot know the asset's real use, scale or project conventions, so treating suggestions as final easily files assets under the wrong category. With 「移动到分析出的分类」 (move to the suggested category) checked by default, applying actually moves the asset to that category directory, which matters more than changing tags. Scope of application Single asset: check fields one by one in the result window and confirm to write them immediately. Batch: select all or check items one by one in the batch result window and click 「应用选中的资产」 (Apply selected assets) . Recommendation When the category is uncertain, first uncheck 「移动到分析出的分类」 (move to the suggested category) and apply only the name and tags; move the asset once the category is confirmed.

items.title: Batch analysis and applying results
items.summary: After selecting several assets, AI analyzes their thumbnails one by one and collects every result in an editable batch window that is applied at once after conf
items.text: After selecting several assets, AI analyzes their thumbnails one by one and collects every result in an editable batch window that is applied at once after confirmation. Prerequisites Several assets are selected, they all have thumbnails and a vision model is available. Steps Multi-select assets in the asset grid. Open the 「AI 工具」 (AI tools) menu and click 「AI 分析缩略图 (N 个选中资产)」 (AI thumbnail analysis, N selected assets) . Choose the model and language in the configuration window, decide whether to review the results and click 「开始分析」 (Start analysis) . The progress window shows each asset in turn and can be cancelled at any time; assets without a thumbnail or whose analysis failed are skipped. When it finishes the 「批量 AI 分析结果 — N 个资产」 (Batch AI analysis results — N assets) window opens: edit the name, category, tags and notes on the left and preview the thumbnail on the right; use 「全选 / 取消全选」 (Select all / Deselect all) to control what is applied. Decide whether to check 「移动到分析出的分类」 (move to the suggested category) and click 「应用选中的资产 (N 个)」 (Apply selected assets, N) . Verify the result After applying, names, tags and categories in the grid update and the state and count match the items checked in the window. With review turned off the results are applied directly without a window. Tips and warnings A batch category move really changes where the assets live, so confirm the category names before applying. Assets whose analysis failed get no fields written and can be retried individually. With large counts, work in batches so each result can be checked in the window.

items.title: Natural-language search
items.summary: With 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) checked, typing a Chinese description and pressing Enter makes the plug-in search assets with local vectors first and only ask a large
items.text: With 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) checked, typing a Chinese description and pressing Enter makes the plug-in search assets with local vectors first and only ask a large model to parse the intent when needed. Prerequisites An asset library is open and a local embedding model plus asset index are available. No cloud key is needed, and large models are not called during queries by default. Steps To limit the scope, select a category or sub-library on the left first. Check 「AI 搜索」 (AI search) in the search bar. Type a colloquial description such as "old wood weathered by sun and rain" and press Enter. Wait for results. Local semantic hits are shown directly; only when local search misses and a model is configured does it parse the intent and search by keywords. Click ✕ on the right of the search box to clear the search and restore the full list of the current category. Verify the result The status bar shows 「语义检索 N 条 · 本地嵌入 <model> · <ms> ms」 (semantic: N results · local embedding … · … ms) or the number of assets found with the keywords. The result grid stays isolated and never modifies the assets. Tips and warnings Freshly imported assets may not be searchable until they are indexed; opening the library or the next search syncs incrementally. With a category selected the search only covers that category and never crosses libraries. When local semantics are unavailable it falls back to the previous keyword and large-model flow without aborting with an error.

items.title: Intent parsing
items.summary: When local vector search finds nothing, AI search breaks your sentence into 3–6 summary keywords, infers which sub-library the asset belongs to and hands the re
items.text: When local vector search finds nothing, AI search breaks your sentence into 3–6 summary keywords, infers which sub-library the asset belongs to and hands the result to lexical search. What the model receives The prompt requires strict JSON only: keywords in Chinese-English pairs, a sub-library limited to materials , models , textures , lights , scenes or hdr , and one explanatory sentence. The plug-in cleans the result, removes duplicates, caps the count and fills in missing Chinese or English forms. Multi-turn refinement The dialog carries the previous turn's text, keywords and sub-library. When you say "a bit darker" or "make it wood", the model adds or removes keywords based on the previous turn instead of guessing again. Keywords in the result bubble appear as chips that can be deleted or edited individually, and changes trigger a new search. Fallback paths AI service unavailable: local tokenization removes lead-ins such as "help me" or "I want" and generic words such as "material" or "asset", splits on whitespace and punctuation, and keeps at most 6 tokens. Model does not exist: it reports that the model name is unavailable and lists the available models where possible. Keywords return nothing: it tokenizes the original text and searches once more, so "using AI" never makes results worse. Limits Intent parsing does not understand assets themselves; it only turns words into search terms. Whether an asset is found still depends on the quality of its name, tags, notes and index text.

items.title: AI search preview panel
items.summary: 「AI 搜索预览资产」 (AI search preview) is a chat-style search window: you state a need, it returns keywords and result cards, and you can keep refining or add assets t
items.text: 「AI 搜索预览资产」 (AI search preview) is a chat-style search window: you state a need, it returns keywords and result cards, and you can keep refining or add assets to the wishlist. Prerequisites An asset library is open; for search by image an image index or a usable vision model is also needed. Steps Open AI 工具 (AI tools) → AI 搜索预览资产 (AI search preview) . Describe the need in the bottom input box, or click 「添加图片」 (Add image) to add a reference image, or 「截图搜索」 (Screenshot search) to marquee a screen region. Click 「发送」 (Send) . The window first shows 「AI 正在分析意图…」 (AI is analyzing the intent…) and then returns keyword bubbles and result cards. Keywords can be edited or deleted, and changes re-run the search; you can also type the next refinement. Right-clicking a result card offers import into Maya, locate in the library, find similar, send to AI analysis or view details; cards can be dragged straight into the viewport. To handle them later, right-click a card to add it to the wishlist on the right. Verify the result The result bubble shows the number found and "sorted by relevance", card thumbnails load, and the wishlist count grows. Tips and warnings 「使用全局大模型」 (Use the global model) at the top is unchecked by default, so only local vector retrieval runs; once checked, intent analysis uses the global model from Settings → AI 设置 (AI settings) . The settings at the top right are AI search's own model configuration, stored separately from AI analysis. With no results, check the index status first instead of rewording repeatedly.

items.title: Search by image
items.summary: Give the plug-in a reference image and it first uses image vectors to find visually similar assets; only when image retrieval is unavailable does it fall back t
items.text: Give the plug-in a reference image and it first uses image vectors to find visually similar assets; only when image retrieval is unavailable does it fall back to "image to description" or "vision keywords". Prerequisites Image search from the main interface: an asset library is open. Pixel-level retrieval needs the image sidecar and the image index; without them a vision model or tag fallback is still possible. A dropped asset must have a usable thumbnail. Steps In the search bar click the upload button (tooltip 「上传文件搜索」 (Upload a file to search) ) and pick one of 「上传图片搜索」 / 「上传视频搜索」 / 「上传音频搜索」 (upload image / video / audio search) , or click screenshot search and marquee a screen region. You can also drag a local image, video or audio file onto the search bar (the placeholder changes accordingly: images, audio and video each have their own hint). To find music by "the sound that is playing", switch to the music (audio) category and use record system audio search : it records what this computer is playing , not the microphone. To find assets from an animation picture, click screen-recording search and record a marquee region. Wait for retrieval. The internal order is: image vectors → turn the query image into one Chinese description and use text vectors → vision-model keywords and lexical search. Results appear isolated in the asset grid; click ✕ on the right of the search box to cancel the isolation and restore all assets of the current category. In 「AI 搜索预览资产」 (AI search preview) you can also add several reference images at once and send them together with text. Verify the result The status bar reports the path actually used: image-vector hits show the count and duration, the description route shows the recognized description, and the keyword route shows the keywords. When all three fail it reports no matching assets. Tips and warnings Building the image index the first time, or a cold start of the sidecar, is noticeably slower; afterwards it is incremental with a resident process. The image index syncs incrementally on thumbnail changes; never use a sync command with --limit as sampling, because it trims index entries. Chinese text-to-image search is not the image index's strength, so prefer a reference image for finding pictures.

items.title: How it differs from ordinary search
path: How it differs from ordinary search
items.summary: Ordinary search does substring matching on names, tags and categories; AI search encodes your words into vectors and compares them, which catches synonyms but d
items.text: Ordinary search does substring matching on names, tags and categories; AI search encodes your words into vectors and compares them, which catches synonyms but depends on indexes and needs more preparation. Comparison Dimension Ordinary search AI semantic search AI search preview panel Input Keywords One natural-language sentence Natural language, images, multi-turn chat Matching Substring on name / tags / notes Vector similarity fused with lexical results Local vectors first, a large model when needed Dependencies None Embedding model and asset index Same, plus optional large and vision models Speed Fastest First search syncs, then usually tens of milliseconds One extra chat round compared with the main search When unavailable Always works Falls back to keyword search Falls back to keywords or reports no results Shared limits Both only search the active library and never cross libraries; with a category selected they search only that category.
