Values and defaults Option Behavior Copy textures into the project Extracts textures to {project}/sourceimages/squirrel_asset/{asset name}_{last 4 of ID}/ and points the material there Current asset directory (default) No copying; the material points directly at textures/ inside the .zasset Source file directory Prefers the original absolute paths recorded at export, falling back to in-asset paths when they do not exist The preset file currently holds asset_directory ; when that key is missing the code falls back to copy_to_project . Scope Material import, light texture import, texture assignment and reference import — every path that reads textures from an asset. It only changes the paths after import and never modifies the asset package. It is stored as texture_import_policy in config.json . When to change it The asset must be delivered to another machine, or the project must be self-contained: choose 「拷贝贴图到项目」 (Copy textures into the project) . Single-machine use where disk space matters and assets should stay together: keep 「当前资产目录」 (Current asset directory) . Textures still live in the original working folder and should stay editable: choose 「源文件目录」 (Source file directory) . Tips Warning : 「源文件目录」 (Source file directory) relies on the absolute paths recorded at export; after moving machines or directories the textures are not found, so switch to one of the first two options. Tip : copying into the project creates a sub-directory from the asset name and the last four characters of the ID, so different assets never overwrite each other.

items.title: Dependency file import policy
items.summary: The dependency file import policy decides whether linked files such as caches, proxies and references are copied into the project on import. Effect It controls
items.text: The dependency file import policy decides whether linked files such as caches, proxies and references are copied into the project on import. Effect It controls where files under .zasset/deps/ end up in Maya and which paths they use. Values and defaults Option Behavior Copy into the project Caches and proxies are copied to {project}/cache/squirrel_asset/{asset name}_{last 4 of ID}/ ; reference files go to {project}/references/squirrel_asset/... Current asset directory (default) No copying; points directly at deps/ inside the .zasset Source file directory Rewrites nothing and keeps the original paths recorded at export The preset file currently holds asset_directory ; when that key is missing the code falls back to copy_to_project . Scope It applies to file-based nodes such as Alembic, gpuCache, proxies, Maya references and volumes when importing geometry, scenes and animation. It only changes the paths after import and never modifies the asset package. Scanning always runs even without redirection, and missing dependencies are recorded in the asset metadata and the log. It is stored as dependency_import_policy in config.json . When to change it The asset must be delivered to another machine, or the project must be self-contained: choose 「拷贝到项目」 (Copy into the project) . Single-machine use where dependencies live with the asset: keep 「当前资产目录」 (Current asset directory) . Still in the original working environment and wanting to keep referencing it: choose 「源文件目录」 (Source file directory) . Tips Warning : 「源文件目录」 (Source file directory) relies on the original absolute paths; after moving machines the paths break and import reports missing dependencies. Tip : reference files land in a different place from ordinary caches, going into the project's references/ and cache/ areas respectively.

items.title: Import namespace
synonyms: imported node names have a prefix
why does the model name carry the asset name
items.summary: Import namespace decides which namespace freshly imported nodes land in . It is the isolation layer that stops an import from clashing with nodes already in the
items.text: Import namespace decides which namespace freshly imported nodes land in . It is the isolation layer that stops an import from clashing with nodes already in the scene. Where it lives, and the default Location: Settings → General → Import namespace (the checkbox "Create a namespace automatically on direct import (named after the asset)"); Default: ticked ( import_namespace is true in config.json ; a missing key is treated as on). When it is on (default) The namespace name comes from the asset name : characters other than letters / digits / CJK / underscore become _ , and leading or trailing underscores are trimmed; If the name starts with a digit it is prefixed with ns_ (Maya does not allow namespaces starting with a digit); If the scene already has that namespace, _1 , _2 … is appended; Result: the whole asset forms one group of nodes you can select, hide or delete by namespace, and it never fights with same-named objects already in the scene. When it is off New nodes go straight into the root namespace : ; Nodes that clash with existing ones are renamed by Maya ( pCube1 , pCube2 …), so you can no longer tell which nodes came from this import. Scope It only affects later imports: save, and the next import follows the new rule; nodes already imported are not moved into or out of a namespace; It applies to direct imports (geometry / scenes / animation / caches and proxies); the right-click Add reference has its own namespace rule (asset name plus _1 / _2 ) and is not controlled by this switch; It changes node placement only — not the asset package, texture paths or dependency paths; Stored as import_namespace in config.json . Notes Tip : To get rid of that prefix, untick the option and click Apply / OK ; no plug-in restart is needed. Warning : With it off, clashing nodes are silently renamed by Maya, so finding "what this import brought in" by name becomes much harder; keep it on when importing a batch of assets.

items.title: AI dependency check and install
items.summary: Run the dependency check to see what is missing, then fill the gaps with the one-click install; that is the shortest path to working AI search and analysis. Pre
items.text: Run the dependency check to see what is missing, then fill the gaps with the one-click install; that is the shortest path to working AI search and analysis. Prerequisites The plug-in main window is usable; the install needs a network. Installing Ollama is allowed on this machine; the one-click install uses the system package manager. Steps Open Settings → AI 设置 (AI settings) and find 「AI 功能与依赖」 (AI features and dependencies) at the top. Click 「AI 依赖检查」 (AI dependency check) . After a few seconds a text report is generated and opened in Notepad, and the status line shows how many items are missing. Click 「一键安装 AI 功能与依赖」 (One-click install of AI features and dependencies) . The confirmation lists the steps and expected downloads; keep 「同时安装图像检索」 (Also install image retrieval) when image search is wanted and fill in the vision chat model name. Check 「强制重装（覆盖已装部分）」 (Force reinstall, overwriting installed parts) to overwrite existing parts; otherwise finished steps are skipped automatically. Watch the live log in the progress window; closing the window cancels, and parts already installed are kept. After a failure, clicking again fills only the failed or missing steps. When it finishes, run 「AI 依赖检查」 (AI dependency check) once more to confirm. What gets installed Step Notes Install Ollama The local AI service, about 1 GB Start the Ollama service Used for embeddings and model calls Pull the embedding model embeddinggemma-2:740m , about 1.3 GB Documentation vector index About 23 MB, rebuilt only when the model changes Asset library semantic index The current library, optional Image retrieval sidecar Installed with image retrieval, numpy + Pillow, about 30 MB Vision chat model Pulled by the given name with image retrieval, about 5.6 GB Verify the result A second check shows fewer missing items or everything ready, and the status line no longer reports missing dependencies. Natural-language search, search by image and AI analysis work. Tips Tip : the report is %TEMP%\squirrel_asset_manager\AI依赖检查报告.txt and the install log is ai_install.log in the same directory. Tip : the Ollama service must stay running for installation and use; stopping it makes AI features unavailable. Tip : an interrupted install does not break finished parts; click one-click install again to continue.

items.title: Global model
items.summary: The global model is the provider and model configuration used by default by every feature that needs a large model. Effect Configure the provider, API key, API
items.text: The global model is the provider and model configuration used by default by every feature that needs a large model. Effect Configure the provider, API key, API endpoint and model name in one place for reuse by AI thumbnail analysis and similar features. Values and defaults Provider: Ollama (local, default), LM Studio (local), DeepSeek, Qwen (Alibaba Cloud DashScope), Zhipu (BigModel), Kimi (Moonshot), OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Custom (OpenAI compatible). API key: required for cloud providers; local services such as Ollama need none and the input is greyed out. API endpoint: empty means the provider's default; a custom provider needs a compatible endpoint. Model: the dropdown fetches the provider's live model list, and a name can also be typed; empty by default. Thinking mode: off by default. When on, the model prints its reasoning before answering, which is only recommended for hard reasoning tasks. Keys are stored per provider, so switching providers never mixes them up. Using another vendor or a self-hosted endpoint The plug-in only speaks the OpenAI-compatible protocol ( POST {endpoint}/chat/completions , with the model list from GET {endpoint}/models ). For any provider not in the dropdown that offers an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, choose Custom (OpenAI compatible) and fill in the endpoint, key and model name: Service What to put in the API endpoint Google Gemini https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/ Anthropic Claude Choose Anthropic Claude in the dropdown (endpoint https://api.anthropic.com/v1/ , the official OpenAI SDK compatibility layer) OpenRouter https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 SiliconFlow / Volcano Ark / Moonshot / Baichuan and others The "OpenAI compatible" endpoint from each console Aggregate gateways (OneAPI / NewAPI) http://<your gateway>/v1 Local LM Studio / vLLM / Xinference LM Studio can be chosen as LM Studio (local) (default http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 ); other local services use http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1 Notes: Do not repeat /chat/completions at the end of the endpoint; stop at the /v1 level; When no model list is available, type the model name directly; For a local service that wants no key, any placeholder value works (the custom provider's key input is enabled); Azure OpenAI ( api-key auth header, deployments/<deployment name> path and api-version parameter) and the native Anthropic / Gemini protocols ( /v1/messages , generateContent ) do not use the OpenAI-compatible format, so the current version does not support them directly — prefer the vendor's compatible endpoint or a gateway such as OneAPI that converts to OpenAI compatibility. Thinking mode It is off by default. Thinking (the reasoning process) and the answer share output tokens, so for tagging, classification and one-line descriptions it only makes things slower, and with a tight budget the answer itself can come back empty — which is why everything that can be off defaults to off. Only scenarios needing multi-step reasoning (complex descriptions, difficult judgments) are worth enabling 「开启思考模式」 (Enable thinking mode) . How each provider behaves: Provider What happens when it is off Ollama The OpenAI-compatible endpoint gets reasoning_effort: none (verified); the native endpoint gets think: false DeepSeek / Zhipu (regular models) Sends thinking: disabled Zhipu glm-5.2 / glm-5.3 Always thinks and cannot be turned off → drops to the lowest level when off OpenAI o series / GPT-5 Cannot really be turned off → uses reasoning_effort: low when off Kimi / Claude compatibility layer / custom / LM Studio No universal switch, keeps the server default Tip : an empty answer with thinking on usually means max_tokens was consumed by the reasoning, which is unrelated to the switch itself. Scope Features that need a large model, such as AI thumbnail analysis, read this configuration by default. AI search only calls it when 「使用全局大模型」 (Use the global model) is checked in the search configuration; otherwise it does local vector retrieval only. Seman

items.title: AI chat surface
items.summary: The AI chat surface setting decides whether the dsh chat panel docks inside Maya or opens in the system browser when 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) is clicked. Effect I
items.text: The AI chat surface setting decides whether the dsh chat panel docks inside Maya or opens in the system browser when 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) is clicked. Effect It chooses how the dsh front end is hosted. Values and default The checkbox 「在 Maya 内嵌 AI 对话面（取消则用系统浏览器打开）」 (embed the AI chat surface in Maya; uncheck to open it in the system browser) is checked by default. Checked: dsh docks into Maya as a panel on the right. Unchecked: the system default browser opens it and the plug-in creates no panel. dsh release track (stable / early access) The same group has a 「版本轨」 (Release track) dropdown that decides which dsh the next one-click install fetches: Stable track (default): installs the pinned version verified with the plug-in, so problems find a backstop; recommended. Early access track : clicking 「一键安装」 (One-click install) queries the latest version on npm and installs that exact version , pinned; it never auto-upgrades afterwards. That version is unverified , and individual tool behavior may differ. An early-access install first lands in a staging directory and replaces the current one only after verification, so a failure never damages the installed stable version . Switching the dropdown itself never changes an already installed dsh; installing the new version still needs another one-click install. If the early-access version misbehaves, switch the track back to 「稳定轨」 (Stable track) and click one-click install again to recover. Scope Both modes start the same dsh front end with identical sessions, skills and tool calls. The embedded panel takes space on the right of the Maya main window; the browser mode suits a second screen. The panel or tab title automatically carries the current scene name so it is easy to tell apart from your own dsh. Changes apply the next time 「AI 助手」 (AI assistant) is clicked; no restart is needed. When to change it To chat while watching the viewport: keep it embedded. Two-screen work, or when the panel should not compress the Maya layout: uncheck and use the browser. Verify the result Click AI 工具 (AI tools) → AI 助手 (AI assistant) in the main window and the chat surface appears in the chosen mode. Tips Tip : this only decides where the chat surface opens and never installs dsh; when it is missing follow "Install guide when dsh is missing". Tip : the Settings window is the only place to switch this; the 「AI 工具」 (AI tools) menu does not offer it.

items.title: External connection (bridge port)
items.summary: When on, Maya listens on a local loopback port at startup so the standalone edition, a command line or the AI backend can connect to the current Maya. Effect It
items.text: When on, Maya listens on a local loopback port at startup so the standalone edition, a command line or the AI backend can connect to the current Maya. Effect It gives external tools a channel to read scene information and import or export assets, and is also the fallback connection when the backend is unavailable. Values and default The checkbox 「允许外部工具连接 Maya（独立版 / 命令行）」 (allow external tools to connect to Maya, standalone / command line) is off by default, so it must be checked for Maya to listen at startup. Scope When on, Maya listens on a loopback port at startup, assigned by version: 2026 → 7001, 2025 → 7002 and so on. A second instance of the same version uses the backup range 7110–7129. The port only binds 127.0.0.1 and is never opened to the LAN. Clicking 「应用」 (Apply) tries to open or close it immediately without restarting Maya; on failure it reports that the port could not listen, still saves the setting and retries at the next start. When to change it Turn it off when security requirements are high and no external tool needs to connect. When a firewall or security software blocks the port, confirm an exception first, or disable this item temporarily to isolate the cause. Verify the result External tools connect to the current Maya and the connection page shows the matching version and port. After disabling and restarting Maya, external tools can no longer connect. Tips Warning : this channel is equivalent to an arbitrary-code-execution entry; even though it binds loopback only, do not leave it on long term in untrusted environments. Tip : with several sessions of the same version the port steps aside automatically; no manual port changes are needed. Tip : the port-to-instance mapping is described in "Connection method and ports".

items.title: External AI tools
synonyms: connect the plug-in to external AI
items.summary: Connecting the plug-in's skills and MCP channel to external AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Trae requires both skill landing and MCP to be done. Prerequi
items.text: Connecting the plug-in's skills and MCP channel to external AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Trae requires both skill landing and MCP to be done. Prerequisites The target AI tool is installed; with a custom directory, its skill root is known. Steps Open Settings → AI 设置 (AI settings) → 外部 AI 工具 (External AI tools) and click 「外部 AI 工具…」 (External AI tools…) . Each row in the panel is one tool; read the two statuses first: whether the skills are in place and whether the MCP channel is mounted. When a tool is unrecognized or installed elsewhere, click 「选择路径…」 (Choose path…) to set the skill directory. Click 「安装技能」 (Install skills) to copy the squirrel-* skills into the other tool's directory; 「移除技能」 (Remove skills) undoes it. For tools supporting MCP check 「MCP 通道」 (MCP channel) to write into the other tool's configuration; for unsupported tools or unconfirmed paths click 「复制配置片段」 (Copy the configuration snippet) and paste it by hand. Click 「重新探测」 (Detect again) to refresh the status; the settings status line shows how many directories are selected and how many MCP clients are mounted. Verify the result The panel shows 「技能已就位（n 个）」 (skills in place, n) and 「MCP 通道：已挂上」 (MCP channel: mounted) . The other tool lists skills such as squirrel-assets and the squirrel_* tools. Tips Tip : with skills installed but MCP unmounted, the model knows an asset library exists yet cannot call the tools. Warning : operations in the panel write into the other tool's directory immediately and are unrelated to the Settings window's Cancel; the original configuration is backed up before writing. Tip : tools marked "to be verified" have paths not yet verified on this machine, so installing them may not take effect; the dsh desktop app needs a restart to read the new configuration. Tip : for tools whose MCP format is not covered, use 「手工配置说明」 (Manual configuration instructions) to get the full paths and snippet.

items.title: AI / MCP channel (off by default)
synonyms: how to turn off AI permissions
items.summary: In one line: this group decides whether external processes may drive this software — every item is a permission switch, all off by default, enable the minimum y
items.text: In one line: this group decides whether external processes may drive this software — every item is a permission switch, all off by default, enable the minimum you need. Why it is its own group, all off They are not ordinary preferences but permissions : once on, an external AI or MCP client can read and write your asset library and even make Maya execute code. All off by default so a fresh install never leaves an unattended execution entry. What each of the five unlocks Switch Default What happens when on Recommendation Connect to the AI backend when the asset manager opens Off Opens the broker automatically with the main window and registers this machine as an instance, so the web client and external AI can drive this software Turn on only when external AI must drive it; otherwise leave it off and connect manually via AI tools → AI assistant Register this machine with the AI backend when Maya starts Off Registers even without opening the asset manager window, so external AI clients can drive this machine at any time Independent of the previous item; more "resident", and the permission lasts longer Query the official Maya help online when local docs are missing Off When the local Maya documentation knowledge base misses, allows an online lookup against Autodesk's official help as a supplement Only for looking up new commands; keep it off on offline or intranet machines Allow AI to execute arbitrary Python / MEL in Maya (high risk) Off maya_run_python / maya_run_mel become available: executed on call, no approval, no rollback , with the permissions of the current system user Enable temporarily only on trusted machines for controlled tasks; turn it off afterwards Allow AI to delete or overwrite assets (destructive) Off AI can delete through the asset interface (soft delete into the recycle bin, restorable) or overwrite on export (old version kept in history) Leave it off unless AI must do destructive work; manual operations in the interface are unaffected The environment variable SQUIRREL_ENABLE_MAYA_EXEC=1 can force the universal channel on; the risk is higher, so it is not recommended. First enabling a high-risk item: the risk confirmation Going from off to on (the first time) opens 「AI 助手授权与风险确认」 (AI assistant authorization and risk confirmation) listing every risk; it only enables after you check the confirmation: The dialog states: No approval : every command runs directly, with no confirmation dialog; Arbitrary Python : permissions equal the current system user, with read, write and delete access to any file on this machine; Protections bypassed : the recycle bin's soft delete and library path restrictions are no technical barrier to arbitrary code; System / Maya permissions : nodes, materials, animation and project settings can be changed, equivalent to you operating the scene by hand; Damage risk : mistaken edits or deletions may be irreversible (soft deletes restore from the recycle bin and overwritten exports keep history, but hard deletes cannot be restored); Cloud : with a cloud service enabled, thumbnails and prompts leave this machine and require separate consent (see 11.4.7 ). The confirmation record is kept locally for later review; leaving the box unchecked keeps the universal execution channel off. Recommendations Enable only the one or two items the current task truly needs; Keep everything off on managed or production machines; Turn high-risk items off promptly after use, so the next start exposes no execution entry. Related AI dependency check and install → 11.4.1 External connection (bridge port) → 11.4.4 Cloud service consent → 11.4.7 Item-by-item description of the AI settings page → 15.9.3 The AI assistant chat surface switch → 8.3.2

items.title: Cloud service consent
items.summary: In one line: with a cloud provider selected, data may only be sent after you consent separately once — the record is stored locally, can be withdrawn at any tim
items.text: In one line: with a cloud provider selected, data may only be sent after you consent separately once — the record is stored locally, can be withdrawn at any time, and withdrawal stops sending immediately. Why it is needed Local services (Ollama / LM Studio) never send data off the machine, so they need no consent; a cloud service sends asset thumbnails, prompts or query text, and metadata such as asset names and categories to the provider, which is why this uses "separate consent plus withdrawal" instead of hiding inside a master switch. Interface Settings window → AI settings page → the 「云端服务同意（单独同意 · 可撤回）」 (Cloud service consent: separate, withdrawable) group: Element Notes Status text 「未同意（不会发送数据）」 (not consented, no data is sent) or 「已同意（时间）」 (consented at …) Review and agree Opens the consent dialog; without consent, cloud calls are blocked with a prompt to consent first Withdraw Shown only when consented; withdrawing returns the state to not consented and immediately stops sending data to that provider Consent is recorded per provider : consenting for provider A does not mean B is consented. What the consent dialog lists It states every fact and requires checking the box at the bottom before 「同意并启用」 (Agree and enable) becomes available: Recipient: the provider name and API endpoint; Data categories: thumbnails, prompts or query text, and metadata such as asset names and categories; Purpose: generating thumbnail descriptions and tags, and intent analysis for semantic retrieval; Retention: decided by that provider's privacy policy; this software stores none of this data locally; Cross-border risk: the server may be abroad and subject to local law; cloud services are not recommended for sensitive assets; Privacy policy: available on the provider's website (this software does not reproduce it). After withdrawing The state returns to 「未同意（不会发送数据）」 (not consented, no data is sent) and the next cloud call is blocked again; Data already sent cannot be recalled (that is governed by the provider's privacy policy); To use it again, simply go through consent once more. Recommendations Prefer local services (Ollama / LM Studio) for sensitive or managed assets; Consent only when you clearly understand that data leaves the machine and accept that risk; After a project ends or when moving machines, remember to withdraw or confirm the state. Related Global model (provider / model / thinking mode) → 11.4.2 AI / MCP channel (high-risk permission switches) → 11.4.6 Item-by-item description of the AI settings page → 15.9.3 License and machine code → 11.10.1

items.title: Material formats
items.summary: Material formats preset which material-related options are checked by default when exporting each asset type. Effect When a new export dialog or asset creation
items.text: Material formats preset which material-related options are checked by default when exporting each asset type. Effect When a new export dialog or asset creation starts, material formats are pre-checked for the current asset type, reducing repeated setup. Values and defaults Choose the asset type in the list on the left, shown as a sub-library ID; there are 11 built-in entries: materials , models , lights , textures , scenes , hdr , ani , images , audio , animation , nodetree (custom sub-libraries also appear). The three options and their default asset types: Option Asset types where it is checked by default Material node (.zmetal) materials , lights Merge materials (.zmetal_merge) materials Material → model mapping (.mcm) None Scope It only decides the initial state of checkboxes in the export interface; a single export can still change them. It never changes existing assets, the context menu or quick tools. It is stored under the matching asset type key in Assets/preset/export_preset.json . When to change it The material library always delivers .zmetal : keep the defaults. Every material node must be its own file without merging: uncheck 「合并材质」 (Merge materials) . A mapping file between materials and models is needed: check .mcm . Tips Tip : the list on the left holds asset types, not categories; all categories under one type share the same defaults. Tip : changes are written to the preset file only after clicking 「应用」 (Apply) and apply the next time the export dialog opens.

items.title: Geometry formats
items.summary: Geometry formats preset which geometry file formats are checked by default when exporting each asset type. Effect When a new export dialog or asset creation sta
items.text: Geometry formats preset which geometry file formats are checked by default when exporting each asset type. Effect When a new export dialog or asset creation starts, geometry formats such as Maya, FBX, OBJ and USD are pre-checked for the current asset type. Values and defaults Choose the asset type in the list on the left, shown as a sub-library ID. The five options and their default asset types: Option Asset types where it is checked by default Maya ASCII (.ma) materials , models , lights , scenes , ani Maya Binary (.mb) None FBX (.fbx) None OBJ (.obj) None USD (.usd) None Scope It only decides the initial state of checkboxes in the export interface; a single export can still change them. It never changes existing assets, the context menu or quick tools. It is stored under the matching asset type key in Assets/preset/export_preset.json . When to change it Models must be delivered to an engine or another DCC: check .fbx or .usd for models . Only Maya itself uses them: keep .ma , or switch to .mb for smaller files. Material or light assets should not carry geometry by default: uncheck .ma for those types. Tips Tip : .ma excludes the default initial SE nodes so the default shader never enters the asset. Tip : the list on the left holds asset types, not categories; all categories under one type share the same defaults.

items.title: Caches and proxies
items.summary: Caches and proxies preset which cache and render-proxy formats are checked by default when exporting each asset type. Effect When a new export dialog or asset c
items.text: Caches and proxies preset which cache and render-proxy formats are checked by default when exporting each asset type. Effect When a new export dialog or asset creation starts, Alembic, Arnold, V-Ray, Redshift and V-Ray proxy formats are pre-checked for the current asset type. Values and defaults Choose the asset type in the list on the left, shown as a sub-library ID. The five options and their default asset types: Option Asset types where it is checked by default Alembic (.abc) ani Arnold (.ass) None V-Ray (.vrscene) None Redshift (.rs) None V-Ray proxy (.vrmesh) None Scope It only decides the initial state of checkboxes in the export interface; a single export can still change them. Proxy formats only make sense when the matching renderer (Arnold / V-Ray / Redshift) is available. It never changes existing assets, the context menu or quick tools. It is stored under the matching asset type key in Assets/preset/export_preset.json . When to change it Animation or FX assets need caches: keep .abc for ani . Delivery to a render farm needs lightweight proxies: check the proxy formats matching the farm's renderer. Only local Maya use: keep everything unchecked to shrink assets. Tips Tip : cache and proxy files are usually large, so confirm free disk space before exporting. Tip : the list on the left holds asset types, not categories; all categories under one type share the same defaults.

items.title: Collecting linked files
items.summary: Collecting linked files presets, per asset type, whether caches, proxies, references and textures are packaged by default on export. Effect When a new export di
items.text: Collecting linked files presets, per asset type, whether caches, proxies, references and textures are packaged by default on export. Effect When a new export dialog or asset creation starts, collect caches / proxies / references attached in the scene and textures are pre-checked. Values and defaults Two checkboxes: 「收集场景中已挂载的缓存/代理/引用文件」 (collect caches / proxies / references attached in the scene) , mapped to collect_associated . 「贴图 textures/」 (textures) , mapped to textures . Defaults per asset type: Asset type Collect linked files Textures materials Checked Checked models Checked Checked lights Unchecked Checked textures Unchecked Checked scenes Checked Checked hdr Unchecked Checked ani Checked Checked Scope It only decides the initial state of checkboxes in the export interface; a single export can still change them. Linked files are copied into the asset's deps/ only when 「收集关联文件」 (Collect linked files) is checked; when unchecked the scan still runs and records missing dependencies, it just does not copy. 「贴图 textures/」 (textures) controls whether textures enter the asset's textures/ . It is stored under the matching asset type key in Assets/preset/export_preset.json . When to change it The asset must be delivered to another machine: turn collection on for that type so textures and caches are not missing. The library is local only and smaller assets are wanted: turn collection off and check it per export when needed. Only materials matter and scene references do not: keep texture collection for materials and turn linked files off. Tips Tip : even without collection, missing dependencies appear in the export log and meta.json , so you can diagnose before deciding to package. Tip : files already placed in textures/ as textures are never stored a second time under deps/ .

items.title: Export materials only
items.summary: Export materials only presets, per asset type, whether geometry and proxies are skipped so only materials are packaged. Effect When a new export dialog or asset
items.text: Export materials only presets, per asset type, whether geometry and proxies are skipped so only materials are packaged. Effect When a new export dialog or asset creation starts, 「仅导出材质（跳过几何体/代理）」 (export materials only, skipping geometry / proxies) is pre-checked. Values and defaults The checkbox 「仅导出材质（跳过几何体/代理）」 (export materials only, skipping geometry / proxies) , mapped to material_only . Default: checked for materials ; unchecked for models , lights , textures , scenes , hdr and ani . Scope When checked, the geometry and proxy export stages are skipped and only material nodes are exported. .ma / .mb can still write material nodes in this mode without exporting the associated DAG objects. The animation frame mode uses the current frame and the thumbnail captures the current viewport. It never changes existing assets; it is stored under the matching asset type key in Assets/preset/export_preset.json . When to change it Material library assets only need materials and textures: keep the materials default checked. Model, scene or animation assets need full geometry: confirm the matching type is unchecked. Only delivering materials for one occasion: check it in that export dialog rather than changing the default. Tips Warning : with 「仅导出材质」 (Export materials only) checked and no material nodes selected, an empty shell asset is exported; confirm that materials or material-carrying objects are selected first. Tip : whether textures are packaged in this mode is still decided by 「收集关联文件」 (Collect linked files) .

items.title: Menu item switches
synonyms: where is the context menu switch
items.summary: Every context menu item can be switched per sub-library; it only appears in the asset card's context menu when checked. Effect The right side of Settings → 右键菜单
items.text: Every context menu item can be switched per sub-library; it only appears in the asset card's context menu when checked. Effect The right side of Settings → 右键菜单 (Context menu) is a set of checkboxes, each mapping to one menu item. Checked means shown, unchecked means hidden. The sub-library list on the left decides which configuration is being edited. Values and defaults Values: checked / unchecked, written as true / false . Defaults come from Assets/preset/context_menu_preset.json : each sub-library checks only the items it actually has, while unrelated items are false . Unregistered sub-libraries or custom categories read the default section of the same file. By scope the items fall into two kinds (the table follows the actual checkboxes on the settings page, 27 in total): Kind Menu items Shared by all categories Import, import geometry, add reference, favorites, select all, copy, open folder, move to, copy to, edit, create asset, update thumbnail, update asset, delete, preview nodes, AI thumbnail analysis, asset details Category specific Background render (models / scenes / dynamics / materials / textures / lights / node trees), format conversion (models / node trees / scenes / dynamics / audio only), assign material to the current selection (materials / textures), apply material parameters (materials), create material (textures only), convert import (materials / lights), import texture (textures only), assign texture to material (textures / HDR only), apply light parameters to the selected light (lights only), create environment light (HDR only) Notes: The generic 「导入」 (Import) of the 「贴图」 (Textures) sub-library is greyed out with a hint to use 「导入贴图」 (Import texture) instead. 「后台渲染」 (Background render) is the headless offscreen thumbnail generation (the old "generate thumbnail"); it sits at the bottom of the 「更新缩略图」 (Update thumbnail) submenu and is on by default only for models / scenes / dynamics / materials / textures / lights / node trees. The first group of import items for images, audio and animation data is generated statically and is not controlled by this page: images have import as file node / create imagePlane / assign to selected material slot, audio has import to timeline / Time Editor / Trax Editor / camera sequencer, and animation data has automatic mapping import / import animation / import to selected attributes. What this page can switch for them are the generic items above (favorites, select all, copy, open folder, move / copy to, edit, delete, AI analysis, asset details and so on). In the factory preset images, audio and animation data have the generic 「导入」 (Import) turned off (their dedicated imports replace it), while node trees use the same set as models. Scope It only affects the asset card's context menu and never double-click behavior (see "Choosing a command per sub-library"). Changes require unlocking first and then 「应用」 (Apply) or 「确定」 (OK) to write the JSON; the next context menu is built with the new configuration. When to change it When the menu is too long, dangerous items are often clicked by mistake (delete, format conversion), or a sub-library never uses a feature. Related settings The lower half of the same tab holds double-click commands, and both share the sub-library list on the left.

items.title: Configuring per sub-library
items.summary: The context menu configuration is not one global set but one per sub-library, independent of each other. Effect The list on the left shows every entry of sub_li
items.text: The context menu configuration is not one global set but one per sub-library, independent of each other. Effect The list on the left shows every entry of sub_libraries in config.json , including the 11 built-in sub-libraries (materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, HDR, dynamics, images, audio, animation data, node trees) and custom sub-libraries. Selecting one shows that sub-library's current checks on the right. Values and defaults Each menu item is true / false for that sub-library. Factory presets are stored per sub-library in context_menu_preset.json . For example models have 「格式转换」 (Format conversion) on by default, and HDR has 「创建环境光」 (Create environment light) and 「指定贴图到材质」 (Assign texture to material) on. Custom sub-libraries and categories not registered in the preset read the default section: shared items are true and category-specific items are false . When switching sub-libraries the checks of the current page are held in memory, and only 「应用」 (Apply) writes them all. Scope The context menu uses the section matching the asset's sub-library (the category type ), so the same asset can show different menus under different sub-libraries. Category-specific items are greyed out in sub-libraries where they do not apply, with notes such as 「（仅 材质/贴图）」 (materials / textures only) appended; their checked value is kept and becomes usable again in the right sub-library. Custom sub-libraries can only use shared items; category-specific items are always greyed out for them. When to change it When different asset types should have different menus, for example showing 「格式转换」 (Format conversion) in the model library and hiding it in the material library, or keeping only import and open folder for a custom sub-library. Tips An unregistered category never ends up with "no menu": it inherits the default section, so the context menu is never missing items.

items.title: Unlocking and restoring
items.summary: Configuration pages such as 「右键菜单」 (Context menu) are read-only by default; check 「解锁全部配置」 (Unlock all configuration) before changing them. Effect The lock prev
items.text: Configuration pages such as 「右键菜单」 (Context menu) are read-only by default; check 「解锁全部配置」 (Unlock all configuration) before changing them. Effect The lock prevents accidental changes. While locked, checkboxes, inputs and buttons are not editable, though current values stay visible. Values and defaults The 「解锁全部配置」 (Unlock all configuration) checkbox at the bottom of the Settings window is unchecked by default, meaning locked. Checking it opens a 「配置修改警告」 (Configuration change warning) ; confirming unlocks it, and choosing 「否」 (No) unchecks it automatically. Unlocking affects the export defaults, context menu, supported formats, texture suffixes, sub-libraries and categories and other configuration pages; General, AI settings and About (which holds the license) are never locked, and 「显示在主 UI」 (Show in the main UI) under sub-libraries and categories is directly editable. Steps Open Settings → 右键菜单 (Context menu) , check 「解锁全部配置」 (Unlock all configuration) at the bottom and choose 「是」 (Yes) in the warning. Change the menu item checks. Click 「应用」 (Apply) or 「确定」 (OK) . While unlocked, applying opens one more 「配置变更确认」 (Configuration change confirmation) before writing. Restoring Click 「恢复默认设置」 (Restore default settings) at the bottom left; after confirming, values in the dialog return to factory state and only 「应用」 (Apply) writes them. For the context menu this step rereads Assets/preset/context_menu_preset.json and does not rewrite that file to factory content; if the file was edited before, the edited values are read again. To really restore the factory menu, overwrite that JSON with a backup or change each item back to its default. Verify the result Being able to change checkboxes proves it is unlocked; closing and reopening Settings still shows the bottom box unchecked (locked), matching the unlocked state having lapsed. Tips Do not unlock when a setting's meaning is unclear; a wrong configuration can leave the context menu missing items or make library features misbehave.

items.title: Choosing a command per sub-library
items.summary: Which command runs when an asset thumbnail is double-clicked is configured per sub-library, and only one can be chosen. Effect The lower half of Settings → 右键菜单
items.text: Which command runs when an asset thumbnail is double-clicked is configured per sub-library, and only one can be chosen. Effect The lower half of Settings → 右键菜单 (Context menu) is the double-click command area, sharing the sub-library list on the left. Selecting a sub-library lists its available commands on the right, and one can be chosen. Values and defaults Sub-library Available commands Factory setting materials None / Import / Assign material to current selection Import, sub-option zmetal models None / Import Import, sub-option ma nodetree None / Import Import, sub-option ma lights None / Import / Apply light parameters to selected light Import, sub-option zlight textures None / Import / Import texture / Create material / Assign material to current selection / Assign texture to material Create material, sub-option openPBRSurface scenes / ani None / Import Import, sub-option ma hdr None / Import / Create environment light / Assign texture Create environment light, sub-option aiSkyDomeLight.ma images None / Import (generic fallback) Import: create a file node (the same action as the context menu's import as texture) audio None / Import (generic fallback) Import: import to the Maya timeline (current frame = first audio frame) animation None / Import (generic fallback) Import: hierarchy mapping plus the channel selection dialog Custom sub-libraries None / Import Inherits default : import, format chosen automatically Images, audio and animation data have no separately registered commands, so they only offer None / Import; what Import really does is decided by the sub-library (see the table above). Factory values live in the cmd and option fields of Assets/preset/double_click_preset.json . Scope It only affects double-clicking a thumbnail, never "Import" in the context menu. When the command has a secondary action a 「子选项:」 (Sub-option:) dropdown appears below; without one it is hidden. With 「无操作」 (None) chosen a double-click does nothing at all. When to change it When double-clicking a texture should build a material directly, double-clicking an HDR should create a dome light, or double-clicking should never import by accident. Steps Open Settings and check 「解锁全部配置」 (Unlock all configuration) . Select a sub-library on the left of the 「右键菜单」 (Context menu) page. Choose a command in the double-click command area below and pick a sub-option when needed. Click 「应用」 (Apply) or 「确定」 (OK) . Verify the result Back in the asset grid, double-click an asset of that type and confirm the new command runs; reopening Settings shows the configuration still there. Tips This area is also locked by 「解锁全部配置」 (Unlock all configuration) and is read-only until unlocked.

items.title: Import format sub-options
items.summary: When the chosen double-click command has a secondary action, the 「子选项」 (Sub-option) dropdown decides which format or type is used. Effect The dropdown appears o
items.text: When the chosen double-click command has a secondary action, the 「子选项」 (Sub-option) dropdown decides which format or type is used. Effect The dropdown appears only when the command has optional sub-items, labelled 「子选项:」 (Sub-option:) . It refines the command: for example Import needs to know which format and Create material which material node type. Values and defaults Command Sub-options Notes Import Automatic (the asset's default format), ma , mb , fbx , obj , usd , abc , ass , vrscene , rs , vrmesh , zmetal , zlight , proxy , vdb Automatic or empty prefers the preset format and otherwise takes the asset's first available format Import texture All Fixed: imports every texture inside the asset, with no other option Create material Automatic (follow the renderer) plus the node types in material_presets from config.json Third-party renderer materials carry a short suffix such as aiStandardSurface（AI） or VRayMtl（VR） Create environment light Scans Assets/HDR_ligt/*.ma dynamically The list follows the files in that directory Create material and create environment light are not hard-coded: the former reads material_presets from config.json and the latter scans the plug-in's built-in HDR light directory. Scope Sub-options only affect double-clicking; Import in the context menu still follows each command's own format selection. Choosing 「自动」 (Automatic) is equivalent to leaving option empty: the format actually in the asset decides, and the first available is used when nothing matches. When to change it When the asset package holds several formats and a fixed one should always be used on double-click, for example always fbx for models. Verify the result After applying, double-click an asset of that type and the format actually imported should match the dropdown. Tips Older data may store only the command string without a sub-option; the interface then offers the current command's default items again.

items.title: Default fallback behavior
items.summary: A sub-library without its own double-click configuration does not break: it follows the default section of double_click_preset.json . Effect Double-click preset
items.text: A sub-library without its own double-click configuration does not break: it follows the default section of double_click_preset.json . Effect Double-click presets are stored per sub-library. Lookup order: the sub-library's own section, then default , and when default is missing too it counts as 「无操作」 (None) . Values and defaults The factory default section is {"cmd": "import", "option": ""} , that is "import with an automatic format". Unregistered custom sub-libraries, and custom top-level categories without a type field, all use this section. Sub-libraries that are explicitly registered (even when the choice is 「无操作」 (None) ) follow their own configuration and never fall back. Scope A custom sub-library imports on double-click by default instead of doing nothing. With option empty the import format is the asset's first available format; when the asset has no importable format that double-click does nothing. When the saved command is not in the sub-library's available list (for example leftover configuration after a rename), the interface falls back to 「无操作」 (None) . When to change it To give a custom sub-library a specific double-click action, select it in Settings and configure it directly; the result is written into its own section and overrides default . Verify the result Create a new custom sub-library and apply settings; double-clicking an asset inside should run "import". If nothing happens, first check whether that sub-library was explicitly set to 「无操作」 (None) . Tips default is a fallback, not a place to configure one specific sub-library; to change specific behavior, select that sub-library on the left and edit it there.

items.title: Supported formats
items.summary: Supported formats define which file extensions the library treats as importable asset files: one per line, each with a leading dot. What it does The list is wri
items.text: Supported formats define which file extensions the library treats as importable asset files: one per line, each with a leading dot. What it does The list is written to asset_file_extensions in Assets/preset/config.json . The library reads that field and uses it in two places: The file filter of the Import from file dialog, which then lists only these extensions. When a whole folder is collected into the library, it decides whether a root-level file counts as an asset file and takes part in grouping. Values and defaults One extension per line, for example .ma or .png . The factory list contains: .zasset , _zasset , .ma , .mb , .fbx , .obj , .abc , .usd , .usda , .usdc , .glb , .gltf , .dae , .ass , .rs , .proxy , .vrmesh , .vdb , .png , .jpg , .jpeg , .exr , .hdr , .tga , .tiff , .tif , .bmp , .psd , .sicon , .aicon , .mcm , .wav , .mp3 , .aiff , .aif , .flac , .ogg , .m4a , .aac , .atom (40 entries). Scope of effect It affects which file types Import from file can see, and how root-level files are recognized when a folder is collected. It does not affect the geometry and image extensions in Other configuration ; those only classify files when a whole folder is collected. When a single file is collected, the sub-library type is still inferred from the built-in extension table; changing this list does not change that result. Steps Open Settings → Supported formats . Tick Unlock all settings . Add or remove extensions line by line; one per line, and do not drop the leading dot. Click Apply or OK . Verify the result Reopen Import from file : the file filter should include the new extension. Existing assets are not affected. Tips A wrong configuration breaks asset import. Back up config.json first if you are unsure.

items.title: Texture type aliases
items.summary: An alias is a keyword in the file name used to decide which PBR channel a texture belongs to. What it does Settings → Texture suffixes lists the texture types o
items.text: An alias is a keyword in the file name used to decide which PBR channel a texture belongs to. What it does Settings → Texture suffixes lists the texture types on the left and the alias list for the selected type on the right, one per line. The data comes from texture_type_rules in Assets/preset/pbr_mapping.json ; the aliases array of each entry is exactly this list. Values and defaults The types are defined by the JSON. Currently they include baseColor , normal , roughness , metallic , ao , arm , orm , emissive , height , opacity , clearcoat , clearcoatRoughness , specular , subsurface , anisotropy , ior . Each type can have several alias lines. An alias is a keyword without the extension. For example normal contains nrm , n and normal , so crate_n.png is recognized as a normal map. Type matching priority comes from priority in the JSON; the UI only edits aliases. Scope of effect It affects texture channel detection in PBR-to-asset conversion and in material creation. It only matches file name keywords: it does not rewrite files, and it does not change texture paths in assets that already exist. When to change it When your naming convention differs from the default aliases, for example when roughness is written _r and metallic is written _m . Steps Open Settings → Texture suffixes and unlock if necessary. Select a type on the left, then edit alias lines on the right. Click Apply or OK to write back to pbr_mapping.json . Verify the result Run PBR-to-asset conversion with a texture named after the new alias; the texture should land in the matching channel. Tips The Restore defaults button on this page re-reads pbr_mapping.json from disk so you can discard unapplied edits. It does not generate a factory copy.

items.title: Geometry, image and material node extensions
path: Geometry, image and material node extensions
items.summary: These three advanced fallbacks on the Other configuration page control how files are classified when a whole folder is collected, and which nodes count as mater
items.text: These three advanced fallbacks on the Other configuration page control how files are classified when a whole folder is collected, and which nodes count as material nodes during export. What it does Settings → Other configuration has three entries on the left, each taking one value per line on the right: Setting JSON key Effect Geometry extensions geometry_extensions When a whole folder is collected, root-level files matching these are treated as geometry and split into node.{ext} Image / texture extensions image_extensions Files matching these under the same path go into textures/ Material node types material_node_types Used by asset export, right-click Update asset and batch export to decide which scene nodes are material nodes Values and defaults Geometry: .ma .mb .fbx .obj .abc .usd .usda .usdc .glb .gltf .dae .ass .proxy .vrmesh .vdb Images: .png .jpg .jpeg .exr .hdr .tga .tiff .tif .bmp .psd Material nodes: aiStandardSurface , standardSurface , lambert , blinn , phong , openPBRSurface , pxrSurface , aiHair , aiSkin , aiVolume , VRayMtl , RedshiftMaterial Scope of effect The first two only apply to collecting a whole folder into the library. Single-file collection and texture scanning use the built-in extension table; changing these does not affect them. Material node types are the single source of truth for the three export paths. A missing node type means that material is not recognized during export. Steps Open Settings → Other configuration and tick unlock. Pick a category on the left, then edit line by line on the right. Click Apply or OK to write back to config.json . Verify the result Check geometry and image classification with a whole-folder collection; check material detection by exporting a scene that contains the target material. Tips These three settings take part directly in library reads and writes; a wrong value breaks import and export. Back up config.json before changing them.

items.title: Show in main UI
items.summary: Show in main UI controls whether a sub-library or top-level category appears in the main window sidebar. Everything is shown by default. What it does The checkb
items.text: Show in main UI controls whether a sub-library or top-level category appears in the main window sidebar. Everything is shown by default. What it does The checkbox sits at the top right of Settings → Sub-libraries and categories . After selecting a sub-library on the left, ticking it means the entry appears in the main window category tree; clearing it hides that entry. Values and defaults Values: ticked = shown, cleared = hidden. Default: all ticked. The settings file stores hidden entries as a blocklist hidden_top_categories , so top-level categories added to the library later appear automatically. The state is written to ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/app_settings.json , not to config.json . Scope of effect It only affects sidebar entries in the main window, including the category tree and the collapsed icon strip. All assets is always shown and is not affected; a hidden category can still be browsed and searched through All assets . The category tree of project libraries is not affected. The checkbox is not covered by Unlock all settings ; it can be changed even while locked. Steps Open Settings → Sub-libraries and categories . Select the sub-library or top-level category on the left. Tick or clear Show in main UI . Click Apply or OK . Verify the result Return to the main window: the sidebar should show or hide that entry according to the new setting. When to change it When there are many sub-libraries and the sidebar is too long, or when a sub-library is not needed by the current project. Do not use it to "delete" a category; no data on disk is deleted.

items.title: Sub-library ID and display name
items.summary: The sub-library ID is the unique identifier; the display name only affects text in the UI. Both are edited on the right side of the Sub-libraries and categories
items.text: The sub-library ID is the unique identifier; the display name only affects text in the UI. Both are edited on the right side of the Sub-libraries and categories page. What it does The left list shows Display name (ID) . The ID also maps to the sub-library folder name inside the asset library, and is referenced by per-sub-library configuration sections such as the right-click menu, double-click presets and export presets. The display name is only for presentation. Values and defaults There are 11 built-in sub-libraries, with IDs and display names: materials Materials, models Models, lights Lights, textures Textures, scenes Scenes, hdr HDR, ani Animation, images Images, audio Audio, animation Animation data, nodetree Node tree. materials , models , lights , textures , scenes , hdr and ani are protected from deletion. images , audio , animation and nodetree are built-in IDs but can currently be deleted (see Add and delete sub-libraries for the risks). Custom sub-library IDs look like custom_1 , custom_2 , with display names like Custom1 . An ID must not duplicate an existing sub-library; otherwise the UI reports "Sub-library ID 'xxx' already exists". Steps Open Settings → Sub-libraries and categories and select a sub-library on the left. Edit Sub-library ID: or Display name: . Click Apply or OK . Scope of effect Changing the display name is safe; it only changes UI text. Changing the ID only changes the key in the configuration file. It does not rename the sub-library folder on disk, so existing assets may no longer find their sub-library. IDs of core sub-libraries are referenced by sections in other presets; after a change those old sections may stop applying. Verify the result After applying, the left list should show the new Display name (ID) and keep it after reopening settings. When to change it Normally only change the display name. If you really must change an ID, back up the asset library and config.json first, then check the sections with the same name in the right-click menu and double-click presets.

items.title: Default categories
synonyms: default categories when creating a library
items.summary: Default categories are the sub-category folders created automatically when a sub-library is initialized, written as id name . What it does It is the multi-line
items.text: Default categories are the sub-category folders created automatically when a sub-library is initialized, written as id name . What it does It is the multi-line text box in the middle right of Settings → Sub-libraries and categories . Each line is one category: the first part is the folder name (id), the second part is the display name, separated by a space, for example AAAcustom 自定义 . Values and defaults The factory value lives in default_sub_categories in config.json : Materials, models, lights, scenes, HDR, animation, images, audio, animation data, node tree: AAAcustom 自定义 Textures: AAAcustom 自定义贴图 Scope of effect It is used to create folders only on first run , or when the sub-library root has no sub-category folder at all. Existing category folders are neither deleted nor recreated. Each sub-library root also gets AAAcustom (custom) added automatically, so there is always a category that can hold assets. Steps Open Settings → Sub-libraries and categories and select a sub-library. Edit the lines under Default category list (one per line, format: id name) . Click Apply or OK . Verify the result Open a new library that has not been initialized yet: the category folders listed here should appear under the sub-library with the matching display names. When to change it When you are preparing to create several new libraries from the same configuration and want each of them to start with fixed categories. For libraries that already exist, add and remove categories through category management instead of editing this list. Tips The id becomes a folder name on disk, so avoid special characters. Changing an id does not rename an existing folder.

items.title: Sync categories
items.summary: Read current category folders uses the real folder structure of the asset library to overwrite the sub-library and default category lists in settings. Prerequis
items.text: Read current category folders uses the real folder structure of the asset library to overwrite the sub-library and default category lists in settings. Prerequisites An asset library is loaded. Otherwise the UI reports "Please load an asset library first"; when the asset manager is unavailable it reports "Cannot get the asset manager". Steps Open Settings → Sub-libraries and categories . Click Read current category folders . Confirm in Sync confirmation . The prompt explains that the default category list will be overwritten, but no folder on disk is deleted or modified; only the configuration is updated. When syncing finishes, the UI reports "Categories synced from the current asset library". Click Apply or OK to write the result back to config.json . Result The left sub-library list is rebuilt from the top-level categories of the current library, including custom top-level categories. All sub-categories under each top-level category (recursively) are collected into that sub-library's default category list, using the readable category name as the display name. Syncing only changes settings data; it does not touch disk folders. Verify the result The left list shows the top-level categories of the current library, and the default category list on the right matches the disk structure. Tips Syncing rebuilds the whole list, so custom sub-library entries that do not exist in the current library disappear from the list and from the configuration after applying. If you cancel before clicking Apply , no change is saved. This action is also subject to Unlock all settings .

items.title: Add and delete sub-libraries
items.summary: The sub-library list supports right-click Add sub-library and Delete sub-library . The 11 built-in default sub-libraries cannot be deleted ; you can only hide t
items.text: The sub-library list supports right-click Add sub-library and Delete sub-library . The 11 built-in default sub-libraries cannot be deleted ; you can only hide them by clearing Show in main UI . Only sub-libraries you created yourself can be deleted. Prerequisites Settings → Sub-libraries and categories is open and Unlock all settings is ticked. Steps Add a sub-library Right-click an empty area of the left sub-library list and choose Add sub-library . A new sub-library is generated automatically: ID custom_N (N is the first unused value starting from 1) and display name CustomN . Adjust the display name, ID and default categories as needed. Click Apply or OK . Delete a sub-library Right-click the sub-library to delete and choose Delete sub-library (this item does not exist in the context menu of built-in sub-libraries). Confirm in the dialog "Delete sub-library 'name'?". Deletion is written to config.json immediately and also removes that sub-library's default category configuration. Scope of effect None of the 11 built-in sub-libraries materials , models , lights , textures , scenes , hdr , ani , images , audio , animation , nodetree can be deleted . Trying reports "Built-in default sub-libraries (materials, models, lights, textures, scenes, HDR, animation, images, audio, animation data, node tree) cannot be deleted; hide them with Show in main UI". To keep a built-in sub-library out of the sidebar, clear Show in main UI . Assets and disk folders stay. Deleting only changes configuration; it does not delete folders or assets on disk. If the default category folders of a built-in sub-library are removed by hand outside the system, reloading, switching or refreshing the library rebuilds the folders, metadata and the default custom sub-category. A newly added custom sub-library does not get folders in an existing library right away. If you need the folder structure, fill in the default categories first, then reload or switch the library once. Verify the result The entry appears in or disappears from the left list, and the state persists after reopening settings. Tips Before deleting, make sure no assets under that sub-library still rely on its configuration. Custom sub-libraries can only use the generic context-menu items and the Import / Do nothing double-click commands. To give a custom sub-library the same folder layout as the others, set its default categories first, then reload or switch the library once; folders are created from the default categories.

items.title: License status
items.summary: The Current license card on Settings → License activation shows the license state and tells you whether import, export and conversion are available. What it doe
items.text: The Current license card on Settings → License activation shows the license state and tells you whether import, export and conversion are available. What it does The status text is read live by the licensing module and is read-only here. It answers two questions: is the license valid, and which licensing stage are you in. Values and meanings Text Meaning Licensed / Licensed: customer name A valid license; all features are available Trial (N days left) A server-issued trial license is valid Subscription expired (in grace period) The subscription expired but you are still in the grace period License expired (read-only) The license expired; browsing only Not activated (read-only) No valid license; browsing only Status badge and actions Control / button Effect When it appears Status badge Shows Licensed / Trial / Grace period / Expired / Not activated Always Sync license Syncs the license with the server now (no need to wait for the daily heartbeat) Shown when a license record exists; works for offline licenses too (read-only registration and heartbeat, never revokes or downgrades) Activation key field + Activate Sits directly under the machine code; enter a key and click Activate Always Primary button State-driven: Not activated → License management; Trial → Purchase license; Licensed → License management; Expired → Renew license Always; exactly one primary action per state Secondary button Purchase license / License management (always visible; greyed out with a reason when not applicable) State-driven Account & my licenses Sign in / Sign up, Manage devices, Sign out When accounts are enabled License details & advanced Offline license import (file / clipboard), deactivate this machine, restore this machine Always, collapsed by default License management opens the license window. Offline import and deactivate / restore also live in License details & advanced on this page — both paths use the same capabilities. Scope of effect The license is stored locally and bound to this computer. While expired or not activated you can still browse the library; import, export and conversion require a valid license. The License activation tab is not covered by Unlock all settings ; the activation entry is always available. When to check it When import, export or conversion shows a licensing prompt. After changing computers, reinstalling the system, or renewing the license. The status does not refresh continuously; it is re-read when you reopen settings or complete an activation. Verify the result After activating, return to this page: the status should become Licensed or Trial . Tips The read-only wording only limits write operations; browsing and searching assets still work.

items.title: Machine code
items.summary: The machine code identifies this computer for licensing. Provide it to the licensor when requesting an offline license. What it does The read-only Machine code
items.text: The machine code identifies this computer for licensing. Provide it to the licensor when requesting an offline license. What it does The read-only Machine code box in the Current license card of Settings → License activation shows the value, and the Copy button on its right puts the whole string on the clipboard. It shows - when the licensing module is unavailable. Values and defaults There are no selectable values; the licensing module generates the machine code from the current computer. An empty value or - means the machine code cannot be read, which usually indicates a missing or failed licensing module. Scope of effect A local license is bound to this computer; moving to another machine requires a new request or activation. The machine code itself is not a license and cannot replace an activation code or license file. The copy button only writes to the clipboard; it changes no configuration. When to use it Offline activation: send the machine code to the licensor to obtain a license file that matches this machine. Licensing troubleshooting: give the machine code to support so they can check which license belongs here. Steps Open Settings → License activation and look at the Current license card. Click Copy next to the machine code. Paste it into an email, form or chat message to the licensor. Verify the result After clicking Copy , paste into a text editor; the content should match the box. Tips The machine code may change after a hardware change or system reinstall. Whether an old machine's license file works on a new machine depends on the license type and the remaining switch count, so confirm the target machine's code before migrating.

items.title: Activation management
items.summary: Day-to-day activation happens on Settings → License activation : the activation key field sits directly under the machine code , and clicking the green Activate
items.text: Day-to-day activation happens on Settings → License activation : the activation key field sits directly under the machine code , and clicking the green Activate button verifies it online. If you have not started a trial yet, leave the key empty and click Activate to start the free trial . Offline import, deactivate and restore remain in the License management window. Prerequisites Open Settings → License activation ; that tab is not locked, so it works without unlocking. Online activation requires a configured activation server. Without one, Activate and the activation key field are unavailable. Steps Online activation Open Settings → License activation . Enter a SQAM-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX key in the Activation key field under the machine code and click Activate . On success the status badge and status line refresh immediately, and the key field is cleared. Free trial Before any trial has been started, leave the key empty and click the green Activate button to start the trial (the server issues it per machine; no sign-in needed ). The page's primary button reads License management while unlicensed and opens the license window; the green Activate there also starts the trial with an empty key. The trial includes all features; once a full license is active, the trial entry is no longer offered so it cannot overwrite a real license. Offline license Offline import has two entries: Settings → License activation → License details & advanced , or the License management window. The steps below use the settings page: Click the License details & advanced title to expand the card. From a file: click Import license file… and choose a .lic , .dat or .json file; you can also drag the file into the window. From the clipboard: copy the full license text first, then click Import from clipboard . It reads and activates directly and never shows the license content in the UI . Offline import only accepts offline licenses issued manually by support (marked with the offline channel). A license file issued by online activation cannot be used for offline activation; to move or reinstall, click Activate on the License activation page. Deactivate / restore To move to another machine or re-activate, click Deactivate this machine under License details & advanced (or the same button in the License management window) and confirm. After server confirmation the seat is released; it is limited only by the server's daily release cap (3 per 24 hours), with no machine-switch counter. Restore this machine re-enables a license you deactivated earlier while its local copy is still present; the button is greyed out when there is nothing to restore. Offline-issued licenses do not support unbinding to another machine, so the button is disabled. Contact the licensor for a new license when you need to move. Sync license Sync license at the top right of the Current license card syncs with the server immediately (no need to wait for the daily heartbeat after a renewal or machine change). It also works for offline licenses: it only performs a read-only registration and heartbeat, and never revokes, deletes or downgrades the local license. Scope of effect Activation writes to local license storage; it does not modify the asset library or plug-in configuration. Online and offline licensing are separate paths: a file from online activation cannot be used for offline activation (it reports E_LIC_ONLINE_FILE ); offline import only accepts offline license files issued manually by support. After deactivating this machine you must activate again to use restricted features. When online activation fails, the error is shown and nothing falls back to offline automatically; import a license file manually. Verify the result The badge on License activation becomes Licensed or Trial , and the status line updates; the settings page refreshes after the license window closes. Tips A failed activation shows [error code] explanation ; check the code, the license file and the network as suggested.

items.title: Backup and migration
items.summary: Plug-in configuration lives in two places: presets inside the package and the user directory. Backing up means copying these JSON files; migrating means putting
items.text: Plug-in configuration lives in two places: presets inside the package and the user directory. Backing up means copying these JSON files; migrating means putting them back in the right place. Prerequisites Close Maya first, or at least close the settings window, so you do not copy a half-written file. Configuration files File Location Content config.json <plugin package>/Assets/preset/ Sub-libraries, default categories, supported formats, extensions, material node types, import strategy and more context_menu_preset.json Same Checked state of the context menu per sub-library double_click_preset.json Same Double-click commands and sub-options export_preset.json Same Default export format pbr_mapping.json Same Texture type aliases and PBR mapping app_settings.json ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/ Personal settings: font size, theme, language, library list, hidden categories, AI configuration and keys Steps Close Maya. Copy the six files above into a backup folder. On the new machine, put them back at the same relative locations: preset files into the plug-in package's Assets/preset/ , and app_settings.json into the current user's ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/ . Start Maya and the plug-in, then check each settings page. Verify the result Each settings page shows the same values as before the backup, and the asset library list opens normally. Tips Preset files live inside the EXE installation directory, and an overwrite install replaces them with the presets from the new package (your edits under Assets/preset/ are lost), so back them up before upgrading. ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/app_settings.json is outside the install directory and is not affected by an overwrite install. Library paths in app_settings.json are absolute; after moving to another machine you may need to reselect them in settings. These files contain sensitive data such as AI API keys, so keep backups and transfers private. The asset library itself is not in these files; see Backup and restore for how to back it up.

items.title: Reset
items.summary: Restore defaults sets every item in the settings window back to its factory value; nothing is written to disk until you confirm and then click Apply or OK . Pre
items.text: Restore defaults sets every item in the settings window back to its factory value; nothing is written to disk until you confirm and then click Apply or OK . Prerequisites The settings window is open. The reset button sits at the bottom left and is not restricted by Unlock all settings . Steps Click Restore defaults . In the confirmation dialog "Restore all settings to their default values? (config.json will be reset)", choose Yes . Review the reverted values page by page. Click Apply or OK to save; click Cancel to abandon this reset. What gets reset General: font size back to 13, UI scale back to automatic, default view back to icons, name conflicts back to Auto rename (the same value as the factory preset's name_conflict_policy.mode ). Export defaults: export_preset.json is re-read. Texture suffixes: pbr_mapping.json is re-read. Other configuration: geometry extensions, image extensions and material node types return to the built-in default lists. Context menu: context_menu_preset.json is re-read. Scope of effect It does not delete asset library files, does not reset licensing, and does not delete preset JSON files. For preset files, restoring defaults means re-reading the disk content, not reverting the file to factory values; if the file was edited earlier, you still read the edited values. Before you click Apply or OK , the reset only affects the current dialog. Verify the result After applying, reopen settings: each page should show default values. Tips Before resetting, copy config.json and the preset files as described in Backup and migration , so manual tweaks are not lost.

items.title: Multi-machine sync
items.summary: The current version has no one-click multi-machine sync. To keep several computers consistent, share the asset library and maintain local configuration and lice
