items.text: The current version has no one-click multi-machine sync. To keep several computers consistent, share the asset library and maintain local configuration and licensing on each machine. What it does This page helps you decide what can be shared and what must be handled per machine, so you do not treat the configuration directory as a sync drive. What can be shared and what must stay separate Item Shared with the library Notes Asset files and category folders Yes Put the asset library on a network or sync drive and point each machine at the same path in settings Plug-in presets Assets/preset/*.json Manual copy They live in the plug-in install directory and do not sync automatically; overwrite them with backup files app_settings.json No It lives in ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/ on each machine and holds the library list, UI preferences and AI keys License No Licensing is bound to the machine, so each computer must be activated separately Semantic index Shared by default (separated per backend) By default it lives inside the library in `.squirrel_ai_index\<official\ ollama> : vectors from the two backends are not interchangeable, each uses its own subfolder and they do not overwrite each other. Concurrent writes from multiple machines on the same backend are still not coordinated, so you can point ai_asset_index_dir` to a per-machine local folder Library lock No The lock only applies inside one plug-in process; multiple machines writing the same library at once are not coordinated Steps On each machine, add the same shared asset library path in settings and make it the default. Activate the license separately on every machine. When the context menu, double-click commands and export defaults must match, copy the corresponding preset JSON from one machine to the others. Set a local ai_asset_index_dir on each machine so the indexes do not overwrite each other. Agree that only one machine writes to the library at a time, or coordinate concurrency manually. Verify the result Every machine opens the same asset library and sees the same categories and assets, and each shows a licensed state. Tips Do not copy app_settings.json straight onto another machine: its absolute library paths and AI keys are machine-specific. Several machines writing the library simultaneously can conflict; see Library lock and concurrency . There is currently no formal configuration sync feature: the settings window has no such switch, so multi-machine consistency depends on copying preset files by hand.

items.title: Parameters and return structure
synonyms: what does the return value mean
items.summary: Every command is called and returns through the same structure: the caller provides command_id , params and dry_run , and the broker replies with status , resul
items.text: Every command is called and returns through the same structure: the caller provides command_id , params and dry_run , and the broker replies with status , result and error . Request parameters Field Required Description command_id Yes Command id; follow the params_schema in the command reference and manifest params No Command parameter object; keys must come from that command's params_schema dry_run No Preview only, change nothing; default false instance_id Depends on entry Target instance; can be omitted when the chat runs inside Maya session_id No Audit owner, written to audit.jsonl request_id No Handle for progress and cancellation; the broker pre-generates it for async jobs allow_cross_instance No By default only the currently bound instance is touched The unified executor signature is executor(dry_run=False, **params) . Only commands declaring progress_supported / cancel_supported get the progress / cancel objects injected; commands that do not declare them raise TypeError if they receive them. Command return Commands return a dict with status set to ok , preview or error . preview is the dry_run preview, not a failure; the other fields are defined per command, for example changes , moved , created_ids , warning , missing . The outer envelope is wrapped uniformly by /execute or squirrel_execute_command : {"status": "ok", "result": {"status": "ok"}, "error": null} An inner status="error" is promoted to an outer error, so only an outer ok means real success. A single response is capped at 262144 bytes; when exceeded it returns truncated: true , original_bytes and content_prefix , in which case use a more precise query (add limit , specify fields, or batch). Tip : Never guess parameter names. The same field name can mean different things in different commands; the manifest's params_schema is the only authority.

items.title: Risk levels
items.summary: A risk level only describes a command's blast radius; there is no approval gate. All three levels execute directly, and the caller should decide from the level
items.text: A risk level only describes a command's blast radius; there is no approval gate. All three levels execute directly, and the caller should decide from the level whether to run dry_run first. Of the current 146 commands, 42 are readonly , 67 are low and 37 are high (counted from generated/commands.json ). The three levels Level Meaning Typical commands dry_run undo_last readonly Read-only; changes neither the library nor the scene search_assets , get_asset_info , scene_info , list_category Not supported Not needed low Reversible write with a clear scope move , rotate , rename , set_visibility , set_attr , assign_material Supported Supported high Destructive, bulk, or runs arbitrary code delete , batch_delete , batch_move_to , maya_run_python , maya_run_mel Supported Mostly supported, see below Usage rules Read-only commands have no preview branch; they return the current facts. Low-risk write commands return status="preview" with dry_run=true , listing the objects or fields that would change. High-risk commands should be checked with dry_run first; the broker never returns approval_required , so seeing that status means the host is running old code. The contract requires high-risk commands to offer rollback or undo: library writes use snapshots, and delete_objects uses Maya's own undo stack. maya_run_python / maya_run_mel are explicit exceptions — they try to wrap the whole call in one Maya undo chunk, but undo_last does not cover them, so back up the scene yourself before running. The universal execution channel is off by default : enable allow_maya_exec in settings to use it (the first enable goes through a separate consent dialog). The environment variable SQUIRREL_ENABLE_MAYA_EXEC=1 forces it on. Warning : risk_level does not block a command. It is only a judgement aid for the caller and the user; destructive operations still require confirming the target and making a backup.

items.title: dry_run and undo
items.summary: dry_run previews, and undo_last is the plug-in's only rollback entry: the first writes no state, the second restores from the snapshot taken before execution. d
items.text: dry_run previews, and undo_last is the plug-in's only rollback entry: the first writes no state, the second restores from the snapshot taken before execution. dry_run Of the current 146 commands, 106 declare dry_run_supported=true . With dry_run=true : The library, scene and configuration are unchanged, and no rollback snapshot is written; the audit record is marked dry_run . The command returns status="preview" whose content varies: move returns from / to for each node, batch_move_to returns the whole destination plan, and import commands return the list of files that would be created or copied. dry_run can be a standalone parameter or a key inside params ; the executor pulls the latter out and honors it. Read-only commands do not support preview; they return current data directly. undo Thirty commands in the manifest declare undo_supported=true . Before executing, the executor calls snapshot_fn to record a snapshot, then completes it with snapshot_after_fn afterwards (for example, copy operations need the newly generated ids), and finally pushes it onto the in-memory UndoStack . Coverage Rollback method Scene transforms, parenting, grouping, visibility, attributes, material assignment, zeroing Inverse operation Scene deletion delete_objects Maya's own undo stack (snapshot marked maya_undo ) Library move, copy, rename, edit, delete, import Restore the original category from the snapshot, or delete newly created folders When calling undo_last , steps=N rolls back the most recent N entries consecutively; dry_run=true only reports which entries would be rolled back. If one entry fails to roll back, its snapshot is returned to the top of the stack for a retry. Warning : The UndoStack lives only in memory and is cleared when the plug-in reloads or Maya restarts. maya_run_python / maya_run_mel do not enter undo_last ; back up the scene separately before using them.

items.title: Async, progress and cancellation
items.summary: Execution mode is declared by the command: the 9 commands with execution="async" should go through the job entry, since a synchronous wait hits the 30-second ca
items.text: Execution mode is declared by the command: the 9 commands with execution="async" should go through the job entry, since a synchronous wait hits the 30-second cap. Async jobs Command Default timeout ai_deps_install 10800 seconds render_frames , index_sync 1800 seconds capture_sequence 900 seconds encode_sequence , maya_run_python , maya_run_mel 600 seconds capture_viewport 300 seconds ai_analysis 180 seconds Submission returns a job_id immediately; query it with GET /jobs/<job_id> . The state machine is queued → running → done / error / timeout / cancelled / interrupted . By default there are 4 worker threads, a queue limit of 32 and a per-command default timeout of 60 seconds; finished jobs are kept for 1 hour, up to 200 entries. When the queue is full you get QUEUE_FULL ; check /jobs before submitting again. Progress Commands that support progress receive a callable progress(percent, message, **extra) . percent is clamped to 0–100, message is cut to 200 characters, and extra keeps at most 8 scalar fields. Progress frames are emitted at most every 0.4 seconds, but the final frame on completion is always delivered; progress_age_secs tells you how old a progress report is. Cancellation Seven commands currently declare cancel_supported=true . Cancellation is cooperative: Stage Effect queued Truly cancelled; the command was never dispatched to the host running and the command checks for cancellation Stops at the next checkpoint, the job is marked cancelled and returns partial results running but the command never checks It cannot stop; it runs to completion and is marked cancel_ignored Long loops you write yourself should call cancelled() or cancel.raise_if_cancelled() . Warning : A synchronous timeout does not mean failure. The command may still be running on the Maya main thread and its result goes to the late-results mailbox ( GET /late_results ); check the mailbox before rerunning. Job history lives in <dsh_home>/ai_jobs.jsonl ; jobs left over after a broker restart are marked interrupted and are not replayed automatically.

items.title: config.json
items.summary: Assets/preset/config.json is the plug-in's shared structural configuration. It decides sub-libraries, default categories, format detection, tags and colors, and
items.text: Assets/preset/config.json is the plug-in's shared structural configuration. It decides sub-libraries, default categories, format detection, tags and colors, and a change affects every machine using this plug-in directory. Location and writes The file is at <plugin package>/Assets/preset/config.json and the current schema version is "1.0" . The General (asset library management group), Supported formats , Texture suffixes and Sub-libraries and categories pages of the settings window write their results back here. Personal preferences (font size, theme, library paths, AI keys) are not here but in ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/app_settings.json . Main fields Field Current content Effect sub_libraries 11 built-in sub-libraries: materials / models / lights / textures / scenes / hdr / ani / images / audio / animation / nodetree (display names: Materials / Models / Lights / Textures / Scenes / HDR / Animation / Images / Audio / Animation data / Node tree) Left navigation, asset classification and the sub-library parameter of commands default_sub_categories The default custom category of each sub-library (one group for each of the 11) Fallback category when a library is created or a category is missing asset_file_extensions 39 extensions: .zasset , geometry, images, audio (wav/mp3/aiff/aif/flac/ogg/m4a/aac), animation data ( .atom ), .mcm and more Which files are recognized as assets geometry_extensions 15 geometry and proxy extensions Geometry import/export and format routing image_extensions 10 image extensions Image formats usable for textures and previews texture_suffixes 49 texture suffixes such as _basecolor , _normal PBR texture type detection material_node_types 12 material node types such as openPBRSurface , VRayMtl Material detection and conversion common_tags Common tags grouped per sub-library (currently one group for each of 7 early sub-libraries) Suggestions when editing and batch tagging node_type_colors / category_colors Node and category colors Main window coloring material_switch_delay_ms 1000 Reserved material switch delay; not referenced by current code thumbnail_placeholder_enabled true Reserved placeholder thumbnail switch; not referenced by current code name_conflict_policy Object: {"remember_choice": true, "mode": "auto_rename", "manual_name": ""} Strategy on name conflicts ( prompt / auto_rename / manual ), plus whether to remember the last choice texture_import_policy asset_directory Import textures into the asset directory, the source directory or the project directory dependency_import_policy asset_directory Same as above for associated files material_presets 7 material presets, each like {"name": "openPBRSurface", "node_type": "openPBRSurface"} Node type options when creating a material Editing notes Manual edits must stay valid JSON; back up first, then reopen the main window or reload the plug-in afterwards. Adding a sub-library is not just one line: you also need the matching asset folders and a category sync in the settings window. Unknown keys are ignored without an error; a misspelled key silently does nothing. Warning : This is shared configuration, not personal settings. When several machines share one plug-in directory, a change affects every other user too.

items.title: Context menu, double-click and export presets
path: Context menu, double-click and export presets
synonyms: where to configure the context menu
items.summary: Three preset files control the context menu, double-clicking a thumbnail and the default export options for asset creation. All are written by the settings wind
items.text: Three preset files control the context menu, double-clicking a thumbnail and the default export options for asset creation. All are written by the settings window and sectioned per sub-library ( asset_type ). File Purpose Settings entry Assets/preset/context_menu_preset.json Which context menu items each sub-library shows Settings → Context menu Assets/preset/double_click_preset.json Which command runs when a thumbnail is double-clicked Settings → Context menu (the Double-click commands group in the lower half of that page) Assets/preset/export_preset.json Default export options when creating assets Settings → Export defaults Settings has no separate Double-click commands tab; double-click commands live in the lower half of the Context menu page. Context menu preset The default section is the fallback used by custom sub-libraries or categories that are not registered; each of the 11 built-in sub-libraries has its own section. Every key is a boolean and defaults to false . Common items are on by default: import , import_geometry , add_reference , favorites , select_all , duplicate , open_folder , move_to , copy_to , edit , create_asset , update_thumbnail , update_asset , delete , preview_node , ai_analysis , generate_thumbnail (background render) and asset_details . Specialized items are off by default and turned on per sub-library: materials enable apply_material , apply_material_params , convert_import ; textures enable apply_material , create_material , import_texture , assign_texture ; lights enable apply_light , convert_import ; HDR enables create_dome_light , assign_texture ; models / scenes / animation / node tree enable convert_format . Images / audio / animation data only have the common items (favorite, duplicate, open folder, move to, edit, delete, AI analysis, asset details and so on); audio additionally enables convert_format (convert to a WAV copy) and animation data additionally enables update_thumbnail . Their own import items are not in this preset table; the UI provides them directly per sub-library. The file only lists items that sub-library actually has; items that do not exist are not shown. Double-click preset default is {"cmd": "import", "option": ""} , meaning import the first available format. Current built-in values: Sub-library Command Sub-option materials import zmetal models / scenes / nodetree / ani import ma lights import zlight textures create_material openPBRSurface hdr create_dome_light aiSkyDomeLight.ma audio / animation import "" (no sub-option; the importer picks by content) images Not registered → uses default Import the first available format Export preset _default provides the fallback and other keys override it per asset_type . The fields fall into four groups: Format switches: zmetal , zmetal_merge , mcm , mcm_min_count , ma , mb , fbx , obj , usd , abc , arnold , vray , redshift , vrmesh . Content switches: material_only , collect_associated , textures . Animation frame capture: ani_frame_mode takes current / timeline / keyframe . Thumbnail: delay_ms (default 2000) and thumb_source ( screenshot / playblast / render ). Current defaults: collecting associated files and textures are both on, thumbnail source is screenshot ; the materials sub-library has material_only=true ; the animation sub-library has ani_frame_mode=timeline . All 11 built-in sub-libraries have sections, and the newer ones differ noticeably: Section Difference from _default images All geometry formats off ( ma is false too), material_only=true , collect_associated=false , texture packing for images only audio / animation All geometry formats off, material_only / collect_associated / textures all false (these two have no geometry or textures to export) nodetree Essentially the same as _default ( ma on) ani abc=true , ani_frame_mode=timeline Tip : After a manual edit, reopen the main window or reload the plug-in; changes made in the settings window are written back to these files immediately.

items.title: Material and PBR mapping
items.summary: pbr_mapping.json handles "texture file name → PBR channel", while material_mapper_presets/*.mmap handles "source material attribute → target material attribute"
items.text: pbr_mapping.json handles "texture file name → PBR channel", while material_mapper_presets/*.mmap handles "source material attribute → target material attribute". Both live inside the plug-in package and take effect the next time the tool is opened. PBR mapping The file is at Assets/preset/pbr_mapping.json , schema version "1.0" , and the default material type is openPBRSurface . Field Description resolution_subdirs / resolution_patterns Recognize resolution folders and file name suffixes such as 2k , 4k , 8k texture_type_rules The current 16 texture type rules: baseColor, normal, roughness, metallic, ao, arm, orm, emissive, height, opacity, clearcoat, clearcoatRoughness, specular, subsurface, anisotropy, ior material_property_mappings Attribute connection tables for 9 materials, including node_attribute , connection_type , requires_conversion , conversion_node Each texture_type_rules entry can contain: aliases (file name keywords), priority (detection priority), color_space ( sRGB / Raw ), is_color , invert_if (for example inverting roughness when glossiness is found), is_combo with channels (for example arm/orm mapping R/G/B to ao/roughness/metallic), and is_numeric . Material mapping .mmap Assets/material_mapper_presets/ currently holds 58 .mmap files named {source type}_{target type}.mmap . The content is JSON, with these core fields: Field Meaning version / name / software File version, display name, target software source_type / target_type Source material and target material node type mappings Attribute mappings, one per entry source_attribute Source attribute; an empty string means "no source", used to reset the target attribute to its default target_attribute Target attribute; an empty string skips that entry transform Conversion function id, empty when not needed default_value Fallback value when the source attribute is missing parameters Conversion function parameters, such as min_val / max_val for clamp Execution processes entries in order: if the target attribute does not exist, it is recorded as a failure and skipped; color sub-channels (such as diffuseColorR ) are skipped unconditionally because colors must be written to the parent attribute; when the source attribute has a texture connection, the connection is copied; when the source value is missing, default_value is used, and if that is also empty the target attribute is reset to its current default. Common conversion functions include roughness_to_shininess , shininess_to_roughness , specular_to_specular_weight , transparency_to_transmission , translucence_to_subsurface , emission_to_emission_luminance and clamp . Forward and reverse conversion share the same .mmap ; the reverse function is applied automatically when converting backwards. Tip : For more rules and verified attribute pairings, see Assets/material_mapper_presets/材质映射指南.md .

items.title: External tools and skill bundles
items.summary: Assets/preset/external_agents.json is the ledger of which external tools have had skills landed into them; the actual skill sources live in dsh_plugins/skills/
items.text: Assets/preset/external_agents.json is the ledger of which external tools have had skills landed into them; the actual skill sources live in dsh_plugins/skills/ , currently 13 skill bundles. Landing ledger The ledger schema version is 1 , with one key per tool: Field Meaning root The skill root directory of that tool (absolute path after expanding the local user directory) landed Names of skills already landed problems Issues found while landing (missing name: , directory name mismatch, and so on) The tools currently recorded are codex , custom , workbuddy , doubao , qoderworkcn , trae-cn , agents-shared , dsh-desktop , qoderwork and claude-code . The paths are local values; they are re-detected on another machine, so do not copy them around as generic configuration. Skill bundles dsh_plugins/skills/ currently holds 13: Category Skills Assets and conversion squirrel-assets , squirrel-asset-conversion Maya operations squirrel-maya-help , squirrel-maya-modeling , squirrel-maya-headless , squirrel-maya-plugins , squirrel-bifrost Plug-in and scripts squirrel-plugin-internals , squirrel-script-assets Docs and writing squirrel-docs-site-to-llm-wiki , writing-for-agents Meta skills skill-creator , mcp-builder Skills are only manuals: they tell an external model which commands and disciplines exist. The actual executable channel is the MCP entry ( mcp/squirrel_mcp_server.py ), and both are needed. Install and update In Settings → AI settings → External AI tools , tick per tool to install, update or remove. Landing is a plain copy and writes SQUIRREL_PROVENANCE.txt into the target directory to record the source; the ledger is maintained by the plug-in. MCP configuration comes in three kinds: writable directly (writer), requiring the user to paste manually (manual-needed), and no MCP support for that tool (not-supported). Warning : Do not hand-edit the ledger and do not edit the landed skill copies directly — the next update overwrites them wholesale. To change content, edit the sources under dsh_plugins/skills/ and land them again.

items.title: Directory structure
synonyms: what does the asset library look like
items.summary: The plug-in package is self-contained: placing the single squirrel_asset_manager/ directory is enough to run it. The asset library, user settings, caches and lo
items.text: The plug-in package is self-contained: placing the single squirrel_asset_manager/ directory is enough to run it. The asset library, user settings, caches and logs live outside the package. Plug-in package Directory Content core/ Data layer: manager, .zasset read/write, export orchestration, materials and categories ui/ Main window, thumbnail grid, preview, settings and the various dialogs integration/ Maya import/export executors, format routing, texture and dependency handling utils/ Settings, JSON, screenshots, bridging and exception handling quicktools/ Standalone tools: PBR/model/HDR to asset, image format conversion, batch processing and more ai/ Maya-side command implementations (query / generate / convert / organize / scene and so on) ai_base/ Host-independent base: command registry, broker, jobs, progress, cancellation, indexing embedded/ Standalone mounting and resident warm-up mcp/ MCP server entry dsh_plugins/ Skill bundles under skills/ and dsh-side tool patches dsh_home/ Runtime dsh directory: sessions, skills, audit and job records knowledge/ Maya documentation knowledge base and releases Assets/ preset/ presets, prompt/ prompts, help/v2/ help, icons, material mappings, IBL and sample meshes bin/ Bundled ffmpeg.exe / ffprobe.exe (animated images and sequence encoding) tools/ Index, help build, license and self-check scripts After installation it lives in Documents/maya/squirrel_asset_manager/ ; the README recommends the version-independent maya\ folder so one copy serves all Maya versions. Asset library <library root>/ ├── materials/ models/ lights/ textures/ scenes/ hdr/ ani/ ├── .squirrel_index_cache.json └── .squirrel_ai_index/ # semantic search index (split per backend: official/ ollama/; can be moved to another local root) Each .zasset is a folder asset package, typically containing meta.json , node.zmetal , thumb.sicon , thumb.aicon , thumb.mp4 , node.mcm , geometry/proxy files and textures/ . Locations outside the package Path Content ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/ app_settings.json , bridge port/self-heal logs, broker boot log, Maya help cache <package>/dsh_home/ dsh runtime directory; can be moved with SQUIRREL_DSH_HOME or DSH_HOME %TEMP%\squirrel_asset_manager\ AI dependency check reports and install logs {project}/cache/alembic/squirrel_asset/ Imported abc cache {project}/cache/squirrel_asset/ Imported proxy cache Help sources live in Assets/help/v2/pages/ ; toc.json , pages_html/ , search/ and generated/ are build outputs and should not be edited by hand.

items.title: Glossary
items.summary: This page standardizes the terms that recur throughout the help center; whenever another page uses them, the meaning here applies. Term Meaning Asset A single i
items.text: This page standardizes the terms that recur throughout the help center; whenever another page uses them, the meaning here applies. Term Meaning Asset A single importable, searchable unit that exists as a .zasset folder Sub-library A first-level directory under the asset library, split by type; 11 are built in: Materials, Models, Lights, Textures, Scenes, HDR, Animation, Images, Audio, Animation data, Node tree Category A tree node inside a sub-library, nestable to several levels; it has a folder name and a readable name Top-level category A first-level node of the category tree, which can be shown or hidden in the sidebar Tag A free keyword that spans categories, used for filtering and search Main asset library (category library) The fixed library organized by categories, corresponding to Category library in the sidebar Project library A library organized per project, switched by tab and independent of the main library Favorites / wishlist Favorites is a cross-category set of frequently used assets; the wishlist is the cross-session queue of favorited assets from AI search Version One iteration of the same asset (such as v1 → v2), fully self-contained (geometry, material, textures, thumbnail), and each version has its own LOD chain LOD A detail level within one version (lod0 high, lod1 medium, lod2 low) Variant Several geometry forms under one asset that share a single set of textures and materials; only geometry is stored, while materials and textures are inherited from the asset root .zasset The unified asset folder format; ZIP packages are no longer used .zmetal Serialized file of material node attributes .mcm File describing which material maps to which object .sicon / .aicon Static PNG thumbnail / animated GIF thumbnail Thumbnail The asset card image, which can come from a screenshot, playblast, render, imported image, or multiple slots Proxy file Substitute geometry as a low-poly model or cache, such as .ass , .vrmesh , .rs , .abc Associated file External files an asset depends on, such as textures, caches and references PBR mapping Rules that map texture file names to channels such as baseColor, normal and roughness Material mapping ( .mmap ) Entry-by-entry mapping and conversion rules from source material attributes to target material attributes Semantic index Encodes assets or help text as vectors to support colloquial Chinese search; falls back to lexical search when missing Broker The separate process that routes commands and hosts jobs; Maya, MCP and dsh all connect to it Instance A registered host process, shaped like maya-2026-12345 Command surface All callable commands the plug-in registers, plus their parameter schemas dry_run An execution mode that previews without changing state and returns status="preview" Job The record of a long-running async command, with a job_id and its own state machine Cooperative cancellation The command checks a checkpoint in its loop and stops by itself; without a checkpoint it cannot stop Late result A result delivered after a synchronous call timed out, kept in the /late_results mailbox

items.title: Log locations
items.summary: When something breaks, check three places first: the live traceback in the Maya Script Editor, the bridge logs under ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/ , and the broker
items.text: When something breaks, check three places first: the live traceback in the Maya Script Editor, the bridge logs under ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/ , and the broker and audit records under dsh_home . User directory ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/ (on Windows, C:\Users\<user>\.squirrel_asset_manager\ ): File Content app_settings.json Personal settings; on corruption it is renamed to .bak or .corrupt_<timestamp> bridge_port.log commandPort results; also records the fallback to 7110–7129 when the default port is taken bridge_recover.log Self-heal records from --retry-if-crashed : disconnect reason, cleanup, launch and re-dispatch port broker_boot.log Why auto-registration with the broker succeeded or failed at Maya startup broker_endpoint.json The broker's actual TCP/HTTP ports; clients reconnect based on it help_cache/ Directory tree and page cache for the maya_docs online fallback dsh runtime directory Default <plugin package>/dsh_home/ , overridable with SQUIRREL_DSH_HOME or DSH_HOME : File/directory Content broker_daemon.log Output of the standalone broker process; the reason it will not start is almost always here ai_jobs.jsonl Async job history, including status, results and final progress audit.jsonl One line per command call: command, parameters, risk level, session, instance and result summary dsh_install.log dsh runtime installation log squirrel_web_<instance>.log dsh web front-end startup output sessions/ , storages/ Sessions and storage; broken sessions are moved to quarantine/ (renamed, not deleted) skills/ Skill bundles after landing Temporary directory Path Content %TEMP%\squirrel_asset_manager\AI依赖检查报告.txt AI dependency health report %TEMP%\squirrel_asset_manager\ai_install.log Full log of the one-click AI dependency install %TEMP%\squirrel_standalone_host.log Output of the standalone mounting host %TEMP%\squirrel_jobs.jsonl Default job history of the standalone broker when no job file is specified %TEMP%\MayaCrashLog<yyyymmdd>.<hhmm>.dmp Maya crash dump In-app logs The Maya Script Editor shows plug-in tracebacks and print output. Quick tools such as batch processing and batch mirror copy show progress in their own log panel, some with save-as-text. Tip : For crash forensics, check the Windows event log's "faulting module name + fault offset", the .dmp above and the bridge logs together; if the crash is inside the renderer's own dll, prefer out-of-process rendering.

items.title: Common error messages
items.summary: The error text itself is the most accurate clue: match the original wording against this page first, then use the Action column to check logs or diagnostic comm
items.text: The error text itself is the most accurate clue: match the original wording against this page first, then use the Action column to check logs or diagnostic commands. Chinese UI messages are quoted verbatim in code , because that is exactly what you will see. Commands and jobs Error text Meaning Action 未知命令: <id> (unknown command) The command id is not in the registry, or is misspelled Check the id with squirrel_list_commands / GET /commands 命令未绑定执行器: <id> (no executor bound) The command is registered but the current host does not implement it Confirm whether the host is Maya or Blender; command sets are not interchangeable 实例 <id> 未在 N 秒内回传结果 (no result within N seconds) The synchronous call timed out; the command may still be running on the Maya main thread Check GET /late_results first; never blindly rerun destructive commands 作业队列已满（排队 n / 上限 32） (queue full) Backpressure: the queue reached its limit Check /jobs and submit again after running jobs finish 没有这个作业：<job_id> (no such job) The job id does not exist or was evicted Re-confirm with GET /jobs Result over 262144 bytes returns truncated: true The response body was truncated Add limit , specify fields, or query in batches Connection and installation Error text Meaning Action 连接 Maya commandPort 失败 (127.0.0.1:7001)：[WinError 10061] No Maya is answering on that port Run python maya_bridge.py --scan / --doctor ; confirm port and version 当前运行在 Maya 内部，无需经 socket 连接自身 (already inside Maya) The bridge client was called from inside Maya Use import maya.cmds directly; never connect to your own commandPort from Maya 底座进程未能在 Ns 内就绪 (broker not ready) The broker failed to start Read dsh_home/broker_daemon.log , then check for port conflicts 找不到底座脚本 (broker script not found) The plug-in installation is incomplete Reinstall, or check whether ai_broker_daemon.py exists 实例 <id> 没有命令 <cmd> (instance has no such command) A Maya command was sent to a Blender instance, or the instance runs old code Confirm host and instance with /instances , restart the plug-in to refresh the manifest 该 request_id 当前不在飞 (request not in flight) The cancel request found no matching command, possibly because it already ended Check the job or command result; do not cancel twice Assets and configuration Error text Meaning Action 有 N 个资产建在了盘上但没能注册进库索引 (created but not indexed) Import finished but the index was not written Rescan the library; such assets are temporarily unsearchable and cannot be rolled back with undo_last 加载设置失败 (failed to load settings) app_settings.json is corrupted The plug-in writes a .bak and falls back to defaults; fix the file before editing settings again 命令内部报错（详见 result） (internal command error) The command returned an inner status="error" Expand result.error to see the original cause Tip : See Log locations for the full path and log mapping; when you need a complete health check in one go, use Diagnostic commands .

items.title: Diagnostic commands
synonyms: how to run a health check
items.summary: The troubleshooting order is "check state first, then act": a bridge health check confirms Maya is alive, broker endpoints confirm instances and jobs, and index
items.text: The troubleshooting order is "check state first, then act": a bridge health check confirms Maya is alive, broker endpoints confirm instances and jobs, and index and AI checks confirm the search chain. Maya bridge Run from the project root or the plug-in package directory (with the system Python on Windows): Command Purpose python maya_bridge.py --ping Actually dispatches one command and returns the Maya version and current scene python maya_bridge.py --scan Scans the per-version ports and the fallback range 7110–7129, listing online instances python maya_bridge.py --doctor Report only: who is online, who is hung, what should be cleaned, whether render leftovers exist python maya_bridge.py --doctor --kill-hung Cleans only instances that "listen but do not answer"; healthy instances are untouched python maya_bridge.py --doctor --launch Launches Maya and waits until it really answers python maya_bridge.py <task.py> --retry-if-crashed On disconnect, automatically diagnose, clean, launch and re-dispatch once; for idempotent tasks only To target a version or port: --maya 2025 , --port 7002 , or the SQUIRREL_MAYA_PORT environment variable. Asset index and AI Command Purpose python tools/asset_index.py --status Show index count, dimensions, model and owning library python tools/asset_index.py --verify Consistency self-check: dimensions, row numbers, id mapping python tools/asset_index.py --doctor Environment check: Ollama, models, index and suggested commands python tools/asset_index.py --query "生锈的金属" Semantic search spot check python tools/setup_semantic_env.py --all Install and verify AI dependencies (Ollama, models, index) The in-plug-in equivalent is Settings → AI settings → AI dependency check , whose report lands in %TEMP%\squirrel_asset_manager\AI依赖检查报告.txt . Broker HTTP and commands The broker listens on 127.0.0.1:39001 (TCP) and 39002 (HTTP) by default; the actual ports are in ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/broker_endpoint.json . Endpoint / command Purpose GET /health Broker mode, in-flight commands, instance and job statistics GET /instances , GET /commands Instance list and command list (including params_schema ) GET /jobs , GET /jobs/<job_id> Job list, and a single job's status, result and progress GET /late_results Mailbox of late results from timed-out commands asset_semantic_status Asset semantic index and model status squirrel_ai_deps AI dependency check (run status first) squirrel_maya_bridge Bridge liveness from the broker's point of view (run ping first) Warning : --kill-hung only cleans instances that "listen but do not answer". Look at the Maya window first to rule out modal dialogs such as crash recovery, unsaved changes or error reports — dismissing a modal can rescue an unsaved scene.

items.title: Plug-in not loaded
items.summary: If the plug-in is not loaded, usually the install directory is not on Maya's import path, the userSetup.py startup block is missing, or a stale copy is imported
items.text: If the plug-in is not loaded, usually the install directory is not on Maya's import path, the userSetup.py startup block is missing, or a stale copy is imported first. Symptoms After Maya starts there is no Squirrel Asset Manager entry in the status line (the shelf button is only created during installation and is not recreated at startup). Running import squirrel_asset_manager in the Script Editor raises No module named 'squirrel_asset_manager' . The package imports, but opening the window reports a missing submodule, for example No module named 'squirrel_asset_manager.core' . Different Maya versions on the same machine behave differently, or an update still loads the old interface. Possible causes Cause How to tell Action Incomplete install directory No __init__.py or ui\main_window.py under %LOCALAPPDATA%\SquirrelAM\squirrel_asset_manager\ (or the directory you chose during install) Rerun the installer with Maya integration ticked Missing userSetup.py startup block The current version's Documents\maya\<version>[\<language>]\scripts\userSetup.py has no "Squirrel Asset Manager - import path" marker Rerun the installer and tick Maya integration for that version so the startup block is written Shelf button deleted The Custom shelf has no Squirrel Asset Manager button, but the status line icon works Rerun the installer (the button is only created at install time and is not recreated at startup) Package directory cached as an empty namespace package Only Assets\ remains, there is no __init__.py , yet sys.modules already contains squirrel_asset_manager Fix the directory and restart Maya; the startup block clears that cache A stale copy loads first <app>\scripts\squirrel_asset_manager or <version>\scripts\squirrel_asset_manager still exists After confirming it is an old copy of this plug-in, delete it and restart Maya Core module ABI mismatch Import reports an extension module or DLL error See 6.1.2 "Version and ABI mismatch" Install directory is not readable Directory attributes or antivirus blocking Restore read access, or reinstall into a user-readable directory Steps Confirm the install directory exists and contains __init__.py and ui\main_window.py . Open userSetup.py for the current Maya version and check for both marker lines, "Squirrel Asset Manager - import path" and "Squirrel Asset Manager END". If the markers are missing, rerun the installer with Maya integration ticked, then fully quit and restart Maya. Check for stale copy directories. Delete only copies you are certain belong to this plug-in; never delete the whole scripts directory. In the Script Editor run import squirrel_asset_manager as sq; print(sq.__file__) and confirm the loaded path points at the install directory. Open the plug-in again from the menu, the shelf or the status line. Verify the result sq.__file__ points at %LOCALAPPDATA%\SquirrelAM\squirrel_asset_manager\__init__.py (or the directory you chose during install), and the plug-in window opens with a working category tree. If it still fails Copy the full traceback from the Script Editor, keeping the first error line and the last few stack frames. Check whether the current Maya's Python version matches the installer's ABI, see 6.1.2 "Version and ABI mismatch". If only AI, bridging or licensing features are unavailable, follow 6.1.3 "Startup errors" to check the matching logs instead of reinstalling repeatedly. When reporting, include the sq.__file__ result, the install directory tree and the relevant part of userSetup.py .

items.title: Version and ABI mismatch
items.summary: Core modules are compiled per Python ABI into several coexisting .pyd files; when Maya's Python version does not match the .pyd cp tag, the import fails. Sympto
items.text: Core modules are compiled per Python ABI into several coexisting .pyd files; when Maya's Python version does not match the .pyd cp tag, the import fails. Symptoms Opening the plug-in or importing a core module raises an extension module error such as ImportError or DLL load failed while importing ... . The same installation works in some Maya versions but not in another. After an update only some features fail: the UI opens, but import, export or material operations fail. When both .py and .pyd exist in the source tree, this machine loads .py first, so the problem may only appear in the release build. Possible causes Cause How to tell Action The ABI build for this Maya is missing The core directory has no .pyd with the matching cp tag Use an installer that contains that ABI, or run from source Installer does not match the Maya version cmds.about(version=True) disagrees with the .pyd tag Confirm the mapping in the table below Compiled artifacts from another Maya got mixed in A .pyd of unknown origin appears in the directory Reinstall the complete package; never rename files by hand The .pyd -only release is missing files Only some core modules have .pyd Obtain the complete release package again Hot reload still uses the old module Source changed but behavior did not Fully restart Maya instead of refreshing the UI ABI mapping .pyd tag Maya version Python cp37 Maya 2022 3.7 cp39 Maya 2023 3.9 cp310 Maya 2024 3.10 cp311 Maya 2025 / 2026 3.11 cp313 Maya 2027 3.13 Steps In the Maya Script Editor run import maya.cmds as cmds; print(cmds.about(version=True)) and confirm the Maya year. Run import sys; print(sys.version_info) and confirm the Python major/minor version. Look in the core module directory and confirm a .pyd matching the Python version exists (for example Maya 2026 needs cp311 ). If the tag does not match, switch to a matching installer; never rename a .pyd across versions. For local debugging you may keep the .py sources, since the package entry loads .py first; a .pyd -only release must match the ABI. After replacing files, fully quit and restart Maya. Verify the result The plug-in opens, and importing core modules such as import squirrel_asset_manager.core.manager no longer raises extension module errors. If it still fails Record cmds.about(version=True) , sys.version_info and the failing module name together. Confirm no .pyd left over from an older version is overwriting the current one. If only one core module fails, check whether that module is missing from the installer instead of continuing to change the environment. If you still cannot tell, follow 6.1.3 "Startup errors" to capture the full traceback and report it.

items.title: Startup errors
items.summary: For startup errors, read the full traceback in the Maya Script Editor first; it usually points directly at a missing module, a stale copy, permissions or licens
items.text: For startup errors, read the full traceback in the Maya Script Editor first; it usually points directly at a missing module, a stale copy, permissions or licensing. Symptoms Clicking the plug-in entry opens no window, or the window flashes and closes. The Script Editor shows a red traceback containing ImportError , AttributeError , PermissionError and so on. The window opens, but the status line, category tree or AI panel fails to initialize. Startup reports sq_license 不可用，进入只读模式 (license unavailable, entering read-only mode); features are limited but the program does not crash. Possible causes Cause How to tell Action Package or submodule not found The top of the traceback is No module named ... Follow 6.1.1 "Plug-in not loaded" to check the install path and userSetup.py A stale copy or half-finished directory is loaded sq.__file__ is not in the install directory, or the directory only has Assets\ Delete the stale copy and reinstall Core module ABI mismatch Extension module load failure is reported Follow 6.1.2 "Version and ABI mismatch" Licensing module missing The log shows sq_license 不可用 The program enters read-only; confirm the package is complete, or activate on the license page Install directory is not writable The traceback points at creating directories or writing configuration or logs Restore directory permissions, or move to a user-writable location Old configuration or cache conflicts with the new version Errors cluster around settings, index or category loading Back up the configuration, reset the matching cache, then restart Maya Steps Open the Maya Script Editor, clear the output and click the plug-in entry again to reproduce once. Copy the first error line and the last few stack frames of the traceback; do not just capture the words "error". Run import squirrel_asset_manager as sq; print(sq.__file__) to confirm which copy is actually loaded. For a missing module or stale copy, reinstall as described in 6.1.1 "Plug-in not loaded"; for an ABI error, switch packages per 6.1.2 "Version and ABI mismatch". If errors appear only when AI, bridging or the status line initializes, check ~\.squirrel_asset_manager\broker_boot.log and bridge_port.log . After the fix, fully restart Maya and verify once more. Manual launch (when the startup script does not take effect) If neither the shelf nor the status line works but the install directory is complete, you can run the startup code manually in the Maya Script Editor (Python). First confirm your install directory (it is the level that contains the squirrel_asset_manager folder): Install method Default location EXE install (with Maya integration) The directory chosen in the wizard, default %LOCALAPPDATA%\SquirrelAM ; both SquirrelAssetManager.exe and squirrel_asset_manager\ are at this level How to tell: the directory contains a squirrel_asset_manager folder with __init__.py and ui\main_window.py . If the plug-in started before, you can also run import squirrel_asset_manager as sq; print(sq.__file__) and strip the trailing \squirrel_asset_manager\__init__.py ; what remains is the install root. Put that path into INSTALL_DIR below (keep the r"..." raw string form; backslashes need no escaping). Leave it empty to auto-detect the default locations from the table above : import os import sys import maya.cmds as cmds # 1) Custom install directory: change only this line. Give the directory that CONTAINS # the squirrel_asset_manager folder, e.g. r"D:\Tools\SquirrelAM"; empty = auto-detect defaults. INSTALL_DIR = r"" # 2) Build the candidate list: use the given path if set, otherwise auto-detect app_dir = os.path.normpath(cmds.internalVar(userAppDir=True)) local_appdata = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA") or "" if INSTALL_DIR.strip(): candidates = [os.path.normpath(INSTALL_DIR.strip())] else: candidates = [ app_dir, # legacy script install: %MAYA_APP_DIR% os.path.join(app_dir, "scripts"), # even older script install ] if local_appdata: candidates += [ os.path.join(local_appdata, "Squirrel

items.title: Licensing
items.summary: For licensing problems, first check the status and machine code on Settings → License activation , then handle it as not activated, expired, or integrity check
items.text: For licensing problems, first check the status and machine code on Settings → License activation , then handle it as not activated, expired, or integrity check failure. Symptoms The plug-in opens and browses, but import, export, conversion and similar operations are refused. The status shows Not activated (read-only) , Trial ended or Subscription expired . Online activation keeps failing, or the old license stops working after switching machines. The log contains E_LIC_INTEGRITY , E_LIC_MISSING or sq_license 不可用，进入只读模式 (license unavailable, entering read-only mode). Possible causes Cause How to tell Action Not activated yet License activation shows Not activated Enter a key under the machine code, or open the license manager and import a license Trial expired Status shows the trial has ended with 0 days left Purchase or import a full license Subscription expired Status shows grace period or expired Renew, then activate again Machine change or hardware change The machine code and the license binding disagree First run Deactivate this machine on the old machine (limited by the server's daily cap, max 3 per 24 hours), then activate on the new machine; offline-issued licenses cannot be unbound yourself, contact the licensor to reissue Online activation cannot reach the network The dialog reports server unreachable, timeout or DNS failure Check network, proxy and firewall, or use an offline license Installation package was modified Integrity check failure is reported Reinstall the complete package; never delete or edit integrity.json or the _vendor directory Licensing module missing The log says sq_license is unavailable Confirm the package is complete; without it the program can only run read-only Steps Open Settings → License activation and note the current status and machine code. If not activated or the trial expired, enter the key under the machine code and click Activate ; alternatively open License management to activate online. If online activation is unavailable, use Import license file… , or copy the full license text and click Import from clipboard . When switching machines, copy the machine code on the new machine and activate; if the old machine still holds the license, deactivate it first as the vendor requires. On an integrity check failure, reinstall the complete package to restore deleted or modified files. After a successful activation, restart the plug-in window so the feature gates re-read the status. Verify the result The status badge on License activation shows Licensed or Trial , and the previously refused import, export or conversion operations now run. If it still fails Record the status text, error code and machine code and pass them to the plug-in distributor. When online activation fails, try an offline license first to rule out network and proxy factors. If the log shows E_LIC_MISSING , the licensing module did not load; treat it as an installation problem. Never publish full license files, private keys or credentials containing personal information.

items.title: Category tree will not open
items.summary: If the category tree will not open, usually the library root is unreachable, the index cache is incompatible with the current code, or the category metadata is
items.text: If the category tree will not open, usually the library root is unreachable, the index cache is incompatible with the current code, or the category metadata is corrupted. Symptoms The sidebar stays on the loading placeholder, or is simply blank with no sub-libraries or categories. Sub-library nodes exist, but sub-categories are empty, or the custom category disappeared. The category tree does not refresh after switching asset libraries; only restarting the plug-in restores it. The Script Editor shows [MaterialManager] 库路径无效 (invalid library path) or an incompatible index cache message. Possible causes Cause How to tell Action Library root is invalid The path was moved or deleted, or a network drive is not connected Reselect an existing directory in the library list No read permission Opening the library directory is denied, or antivirus blocks it Restore read access and refresh Index cache incompatible with the current version The log says "index cache incompatible, falling back to a full scan" Clear the cache and reload Category metadata corrupted One sub-library or category directory keeps failing to load Back up the library, then rescan it separately or restore from backup Sub-library/category changed in configuration config.json was edited but the UI did not change Re-read the configuration Folders added or renamed by hand were not synced A directory exists on disk but not in the tree Use Sync categories from folder Steps In the library list or settings, confirm the current library root exists, can be opened, and is not a disconnected network drive. In the AI assistant or command surface run library_health with op=status and check library_root , is_loaded , asset_count and category_count . If you suspect the cache, run op=clear_cache , then op=reload , so the plug-in rescans the disk. If you changed sub-library or category configuration, run op=reload_config , then refresh the UI. If you added category folders on disk by hand, use Sync categories from folder to bring them into the tree. After fixing permissions or paths, close and reopen the plug-in window. Verify the result The sidebar shows all sub-libraries and sub-categories, the asset counts match the number of .zasset folders on disk, and the grid refreshes when switching categories. If it still fails Check the [MaterialManager] log in the Script Editor to see whether the problem is the path, permissions, or a specific asset failing to load. Back up the whole asset library before trying library_health op=reload ; never hand-edit or delete category metadata files. If only one sub-library is affected, switch to another library to confirm the plug-in itself is fine, then handle that sub-library separately. Follow 6.3.3 "Library health anomalies" to read the load-failure list, or 6.8.2 "Diagnostic workflow" to collect information for a report.

items.title: Blank thumbnails
synonyms: still the old image after update
items.summary: A blank thumbnail usually means the .sicon is missing or invalid, the render did not actually produce an image, or the grid still caches old pixels. Symptoms Th
items.text: A blank thumbnail usually means the .sicon is missing or invalid, the render did not actually produce an image, or the grid still caches old pixels. Symptoms The asset card shows a gray square, but opening the asset shows its name and category. Only some assets are blank, typically the first one created in a batch, or one whose thumbnail was just updated. Refreshing changes nothing; the new image appears only after closing and reopening the plug-in window. The Script Editor shows [Render] 未找到输出文件 (output file not found) or [Batch] ... 保留占位图 (keeping placeholder). Possible causes Cause How to tell Action Neither render attempt produced an image The log says the thumbnail failed to render twice Use playblast, import an image, or headless generation instead thumb.sicon does not exist The asset directory has no thumb.sicon Capture, import or render it again thumb.sicon is not a valid image The file exists but an image viewer cannot open it Rewrite the thumbnail; .sicon content should be PNG data The old image is still shown Disk already holds the new image but the card shows the old one Refresh the view; reopen the plug-in window to clear the cache if needed Animated image fails to load An .mp4 thumbnail shows a play-icon placeholder Replace it with a still image, or check the video file The renderer produced nothing The render log shows failure or a crash Follow 6.7.3 "Renderer crash" Steps Right-click the asset, open Update thumbnail and try Capture or Import first to confirm the write path works. When a render is needed, prefer Update thumbnail → Background render (headless offscreen), or try Maya playblast first. Check whether thumb.sicon exists in the asset directory and opens in an image viewer. Refresh the current category, or switch to another category and back, so the grid re-reads the thumbnail. If the old image still shows, close and reopen the plug-in window to clear the grid's pixel cache. In batch creation, if only the first asset is gray, generate it again; the program retries a failed thumbnail once by itself. Verify the result The asset card shows a real thumbnail, it persists after reopening the plug-in window, and the log no longer reports "keeping placeholder". If it still fails Test with another asset to tell whether it is one asset or a whole batch. Check the [Render] , [Batch] and [Export] logs in the Script Editor to see whether nothing was rendered or the write failed. Handle renderer-related failures per 6.7.3 "Renderer crash"; check library anomalies per 6.3.3 "Library health anomalies". When reporting, include the thumbnail file name and size in the asset directory plus the relevant log lines.

items.title: Library health anomalies
items.summary: When library health looks wrong, check the four criteria of library_health first: whether it is loaded, asset and category counts, duplicate UUIDs, and the load
items.text: When library health looks wrong, check the four criteria of library_health first: whether it is loaded, asset and category counts, duplicate UUIDs, and the load-failure list. Symptoms The asset total does not match the number of .zasset folders on disk. Assets clearly exist in the library directory but cannot be found in the plug-in grid. Favorites, versions or category references are scrambled and do not recover after a rescan. library_health returns is_loaded false, has_duplicate_uuids true, or load_failure_count greater than 0. Possible causes Cause How to tell Action The library did not load is_loaded is false and the asset count is 0 Check the library path and permissions, then rescan Index cache is stale The category tree or asset count disagrees with disk Clear the cache and reload Duplicate UUIDs has_duplicate_uuids is true Preview, then fix the duplicates and rescan Asset metadata corrupted An entry in load_failures carries a reason Restore from backup, or re-import that asset Configuration disagrees with disk Sub-library or category counts do not line up Re-read the configuration Several people or machines edit the library at once The index lags or entries overwrite each other Keep the index in a local directory and rebuild when necessary Steps Run library_health with op=status and record the library root, whether it is loaded, asset and category counts, duplicate ids and load-failure count. Read the reason of each asset in load_failures to see whether a file is missing, metadata is corrupted, or the version is incompatible. For cache problems run op=clear_cache first, then op=reload , so the plug-in rebuilds the index from disk. For configuration problems run op=reload_config to re-read sub-library and category configuration. For duplicate UUIDs, preview with op=fix_uuids plus dry_run=True before running it for real; a rescan happens automatically afterwards. If one asset's metadata is corrupted, back up that .zasset first, then restore from backup or delete it and import again. Verify the result Running op=status again shows is_loaded true, has_duplicate_uuids false and load_failure_count 0, with the asset count matching disk. If it still fails After fixing duplicate UUIDs, places that stored the old ids (such as favorites) may need rechecking. Back up the whole asset library before going through the failing assets one by one; never bulk-delete library directories. When several machines share a library, put the semantic index in a local directory so index files do not overwrite each other. When reporting, include the status return of library_health , the load-failure list and the most recent rescan log.

items.title: Hollow assets
items.summary: A hollow asset is a .zasset that contains only meta.json and a thumbnail, with formats listing only sicon or aicon and no geometry, material or textures. Sympto
items.text: A hollow asset is a .zasset that contains only meta.json and a thumbnail, with formats listing only sicon or aicon and no geometry, material or textures. Symptoms The asset can be found in the grid, but importing it adds no objects to the scene. Opening the .zasset directory shows only meta.json and thumb.sicon . formats in meta.json lists only sicon / aicon , where it should include ma , mb , zmetal or textures . The asset creation result has status ok, but notes mentions that one format failed to export. Possible causes Cause How to tell Action The scene holds unknown data that blocks saving .ma notes says "this file contains unknown data" Tick .mb , or let the tool fall back automatically A geometry format is ticked but the selected objects have no shape The log says no exportable objects were found Select models with meshes, not empty groups Only textures, or only materials, are ticked All geometry formats are off in the preset Tick at least one geometry format, or confirm the asset type The export error was swallowed by an older build The old build still reports success Upgrade to a build with the geometry self-check and .mb fallback The target directory is not writable The export log shows a permission error Restore directory permissions and export again The asset was damaged by hand Metadata or directory structure is incomplete Delete and recreate it; never assemble a .zasset by hand Steps Open meta.json and confirm whether formats contains the expected formats. Back in Maya, confirm the selected objects really have meshes or materials, not just empty transforms. When recreating the asset, tick at least one geometry format; for material assets also tick the material preset and textures. If notes says .ma failed because of unknown data, tick .mb instead; newer builds fall back automatically when .ma fails. After export, check formats again to confirm the geometry files were really written. Once you confirm it is hollow, back it up, delete the old asset and recreate it with the fixed workflow. Verify the result formats contains geometry, material or texture formats, and importing into the scene produces the matching objects or materials instead of an empty group. If it still fails Retry in a new empty scene containing only the target objects to rule out unknown nodes and third-party plug-ins. Use cmds.unknownPlugin(q=True, list=True) to check whether the scene carries unknown plug-in data. Export with only .mb ticked first to confirm the geometry itself is writable, then add other formats back one at a time. Check with 6.3.3 "Library health anomalies" whether the asset is recorded as a load failure, and report the original notes text.

items.title: Missing textures or dependencies
items.summary: Missing textures or dependencies usually mean files were not collected during packing, or that after import the paths still point at the author's machine or a t
items.text: Missing textures or dependencies usually mean files were not collected during packing, or that after import the paths still point at the author's machine or a temporary directory. Symptoms After import the material turns black or pink, or the viewport shows a checkerboard. A file node's texture path points at a drive letter or author directory that does not exist. Proxies, caches, ABC or USD references are missing and only an empty group remains. Only some textures of one asset are lost while others are fine. Possible causes Cause How to tell Action Associated files were not collected on export textures/ or deps/ is missing from the asset directory Tick collect associated files when exporting Textures originally lived outside the project Paths point at external directories such as X:/Megascans/... Move the source files somewhere reachable and export again A .zasset was copied by hand and is incomplete The directory holds clearly fewer files Delete it and re-obtain it through the library copy/import workflow Relative paths break after import The texture file names exist but the base path is wrong Re-import the asset so paths resolve against the asset directory Proxy type does not match The cache/proxy node type differs from the renderer Confirm the node for V-Ray, Redshift or USD Permission or network drive issue The file exists but cannot be read Restore permissions, or copy the asset to a local drive first Steps Open the .zasset and confirm the files really exist under textures/ and deps/ . On the export side, tick Collect associated files again and confirm the source textures, caches and proxies are accessible. Use a dependency scan to see the missing count and exact paths; fill in the source files before exporting again. Delete the hollow or incomplete asset and import it again from the library; never copy half a directory by hand. For proxy assets, make sure the object is connected to the right node before collecting: V-Ray, Redshift and USD each have their own proxy node type. If paths still point at the author's machine after import, confirm the texture files are inside the asset directory and trigger a path rewrite once more. Verify the result Every file node path in the material exists, the viewport renders correctly, and the dependency scan reports zero missing files. If it still fails Use Maya's File Path Editor to see which textures are still broken, and record the file names and expected directories. If only proxies or caches are missing, confirm the corresponding node really existed at export time instead of an empty group. Locate the problem further with 4.1.12.3 "Dependency scan" and 4.2.7.2 "Missing dependencies". When reporting, include the missing file list, the asset directory structure and the "missing N" line from the export log.

items.title: Unsupported format
items.summary: The plug-in routes files to different importers by extension; when an extension is not in the supported set it is treated as an unknown format and fails immedia
items.text: The plug-in routes files to different importers by extension; when an extension is not in the supported set it is treated as an unknown format and fails immediately. Symptoms Right-click import does nothing, or the log reports an unknown format. A file type is missing from the file chooser, or cannot be imported after selection. Image format conversion reports an unsupported target format. A format checkbox in the export dialog is grayed out, or shows unavailable next to it. Possible causes Cause How to tell Action The extension is not in the supported set explain_format returns importer=unknown Convert to a supported format, or import as an external file Upper case or multiple suffixes The file suffix is not a single dotted extension Rename to a standard extension and retry A Maya-side plug-in is missing The import plug-in that format depends on is not loaded Load the plug-in in the plug-in manager An internal format treated as an external file .zmetal and .zlight are not ordinary external files Import from the asset library, or use the matching conversion tool The external-file import set is narrower The extension is missing from the importable_external group Collect it into the library first, or convert the format The export format plug-in is unavailable The format checkbox is grayed out See 4.3.5.4 "Format unavailable" Steps Run list_supported_formats and confirm which group the extension belongs to: geometry, proxy, volume, texture, HDR, zmetal or zlight. For a single file, run explain_format with the extension and confirm the returned importer is not unknown . Geometry supports ma , mb , fbx , obj , abc , usd , usda , usdc , glb , gltf , dae ; proxies support ass , rs , proxy , vrmesh , vrscene ; volumes support vdb . Textures support png , jpg , jpeg , exr , hdr , tga , tiff , tif , bmp , psd . To collect an external file into the library, first confirm the importable_external group of list_supported_formats contains that extension; if not, convert it first. For formats that depend on a Maya plug-in, load that plug-in in the plug-in manager and retry the import or export. Verify the result explain_format returns a definite importer type (such as geometry , texture , hdri ) and the file imports or converts normally. If it still fails Record the file extension, source software and full error to confirm the file itself is not corrupt. Save the file as a standard format in the target software first, then import it to verify. For export-side problems, check the plug-in and format presets per 4.3.5.4 "Format unavailable". When reporting, include the returns of list_supported_formats and explain_format so it is clear whether the manifest is missing an entry or a plug-in failed to load.

items.title: Semantic search unavailable
items.summary: Semantic search is an optional enhancement. When it is unavailable, search falls back to lexical matching automatically and never stops working entirely. Sympto
items.text: Semantic search is an optional enhancement. When it is unavailable, search falls back to lexical matching automatically and never stops working entirely. Symptoms Search still returns results but matches literally only, so colloquial descriptions miss the target asset. The status shows available=false with a reason such as "no index", "cannot reach Ollama" or "circuit breaker". The first search is noticeably slow and then normal again for a while, or semantic search stays unavailable. The index was built already, but it stopped working after the model changed in settings or environment variables. Possible causes Cause How to tell Action The ai_asset_semantic setting is off ai_asset_semantic is false in app_settings.json , and the reason says it was turned off in settings Set it back to true ( the settings UI has no switch for this ; edit the config file or use the command settings_set ) The asset library index does not exist No .squirrel_ai_index\<official / ollama> or meta.json under the library root Sync or rebuild the asset index Ollama is not installed or not running The status says the service cannot be reached Install and start Ollama The embedding model is not pulled ollama list does not show the model Pull embeddinggemma-2:740m A recent failed call tripped the circuit breaker The status reports a cooldown in seconds Wait for the cooldown, or set the cooldown environment variable to 0 to retry immediately The model from environment variables does not match the index The status reports a model mismatch Remove the environment variable, or rebuild with that model The host lacks numpy A notice says it still works but recall is narrow Install numpy, or accept degraded results The index lives on a shared or synced drive Several machines write the same backend index concurrently Move the index to a local directory (different backends are already split into official / ollama and do not overwrite each other) Steps Open Settings → AI and run an AI dependency check to confirm the state of Ollama and the embedding model. In a terminal run ollama list to confirm the service is running and the model is pulled; if missing, run ollama pull embeddinggemma-2:740m . Confirm the semantic search master switch is not off: it maps to the config key ai_asset_semantic (on by default), and the settings UI currently has no switch for it — edit ~/.squirrel_asset_manager/app_settings.json , or have the AI assistant run settings_set(updates={"ai_asset_semantic": true}) (that command is high risk and asks for confirmation first). The same group also has ai_asset_semantic_sync (on by default; when off, it only builds once if no index exists). When the asset index is missing or damaged, run python tools/asset_index.py --sync ; use --rebuild for a full rebuild. Check whether environment variables such as SQUIRREL_EMBED_MODEL are set; never let the query model differ from the index model. After moving the index to a local disk, reopen the plug-in window so the setting takes effect, then search again. Verify the result asset_semantic_status returns available=true , the match field shows semantic or both , and colloquial queries hit the target asset. If it still fails Use mode=keyword to keep search usable while you investigate the semantic chain separately. Read reason and index_dir from asset_semantic_status to see whether the index, the model or the service is missing. The first query may exceed the 20-second timeout while the model cold-starts; try again afterwards, since queries are much faster once the model stays resident. Continue with 4.5.9.1 "AI unavailable" and 4.8.4.1 "AI dependency check and install".

items.title: Missing model or index
items.summary: The asset library index and the Maya documentation index are two independent datasets; rebuild whichever one is missing. If you switch the embedding model, you
items.text: The asset library index and the Maya documentation index are two independent datasets; rebuild whichever one is missing. If you switch the embedding model, you must rebuild. Symptoms A notice says there is no asset library semantic index yet, or that kb/semantic/meta.json is missing. The index directory exists but is missing vectors.i8 , scales.f32 or meta.json . The status says the index model differs from the expected model, or that the index directory belongs to another asset library. After changing models, search suddenly falls back to lexical matching, or results get clearly worse. Possible causes Cause How to tell Action The asset library index was never built No .squirrel_ai_index\<official / ollama> under the library root Build it on first sync or rebuild Index files are incomplete vectors.i8 or scales.f32 is missing Rebuild the index Model, text template, primary-key scheme or backend changed meta.json disagrees with the current code or backend Full rebuild The index directory points at another library A notice says the index belongs to another asset library Clear the override directory or let it be taken over by a rebuild Ollama does not have that model ollama list does not show the name Pull the model, then rebuild The Maya documentation index is missing No meta.json under kb/semantic/<official / ollama> Rebuild the documentation index The index lives on a network drive Several machines write the same directory on one backend Use a local directory per machine (backends are already separated) Steps Run asset_semantic_status and record dir , model , count , reason and index_dir . When the asset library index is missing, run python tools/asset_index.py --rebuild ; use --sync when you only want to catch up with newly added assets. When the Maya documentation index is missing, run python tools/build_semantic_index.py --model embeddinggemma-2:740m . When the model is not pulled, run ollama pull embeddinggemma-2:740m first, then rebuild. If you set an index root directory, confirm it is on a local disk; each library automatically uses its own subdirectory under that root. When told the index belongs to another library, either clear the directory override and rebuild, or confirm the original library no longer uses it and let the new one take over. Verify the result asset_semantic_status shows an index count greater than 0, model matches the index record, and search no longer reports a missing index. If it still fails Confirm the model name in meta.json exactly matches the pulled model, including the tag. Back up the index directory before deleting it; if a rebuild fails, keep meta.json and the error message. Verify the documentation index with maya_docs(action="status", probe=true) or tools/setup_semantic_env.py --all . Follow 4.5.6.5 "Rebuild and model selection" for the correct procedure after switching models.

items.title: Irrelevant results
items.summary: Irrelevant results usually mean the asset lacks searchable text, the index lags behind, or a strong lexical hit pins another name to first place — not that the
items.text: Irrelevant results usually mean the asset lacks searchable text, the index lags behind, or a strong lexical hit pins another name to first place — not that the model is broken. Symptoms Colloquial descriptions miss the target asset, and the top results are clearly unrelated. Typing the asset name exactly still ranks the target second. An asset whose tags were just added or changed cannot be found. Searching inside one category returns very little, but searching all assets works. Possible causes Cause How to tell Action The asset lacks searchable text No Chinese name, tags, note or AI description Add metadata, then sync The index lags behind the library index_lag above 5 seconds, or a stale notice Run an incremental sync A strong lexical hit pins first place The query happens to match another asset name Use a more precise name or add a category filter The scope is limited to one category Search runs only inside the current category Switch to all assets and search again The index model differs from the query model The status reports a model mismatch Unify the model or rebuild the index The query is too broad or ambiguous One phrase could mean several assets Add qualifiers such as material, style or purpose Steps First type the exact asset name to confirm the target asset itself can be found. Look at the match field of the results: keyword is a lexical hit, semantic a semantic hit, both both. Give the target asset a Chinese name, tags, a note or an AI description; all of these fields enter the indexed text. Run asset_semantic_status to check index_lag ; when the index lags, run python tools/asset_index.py --sync . Switch the search scope back to all assets to rule out filtering by the current category.
